calls.name: Jindal Steel Ltd
calls.gLine: Coal self-sufficiency: 65-70% from own mines (next period)
calls.thesis: Record Q2 gross revenue INR 19,448 crore and 2.38 Mt volume, with net debt/EBITDA down to 1.51x; management reaffirmed the 10.5-11 Mt FY27 volume range but gave no fresh capacity-discipline numbers beyond ramp-up.
calls.top: Blast furnace ramp to 12,000 tpd by Dec

calls.name: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days: below 120 days by end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 standalone revenue INR709 cr (+66% YoY) and EBITDA margin 16.1%, with capacity expansion at Changodar (to 35,000 MVA) due around Diwali, but working capital at 154 days and FY27 guidance held rather than raised.

calls.name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
calls.thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q2 pre-sales INR470 crores (+83% YoY) and H1 EBITDA margin 38.8%, but collections of only INR209 crores against INR879 crores pre-sales (about 24%) keep cash flow weak.

calls.name: Varmora Granito Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year revenue growth: ~15% value, ~10% volume, if exports revive
calls.thesis: Morbi tile maker's Q2 utilisation jumped to 89% (Q1 63%) as ~10-11 PVT/ceramic plants shut and no net capacity added in H1, but management is pricing-led and the export/freight recovery is unproven.

calls.name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: IHCL raised FY27 consolidated revenue growth to 15-17% from 12-14% after H1 growth of about 18%, with standalone EBITDA margin up 400 bps to 38.9%, but the upgrade is demand and rate-led rather than supply-led.

calls.name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd
calls.gLine: Exports FY27: INR600-750 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +61% to INR1,930 cr and EBITDA/wheel INR404 vs INR242, but management attributes part of the gain to raw-material pass-through invoicing, and capex rises to a INR1,400 cr greenfield plus the INR600 cr+ FY27 plan.

calls.name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: IHT/OHT capacity: 15,000 tons within this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA of Rs 105 crore and ~Rs 7,800-8,000/ton, but ~Rs 200/ton was one-time inventory gain; Dadri ramp and mix drive a Rs 7,000-7,500 FY27 guide, with 20% H2 volume growth at risk from wire-rod shortage.
calls.top: Raw material shortage hits October output

calls.name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
calls.thesis: Volume up 10% with price hikes of 12-13% in North/South and Morbi cost squeeze; management held margins near 19% and guided no further price hikes, while Morbi capacity sits 40-50% offline.

calls.name: India Cements Ltd
calls.thesis: Document is an UltraTech Cement Q2 FY27 call transcript filed under India Cements' exchange code, so it does not read on India Cements; UltraTech shows prices up about 5% from Q2 average and utilisation near 71%.

calls.name: JK Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: RMC FY27 top line: Q4 may touch INR100 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Q2 grey volume up ~19% H1 to 11.3 Mt on Central India expansion, but Q2 cost/t rising toward INR2/kcal with INR80-90 hit per quarter in Q3 and Q4; price up ~INR20/bag but INR10-15 more needed.

calls.name: Aurum PropTech Ltd
calls.gLine: Housing.com revenue growth: INR 100-150 crore revenue growth over next 4-6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
calls.thesis: Proptech platform (ex-Housing.com) reports 64% YoY revenue growth to INR 130.2 crore and 29.8% EBITDA margin, but Housing.com breakeven now guided at 12-18 months, a shift from prior 4-6 quarters.

calls.name: Ather Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Installed capacity: 11.4 lakh units annual by Q2 FY28 (Q2 FY28)

calls.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of debt: Rated average debt ~8.18%; refinancing cut ~71 bps on INR 635 cr (post deleveraging)
calls.thesis: Leasing 4.4 mn sq ft in H1 (68% of 6.5 mn FY27 target) and 2.7 mn sq ft completions (~50% of 6 mn) keep guidance on track, but no fresh numbers were given on positive P&L or cost of debt, and the in-city yield target was not repeated.
calls.top: Re-leasing spread 12% on 1.2 mn sq ft

calls.name: WeWork India Management Ltd

calls.name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 27% plus/minus 2% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR696 crore (+22% YoY) and EBITDA margin 27.2%; capacity ramp to INR3,500 crore at full use via TPU line (Q3 FY27) and new SCF line (June 2027), with FY27 margin guide raised to 27% ±2%.

calls.name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt/EBITDA: below 1x by end of March
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes +13.8% vs industry near 10%, with trade prices exiting September ~3% above Q1 average and ~5% higher spot into October; capacity utilisation 71% and sold-out South, supporting a supply-tight pricing read.

calls.name: Aye Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating expense ratio: 8.5% this year; ~8% next year (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Aye Finance Q2 FY27: AUM up 26% YoY to INR7,597 cr, credit cost 3.82% within 3.5-4% guide, NIM 15.6% above 14.25-14.75% band; supply-side metrics (branches flat, opex ratio 8.6%) support margin, but H2 growth depends on festive disbursements and a 3.5% credit cost exit.

calls.name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY29 EBITDA margin: about 30% (FY29)
calls.thesis: Record Q2 FY27 revenue INR2,529 cr (+145% YoY) and 27.1% operational EBITDA margin; FY29 margin target raised to ~30%, but utilisation undisclosed and receivables/working capital drifting up.

calls.name: Bank of Maharashtra
calls.gLine: Credit pipeline disbursal: INR10,000 crores by March '27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Credit grew 23% ex-IBU and GNPA fell 47bp to 1.25%, but ECL front-loading of INR500cr and FCNR(B)/OFCB fund-raising at 6.1–6.5% lift cost of funds risk; drought stress unproven.

calls.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: Apollo brand and roofing growth: 15%-20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volume of 960,000 t was a record, but volume guidance was dropped and EBITDA growth of 20% kept, with Rs 6,000/t EBITDA claimed sustainable on branded and roofing mix while Dubai and SG Premium stay disrupted.

calls.name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY27-end: INR900 crores to INR950 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 NBFC growth story: AUM INR610 crores, H1 PAT INR16.3 crores and FY27 guidance raised, but supply-side evidence absent and capital raise plus acquisitions dominate the call.
calls.top: AUM target raised to INR900-950 crores

calls.name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year revenue growth: outperform; similar to H1 (~27%), no number (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes +26% and consolidated EBITDA +39%, but India EBITDA margin fell 340 bps to 69.5% and management raised FY27 outlook only qualitatively ("similar to H1" ~27% revenue growth) with no hard number.

calls.name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
calls.thesis: Leela posted 30% RevPAR and 36% EBITDA growth in Q2 on pricing power, but supply is pipeline-led (1,000+ keys, Srinagar/Bandhavgarh slipping to end-CY27), with H2 EBITDA guidance held at high-teens.

calls.name: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue CAGR FY28-FY30: 30-35%, reaching INR1,000 crore by FY30 (FY28-FY30)
calls.thesis: Maiden call from a small aluminium precision caster: H1 FY27 revenue INR210 crore (+68%) and EBITDA margin 19%, with 82% utilisation and a new plant that doubles capacity, but guidance is aspirational and unaudited by numbers.

calls.name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q2 FY27 EBITDA of INR9,285 crores at 62% margin, with zinc COP cut to $825–850/t from $975–1,000, but growth capex is small (~INR700 crore in Q2) and the call gave little on supply additions beyond the 250 KTPA expansion due in Q3–Q4.

calls.name: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Energy solutions tie-up: 7,000-8,000 MW over 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Transmission capitalisation still guided at about INR14,000 crore for FY27 despite Gujarat ROW slippage, with INR8,000-9,000 crore needed in H2; Energy Solutions earnings rode merchant spreads that management says it wants to lock into long-term PPAs.

calls.name: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA target: 3% ROA, ~18% ROE (medium term)
calls.thesis: Fedfina Q2 FY27 ROA 2.8% and ROE 17% on a fully secured gold book, but gold yields and Stage II/III are rising amid heightened gold-loan competition, and AUM guidance was held at 20–25% with no revision.

calls.name: Ganesh Benzoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: Chemical PAT FY27: INR20 cr+ (Q1 run-rate continued) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-sale of JNPA/Goa/Cochin liquid tank farms and rail for INR1,154 cr; INR500 cr due Jan-27, ~INR200 cr to buyback/special dividend; chemicals capacity doubling (utilisation 70-80%) and EPC pivot are the new story.
calls.top: Asset sale INR1,154 cr; INR500 cr by Jan-27

calls.name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
calls.gLine: Mid-single-digit SSSG: high single digit minimum (rest of FY27)
calls.thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India West & South) posted 10.1% SSSG and 16% revenue growth on double-digit guest count, with EBITDA margin up 130 bps to 13.1%, but supply-side data is thin: 11 openings and guidance held. Note: company is a QSR operator, so the chemicals subsector tag is a placeholder; see fields.

calls.name: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Raw material basket Q3: +4% to 5% QoQ (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 revenue Rs.4,850 cr (+20% YoY) but EBITDA margin only 7.1% vs 10-11% FY27 guide; RM basket up 9% QoQ after 22% in Q1, with net debt up Rs.751 cr QoQ to Rs.5,696 cr.
calls.top: Net debt up Rs.751 cr QoQ

calls.name: Adani Green Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 power-supply EBITDA up 51% to INR3,835 cr on 20.8 GW, but curtailment from delayed Khavda evacuation lines pushed commissioning of 4.5-5 GW to Q4, a slip of about one quarter.
calls.top: Commissioning slips to Q4 from Q3

calls.name: Adani Total Gas Ltd
calls.gLine: CNG station additions FY27: 80 to 90 stations (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes +12% to 315 MMSCM and EBITDA +12% to INR340 cr, but gas costs up 43% YoY squeezed margin to ~16%; CNG network capacity adds of 80-90 stations this year (vs 68 last year) support volume growth.
calls.top: Gas cost up 43% YoY in Q2

calls.name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% to ₹1,546 crore with EBITDA margin 23% (down 2.3pp YoY) as mix and input inflation weigh; management holds 23–25% margin range but says near-term predictability is difficult.

calls.name: LEAP India Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT FY27: around INR90 crore, 60%-80% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pallet utilisation flat at 89.3% (vs 90–91% guided for Q2) while net pallet adds of 417,000 in H1 keep the pool growing; revenue +22.5% with EBITDA margin 50.8%, but DSO still 122 days and the pooling capex is held near INR450 crore.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: Commercial annual income: Rs 1,500 cr (medium term)
calls.thesis: Residential developer with 78% of inventory sold and net debt zero; Q2 net presales only Rs 298 cr, FY27 presales tracking below last year, with BD guidance reaffirmed at Rs 10,000 cr+ and Niyaara Tower C launch deferred to Q2 FY28.
calls.top: Presales FY27 well below prior year

calls.name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
calls.gLine: Gorakhpur capacity expansion operational: November 2026; 85-90% utilisation by December end (Q3-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 9.64% (from 16.19%) on Gorakhpur shutdowns and coal costs; management expects recovery in H2 as 1.23 mt capacity and TMT prices (+21% YoY) come through, but the Q2 print is weak.

calls.name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
calls.gLine: Marketing spend increase FY27: KFC 50-100 bps; Pizza Hut 100-150 bps (FY27)
calls.thesis: Restaurant operator with no capacity discipline signal: KFC SSSG 14% (near double-digit ex-Navratri) driven by value, marketing up, margins guided to pressure from Q3; Pizza Hut expansion frozen to CY26.

calls.name: Kross Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital cycle: lesser than 90, 95 days; receivable days ~80 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 revenue INR235 cr (+80% YoY) on CV/trailer axle volume (+50-55% YoY) and seamless tube capex ~INR120 cr of INR170 cr done, but margins slipped sequentially on steel and conversion-cost lag.
calls.top: Seamless plant trials pushed to Feb-Mar 2027

calls.name: Manba Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of borrowing reduction: around 25 bps impact in third to fourth quarter (Q3-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 NBFC AUM up 21% YoY to INR1,811 cr with H1 growth only ~5%, GNPA improved to 2.96%; management reiterates 30-35% FY27 AUM growth and cost of funds relief, despite NIM tracking below guidance.

calls.name: Sagility Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin: 25% to 26% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin hit 26.3%, six-quarter high, prompting FY27 margin guide raised to 25–26% from 24–25%; organic growth guide of low double digits held, but OE/AEP revenue seen slightly lower.

calls.name: Waterways Leisure Tourism Ltd
calls.gLine: Sky revenue contribution: from second half FY27; larger benefits building progressively
calls.thesis: Cordelia Sky (2,400 beds) delivered early, lifting capacity ~126%, but H1 EBITDA margin 38% is pressured by fuel per APCD up ~68% (Q2 Rs 2,471 vs Rs 1,434); fleet expansion beyond SUN is only at discussion stage.

calls.name: HFCL Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: at least 80% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 25.89% and revenue Rs2,541.79 crore (+143.6% YoY), with FY27 growth raised to at least 80% from 40%, but capacity-expansion and preform-cost commentary is largely unquantified and management stated no capacity constraint.
calls.top: FY27 revenue growth now at least 80%

calls.name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per MT: 20,000 to 24,000 (INR/MT) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Carbon black utilisation 88% with 70,000 TPA added, but EBITDA/tonne fell to ~21,000 from ~22,800 QoQ; anthraquinone/carbazole Q2 FY27 start slipped to a combined Q4 FY27 commissioning of 5,300 TPA.

calls.name: LMW Ltd
calls.gLine: Machine tool growth: ~50% for current year (FY27)
calls.thesis: LMW's Q2 revenue rose 30% to ₹1,153 crore with TMD utilisation only ~60%, MTD at 75–80%, and management calling the textile cost environment "very tough" with no price pass-through yet.

calls.name: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated volume FY27: ~160,000 tons (vs 133,000 FY26) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity expansion is being added on top of near-full utilisation (Thailand ~100%, Chennai rated 40k t), but margins are flat-to-down and price relief is deferred to the next quarter or two.

calls.name: L&T Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Gold branches: 800 by end FY27; 2,000 long term (FY27 / Lakshya 2031)
calls.thesis: Record PAT ₹975 Cr (+33% YoY) and credit cost down to 2.46%, but rural disbursements were deliberately throttled on drought, and Q2 personal-loan and collection softness is being explained away.

calls.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
calls.thesis: Microfinance lender (not metals; subsector set to Other) with NIM guided up and ROA raised to 5.2-5.8%, but credit cost rising into Q3 from drought and a 50 bps price cut is being passed on.

calls.name: One 97 Communications Ltd
calls.gLine: UPI MDR upside: 2.5 bps on GMV, ~Rs 700 crore at current scale (FY28)
calls.thesis: Paytm Q2 FY27 shows 28% reported growth and MDR-on-UPI upside of about 2.5 bps (~Rs 700 crore on GMV), but the call gave no capacity or supply-side read; the prior LTV/customer-addition guidance was not repeated.

calls.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM: INR 1.2 lakh crore for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager reports H1 FY27 PAT up about 23% to INR 238 crore and record net flows of INR 4,186 crore, but has no capacity or pricing supply signals; AUM guidance trimmed to a 2-3% mark-to-market dependent outlook.

calls.name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd
calls.gLine: Greenfield + Brownfield revenue potential: INR900-1,000 cr combined by 2030-31 (FY31)
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 95% to INR194.5 cr with gross margin 48.3% and order book INR760 cr, but capacity is still ramping: greenfield localized core not yet type-tested and volume growth ~40%.

calls.name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Pirelli offtake volume: 800,000 Pirelli-branded tyres per year by 2030 (ramp from 2027) (CY2030)
calls.thesis: Pirelli offtake of 800,000 car tyres/yr by CY2030 is a conversion-margin contract using existing Bhuj PCR capacity (6,700/day, ~80% kept for BKT); no new capex stated and no margin or revenue numbers given.

calls.name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
calls.thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.19% from 2.40% and GNPA to 1.20% from 1.37%, but no capital-cycle or supply signal; growth is retail-led with AUM up 10.4% QoQ and management pitching margin expansion over ~2 years.

calls.name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross block: more than INR 1,000 crore by FY30 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Crane rental fleet at ~100% utilisation with ~INR 370 crore deployed and INR 95 crore in CWIP, but debtor days drifting up and management pushing a 2030 INR 1,000 crore gross-block target with debt-led funding.
calls.top: Gross block target INR 1,000 cr by FY30

calls.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Naukri sales growth: sales to keep growing higher than 10% YoY; internal target 14-15% billings
calls.thesis: Naukri billings healthy at 13% reported (14-15% underlying per management), 99acres turning cash-positive with 21% billing growth, but CEO Hitesh Oberoi stepping down with no named successor and Shiksha billings down 27%.

calls.name: Sejal Glass Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 consolidated income up 33% to INR139.86 cr with EBITDA margin 18.35%, but Taloja/Erode still near break-even and utilisation levels low; guidance on 25-40% growth held, Q2 guide of INR140-145 cr met at ~INR140 cr.

calls.name: Gravita India Ltd
calls.gLine: Lead volume growth: 18% to 20% CAGR for next three years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volumes up only 3% and lead volumes down ~11% on scrap shortage; copper EBITDA of INR84,671/t is flattered by one-off high-value orders, management guides INR65-70k sustainable, below prior INR55k-to-60k path, and copper utilisation is 50% in H1, short of the 60% target.

calls.name: Punjab & Sind Bank
calls.gLine: Deposit growth: 13% to 14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Advances grew 19.28% to Rs.1,25,919 crore with NIM 2.77% and ROA 0.88%, but CASA slipped to 28.83%, ECL adds ~Rs.700 crore net worth hit, and capital raise of Rs.7,000 crore is pending.

calls.name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Advances growth: 22% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR451 cr profit and 27.25% business growth, but NIM guided down to 4.10% ±5bp and ECL gap of about INR81 cr (INR304 cr held vs INR385 cr needed) keeps the cost of growth rising.

calls.name: Urban Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated NTV growth Q2+Q3 combined: 50% to 55% (Q2 and Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Urban Company's Q2 FY27 shows NTV up 39.1% to ₹1,432.3 crore and loss-making Native and International narrowing, but the ₹2,500 crore fundraise and continued aggressive spending keep losses elevated.

calls.name: Digilogic Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 91% to INR34.96 cr and PAT up 151%, but margin gains are attributed to FD interest income; order book only INR20 cr with H2 back-end loaded and FY27 25-30% growth reaffirmed without a new number.

calls.name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Launch pipeline FY27 ex-Dubai: INR70 billion (FY27)
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with no capacity utilisation or supply-discipline metric; H1 presales +19% YoY, management reiterates 25% FY27 presales guidance on a H2-weighted INR7,000 cr launch pipeline, while BD spend rose to ~INR400 cr in H1.

calls.name: Heritage Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Milk procurement price trajectory Q3: Expected to stay elevated, around 11% YoY, no expected drop
calls.thesis: Heritage Q2 FY27 revenue +19% to INR13,196m and EBITDA margin 5.6% (+98bp QoQ), but raw milk procurement cost +11% YoY with management expecting no relief in Q3 and only ~8% price pass-through.
calls.top: Weighted price hike ~8% vs milk cost +11%

calls.name: Bank of India
calls.gLine: Global deposits growth FY27: 16-17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bank of India guides FY27 advances 15-16% and deposits 16-17%, ROA above 1% by March 2027, and CASA ratio slipped to 34.16%; ECL front-loading from Q3 is the key unquantified risk.

calls.name: DLF Ltd
calls.gLine: Rental exit run-rate (DLF): INR 175-180 crore per quarter at full potential
calls.thesis: Pre-sales of INR 3,800 crore and a INR 15,000 crore unsold inventory base, but reported revenue is held back by completed-contract accounting until FY28 project completions; the INR 738 crore revenue figure was a one-time fair-valuation gain, not operating.

calls.name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
calls.gLine: Aarohan 2.0 direct distribution expansion: 10% year-on-year (next six quarters)
calls.thesis: Consumer hair-oil FMCG with no capacity signal; H1 revenue up 28% to INR674 crore and gross margin fell to 59.9% in Q2, cushioned by cost cuts, with a ~5% price increase planned for Q3.
calls.top: Another ~5% consumer price increase in Q3

calls.name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT positivity for MESPL: next few months and quarters (near term)
calls.thesis: Consolidated gross margin flat YoY at 10.1%; MESPL (Rivigo) turned EBITDA positive at INR2.3 crore, but management pushed contract-logistics 100 bps gross margin target out as medium term with manpower costs not fully passed through.

calls.name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
calls.gLine: Broking revenue growth: 15-20% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Broking-led growth with MTF book at INR14,993m (57% of FY target) and zero MTF NPAs; no supply-side levers, but management guides 15-20% top-line and 20-25% to 30% bottom-line growth.

calls.name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
calls.gLine: Module utilisation: 45% to 60% range
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA Rs557cr at 35.3% margin with cell utilisation 89% but module utilisation only 44%, and a 6 GW integrated expansion (capex ~Rs5,500cr) adds 6 GW of modules and cells through March 2027.

calls.name: Veerhealth Care Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: ~100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small contract personal-care maker targets ₹100 cr FY27 revenue from ~₹25 cr Q1 run-rate, but capacity is 65-75% utilised and funding, customer concentration and receivables are unverified.

calls.name: South Indian Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA medium term: 1.25% to 1.30% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Asset quality at multi-year best (GNPA 1.24%, slippage 0.09%) with NIM rising to 3.33%, but management signals opex growth above guidance and ROA target pushed to 1.20-1.25% within a year.
themes: Segment mix shift retail vs corporate

calls.name: Punjab National Bank
calls.gLine: Domestic NIM FY27 trajectory: further improvement; 7-9bp addition in Q3 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Domestic NIM rose 10bp QoQ to 2.74% and management guides 7-9bp more from repo hike, but credit cost guided 0.25-0.30% after ECL transition needing only ~INR 5,000 crore more; recovery target trimmed to INR 12,000-13,000 crore.

calls.name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: FY27 constant currency revenue growth: 10.5% to 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Firstsource raised FY27 constant-currency revenue floor to 10.5% (from 10%) and reaffirmed 12.25–12.75% EBIT margin; no supply-side or capex signal, growth and margin story is management-led with H2 back-loading.

calls.name: Central Bank of India
calls.gLine: ECL provision requirement: Rs.5,000 to Rs.5,500 crores (Apr 1, 2027)
calls.thesis: Strong Q2 FY27 headline growth (advances +29.8%, deposits +14.4%, NIM 3.01%, ROA 1.03%) but CASA missed guidance at 44.65% and cost-to-income at 58.95% missed sub-56% target; ECL transition adds ₹5,000-5,500 crore hit risk.

calls.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue +18.2% to Rs 2,263 cr with price-led gross margin restoration (~80% of cost increases passed through), but capacity is outsourced and no capex is quantified, so supply-side read is neutral.
calls.top: Price increases ~80% of cost passed on

calls.name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue from projects completing in H2: approx INR200 crores (by 31 March 2027)
calls.thesis: Redevelopment developer reports H1 FY27 revenue INR127.64 cr (+53% YoY) and sales INR202 cr, but H1 operating cash flow was negative (INR16.51 cr) and management gave no capacity or capex metrics.
calls.top: H1 operating cash flow negative INR16.51 cr

calls.name: Swiggy Ltd
calls.gLine: Quick commerce sequential NOV growth: double-digit QoQ (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Swiggy guides Q3 quick-commerce NOV to double-digit QoQ and 100 bps Adjusted EBITDA improvement, while Toing losses are range-bound and food EBITDA holds the 5% GOV path; supply discipline is only partial as store additions track throughput.

calls.name: Chembond Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Q4 sales and profit: Q4 expected to be high sales and profit quarter
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 revenue up 32% to Rs 182.25 cr but material cost jumped to 56% of sales from 46%, cutting PBT margin to 11% from 14%; management gave no timeline for normalisation.

calls.name: Shree Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Tax rate FY27: 31% to 32% (FY27)
calls.thesis: India volume +18% YoY to 9.31 Mt at 56% utilisation, but EBITDA/t fell to INR966 on fuel; capex H2 guided INR700-800 cr versus prior ~INR1,500 cr full year, implying a cut.

calls.name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Elecon H1 FY27 revenue +11% with Q2 EBITDA margin 23.1%, but guidance cut to mid-to-high single/medium double-digit growth for H2 from prior low double-digit, with utilisation ~60% and no capacity-discipline signal.

calls.name: Havells India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 35% with EBITDA up ~30%, but cables contribution margin fell (~15% H1 vs prior-year peak) and Lloyd margins stayed weak; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing of 5–7% more is planned for Q3.

calls.name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 volume up 10-15% but EBITDA up only ~9.5% to INR217cr; management guides 15% volume and similar EBITDA growth, utilisation ~70% consol with FD tighter and FD expansion of ~6,000t under evaluation.

calls.name: Cyient Ltd
calls.gLine: TAO Digital revenue (next 12 months): $100 to $110 million
calls.thesis: DET organic revenue grew only 1.6% QoQ and 0.4% YoY in constant currency, with EBIT margin up to 14.2% on cost cuts; the headline beat leans on TAO Digital M&A and FX.

calls.name: Indian Bank
calls.gLine: Deposit growth: 11-12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 PSU bank call: advances growth raised to 13-14% and deposit guide to 11-12%, but NIM tailwind is modest at 5-6 bps and ECL top-up of Rs.2,500 crore so far with Rs.3,500 crore total expected.

calls.name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
calls.gLine: App go-live: live in Q3, metrics from Q1 FY28 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Paisalo grew AUM 33% and PAT 27% in Q2 with NIM at 5.7% vs ~6% target, cost of funds down to 10%, and management leaning on yield-timing and AI-efficiency explanations; no capacity or industry supply discipline evidence.

calls.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Fifth straight quarter of underwriting improvement: Q2 underwriting profit Rs 99 crore vs loss of Rs 40 crore, CISR 98% (improved 2.9 pts), but no numeric FY27 guidance was repeated and reported growth is inflated by 1/n multi-year accounting.

calls.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 26–27% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bajaj Finance Q2 FY27 is a consumer lender with AUM up 26.5% to ₹5,84,624 crore and 26–27% FY27 growth guided, but credit-cost overlays, gold stage-2 slippage and NIM compression are the watch items; no supply-side discipline evidence.
calls.top: NIM compression 10–12 bps Q1 to Q2

calls.name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
calls.gLine: H2 FY27 revenue vs H1: H2 better than H1, implying higher YoY revenue in H2
calls.thesis: Tata Elxsi Q2 FY27 revenue INR 1055.7 cr (+2.3% cc QoQ) and EBITDA margin 21.9%, but no capacity signal; utilisation ~78% vs 81-82% peak, with management giving no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable blended EBITDA margin: 17%+ at Q2 raw material prices (steady state)
calls.thesis: Pitti reaffirmed FY27 lamination 82,000 t and ~₹370 cr EBITDA on Q2 run-rate, but margins fell ~100 bps to 15.8% and a new ₹450 cr capex (modular, to FY31) was announced, with casting volume guidance left unreconciled.

calls.name: Onward Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 revenue INR170.2 cr (+22.4% YoY) with EBITDA margin 15.6%; FY27 guidance raised to 15–18% growth and 13.8–14.3% margin, but DSO stretched to ~80 days and offshore/US hiring drives the ramp.

calls.name: KEI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EPC EBIT loss: INR 5-7 crores per quarter for next 1-2 quarters (next 1-2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Q2 sales +38.5% to INR 3,776 cr with EBITDA margin 10.62%, while Sanand EHV capacity is still ramping; management reiterated 25%+ growth but the 11% margin guide was softened and an EPC exit is underway.
