calls.thesis: Volume guidance cut to 4-6% from 7-9% and H2 implied growth is steep; EBITDA/ton raised to INR20,000-22,000 despite weak domestic volumes and Chinese 200-series import surge.

calls.name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue grew 10% to Rs 429 crore but paying suppliers fell by 615 to 2.17 lakh on Silver churn, and management gave no churn timeline and a 10-15% hit to enquiries from Google/AI search changes.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
calls.gLine: ESOP cost impact: ₹55–60 crore per year for next 2 years plus ₹14–15 crore per annum from new scheme
calls.thesis: Equity MF AUM ₹2.09 lakh crore (+9% YoY) and flows improving on retention and ETF growth (+42%), but employee cost step-up and ESOP ramp (₹55–60 cr/yr) pressure margins; prior yield guidance held.

calls.name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Veefin's H1 FY27 revenue rose 116% to Rs 238.8 cr, but DSO was 88 days and operating cash flow was negative, with no supply-side capacity data to judge the business by.
calls.top: Negative operating cash flow in H1

calls.name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
calls.thesis: Broking-platform read: Cost to Serve rose on AI compute and a one-time INR10-13 crore hit while Cost to Grow fell on IPL timing; no hard numbers on guidance, and CAS outcome is the swing factor for volumes.
calls.top: MTF haircuts raised to 80% on crowded stocks

calls.name: Jindal Saw Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volumes: Higher than FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR265 crore (from INR341 crore in Q1) on MENA delays and low-margin water mix; management expects H2 better than H1 and margins to recover from Q3, without quantified guidance.

calls.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Nagarro one-time expenses: approximately $50 million over three to four quarters (3-4 quarters)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue USD 487.6m (+7.8% QoQ cc) but EBIT margin slipped to 15% with utilisation down to 85.8%; Nagarro deal adds ~USD 50m one-offs and debt, and the supply-side read is hiring ahead of ramp-ups rather than discipline.

calls.name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
calls.thesis: Life insurer H1 VNB up 22.3% to ₹12.83bn with margin 26.0% driven by protection mix, but management flagged a consultation paper threatening credit-life and renewal-commission economics and gave no growth guidance.

calls.name: D. B. Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Newsprint cost Q3-Q4: prices down 2-3% (Q3-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue fell to INR614 cr (from 635) on festive shift and 21% newsprint cost hike; management guides only qualitatively, circulation flat at ~38 lakh with no cover-price hikes, and a capex-light cash pile of ~INR1,120 cr.

calls.name: Music Broadcast Ltd
calls.thesis: Radio revenue flat-to-down with cost cuts driving profit: Q2 revenue INR41 crores (+8% YoY, -8% QoQ), expenses down ~20% YoY; no supply-side or capacity signals, and management declined to guide beyond the current quarter.

calls.name: CSB Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of funds: around 6% next financial year (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 ROA rose to 1.29% and NIM to 3.81%, but management trimmed the FY27 ROA ambition to 1.30-1.50% and gold share guidance to ~50%, with fee-income pressure from draft IRDAI rules.

calls.name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross credit cost FY27: around 6% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Credit cards: gross credit cost fell to 5.6% (down 98bps QoQ) but management guided ~6% for FY27, NIM to be range-bound as CoF rises, and receivables growth only expected from Q3.

calls.name: Metro Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Staff cost: front-end staff cost increase 0.5% to 1% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Metro Brands Q2 FY27 revenue grew 12% with EBITDA margin up to 27.1% and gross margin up, but PAT margin flat at 10.6%; store net adds slowed to 34 opened and 13 closed in H1 on rentals and BIS supply gaps.
calls.top: Inventory normalisation pushed to mid-to-end FY28

calls.name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 turnover: Rs225-230cr (FY28)
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 turnover up 74% to Rs70.06cr and PAT up 29% to Rs9.71cr, but margins fell below guidance on paper costs; management reiterated FY27 Rs150cr±10% and 14-16% PAT with paper 90% pre-bought.

calls.name: Sumitomo Chemical India Ltd
calls.gLine: Inventory: normalise through second half (H2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR907 crore (-2% YoY), volumes down high single digit and EBITDA margin 20.5%; inventory days rose to 115 from 95, with parent-export destocking and no new capacity approved for global supply.

calls.name: Rallis India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 EBITDA fell 18% to ₹126 cr on flat revenue of ₹858 cr; price up 5% offset by volume down, with kharif destocking and seeds volumes down 26% weighing on the quarter.

calls.name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR1,527 crores with H1 down 11% on international lull; order book INR12,481 crores, but FY27 guidance trimmed in practice to "around 10%" from 10-15% and domestic awards stalled by ALMM-II and PPA delays.

calls.name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
calls.thesis: SAIL Q2 FY27 volumes up 5% YoY and EBITDA up to INR4,561 crore with inventory down to 15 days, but FY27 volume guidance cut to ~21 Mt from 22 Mt and iron ore sales target trimmed to 7-8 Mt.

calls.name: Castrol India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q3 EBITDA margin fell to about 15% (9M about 21%) as raw material costs rose 60-plus%; management withdrew explicit quarterly guidance and says volatility will keep margins outside the 21-24% band in the short to medium term.

calls.name: Permanent Magnets Ltd
calls.gLine: Alloys FY28 revenue: INR70-80 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q2 revenue INR72.5cr (+49% YoY) and 25% EBITDA margin on EV recovery, but alloys furnace teething, relay and Quantum commercial ramp pushed to FY28, and FY27 guidance trimmed.

calls.name: Shriram Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Shriram Finance Q2 FY27: NIM 9.52% and PAT up 59% on excess-liquidity tailwind, but gross Stage 3 rose to 4.65% and credit cost to 2.03%; AUM growth guide trimmed to 15–17% from 18%.

calls.name: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 consol revenue up 31% to INR157cr with 18.8% EBITDA margin; capacity additions are slow (India ~185k tpa, 235k target at risk as Saudi delayed), FY27 guidance held at INR700cr revenue, INR126cr EBITDA, INR70cr PAT.

calls.name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 shows volume growth (23,865 pumps, +7% YoY) but no pricing recovery: raw material up ~3% QoQ, pump capacity utilisation ~68%, and margin guidance deferred to KUSUM 2.0 approval.

calls.name: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Shell egg (branded) growth: 5 lakh eggs a day in two to three years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Egg processor guides to flat ~700/kg realisation and "100 plus" crore profit for the year, but gives no quarterly numbers; H1 PAT flat at ~40 crore, with feed costs squeezing Q2 EBITDA to 28 crore from 38 crore.

calls.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 CC revenue +0.5% QoQ with margin flat at 24% as subcontracting and bench build absorb AI-era investment; no numeric guidance, management only says it will "inch up" margins, with MHP ~50bps headwind.
calls.top: Subcon and bench build ahead of demand

calls.name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
calls.thesis: Discount broker reports soft Q2 with net profit INR 7.1 crore, lower than Q1, as it keeps spending on technology and brands; no numeric revenue-growth acceleration given, and the prior "growth to accelerate" claim is not repeated.
calls.top: Trading activity slower; ADTO INR 2.59 trillion

calls.name: Rossari Biotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 698 crore (+19% YoY) and EBITDA margin 12.5%, but management cut its FY27 growth guide to mid-teens to high-teens and EBITDA to ~12%, and utilisation is only ~60% blended.

calls.name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 record revenue INR 803 cr (+53%) mostly acquired via Bluetile; organic gaming +11% with NODWIN flat H1 and no segment guidance, so supply-side read is neutral with weak organic visibility.

calls.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR4,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: AI server OEM posted Q2 revenue of INR1,323 crore (+335.7% YoY) with 14.9% EBITDA margin, but inventory days of 117 and a stated intent to hold stock for the INR2,629 crore order book keep working capital stretched.

calls.name: Raymond Realty Ltd
calls.thesis: Presales nearly doubled in Q2 with no new launches, but EBITDA margin only 15% vs 17-19% FY guide, and debt rising to ~INR1,200 crore to fund JDA-led growth; guidance held with no revenue number.

calls.name: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR 738 crores with AOV-led growth (~29pts); no store-count or A&P-floor reaffirmation, and A&P guided down to ~4.5% over four years.

calls.name: Aptus Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Geographic coverage: 46% of India by March 2027
calls.thesis: Asset-light marketing-led formulator with H1 FY27 revenue Rs 48.90 cr (vs 14.38 cr), but no numeric guidance, receivables of Rs 28.64 cr against Rs 16.25 cr inventory, and no capacity data to read supply discipline.

calls.name: Piramal Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail opex to AUM: further 30-35bp reduction over next 6 quarters (6 quarters)
calls.thesis: Growth RoAUM 2.0% in Q2 (up from 1.7%) with 2.5% exit-Q4 target reaffirmed; but FY28 insurance commission cap is an 18-24bp headwind and management has stopped short of FY28 guidance.

calls.name: Aequs Ltd
calls.thesis: Consumer EBITDA breakeven (Q4 FY27) dropped and capex cut to ~INR160 crore H1 vs INR660 crore guide; aerospace on track but H1 aero EBITDA grew 29% vs 42% revenue, consumer segment EBITDA loss INR763m H1.

calls.name: E2E Networks Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue INR2,238m (+43% QoQ) on Blackwell B200 contribution, but management gave no numbers on utilisation, contracted mix, or next GPU capex, so supply-side read is thin.

calls.name: Ksolves India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 return to growth: return to growth in FY28; ~20% growth hoped for but conditional (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue fell 4.7% YoY to INR 37.8 cr on two enterprise ramp-downs; management now says FY27 will trail last year and has dropped the 4-5% growth guide, while EBITDA margin held at 25.7% and is guided within 25-30%.

calls.name: Infosys Ltd
calls.thesis: Infosys cut FY27 CC revenue growth guidance to 1%-2% from 1.5%-3% on pricing pressure and weak volumes; margin guidance held at 20%-22% despite AI productivity pass-through.

calls.name: Uflex Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: ~35% YoY (also 30%+) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 92% to Rs 9,198m on West Asia-driven price hikes (BOPET up 30-35%) and overseas mix; management guides ~35% FY27 growth but volume up only 1.7%, with new capacity ramping slowly.

calls.name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue: cross INR6,000 cr, possibly earlier (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 24.5% to INR1,528 cr and adj. EBITDA margin 10.7% (+140 bps) on volume and mix; capacity adds lag, India utilisation only 65–70%, and margin is seasonal-mix led.

calls.name: Juniper Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 run-rate EBITDA: close to INR 4,500 crores on ~6 GW (FY28)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with 601 MW commissioned and CUF 30.2%, but no capacity cuts or utilisation tailwind; the story is contracted build-out and a BESS-led pivot, with tariffs and EBITDA guidance that depend on execution.

calls.name: Aegis Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Distribution volume: crossing 1 million tonnes this year; ~1.5 million next year (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 EBITDA of INR727 crores (+184% YoY) driven by LPG distribution margins of ~INR7,000/t and volumes +91%; supply additions are large but margin durability rests on management's assertion, not disclosed data.

calls.name: Neogen Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue FY27: INR 950-1,050 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR 250 crore with EBITDA margin 19.3%; organo-lithium at full utilisation and standalone FY27 guidance raised to INR 950-1,050 crore, but battery revenue (INR 300 crore) rests on a Q3-Q4 customer shift not yet visible.

calls.name: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Xanthine FY27 revenue: INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Xanthine-led Q1 FY27 revenue up 42% to INR535 cr with spot pricing lifted by China rebate removal and raw-material spike, but management itself expects realisations to fall and Xanthine FY27 sales of INR900-1,000 cr.
calls.top: Realisation per kg to decline in Q2

calls.name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR4,300-4,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR690cr (+129% YoY) and EBITDA margin 12.3%, with management guiding FY27 revenue INR4,300-4,500cr and six-line CCV/MV capacity build; QIP-funded ramp is unproven versus a 34% cable utilisation base.

calls.name: Menon Bearings Ltd
calls.gLine: Alkop revenue: INR100 crore FY27, INR125 crore FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record quarter (consolidated sales INR91.79 cr, +36.57% YoY, PAT +67%) with management pointing to INR360 cr FY27 as conservative; capex is small modular top-up (INR9-10 cr bi-metal) with capacity headroom claimed, but no quantified guidance beyond management claims.

calls.name: Shanti Gold International Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (underlying): 7.5-8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 144.7% to INR716 cr with EBITDA margin 9.97% flattered by ~2-2.5pt inventory gain; management guides 7.5-8% underlying, 50-60% value and 30-40% volume growth, with rights issue and debt-funded working capital build.

calls.name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
calls.gLine: Exports monthly run-rate: beyond 250,000 per month (Q2 FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with EBITDA INR3,596 crore (20.9% margin) despite ~4.5% of revenue commodity inflation; capacity is now the binding constraint, with expansion from 7 to 9 million units announced.

calls.name: Kross Ltd
calls.gLine: Export growth FY27: 40-45% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32% to INR184.3 cr with EBITDA margin 12.23% (+63 bps); steel and conversion pass-through lags, trailer axle price up 3-5% from April, plus 1-2% more planned.

calls.name: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR4,490m (+37% YoY) and EBITDA INR1,233m (+39% YoY) on semaglutide and DDC; management reiterates FY28 $400m revenue and 40% margin, with new cartridge line adding sterile capacity, though utilisation is claimed full with no quantified figures.
calls.top: Second cartridge line commissioning this quarter

calls.name: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR 550-600 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flexible-office operator growing revenue 44% to INR 546 cr with 92% mature committed occupancy, but a fresh capex wave (INR 550-600 cr FY27 guide) and falling retention (74%) temper the supply-side read.
calls.top: FY27 capex INR 550-600 cr vs FY26 388 cr

calls.name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 collections: ~INR1,000 crore
calls.thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q1 pre-sales INR409 crore (+567% YoY) and PAT margin 34.5%, but the quarter's sales are largely from FY26 launches and FY27 guidance of INR1,800-2,000 crore pre-sales is reiterated without new supply-side data.

calls.name: Dhoot Transmission Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25%-30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth near 50% YoY with EBITDA margin up 110bp to 15%, but management guides 15-16% margin only as copper pass-through lags; no capacity-discipline signal beyond 15-20% expansion at two plants.

calls.name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,550-1,650 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR90.3 cr (20.8% margin) was flattered by ~INR25 cr inventory gain in a price spike; management guides FY27 adjusted EBITDA INR240-250 cr ex-gain, with Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 cr adding ~60,000 t.
calls.top: Q1 INR25 cr inventory gain flatters EBITDA

calls.name: Finolex Cables Ltd
calls.gLine: Fibre draw capacity: 8 million km by September (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR 2,013 cr with PBT margin 13.4%, but comms-cable margin near 30% is inventory-driven and expected to normalise; fibre draw capacity doubling 4→8 mn km by September is a real supply addition.

calls.name: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper EBITDA per ton before value addition: above INR40,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Copper cathode capex (INR200cr, 36kt) is the supply-side story: 18kt phase due Dec 2026, but lead volumes fell on shipping disruption while lead EBITDA/t hit a record INR21,595 on 85% value-added mix.

calls.name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt-to-equity: 0.5-0.6x ceiling; net debt INR 75-80 cr by FY27 end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light materials and DaaS platform grew revenue 37% YoY to INR 291 cr with EBITDA margin 10.49%, but supply evidence is thin: contract manufacturing utilisation 65-70% and capacity recycling of deposits to ~11 MT.

calls.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
calls.gLine: Leasing FY27: 6.5 mn sq ft (FY27)
calls.thesis: Industrial REIT-style platform with 29.5 mn sq ft operational, Q1 revenue INR200 cr (+23%) and 12% re-leasing spreads, but reported net loss of INR12 cr and no capacity-discipline evidence; supply is self-driven expansion, not industry-wide.

calls.name: GEE Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: INR 1,000 cr by FY29-30 (FY2029-30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY to INR 103 cr and EBITDA margin 7.8% (from 5.7%), but growth rests on a 71,000 MT wire capacity plan and an unquantified INR 1,000 cr target with no prior guidance to test against.

calls.name: Eicher Motors Ltd
calls.gLine: Royal Enfield capacity: 2.45 million units/yr by FY30 (Cheyyar brownfield to 2 million; Tada phase 1 adds 4.5 lakh) (FY30)
calls.thesis: Royal Enfield record Q1 volume of 332,940 (+27% YoY) with 1.5m/yr base capacity and Tada greenfield adding 4.5 lakh units by FY30, but dealer inventory is lean at 10-12 days and commodity costs hit gross margin by 4-4.5%.

calls.name: GRP Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: close to 20%-plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 60% to INR174m with margin 11% (+233bp) on reclaim volumes +12% and price pass-through; Pyrova still sub-scale, rCB commissioning targeted October 2026 with 18–20% margin only after maturity.

calls.name: Batliboi Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth: around 10% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR125 cr (up 80% YoY) with EBITDA margin near 4-6% and PAT INR0.49 cr; backlog INR618 cr and inflow INR283 cr, but no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence and management guides ~10% growth.

calls.name: Carysil Ltd
calls.gLine: Stainless steel capacity addition: 150,000 units by March 2027 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 27% to INR56 cr at 21.2% margin on volume and mix; capacity at 88% (quartz) and 94% (SS) with 250k quartz expansion due by FY27 end, but logistics delays shifted some dispatches into Q2.

calls.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days FY27 end: ~100 days
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR360.7 cr (+130% YoY) at 23.5% EBITDA margin; management reiterates FY27 ~80% growth at 24% margin and expands fuel-cell capacity, but capex (~INR500 cr) is now partly debt-funded and the call is heavy on unquantified claims.
calls.top: Order book INR5,143 cr at quarter end

calls.name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: PCB project commercial production: by April 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 1,604 cr (+67% YoY) and PAT +112%, but working capital days rose 63 to 71 on strategic inventory build amid supply-chain constraints; capacity utilisation 65-70%, so supply discipline is not the story.

calls.name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS commissioning: >10 GWh by FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR954 crore (+63% YoY) on CUF 30.9% and BESS (INR226 crore); 3.62 GWh commissioned, management guides 10 GWh by FY27 and ~INR1,400 crore BESS short-term revenue locked in.

calls.name: Indiqube Spaces Ltd
calls.gLine: VAS share of revenue: rise by 2% to 4% from 17% (over time)
calls.thesis: Flex-space operator adds 1.91 mn sq ft AUM in the year but rent-paying area flat QoQ; management reiterates ~2 mn sq ft/yr, with 3.9 mn sq ft signed headroom and 90% renewals.

calls.name: Studds Accessories Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin Q2 FY27: 14% to 15% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin hit from styrene spike (INR135 to ~INR225 peak) is being passed through with 9% price hike, with EBITDA guided back to 14-15% in Q2 and 18-20% by Q4 FY27 if raw materials hold; utilisation 81% and 1.5m helmet capacity from October.

calls.name: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: in line with blended 3-year growth (~27% CAGR cited) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% to INR118 crores, but EBITDA margin fell to 22% from 25.3%; management guides growth in line with the 3-year blend and ~INR500 crores of capacity coming online by Q3 FY28, with utilisation at about 80%.

calls.name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 30.3% on revenue of INR633 crore (+28% YoY) with mix-led gains; management reaffirmed FY27 INR2,500 crore revenue and 25% ±2% margin, with capacity additions in H1 FY28 rather than near term.

calls.name: HEG Advanced Materials Ltd
calls.gLine: Anode (TACC) first-year revenue: INR600–700 crores at 40–50% utilisation from Q1 FY28
calls.thesis: Graphite electrode pricing turning up: peers announced $600–1,200/t hikes and HEG is booked through September, but utilisation is capped near 90–95% with no new capacity beyond 115kt until early 2028.

calls.name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27 (next two years): 10% to 15% volume growth (next two years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was mostly price-led: API realisations up ~16-17% YoY while volumes rose only ~3.5%, with management admitting demand fell as buyers held stock, and Sayakha utilisation reached ~65%.

calls.name: Confidence Petroleum India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue, PAT and EBITDA growth: 10% to 15% QoQ (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,408 cr (+117% YoY) and PAT ~INR62.6 cr driven by LPG volume and price; management gives no margin or capex numbers, and guides only 10-15% QoQ growth.

calls.name: India Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Grey cement volume growth FY27: Double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: UltraTech Q1 FY27 volumes +13.1% at 81% utilisation with per-ton EBITDA held above INR1,200, but Q2 cost pressure of INR130-140/t and India Cements integration are the key watch items.

calls.name: Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Barrel inventory by March 2027: 1,00,000 barrels, now 1,15,000 to 1,20,000 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18% to Rs270.5cr with branded alco-bev up 47% to Rs82.3cr; capacity ramp (Indri ~60%, Chhattisgarh ~50% by year-end) is supply-led growth, but margin guidance is held, not raised, and H1 margin dipped on costs.

calls.name: Granules India Ltd
calls.gLine: Genome Valley utilisation: above 50% by year-end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% to INR1,477 crore with EBITDA margin 22.9%, but capex moderated to INR89 crore after Genome Valley completion and Gagillapur remains the sole site without a clean EIR, capping new launches.

calls.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (medium term): 32%-33%, plus/minus 1% (next 1-2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR1,045 cr and EBITDA margin 34.2%, but supply-side read is mixed: HFC 15,000 t capacity on track for Q3 FY27, CDMO Phase 2 capex INR125 cr, and management guides margin 32-33% ±1%.
calls.top: New capex INR90 cr advanced materials

calls.name: Electronics Mart India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39% to INR 2,419 cr and EBITDA margin 9.9%, but much of the lift is a weak-base summer and temporary chip-price gains; FY27 guided at 18-20% revenue growth and post-Ind AS EBITDA margin 7.5-8%.

calls.name: GHCL Textiles Ltd
calls.gLine: Normalised EBITDA margin (current year): 14-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17% on inventory-aided spreads (~Rs155/kg vs Rs138 in Q4); management guides normalised 14-15% and says Q2 spreads slightly lower than Q1, with 98% spinning utilisation and no new yarn capacity beyond knitting.

calls.name: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR200-250 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue +37% to INR509 cr and 86% utilisation with 10,000-machine expansion due September, but Huron revenue recognition switched to delivery-based, cutting consolidated EBITDA margin to 23.4% adjusted.
calls.top: Export licence delays hold Huron revenue

calls.name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Other expenses FY27: ~INR400 cr, ~3% of sales (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% to INR2,413 cr and EBITDA margin 8%, but gross margin flat YoY on reported basis and growth is retail/SSSG and bullion-led, with capacity expansion (25 stores) and no capex-discipline signal; supply-side read is neutral.

calls.name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 price increase for the year: around 25%
calls.thesis: CP PLUS-led Q1 FY27 revenue of INR1,402 crores (+89.5% YoY) with EBITDA margin 14.8%; capacity ~2.5 million units/month at 85-90% utilisation, with capex to roughly double capacity over three years, but price pass-through of 10-20% is the main margin driver.

calls.name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Data-centre order in Q2: At least one turnkey PEB order
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~25% to INR366 cr, order book INR1,380 cr; EBITDA margin fell ~100 bps to 9.4% on steel costs, with management guiding FY27 EBITDA margin 10.5% and FY27 revenue INR1,900-1,950 cr.

calls.name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 reported EBITDA: minimum INR3,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 68-74% to ~INR462-494 crore with 500 MW commissioned and FY28 minimum EBITDA guidance of INR3,000 crore, but CTU curtailment of ~70% persists through FY27.

calls.name: E2E Networks Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,568m (+334% YoY, +64% QoQ) on 1,024 B200 going live and near-full utilisation; capacity-led, but no guidance, and management pushed back on MRR, customer mix and loan quantum.

calls.name: LEAP India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth YoY: 20%+ (FY27 and long term)
calls.thesis: Pallet pooling leader LEAP grows revenue 19% and EBITDA 21% in Q1 FY27 while trimming asset capex to INR76 crore from INR110 crore, with utilisation up to 89.2% and no new capacity push.

calls.name: SPML Infra Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS revenue FY27: INR200-300 crore (FY27 (Q4))
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 74% YoY to INR286 crore with EBITDA margin ~10%, but order intake of INR1,293 crore is thin against a >INR5,000 crore FY27 target and BESS revenue depends on NTPC design approval by December.

calls.name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin target: 30% in 2-3 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator (asset-light, leased) reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 91 cr and EBITDA up 36% to Rs 25 cr; no supply discipline data, capex limited, pipeline ~400 keys in 12-15 months.

calls.name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Phase-2 to 66,000 MT: by September 2027 (Sep 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19% to Rs 666 cr with ~25% EBITDA margin claimed, but Phase-1 capacity slipped to September 2026 and gross margin fell ~650bps; capex Rs 850-900 cr over three years.

calls.name: Sterling Tools Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone fasteners FY27 margin: Hold margin structures on full-year basis
calls.thesis: Standalone fasteners at 90–95% utilisation with ₹88 cr capex mostly in H2 FY27, steel pass-through pending; SEM and STML loss-making with breakeven targeted FY28 at ~₹225–250 cr combined revenue.

calls.name: Alicon Castalloy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth (underlying, ex-material): 12% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Alicon's Q1 FY27 revenue crossed Rs 500 crore with 9.5% EBITDA margin (vs 11.4% last year) as aluminium pass-through lags; management guides 12-15% growth and +1% margin, while capacity is ~90-100% utilised and new Rs 125 crore plant adds ~Rs 500 crore revenue by FY30-31.

calls.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Alumina sales volume FY27: 1.6 million tonnes (FY27)
calls.thesis: NALCO Q1 FY27 volumes at record and alumina realisation near $323 with Q2 guided ~$370, but input costs up INR15,000-16,000/t on metal and capex ramps to ~INR2,500 crore next year on a 1 Mt refinery and smelter expansion.

calls.name: Sobha Ltd
calls.gLine: Land payments FY27: INR1,500-1,600 cr if deals close (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 presales of INR3,656 cr (+76% YoY) and 9.7% EBITDA with guidance for 17-20% by Q4, but collections lagged and launch-driven demand is the story, not supply discipline.

calls.name: Allcargo Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex plan: close to INR400 crores over Plan 2030; ~INR100 crores in FY27 (FY27-FY30)
calls.thesis: Container terminal (CFS) operator: Q1 FY27 volumes +7.2% to 1,76,499 TEUs, EBITDA/TEU guided to stay INR2,400-2,500 as capacity rises ~20% to 1.03m TEU, with ~INR400cr capex plan funded partly by equity.

calls.name: Concord Biotech Ltd
calls.gLine: API revenue FY31 scale: INR2,200-2,300 crores in 5-6 years (5-6 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR257cr (+26%) with API +42% and EBITDA margin 32%, but no capacity addition; Unit 3 utilisation ~55% and Unit 2 ~25% leave ample spare capacity, so supply discipline is intact and growth is partly FY26 spillover.

calls.name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Optimal skid utilisation: ~80% in FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 72% to INR146cr with SFN data-centre skids 23% of sales, but skid capacity expansion to 15,000 is dependent on machine suppliers and Q3 timing, and margin fell sequentially to ~23%.

calls.name: Standard Engineering Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Core engineering revenue FY27: ~INR1,200 crores, 40-50% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 with revenue up 41% and EBITDA margin 17.5%, but the story is pivoting to unproven AI data-centre and GL Hakko ventures; core order book INR1,400 crores with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.

calls.name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term ROE and EBITDA margin: 20% ROE, 5.5-6% EBITDA margin, pulled to FY29 (FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 organic-plus-STEAG growth looks solid, but the story is acquisition-led: FY27 guidance of INR4,700 crore revenue and INR200 crore EBITDA hinges on STEAG, foundit burn of INR30-35 crore and rising working-capital days toward 45.

calls.name: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 49% to INR 733 cr with pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin 7.5% (+273 bps); supply-side discipline is not evidenced, and management is guiding ~20% store CAGR with no capex or capacity figures.

calls.name: Pace Digitek Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA/PAT margin BESS: PAT 10.5%-11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: BESS capacity doubles to 10 GWh by December while bidding discipline reportedly returns; FY27 revenue guidance Rs 3,200-3,400 crore held, but Q1 revenue of Rs 555 crore needs ~Rs 2,700 crore in remaining quarters and operating cash flow remains negative.

calls.name: LG Electronics India Ltd
calls.gLine: Export growth FY27: Qualitative: significantly increase exports, no number (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15.5% to INR72.33bn with EBITDA margin 12.5% (+110bps YoY); supply-side evidence is mostly capex deployment at Sri City (INR5.88bn of INR7.36bn), with no capacity cut or deferral.
calls.top: Sri City capex INR5.88bn in Q1

calls.name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 13,457m and EBITDA margin 18.9%, but supply-side evidence is mostly capacity additions (3.5GW panels, 4GW power electronics) with utilisation of new Ratlam plant only 40-50% and a Rs 1,436m fire loss.

calls.name: KSH International Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days: 30-35 net days achievable over multiple quarters (multi-quarter)
calls.thesis: Winding-wire maker KSH is running at 73.5% utilisation on 43,445 MT, with EBITDA/ton at ~INR93,000 vs INR74,000 in Q4; management guides only to a comfortable ~INR75,000 and Phase 2 adds ~16,000 MT by March 2027.

calls.name: Msafe Equipments Ltd
calls.thesis: Msafe's Q1 FY27 PAT rose 44% to ₹7.27 cr on rental-led growth, but the transcript is heavily garbled and capacity additions (Mathura plant targeted May 2027, Delhi premises) are delayed and not yet producing.

calls.name: Susan Electricals India Ltd
calls.gLine: HT & MVCC share of revenue: ~15% by year-end, ~50% by end FY27 (inconsistent) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 279% to ₹95.36 Cr with PAT ₹6.39 Cr, but the transcript is internally inconsistent on HT/MVCC share (5-10% vs 10-15% vs ~50% target) and product margins, and capex is only ₹15-20 Cr against a claimed 60% capacity add.

calls.name: SKF India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: close to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% YoY on 22% volume growth, but QoQ volumes fell 6.3%; capacity near 93% loaded with ~INR500 cr capex mostly landing FY28, and revenue growth guided to ~20%.

calls.name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 operating EBITDA of INR845 crore (26% margin) on TAN and ammonia price strength; two new capacities (Gopalpur TAN, Dahej nitric acid) due to start in Q2 FY27, within approved capex of INR3,850 crore spent.

calls.name: Cosmo First Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated topline growth FY27: about 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 26% to Rs 147 cr on 9% volume, but margin fell to 12.6% from 14.5% as pass-through inflated revenue; BOPET margin Rs 9/kg vs Rs 13 a year ago, with ~15% film capacity still unsold.
calls.top: BOPET margin Rs 9/kg vs Rs 13 a year ago

calls.name: Simplex Castings Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: at least 80% by end of FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to ₹60.95 cr with EBITDA margin 18.89%, but utilisation is only 50-60% and management guides to 80% only by FY28 end, with working capital days still ~100-120.
calls.top: Near-term order book ~₹150 cr+ vs ₹80-100 cr

calls.name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental top line from announced capex: about 600 crores (2027)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 22.3% on 526 crore revenue, but management says volumes fell 10-12% on export disruption and calls the margin a timing-aided blip; 15-16% is the average view.

calls.name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Grey cement volume growth FY27: double-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 13.1% at 81% utilisation on a 200 MT base, but West Asia fuel and packing cost shock weighs; management guides Q2 cost up INR130-140/t and targets double-digit FY27 volume growth.

calls.name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended power cost per unit: about INR5.50 (After full solar capacity)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin 17.78% (up 376 bps YoY) on yarn realisations; spinning at 98% utilisation, spreads ~INR130/kg vs ~INR110, with 35 mn m fabric and 74k spindles adding ~INR1,000 cr turnover by FY28.

calls.name: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue +57% to INR237 cr and EBITDA margin 8.8%, but consolidated EBITDA still a INR22 cr loss; capacity expansion is real but Tritium turnaround and Gurgaon-to-Hyderabad transition keep working capital and fixed costs elevated.

calls.name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30-40% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Growth-led call with no supply discipline: management is adding capacity (Apnar lines 3 and 4, FY27 capex INR100-120 crores) and guides FY27 revenue +30-40% and PAT +50-60%, with Q1 EBITDA margin near 30% and key figures partly restated on the call.

calls.name: Ather Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Phase 1 AURIC ramp to 42,000 units a month: about 4-5 months from zero, finishing around end Q4 or into Q1 FY28
calls.thesis: Demand far exceeds supply: wholesale up 81% to 83,000 units, dealer inventory cut to 3 days, and capacity expansion (AURIC, 4.2 to 9.2 lakh units) is the key supply response, while commodity costs cut gross margin to 22.4%.

calls.name: M & B Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Medium-term CAGR: >20% over 3-4 years (FY28-FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.5% to INR291 cr with capacity adds in H2, but margins squeezed by freight; management withheld FY27 margin guidance, citing volatility, while holding ~25% revenue growth.

calls.name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
calls.gLine: India sequential RM inflation Q2: about 8% sequentially
calls.thesis: Apollo Tyres India volumes grew ~12% with price hikes of 7-9% only partly in Q1 revenue; management says 15-16% needed and only 11%+ announced, with RM still rising ~8% into Q2.

calls.name: Borosil Renewables Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales uplift from 600 TPD expansion: +60% sales and EBITDA (Q4 FY27 commissioning)
calls.thesis: Solar glass at full 1,000 TPD with ASP up to INR160.30/sqm (from 138.10 YoY) and EBITDA ~35%; 600 TPD expansion due Q4 FY27 adds ~60% volume, but furnace repairs (~90 days) loom.

calls.name: EFC (I) Ltd
calls.gLine: Leasing billable seat additions: 18,000 to 20,000 billable seats (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flexible-workspace operator with strong reported growth (revenue +29%, PAT +52% YoY) but no capacity-discipline evidence; EBITDA fell 14% QoQ and furniture margin collapsed, with management deflecting on both.

calls.name: RIR Power Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Core quarterly revenue run-rate: Rs 30+ crore per quarter this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 27.16 cr (+29.3% YoY) and margin lift from ~80-85% pass-through of metal cost hikes; Odisha epi capacity still pre-revenue, guided Rs 12-15 cr for H2 FY27.

calls.name: Manappuram Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Gold loan AUM growth FY27: 25%-30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold loan AUM up 12% QoQ to INR54,655 cr standalone with yield up 59 bps to ~18%; management guides FY27 gold growth 25-30% and 500 new branches, but no supply-side capacity data, and microfinance and vehicle books shrinking.
calls.top: Gold loan yield up 59 bps QoQ

calls.name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 FY27 2W domestic ICE growth: slightly better than Q1 (21%) (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +28% to 1.63m and EBITDA margin 12.8% (+30bp) despite ~4% commodity headwind; capacity rising from 6.8m to 8.3m 2W units by Q4, with ~INR 3,500 cr investment.

calls.name: MPS Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue: approx INR 1,500 crore (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 20.4% to INR 224.24 cr with EBITDA margin 34.3% (vs 27.0%); management reaffirmed FY27 EBITDA above INR 300 cr, but organic growth in Corporate Learning and Research lags the market stated by the company's own commentary.

calls.name: Fineotex Chemical Ltd
calls.thesis: Consol revenue ~INR 387 cr (+165% YoY) on US CrudeChem consolidation; Texas plant only 63% utilised with 148k MTPA capacity, but management gave no numeric margin or volume guidance and relied on promotional answers.

calls.name: Fairchem Organics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation exit FY27: 70% to 75% (FY27 exit)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 176 cr (+34.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin 10.14% on price realisation from import pressure easing; utilisation only ~60% with target 70-75% exit FY27.

calls.name: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR329.7 cr (+59.1% YoY) and EBITDA margin 34.3%, but management guides FY27 revenue +25% and margins only in line with FY26; capacity utilisation at Sachin 83%, Ankleshwar 23%, Jhagadia 55%.

calls.name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales INR 617 cr and collections INR 599 cr (97% efficiency), EBITDA margin 21.3%, but OCF only INR 68 cr against INR 1,000 cr FY guidance; supply-side signals are mainly launch pipeline and land spend.
calls.top: OCF INR 68 cr vs INR 1,000 cr FY guide

calls.name: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Gold AUM up 77% YoY to ₹11,191 Cr and PAT ₹114.4 Cr (+52.5%), but GNPA fell only via write-offs, Stage II rose 2.2%→2.7% on gold bullet-to-interest-due rule change, and CRAR fell to 20.71%.

calls.name: Azad Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Debtor days (working capital): H1 ~200 days; H2 160-180 days (H1 and H2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +26.8% YoY to INR170.5 cr and EBITDA margin 37.6%, but capacity is still ramping with revenue contribution guided only from H2; other income fell to INR4 cr from INR17 cr and receivable days are 170-180.

calls.name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% p.a. FY27-28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 36.5% YoY to INR1,101m with order book INR209cr (+20% QoQ); margin dipped to 12.85% on raw-material costs, with mgmt guiding ~20% growth and 100-200bp EBITDA margin recovery over FY27-28.

calls.name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
calls.gLine: Punjab EBITDA per ton FY28: close to INR30,000 per ton (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 55% to INR108 cr but margin flat at 8.1% and PAT at INR23.8 cr, with Punjab at 80% utilisation and FY27 EBITDA guidance of INR520-540 cr reiterated.

calls.name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: Gas volume growth: at least 25% YoY every year (annual)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 12.4% to INR233.8 crore and EBITDA up 15.6% to INR179.4 crore on liquid volumes, but gas revenue fell 3.5% and management gave no numeric capacity-discipline evidence beyond a INR10,000 crore capex plan.
calls.top: Capex plan INR10,000 cr by March 2027

calls.name: WeWork India Management Ltd
calls.gLine: Customization revenue run rate: INR10-15 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Flex operator growing revenue 28.5% YoY with occupancy up to 84.9% and 22k desks of H1 supply, but Q1 PAT lifted by a Q4-flattered base and capex guide held at INR500-600 crore; sequential EBITDA dipped 13%.

calls.name: Rubicon Research Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin FY27: 23% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rubicon Q1 FY27 revenue INR534 crore (+51% YoY) with op EBITDA margin 24.2% and FY27 margin guide lifted to 23%, but own-capacity constraints keep outsourcing and gross margin pressure in play.
calls.top: FY27 EBITDA margin guide raised to 23%

calls.name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 38% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Express volumes up 83% YoY and revenue up 65% to INR1,358 cr with margin at 4.9%; FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 38-40% from 27-30%, while capex front-loaded in build mode, not supply discipline.

calls.name: Karamtara Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 60% to 65% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,581 crore (+72% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~11% with ramping new capacity; management guides FY27 revenue growth of 60-65% but gives no FY28 number, and capacity utilisation is still low.
calls.top: Capex INR900 crore last year, continuing

calls.name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin FY27: 18% to 19% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Kajaria Q1 FY27 is a price-led quarter: 11% realisation rise after Morbi gas shock, EBITDA margin 19.6%, and a double-digit volume guide that depends on 22 MSM of new capacity arriving only in FY28 and on outsourcing.

calls.name: Grasim Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Birla Opus FY27 revenue growth: >50% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Grasim Q1 FY27 is a supply-side-neutral read: VSF operating rates near 100% and caustic at import parity, but paints growth is price-led with channel stocking and Birla Pivot break-even slipped slightly to FY27 exit.
calls.top: Paints Q1 boosted by dealer channel stocking

calls.name: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR1,500 crore (excl. land for Kutch and Nagore) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 realisation up ~9% QoQ mostly from geo-mix and non-trade price gains, but management flags fuel and packaging cost rising into Q2 with pass-through uncertain; utilisation 76%, capex ~INR1,500 cr for FY27.

calls.name: Black Box Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR7,800-8,000 crore (+23-27%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,719 crore (+24% YoY) and order backlog of about US$950 million (+83%); FY27 guidance kept, with a 10% margin goal pushed to Q4 and beyond.

calls.name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd
calls.gLine: Office leased occupancy Phoenix Asia Towers and One National Park: 90% by end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Retail consumption up 32% and rentals up 17% with 1.5m sq ft of new retail and offices due 2027–28, but rent-to-consumption ratio has drifted toward 12.5% from ~14% three years ago.

calls.name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
calls.gLine: G&A as % of sales: 6% to 6.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India, West & South) grew revenue 12% with SSSG 4.3%, but EBITDA margin slipped on fuel/food/packaging inflation; management guides 100–150 bps annual margin gains and 60+ openings in FY27.

calls.name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR8,500 crore ongoing projects plus ~$300m foreign (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 39.2% (up 639bp YoY) on pellet ramp to 100% utilisation and slurry pipeline savings; capex rising to ~INR11,000-11,500 crore a year, with INR15,000-20,000 crore flagged for year three.
calls.top: Capex to INR15,000-20,000 crore in year 3

calls.name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Lamination volume FY27: 82,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pitti's sheet-metal utilisation rose to 73% from 70% and machining to 86% from 82%, with the Lamination target raised to 82,000 tons; but margins are flat near 16.8% and machining is the bottleneck.

calls.name: KEI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: 11% to 12% (coming year)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin up on mix and retail, with Sanand greenfield ramp at 50% and new ₹700cr LV/MV capex announced; management stays conservative at 20%+ growth despite industry running near 30%.

calls.name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.7% to INR85.2 cr and EBITDA margin up to 10.14% from 7.35%, but growth is export-led; the new Andheri plant adds capacity with domestic sales still mostly unproven.

calls.name: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Steel Abrasive volume growth: approximately 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~21-22% on revenue up ~18-20%, but mostly gross-margin and EPR-credit driven; management guides FY27 revenue INR670-700 crores and 18-20% margin, with the EPR contribution of INR25-30 crores a year at PBT level under analyst scrutiny.

calls.name: V-Mart Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: SSG FY27: Mid-to-high single digit
calls.thesis: V-Mart Q1 FY27 revenue +23% with SSG 9% and days of inventory down 8% to 86, but gross margin fell 80 bps to 34.5% on aged-inventory provisioning and mix; store expansion guidance held at 90+.

calls.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Concurrent construction capacity: 32 platforms by end of calendar year 2026 (CY2026)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 39% to ₹1,815 crore with order book ₹13,596 crore; growth hinges on the pending ₹ NGC contract, expected to be signed this quarter, with revenue only from FY28.

calls.name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 5% QoQ to INR203 cr on realisation gains, with HALS at 22% of sales; volume fell YoY on a two-week raw-material shutdown, and the 3,000 t HALS target was reaffirmed.

calls.name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Decoplast revenue doubling: Double sales in 3 to 4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Record Q1FY27 revenue Rs 2,610 mn (+24.5% YoY) and 27th straight quarter of outperformance, but adjusted PAT margin 19.3% and no peer or industry capacity data; supply-side evidence thin.

calls.name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approximately INR670 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +42% to INR150 cr and PAT INR34 cr, but EBITDA margin slid to ~36% (34.7% ex-other income) and FY27 guide implies ~38.8% margin; supply-side read is capacity expansion (colleges doubled) expensed upfront, with demerger the main catalyst.

calls.name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue target: INR 1,000 crore first milestone; INR 2,000 crore addressable potential (not dated)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 141.8 cr (+85% YoY) and EBITDA margin 29.4%, but driven by a one-off Indonesia transfer-case order (~30% dispatched of 70,000 units); no capacity addition announced beyond a planned line upgrade.

calls.name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: ISCS EBITDA margin: back to 9% in Q2; 9.5% to 10% by Q4 (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% YoY to Rs 3,335 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 7% (+30 bps); ISCS margin dipped to 8.1% on onboarding costs, GFS rose to 4.1%, and management targets 4% PBT by FY28. Asset-light, not a capacity-cycle story.
calls.top: New business wins Rs 543 cr, record

calls.name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Muthoot Microfin Q1 FY27 shows credit cost falling to 2.6%, cost of funds down to 10.13% and AUM growth guidance raised to 20%, but yields are flat and no capacity or supply metrics were given.

calls.name: Innova Captab Ltd
calls.gLine: Jammu peak revenue: INR1,400 crores at 65-70% utilisation (long term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR470.9 cr with volume 20-22%, but Jammu ramp at 25-30% utilisation and only INR1-1.5 cr EBITDA; management reiterates 15-16% margin band and 20% volume growth guidance.

calls.name: Vibhor Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: Monthly sales increase Q2: +1,000 t, ~10 CR monthly
calls.thesis: Vibhor's Q1 FY27 pipe volumes are capacity-constrained by galvanizing tanks, with a 20% top-line rise led by Jharsuguda and capex (new galvanizing tank) only now being added; Jindal still ~80% of revenue.

calls.name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
calls.gLine: Srinagar and Bandhavgarh opening: Oct-Dec 2027 (CY27)
calls.thesis: Leela Q1 FY27 RevPAR +17% (occupancy 67.5%, ADR +10%) and EBITDA margin 41%, but this is a demand-led hotel story with no supply discipline signal; capacity is expanding (10 pipeline properties, 1,000+ keys) rather than being cut.

calls.name: Exato Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: IP revenue start: from this month or next month (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Small CX/AI services firm reports ~50% revenue growth and 104% PAT growth, but supply-side evidence is absent and order-book, ARR and 60-70% revenue growth targets rest on unnamed deals and an undisclosed acquisition.

calls.name: Omnitech Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (YoY): 35% to 40% per year, FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR166.6 cr (+61.5% YoY) with working-capital days cut to 233 from 294, but capex of INR250 cr is for a new Chhapara plant and management guides 35-40% growth with no numbers on prior targets.

calls.name: Lohia Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Woven-plastic machinery maker reported Q1 FY27 revenue INR503 cr (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.9%, with order book ~INR1,778 cr (+30% QoQ) and utilisation of 70-75%, but no capacity added yet.
calls.top: Order book INR1,780 cr, up 30% QoQ

calls.name: Manipal Health Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt to EBITDA post IPO repayment: ~0.9x from ~2.8x
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR3,091 cr (+38% YoY) on volume-led growth; ex-Sahyadri margin 25% vs 26.5% last year, with ~3,000 beds and INR4,000 cr capex plan over 3-4 years keeping supply expanding.

calls.name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year industry growth: approaching double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hero's Q1 FY27 volume grew 23% and revenue 36% on 8% mix benefit, but gross margin fell 300bp on ~4.5% commodity inflation; EBITDA margin 13.3%, with EV capacity rising from 15,000 to ~30,000 a month and targeted 45,000 by year-end.

calls.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd
calls.thesis: Auto and Farm margins absorbed 400-500 bps commodity pressure in Q1 FY27; Auto price hikes of 1.5% then 2.7% average are the offset, while capacity doubling by FY31 (ICE SUV to 60k/month by September) signals competitive capex.

calls.name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin normalisation: back to normalised level by Q3
calls.thesis: Healthcare pen revenue up 85% to INR142 cr (51% mix) on ~9 million pens in Q1, but utilisation only 50.2% and gross margin fell QoQ on pass-through lags; 36 million FY27 guidance said beatable.

calls.name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
calls.gLine: GEML EBITDA positive: Possibly positive in next 4 to 6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 31% to INR975 crore but margins down 2-2.5 pts on commodity inflation and Greaves.Next spend; management guides Q2 marginally better, H2 better, full-year margin held.
calls.top: Margins down 2-2.5 pts on input costs

calls.name: Gufic Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Indore capacity utilisation: 40% to 45% by year-end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gufic's Indore plant is ramping from ~30% toward 40–45% utilisation by year-end with no new capex; Q1 revenue +15% YoY to INR260.8 cr and EBITDA margin 18.1%, but the revenue ceiling rests on management's own unverified estimates.

calls.name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
calls.gLine: Pune CCS/bus bar revenue potential: ₹300-400 cr over ~3 years; 10-15% in year 1 (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +33.4% to ₹182.2 cr with margin gain driven by shunt strip-to-part conversion; bimetal utilisation only 40-45% and capacity still idle, so supply discipline is intact but growth is partly silver-led.

calls.name: Usha Martin Ltd
calls.gLine: Plasticated LRPC volume FY27: 3,500 to 4,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR 1,033 crore and EBITDA margin 20.1%, but wire rope volumes flat on Middle East volume down 28%; management reiterates 10-12% FY27 volume growth with capacity in place.
calls.top: Steel and zinc costs passed through

calls.name: Websol Energy System Ltd
calls.gLine: TOPCon upgrade completion: by March 2027, cell capacity 1.2 GW to 1.35 GW
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 cell utilisation 92% and module utilisation 81% (from 39%) show the base being used, but EBITDA margin fell to 34% from 47% on module mix, with cell prices soft in the prior quarter and inventory building.

calls.name: MM Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 20-plus goal; 2-3% squeeze (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up to ~20,200 t (vs 78,000 t FY26 run-rate) with management guiding 23-25k t per quarter and ~INR1,800-1,900 cr turnover, but working capital and inventory are flagged as needing cuts.

calls.name: TCPL Packaging Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 non-separator capex: INR 100-150 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with PAT up ~79% to INR 40 crore and volumes up high single digit, but management is pivoting capex into a new battery separator venture (INR 125 crore) while folding carton utilisation is only ~70%-plus.

calls.name: Poly Medicure Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone gross margin: 68-69% (near term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 28% on price hikes and inventory gain, with management guiding back to 25-27% and consolidated revenue guide of INR2,300-2,400 crore held; Middle East shipments stalled (-32%).

calls.name: UNO Minda Ltd
calls.gLine: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar seating plant operations: commence by Q2 FY28 (Q2 FY28)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 5,557 cr (+26% YoY) with EBITDA margin 10.3%; management holds FY27 11% ±50bp with bias to upper end, but ~40bp commodity pass-through dilution and capex of ~INR1,750 cr this year.

calls.name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: Africa EBITDA recovery to double digit: Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth led by India (+16% YoY) and Africa (+45%) while Indian apparel exports fell 12%; capacity adds are funded but back-end loaded to FY28-29, and BTPL remains loss-making at about -7.5% to -8% EBITDA.

calls.name: JK Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 cost per tonne increase: INR150/t (fuel ~INR100, diesel/other ~INR50)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes grew 18% YoY on Central India capacity, but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 16.9% from 21.9% a year ago as fuel costs rise; management guides ~INR150/t cost increase in Q2 and no expansion delay.

calls.name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
calls.gLine: Wheelset (Odisha) revenue at full commissioning: INR2,500-3,000 crore; EBITDA at least ~15% (FY28 onwards)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 46% YoY to INR671 crore but EBITDA margin only ~10% and wagon production fell to 1,141 units from 1,347 as the company shifted to new private-wagon designs; order book ~INR4,500 crore.

calls.name: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per ton range: INR 8,000-12,000 next year (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes 59,000 t (+6.5% YoY) with EBITDA ₹10,760/t and realisations rising; capacity capped at 3 lakh t licence, so supply growth hinges on pending 3.6 lakh t EC approval.
calls.top: Rolling mill at 3 lakh t capacity

calls.name: Pricol Ltd
calls.gLine: Polymer turnover capacity: Rs2,000cr from Rs1,000cr (post capex)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 23.5% YoY to Rs1,083.6cr but EBITDA margin 11.41% on input-cost shock; management says lost ~1.5% margin is delayed, recoverable via indexation in Q2–Q3, with polymer capacity the constraint.
themes: Input cost inflation / West Asia crisis

calls.name: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR156 crore (+17% YoY) with 31% EBITDA margin, but guidance is 40-45% growth and the order-book upside rests on QRSAM, MIGM and Pinaka orders not yet placed; no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
calls.gLine: Railway/Defence EBITDA margin FY27: 15% to 16%
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +13% to INR3,888 cr and EBITDA +28% to INR337 cr, but PCB margins compressed to ~12% on a two-quarter CCL pass-through lag; electronics FY27 40%+ growth guide reiterated and ILJIN fire adds disruption risk.

calls.name: Adani Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS cumulative target: 50 GWh by FY30 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 power revenue up 29% to INR4,280 crore with 94% EBITDA margin, but ~all new merchant risk shifted to related-party AESL and FY27 capex guided at ~INR42,000 crore.
calls.top: Merchant risk moved to related party AESL

calls.name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
calls.gLine: Nykaa Now city footprint: over 25 cities by end FY27
calls.thesis: Nykaa Q1 FY27 shows broad demand acceleration (GMV +34%, EBITDA +68%) with capital-light, asset-light model; supply-side signals are limited to capital discipline and modest store expansion, with no capacity-cycle evidence.

calls.name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37% with only ~7pp from copper, but margins squeezed by copper lag and minimum-wage hikes; pass-through still pending with 3–6 month lag, greenfields only at break-even.

calls.name: Flair Writing Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital improvement: ~10 days (by end of FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.6% YoY to INR319.2 cr with EBITDA margin 16.7% (down 46 bps YoY); gross margin hit by West Asia raw-material spike, pricing actions and reiterated 15% FY27 growth guidance.

calls.name: SPR Auto Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: high teens sustainable
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT up only 9% on 51% income growth as commodity pass-through lags a quarter and NCD interest weighs; management gave no numeric guidance and no capacity-deferral signal, while legacy volume grew ~16% vs industry.

calls.name: Sudeep Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: NSS FY27: flattish with single-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% to INR158.3 cr with EBITDA margin 34.7%, but specialty ingredients grew only 19% on LPG-driven utilisation cuts (sub-50% for half the quarter) and NSS is dragging margins.
calls.top: Utilisation fell below 50% in LPG outage

calls.name: CMR Green Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Installed capacity: beyond 7 lakh tons by end FY27 (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% with EBITDA steady at ~INR12/kg, but utilisation near 65%, negative operating cash flow and D/E at 0.86 keep the capital-cycle read cautious.

calls.name: Surya Roshni Ltd
calls.gLine: Lighting EBITDA FY27: ~INR200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Steel pipe volume up 21% to 2.28 lakh tons and EBITDA/ton rose to ₹4,006, but management guided FY27 EBITDA/ton ₹4,600–4,700 and company EBITDA ₹670–680 crore, implying a steep H2 ramp.

calls.name: NOCIL Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,400-1,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr (+20% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.2%, but volumes fell 3% QoQ on supply constraints; FY27 guided Rs 1,400-1,600 cr revenue and ~10% EBITDA, with ADD on Sulphonamides in force and Pilflex 13 pending.

calls.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
calls.gLine: Phenol run rate: close to 4 lakh tonnes per annum, short to medium term (short to medium term)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with consolidated EBITDA INR 554 crore (21% margin vs 11% a year ago) and Phenolics EBIT INR 418 crore, but management withheld spread data and the phenol debottleneck and PCB/BPA timelines are unproven.
calls.top: Phenol run rate ~1 lakh t/qtr, 4 lakh t target

calls.name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Lending yield: stabilise around 20% to 20.5%, ~50 bps uplift (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold lender grew AUM 135% YoY but leverage rose from 0.7x to 2.9x D/E and ROA fell to 2.9%; management guides 50-60% AUM growth and yields ~20%, with gold-price-driven ticket size shrinkage and no supply-side capacity discipline discussed.
calls.top: Ticket size shrinking with gold price

calls.name: Steelcast Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 25% (possibly 30%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Steelcast Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR124.8 cr with 66% utilisation in Apr–Jun; management guides ~25% FY27 volume growth and a INR120 cr greenfield foundry, but margin and price pass-through are lagged to 1 July.

calls.name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term margin target: 15-16% stabilise
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 12% QoQ to 23 mn meters and EBITDA margin rebounded to 13.1%, but management reiterated FY27 guidance without a supply cut and Bhilad flood disruption adds risk to H2 volumes.
calls.top: Raw-material price hikes concluded, flow from Q2

calls.name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37% to INR756 cr and EBITDA margin 14.6%, driven by utilisation of 80–95% across most pharma assets; management says capex is a steady ~INR200 cr a year, with no capacity cut or deferral.

calls.name: Filatex India Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak net debt FY27: INR150-200 crore (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Filatex Q1 FY27 volumes flat QoQ at 89,872 MT with production cut to 84,075 MT in April; margins held on pass-through, Ecosis chemical recycling (1 to 75 TPD) targets ~INR80-85 crore EBITDA, with stabilisation risk and no prior-guidance check.

calls.name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone orders in hand INR 7,727 crore and manufacturing margin held at 12%, but FY27 revenue guided only 10-12% and Philippines ethanol lost INR 83 crore in Q1 at 65% utilisation.
calls.top: Mfg capacity: INR 502 cr approved, ~INR 1,200 cr revenue potential

calls.name: VRL Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: ~8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 freight realisation up 9% YoY to Rs 8,546/ton and volume up ~9% with EBITDA margin 21.8%; fuel pass-through held, but management is guiding FY volume ~8%, capex Rs 200-240cr a year.

calls.name: Sportking India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: around INR3,000 crores (~20% growth) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Cotton yarn spread rose to INR133/kg from INR107 with an 18.8% EBITDA margin; management guides next two quarters around these levels, with the 150,000-spindle Odisha expansion adding capacity from Q3.

calls.name: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported ROA 3.55% absorbs a INR36 crore management overlay (ex-overlay ~4.34%); credit cost 3.06% reported vs 1.97% ex-overlay, with NIM up to 14.36% and GNPA down to 2.2%.

calls.name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: R134A capacity: Commission this financial year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Chemical segment EBITDA up 29% YoY to INR 458 crore on R32 fluorochemicals ramp; R32 at peak utilisation with 20,000 t expansion due Q2 FY27, but battery materials revenue still only INR 20-30 crore and Oman capex shifted to India.

calls.name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
calls.gLine: Marketing spend Q1 vs normal: Q1 6.6% of sales, normalising toward 5-5.5%
calls.thesis: India SSSG 12.6% on traffic with no price hike; gross margin 70.8% targeted to 72% in 3 years, capex discipline, but no capacity or supply-side metrics beyond 80 stores/yr pace and Indonesia capex on hold.

calls.name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA growth: more than 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 23% to INR5,455 cr and EBITDA margin 14.9%, but supply is expanding fast (INR9,580 cr capex pending, flat/aluminium/iron ramps) and management gave no hard volume number, only "more than 20%".
calls.top: Balance capex INR9,580 cr to deploy

calls.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~Rs231 cr (+22.8% YoY) on 16.5% volume growth, EBITDA margin 42.7%, with capex guided at Rs190-195 cr for 9 hubs and 10-12 spokes; supply is expanding steadily while pricing is largely unchanged.

calls.name: Sansera Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: high-teens to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sansera posted record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR10,213m (+33% YoY) with capacity being added across ADS and auto; management guides high-teens to 20% FY27 growth, but capex was not updated and the ADS order book rose to ~INR57.5bn.

calls.name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
calls.thesis: QSR operator (KFC, Pizza Hut, Sri Lanka) posted positive SSSG across all three brands with KFC at 5%, but Sri Lanka margins are under pressure and Pizza Hut restaurant EBITDA is negative at -3.6%.

calls.name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Bed capacity: 5,000 beds in ~2.5 years (~FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR3,927m (+51% YoY) and ARPOB INR34,758 (+7%), but occupancy ~75% on a census-bed base that rose 1,655→1,820 and new hospitals still dilute margins (consolidated EBITDA 23.3%).
calls.top: Capex per bed INR75-80 lakh for 1,800 beds

calls.name: R R Kabel Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 54% to INR3,168 cr and op EBITDA margin 9% vs 7%, driven by volume (W&C +17%) and ~40% LME-led pricing; capacity additions are modest and utilisation in wires is only 65-70%.

calls.name: D.P. Abhushan Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: ~10% p.a. FY27 and FY28 (internal) (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 58% to ₹853.6 cr but volume growth only 1–2%, with gold price doing most of the lifting; management targets ~10% volume growth for FY27 and FY28 and has slowed store additions.

calls.name: Dee Development Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: >Rs 2,000 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 294.5 cr (+31.6% YoY) with Rs 25 cr slipped to Q2; capacity ramp at Anjar and seamless plant support margins, but Anjar utilisation only 60-65% and inflow guidance of Rs 2,000 cr is unchanged.

calls.name: Premier Energies Ltd
calls.gLine: 7 GW cell line first revenue: First revenue September; 50-60% utilisation by November; at least 70% by March quarter
calls.thesis: Premier Energies' Q1 FY27 shows record revenue INR2,508 crore (+34% YoY) and 7 GW TOPCon cell line starting ~Sept, with DCR modules sold out into FY28 but non-DCR modules unprofitable amid ~250 GW module capacity against ~60 GW demand.
calls.top: Non-DCR module capacity 200+ GW vs ~30 GW demand

calls.name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate: around 20% or less than 20%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~INR75 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 16.51% with FY27 guided at 17–19%; order book ~INR110 cr vs INR80–85 cr a year ago, but capacity ramp and working-capital study are still pending.

calls.name: Dr. Agarwals Health Care Ltd
calls.thesis: Greenfield-led eye-care network adding 18 facilities in Q1 (16 surgical) with revenue +26% YoY to INR614 crore; supply expansion is aggressive, so the read is growth-positive but capital-intensive, not a capex-discipline story.

calls.name: Raymond Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 bookings up 129% to INR700 crore and EBITDA margin 13%, but management is an asset-light JDA-led developer with no capacity or utilisation data; supply-side evidence is absent and interest cost is rising with debt at INR1,095 crore gross.

calls.name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ethanol sales volume: ~44 crore litres (order book)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 ethanol volumes ~8.3-8.5 crore litres on ~60% utilisation with a 44 crore litre FY27 order book, but margins rest on cheap grain inventory that management says will fade at INR25.50/kg maize.
calls.top: Maize at INR25.50 squeezes margin to INR6-7/litre

calls.name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA: approx INR 2,400 crore by close of FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 cell utilisation jumped to 83% from 68% and EBITDA margin hit 35%, with a 6 GW expansion (module Dec-2026, cell Mar-2027) adding capacity; per-watt margins were flat QoQ.

calls.name: Wakefit Innovations Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: Rs 100–120 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wakefit Q1 FY27 revenue +16.6% to Rs 405 cr with gross margin 57.1%, but management flags ~100 bps gross-margin compression in H1 from raw-material (polyol/TDI) inflation and capex of Rs 100–120 cr is mostly store rollout, not capacity.

calls.name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental H2 revenue: INR150-200 crore (H2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR973 crore with EBITDA margin 14.9% vs 12.2% a year ago; growth led by paneer, yogurt and ice cream, with capacity still underutilised (~50% per analyst) and no supply-side discipline signal.

calls.name: Tata Power Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Renewable capacity addition FY27: 2,500-2,700 MW; cross 9 GW by FY-end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tata Power Q1 FY27 PAT up 11% to INR 1,401 cr with renewables capacity ramp to 2.5 GW in FY27 and capex of INR 5,300 cr in Q1 against INR 25,000 cr plan; curtailment near 5% and TP Solar supply-side discipline is a watch item.
calls.top: Renewable capacity 6.7 GW → 9 GW by FY-end

calls.name: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd
calls.gLine: Base-case revenue growth: high-teen % growth (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22% to INR43.8 cr with EBITDA margin 47.5%, but capacity doubling (540 KL fermentation) is now starting while the company pivots into an acquisition-funded CDMO story with no quantified guidance and heavy debt/equity plans.

calls.name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per wheel FY27: more than INR310 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,509 cr (+27% YoY) with EBITDA/wheel INR314 vs INR262; management sees upside bias, but capex is ~INR600 cr and steel capacity is being added as industry sells out.

calls.name: Adf Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 25.9% to INR167.3 cr but EBITDA margin 17.7% flattered by INR19.7 cr US tariff refund; freight cost ~3% of revenue, and Surat plant only ~30% utilised this year.
calls.top: 30% of ready goods unshipped in June

calls.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: QliniQ FY27 revenue: INR150-175 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR841 cr (+35.6% YoY) and EBITDA margin 25.3%, but management says gross margin normalises to 55-56% and FY27 guidance is held at 15-20% growth and 20-21% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue INR650.1 crore (+16.3% YoY) and EBITDA margin 35.5% on commercial CMS mix, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and flagged lumpiness from a handful of molecules.

calls.name: Ganesh Housing Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,000-1,200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 280 cr was mostly a one-off Thaltej land sale and old inventory; PAT Rs 42 cr hit by one-time tax; FY27 guide Rs 1,000-1,200 cr revenue, PAT Rs 300-325 cr, with no supply-side or pricing evidence.
calls.top: Thaltej One land sold, not developed

calls.name: Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Export sales FY27: ₹750 crore, ~45% CDMO (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin jumped to 17.91% from 5.33% on 21% revenue growth, but capacity utilisation was only about 70% and the call offered no hard supply-side data beyond a planned ₹250 crore capex spend.
calls.top: CDMO ramp slower: ₹5-6 cr in Q1, ₹100-130 cr for two products

calls.name: Axiscades Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA (normalised pro forma): Rs270 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Reported loss masks a restructuring: continuing revenue up 94% to Rs183 cr with normalised EBITDA ~Rs41 cr, but management is leaning on unannounced acquisitions and a Rs1,255 cr divestment gain to meet FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Mechatronics revenue FY27: around INR 400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,364 crore (+33% y-o-y) and EBITDA margin 15.1% (+190 bps); management held FY27 guidance and capex at about INR 300 crore, with no explicit capacity-cut or discipline signals.

calls.name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin recovery: Improvement expected as pass-through settles by end Q2 / early Q3 (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 34.1% to INR156.4 cr and EBITDA up 33.3% to INR12.4 cr, but margins are under raw-material pressure with only ~2% of a ~4% input rise passed through; utilisation is 73%, so no supply discipline signal.

calls.name: Oil India Ltd
calls.gLine: Crude production FY27: minimum 3.9 MMT, may touch 4 MMT
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 crude output 0.95 MMT (+11% YoY) with management guiding ~1 MMT/quarter and ~3.9-4 MMT for FY27; NRL GRM $35.95 flattered by ~$2 inventory gain, with gas evacuation tied to pending pipelines.

calls.name: Sammaan Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of funds: 9.3% by end of FY27; 9.6% by September (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹243 crore with net NPA 0.15% and cost of funds falling 10.5% to 10%, but the read is a rerating/funding story, not a supply-side one; disbursement guide ₹30,000 crore this year.

calls.name: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd

calls.name: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd

calls.name: NDR Auto Components Ltd

calls.name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd

calls.name: Indigo Paints Ltd

calls.name: Hi-Tech Pipes Ltd

calls.name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
calls.gLine: Food and FMCG revenue growth: 18-20% (FY27 remainder)

calls.top: Edible Oil primary pipeline dried up

calls.name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Inox Green O&M EBITDA of INR57 crore (up 19% YoY) with 96.3% availability, but guidance of INR600 crore annualised EBITDA rests on acquisitions not yet consolidated; INOX Wind pivot to equipment supply leaves Q1 revenue flat and H2 heavy.

calls.name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd
calls.gLine: Asset services full-year revenue growth: more than 20-25%

calls.top: MPIS net new money record above INR3,000 crore

calls.name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross seat additions FY27: 22,000 to 25,000 seats (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex operator growing revenue 27% with occupancy flat at 76% and cash EBITDA margin only 10.1%; supply growth is mostly leased, not owned, so capital-light claims rest on lease-cost pass-through timing.

calls.name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR 57 crore on a gas-cost shock; management absorbed INR 2/kg for 30-40 days of committed orders, margin back to INR 7-8/kg, and it targets 20% volume growth with capex capped at INR 200-250 crore.
calls.top: Margin hit to INR 2/kg in first 45 days

calls.name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: not below 34% (FY27)

calls.top: New centres under 2 yrs at 6.5% margin

calls.name: Regaal Resources Ltd
calls.gLine: Crushing volume FY27: above 400,000 tons (FY27)

calls.name: Tata Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income FY28: 33% to 34% (FY28)

calls.top: Gold loan entry via Yogloans acquisition

calls.name: Aequs Ltd

calls.name: Powerica Ltd
calls.gLine: Genset margin recovery: improve from Q3 onward (Q3 FY27)

calls.top: Data-centre order book INR900 cr → INR1,100 cr

calls.name: Steamhouse India Ltd
calls.gLine: Steam volume growth (current locations): 5% to 10% (near term)
calls.thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

calls.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Investment portfolio yield: around 7% by exit of FY27 (Q4 FY27)

calls.top: Yield on advances to fall 10 bps

calls.name: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd

calls.top: Sugar stock 45.67 lakh quintals at INR 37.19/kg

calls.name: Indian Hotels Company Ltd

calls.name: Kalyani Forge Ltd

calls.name: Trishakti Industries Ltd

calls.name: Divis Laboratories Ltd

calls.name: Sejal Glass Ltd

calls.name: Adani Power Ltd

calls.name: L&T Finance Ltd

calls.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹493 Cr (+720% YoY) on 0.72% credit cost, with management guiding to 3-4% credit cost and only gradual 50bps pricing cuts from Q3; supply-side discipline not discussed, cushion held.

calls.name: Spencers Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Spencer's full-year online growth: ~25% cumulative (FY27)

calls.name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Planned capex FY27-FY29: approx INR30 billion, largely internal accruals (FY27-FY29)

calls.name: BMW Industries Ltd

calls.name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd

calls.name: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd

calls.name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd

calls.name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Ltd

calls.name: Bajaj Healthcare Ltd

calls.name: BLS International Services Ltd

calls.name: HPL Electric & Power Ltd

calls.name: Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd

calls.name: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd

calls.name: IRM Energy Ltd

calls.name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd

calls.name: Laxmi Dental Ltd

calls.name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd

calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR400 crore (FY27)

calls.name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: High-value product share of revenue: ~70% in near future (near future)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from mix (high-value 60.4% of revenue, EBITDA/ton ~13,500), but melt capacity is unchanged until Unit 3 next year, with FY27 capex of INR80 crore (only INR5 crore spent in Q1).

calls.name: Raymond Ltd
calls.gLine: Aerospace mature EBITDA margin: ~25% (longer term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 15.9% (up from 15.7%); aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr but margin fell to 21.2% from 23.7% on expensed R&D; capacity-led growth with a 2 yr-plus greenfield ramp.
calls.top: Aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr

calls.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: India cash cost: up 5-6% QoQ in Q2
calls.thesis: India upstream aluminium EBITDA hit a record INR7,390 crores at 55% margin, but Novelis volumes fell 5% and tariffs of USD70 million weigh; capacity adds (Aditya refinery/smelter) only land FY29.
calls.top: India upstream EBITDA record INR7,390 cr

calls.name: Tata Steel Ltd
calls.gLine: Depreciation step-up: Rs 300 cr/quarter, Rs 1,200 cr/year additional
