calls.thesis: Tata Steel Q1FY27 India EBITDA Rs 19,162/t (up from Rs 15,907 in Q4) on Rs 5,990/t realisation gain, but Q2 India NSR guided down ~Rs 1,500/t and Netherlands DSP shutdown and NINL 4.8 MTPA capex (Rs 33,873 cr) add volume and capex risk.
calls.top: India NSR guided down ~Rs 1,500/t in Q2

calls.name: Asian Paints Ltd
calls.gLine: Price increase pass-through: 8-9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +9% and consolidated PBDIT margin 20.6% (+240bps YoY) on mix, but ~25% raw-material inflation vs ~7% price hikes and low-cost inventory tailwind fading into Q2; guides 8-10% volume and 18-20% PBDIT margin.

calls.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth FY27-28: 35% to 40% minimum rise
calls.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

calls.name: Lumax Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR 200-250 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32.6% to INR 1,223 crore but EBITDA margin flat at 9.2% as OEM commodity recoveries slipped to Q2; FY27 10.5-11% margin guidance and 15-20% growth reiterated, capex raised to INR 200-250 crore.

calls.name: Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Khavda 600 MW revenue FY27: ~INR420 cr
calls.thesis: Khavda 600 MW solar at 33% CUF guides ~INR420 cr revenue and INR350-360 cr EBITDA, with 500 MW ramp-up and ~INR950-1,000 cr blended EBITDA only once fully operational; debt rises to ~INR4,500 cr.

calls.name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex projects: INR340 crores new projects plus INR150 crores carry forward (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR42.8 crores (+33% YoY) with FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores reaffirmed; footwear hit ~INR6 crores and shoe utilisation was poor in Q1, though new capex of INR340 crores is announced.
calls.top: Footwear cost pass-through lag ~INR6 cr hit

calls.name: RACL Geartech Ltd
calls.gLine: Heat-treatment plant trial production: January 2027; full commissioning by end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue ₹132.6 cr (+22% YoY) with ~59% Europe mix; heat-treatment replacement (~₹40 cr) and ₹35 cr expansion capex add capacity, but no capacity utilisation figure was disclosed.
calls.top: Royal Enfield run-rate 7.5–8k sets/month vs 10k nominated

calls.name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy inventory liquidation FY27: 40% to 60% of ~INR 75 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike driven by one horizontal project (Imperia Phase 2, ~60% gross margin on 85% of revenue); bookings fell to INR 105.7 cr with no supply-discipline evidence, and FY28 guidance is only qualitative.

calls.name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA exit: 3%–3.5% by June 2028 (June 2028)
calls.thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.40% from 2.51% and GNPA to 1.37% from 1.44%, with ROA at 1.98%; management gives a June 2028 exit guide of 3–3.5% ROA but no numeric guidance on opex or cost of funds.

calls.name: Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: DOT volume FY27: 1,500 tons
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 70.36 cr (+31%) and EBITDA margin 28.1% on price hikes and utilisation, but management guides FY27 to 20% margin and a softer Q2; the Kronox acquisition dominates the call.

calls.name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 14% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales up 21% to INR2,788 crores with EBITDA margin 22.88%; management raised FY27 growth guidance to 14-16% and margin to around 23%, but gains were mostly from rupee and cost-line mix, not materials.

calls.name: Paramount Communications Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15%-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Paramount's Q1 FY27 margin recovery is mainly US normalisation after tariff relief; existing plants run near 100% utilisation, so growth waits on Narmadapuram (~INR 500 cr FY28 revenue, debt-equity below 0.3x).

calls.name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone utilisation rose to 83% from 72% and JV swung to ₹3 crore profit, lifting EBITDA margin to 11.6%; management says pricing is pass-through and volume guided to mid-single digit.

calls.name: UCO Bank
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: below 50% or around 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit squeezed by a Rs 1,237 crore one-time DTA charge; underlying operating profit boosted by ~Rs 800 crore non-recurring TWO recovery, with credit cost 0.39% and CD ratio 82% supporting a 21% advances growth read.

calls.name: IIFL Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Home finance FY27 book growth: 17% to 18%
calls.thesis: Gold-loan-led growth with AUM up 38% YoY to INR1.15 lakh cr, but parent CRAR is tight and management is pursuing equity/subsidiary stake sales; credit cost guided 1.5-1.7% for FY27.

calls.name: Fiem Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR100 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 18.6% to INR770 cr with margin flat at 13.5%, but 4-wheeler ramp pushed out a year and input-cost pressure of ~120 bps is expected to be recovered with a lag.

calls.name: Puravankara Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 28% to INR1,439 cr with collections up 40%, but net debt INR2,836 cr and debt-cut target of INR700 cr is being softened by new land buys; FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 cr held.

calls.name: Health X Platform Ltd
calls.gLine: RetailerShakti EBITDA: positive EBITDA in Q3 FY27 (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Health X grew revenue 58% YoY to INR440 crores with EBITDA still negative at -3.4% margin and gross margin 7.8%; management refuses EBITDA focus and gives no segment P&L, with no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence.

calls.name: PG Electroplast Ltd
calls.gLine: H2/FY27 RAC volume growth: 15-20% for 6 months; ~20%+ full year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,034 cr (+35%) but operating margin 7.3% under commodity/rupee pressure; management targets ~8% FY27 margin and a compressor line plus 1.2 mn refrigerator plant adds capacity into a tightening import-restricted market.

calls.name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
calls.gLine: Total tenancies FY27 exit: 10,000+ tenancies (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR710m (+6.1% y/y on restated basis) with EBITDA margin cut to 59.3% after electricity moved into revenue; growth hinges on Vodafone Idea tenancy loading (150 done, ~700 more, 3,000 FY27 target) with BSNL billing stalled.

calls.name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
calls.gLine: Chennai footfall to 1 million: Not in one year; a couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR243 crore with EBITDA margin 48%, driven by Chennai ramp (INR45 crore) and mature parks ARPU +8%; supply additions ongoing but no new capacity capex guidance beyond ~10% of revenue.

calls.name: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: STU + HVDC annual inflows: INR20,000-25,000 crore per year (STU) (annual)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 earnings were driven by a ~INR570 crore EBIT from energy-solutions power sales on 3,325 MU of long-term take-or-pay supply, with much of it still open to market price; transmission capex ~INR3,500 crore per quarter, but no explicit guidance.

calls.name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: improve further over next two to three quarters from ~8% (2-3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Bigbloc Q1 FY27 utilisation ~69% on 1.3 mn cbm capacity with EBITDA margin ~8% (INR 6 cr on INR 79 cr); pricing hikes promised but MP plant expansion pushed to FY28 start, keeping capacity-add risk alive.

calls.name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd
calls.gLine: Pharma molecules incremental revenue FY27: INR70 crores to INR80 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,671m (+43% YoY) on volume, with management reiterating 25-30% growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin, while a new INR200 crore greenfield site is being built as Dahej nears saturation.

calls.name: PB Fintech Ltd
calls.gLine: PB Health annual run-rate: ~₹500 Cr, breakeven by Mar'27 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Insurance premium up 41% to ₹8,372 Cr and PAT up 92% to ₹163 Cr, but management openly prioritises fresh-business growth over margin, so no supply-side discipline signal; the read is growth-led and reinvestment-heavy.

calls.name: Metro Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: E-commerce growth: 20% to 30% healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone sales +9% with SOR 3P drag and April–May softness, June recovered to mid-teens; gross margin near 60%, EBITDA ~30%, PAT guidance held at 13–15% with no supply-side signals.
calls.top: June growth mid-teens after soft Apr–May

calls.name: Aether Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR3,000-3,500 million
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27% to INR3,266m and EBITDA margin 31%, but LSM volumes fell 22.5% as lines were moved to CEM, and capex guided to INR3,000-3,500m for Site 5 and R&D.

calls.name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 376.6 cr (+85% YoY) with EBITDA margin ~9.3% flat QoQ; compressor utilisation only ~50% and AC capacity 1.0→1.8m sets with 50-60% FY28 utilisation planned, so capacity additions outrun demand visibility.

calls.name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% YoY to Rs169cr and EBITDA margin 13%, but management concedes gross margin fell to ~41% on metals and semiconductor cost/lead-time shocks, and capacity is ahead of demand with only Rs20-25cr capex left.

calls.name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
calls.gLine: Lumel Alucast adjusted EBITDA: breakeven for full year (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 4.2% to INR1,983m but EEI up 34% with ~24% margin; supply-side evidence is capacity expansion (CT capacity nearly doubling, Nashik plant), not discipline, and Lumel Alucast still loss-making.

calls.name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 PAT ₹143 cr (+23% YoY) and ROE 17.5% held, but Stage 3 rose to 1.5% and management guides only a Q3 turn; disbursement cut to ₹641 cr by a one-time recognition change.

calls.name: EPACK Durable Ltd
calls.gLine: AC industry growth FY27: ~20%, EPACK to outgrow
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~34% to INR886 cr with RAC volume up ~30%, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.21% (6.4% underlying ex-PLI) on forex loss and wage costs; utilisation guided to 55-60% and capex only INR60-70 cr more.

calls.name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable EBITDA margin: 11% to 11.5%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 422.3 cr (+31% YoY) with EBITDA margin 7.4%; management reiterates FY27 EBITDA 8-9% and 20%+ growth, with supply restored after Rajkot restart, but Nagpur utilisation sits below 30%.

calls.name: Waaree Energies Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail revenue FY27: INR9,000 to INR10,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Solar module leader reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 79% to INR7,932 cr with module utilisation near 50% in India and cell integration rising from ~20% to ~65%, while reaffirming FY27 operating EBITDA of INR7,000-7,700 cr.

calls.name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR553 crore with CRO +26% and CDMO only +6%; management keeps 15-20% mid-term growth and INR1,100-1,300 crore capex, with H2 weighted to new Bidar capacity.

calls.name: Indo Farm Equipment Ltd
calls.gLine: New crane plant commercial production: November 2026 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crane volumes flat YoY in Q1 on full plant loading, with 3,600-unit new plant and dealers still at 25 against 50-plus target; tractor utilisation only 35–40% but no tractor capacity added, so growth depends on demand and dealer build-out.
calls.top: Crane new plant 3,600 units, Nov start

calls.name: Jash Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs156 crore (+17% YoY) with PAT turned positive at Rs5 crore; Rs932 crore order book and FY27 Rs875 crore target reiterated, but Middle East and Singapore shipments of about Rs15 crore are stuck.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross store additions FY27: more than 300 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to Rs 2,046 cr and EBITDA margin up 50 bps to 16%, but gross margin fell ~150 bps on channel mix and provisioning; supply-side signals are absent and the company is guiding 300+ gross store adds.

calls.name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
calls.gLine: East India 320 TPD on-site plant revenue: contribute from Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 987m (+18% YoY) and EBITDA margin 39%, driven by ramp of Kurnool and Uluberia 2 merchant plants; capex Rs 2,500m FY27 and Rs 2,000m FY28 with no contracted demand for North India merchant plant.

calls.name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth over FY26: 10-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR732 crore and EBITDA INR100 crore with utilisation near limits, Kesda 3.6 lakh t stainless capacity due Q4 FY27 and FY27 EBITDA/ton guided 7,500-8,500 versus Q1 above 10,000.
calls.top: Stainless capacity 1.16 → 4.76 lakh t by Q4 FY27

calls.name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approx INR370 crores excl. SVP (FY27)
calls.thesis: SteriPort Line 3 commissioning slipped one quarter to late August on civil delays, pushing ~INR70 crores of contribution into FY27 and leaving the INR370 crore base case intact; margin guidance of 25-26% for FY28 rests on capacity still to be built.
calls.top: Price hike INR1.50 vs polymer cost INR2.25

calls.name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin steady state: 3.5% plus
calls.thesis: Steel marketplace volumes up 10% YoY to 2.5 lakh tons with EBITDA margin 3.26%; management targets 3.5%+ steady state and 1.2 MT FY27, but Q1 volumes fell 13% QoQ and the April-May price correction cost about Rs 10 crore.

calls.name: GK Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest expense: stay near INR 5 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 71% to INR 505 cr and 24,118 pump installs (2x), but growth rests on PM-KUSUM 2.0 timing (expected Q3) that management could not firmly pin down; realisations per pump falling.

calls.name: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper value-added EBITDA uplift: +2% to copper margin / ~Rs 25 per tonne once stabilised (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 76% to Rs 2,725 cr but EBITDA margin ~4% vs 5.8% a year ago; management offers no numeric guidance, with copper EBITDA/tonne ~Rs 31,000 vs Rs 36,000 FY26 average.
calls.top: No volume or EBITDA numeric guidance

calls.name: Midwest Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR840 crores (granite 720, quartz 100-120)
calls.thesis: Granite-led quarter with revenue up 35% YoY, but quartz Phase 1 sold only ~5,000 tons with FY27 quartz volume guidance cut from 150,000 to 120,000 tons and EBITDA margin hit by diesel.

calls.name: Corona Remedies Ltd
calls.thesis: Corona Remedies Q1 FY27 revenue +21.9% YoY to INR422 crore, EBITDA margin 22% (+190bps); growth is mostly volume-led and FY27 guidance of 15% organic plus 20% PAT was held, with raw-material risk flagged.

calls.name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 25% to 27% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR118 cr (+119.5% YoY), gross margin 35.46%, EBITDA margin 28.76%; management guides FY EBITDA margin 25–27% after marketing ramp, with 9 COCO stores planned this year and no capacity-discipline issue since the business is retail.

calls.name: One Point One Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue: Roughly double FY27 revenue (qualitative, from analyst Q&A) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue INR 158.3 cr (+129% YoY) mostly from first full quarter of Netcom acquisition; base standalone revenue +11.6% YoY with 30.4% margin, no capacity or pricing data disclosed.

calls.name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 profitability: Entire year profitable on consolidated basis (FY27)
calls.thesis: Insurance distributor reports first adjusted-EBITDA-positive quarter (Q4 FY26) with revenue up 57% to INR 1,098 crore and corporate overheads down to 23% of revenue, but no capacity or supply metrics and guidance is qualitative.

calls.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% minimum YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.
calls.top: Input cost pass-through deferred to Q2

calls.name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: Further price hikes: 2% to 3% in current month (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~24% to INR4,215 cr but consolidated margin fell to 9.6% as raw-material and strategic spend hit; price hikes of ~3% in June plus 2-3% planned lag pass-through, and capex of INR1,700 cr is largely new energy.

calls.name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: Birla Tyres EBITDA breakeven: this financial year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 consolidated revenue INR1,432 Cr (+28% YoY) and EBITDA margin 22%, but the call is heavy on new capex (~INR2,000 Cr) and LFP/anode plans with no disclosed margins, and utilisation is 80% with management guiding to 90%+.

calls.name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
calls.gLine: Fertilizer plant completion: Q1 FY28 (Q1 FY28)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with EBITDA INR8,074 crore (59% margin) and zinc COP USD851/t, but volumes hold at 1.1 Mt guidance and growth capex is re-scheduled; silver and by-product tailwinds drive most of the upside.

calls.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Refining structurally short; cracks reasonably strong: qualitative
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 O2C revenue up 17% on wider refining and ethane-cracking spreads, but management refused to call the spike steady-state; net debt ~Rs 1,23,000 Cr and capex ~Rs 39,000 Cr in the quarter.

calls.name: Bharat Forge Ltd
calls.gLine: Organic capex India: ~INR1,800 crore (18 months)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin hit by 160bp energy/logistics costs (reported EBITDA 26.2% standalone, ~28% normalised) while management guides a ₹1,800 cr organic capex and ₹2,500 cr fundraise, adding capacity ahead of demand.

calls.name: Bosch Ltd
calls.gLine: 2-wheeler industry growth next quarter: resilient 8% growth
calls.thesis: Bosch Q1 FY27 revenue rose 22% y/y to INR58,419m and EBITDA to INR8,180m with margin near 14%, but management gave no capacity, utilisation or numeric guidance; supply-side evidence is absent.

calls.name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
calls.gLine: Animal Health API growth: 20%+ (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 946 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 21.6%, but API flat QoQ on customer wait-and-see; management guides Animal API +20%, company 13-15% growth this year.
calls.top: API customers delayed orders in June

calls.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% YoY and EBITDA up 26% with margin +60bps, but copper up 40% YoY and polymer costs up sharply with pass-through lagging 1-2 quarters; capex ~INR 1,614 crore held in line with guidance.

calls.name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR3,200 crores (~INR3,250 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~39% to INR755 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% and PAT turned to a INR3.4 cr loss on air freight and aluminium settlement lag; capex being curtailed after 54 projects.

calls.name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth: 10-15% p.a. for next 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was ~25% revenue, but only ~2% volume; PVC lines run at 75-78% utilisation with no new capacity sanctioned beyond a 5 lakh metre line due Feb-Mar 2027, and export OEM price hikes remain unpushed.

calls.name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Courtyard occupancy: 80% to 85% over next 2 FYs (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Hotel-owner Viceroy Q1 FY27 revenue up 77% to INR44.9 cr and EBITDA margin 26.3%, but PAT just INR1.4 cr as finance cost quadrupled; supply is expanding (Phase 2 Marriott rooms offline, Greenfield 200-key) with no capacity discipline.

calls.name: Aarti Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 385 cr (+79% YoY) was flattered by inventory and FX gains (guided Rs 50-60 cr), volumes fell 12% QoQ, and management declined to hold the run rate; Zone IV ramp is delayed.

calls.name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 revenue +39% YoY to Rs 380 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 35% from 40% QoQ; core crane margin 47% vs 53%, with receivables ageing (DSO 116 days) and FY27 EBITDA guidance held at Rs 525-575 cr.

calls.name: Marico Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth: High-teens, aspire to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Marico's India volume grew 11% with copra input costs ~35% below peak, but management flagged input-cost pressure from crude and edible oils into Q2 and guided EBITDA growth of high teens, aspiring to 20%.

calls.name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 volume growth YoY: double-digit (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume flat YoY with consol normalised EBITDA 7% after inventory write-downs; management guides Q2 double-digit YoY growth and 7-8% margin, while capex is trimmed to about Rs.200 crores over two years.
calls.top: PVC prices fell Rs.32/kg in April

calls.name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated FY27 turnover: around INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.7% to INR137.6 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2%, but wagon utilisation was ~50% in FY26 and management guided ~500 wagons in Q2 vs 300-odd in Q1, with 3,800-wagon order book and no operating cash flow in FY25-26.

calls.name: Bank of India
calls.gLine: FCNR(B) mobilisation by 30 Sep: $1.2 billion
calls.thesis: Clean Q1 FY27 with ROA ~1%, NIM 2.52% and GNPA 1.81%, but deposit cost relief is coming from bulk and FCNR funding, and the FY27 guidance was held rather than raised.

calls.name: Jindal Stainless Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7.3% YoY on gas shortage, utilisation at 69-70%, yet management held FY27 volume and H1 EBITDA/t guidance of INR18,000-20,000 while flagging gradual recovery.

calls.name: Bank of Maharashtra
calls.gLine: Equity raise: INR5,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth strong (advances +27% YoY, deposits +13%) with NIM 3.85% above 3.75% guidance and credit cost 0.99%, but NII growth (14.5%) lags advances and CASA growth is slowing, with a ~1.45% GNPA and funding reliant on refinance.

calls.name: NTPC Ltd
calls.gLine: Portfolio capacity: 150 GW by FY32, 250 GW by FY37 (FY37)
calls.thesis: NTPC plans 150 GW by FY32 and 250 GW by FY37 with ₹17 lakh crore capex, but FY27 RE addition of 7-8 GW is at risk from transmission and curtailment, with thermal technical-minimum issues.
calls.top: Group capex ₹17 lakh crore to FY37

calls.name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: more than 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: V-Guard Q1 FY27 revenue +23.5% (≈14% price, ≈9% volume) with 10.5% EBITDA margin, but wires volumes near zero as customers defer after steep price hikes and new entrants arrive.

calls.name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: around 15%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR924 cr (+53% YoY) on 889 MWp executed; INR5,300 cr unexecuted order book includes ~INR2,400 cr solar EPC and ~INR200 cr BESS, with no formal guidance given and consolidated margin diluted by T&D acquisition.

calls.name: Minda Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR 400-odd crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,846 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, but ~INR 106 cr exceptional gain inflates PAT; no capacity-discipline signal, FY27 capex ~INR 400 cr spread across verticals.

calls.name: Greenlam Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Plywood utilisation: ~50% for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +18% to INR797 cr and EBITDA pre-forex +48% to INR81 cr, but laminate volume fell 6% on export slippage and domestic volume fell 7.5%; capex falls back to laminate-only expansion with no new large capacity beyond it.

calls.name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 21-22% in next 2 years; 24-25% long term (2 years / 4-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR6,951m on 11% volume growth, ARPP only +2%; adjusted EBITDA margin 19.4% (+120bp) with management targeting 21-22% in two years and 25% in four to five.

calls.name: Share India Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth: around 20% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs 124.41 cr (+48% YoY) led by MTF book (~Rs 470 cr) and subsidiaries, but prop still ~52% of profit and management guides ~20% growth with no capacity or supply-side metrics.
calls.top: PMS AUM Rs 150 cr in first quarter

calls.name: Shalby Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital FY27 EBITDA margin: up to 20% for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA flat at ₹49 cr on 11.6% revenue growth as margin fell to 14.5% from 16%; hospital standalone margin down to 18.4% from 21.6%, with management guiding to 20% for the full year without numbers on capacity.

calls.name: Aartech Solonics Ltd
calls.gLine: Next quarters revenue and margins: Expected to be very healthy
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rose about 1.5x year on year to Rs 728 lakhs and PBT rose to Rs 119 lakhs from Rs 73 lakhs, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or pricing data and pipeline conversion remained vague.

calls.name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Gurgaon EBITDA margin: 20-21% in FY27; 23-24% over 2-3 years (FY27 to 2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 287.32 cr (+12.7%) and EBITDA margin 21.5%; Gurugram occupancy 65.7% with ~200-bed Tower IV and INR 800 cr three-year capex plan adds supply, with a INR 700 cr equity enabling resolution.

calls.name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 orders INR 5,096.5 cr (ex-HVDC +26.1% YoY) and revenue +68.6% YoY, but no capacity-discipline signal: the 20th plant (Karjan) starts in June 2026 for December 2028 commissioning, and gross margin fell YoY on mix.

calls.name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
calls.gLine: BT out rate: around 5% to 6% (near term)
calls.thesis: Housing finance book growing 25.7% YoY with stable asset quality (30+ DPD 3.2%) and spread guided at 5–5.25%; no capacity or pricing-supply signals, growth driven by home loans and ticket size.

calls.name: Delhivery Ltd
calls.gLine: Local (intra-city) ARR exit: 250 Cr original target, now 160-175 Cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Delhivery Q1 FY27: revenue ~Rs3,000 Cr (+28% YoY) with PTL yield up to ~Rs12/kg and FY27 guidance narrowed to 20-30% growth, but profitability hit by two new contracts and labour costs; supply-side signals are light.

calls.name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
calls.gLine: Redevelopment projects to add: two to three projects in this year
calls.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer: Q1 FY27 revenue up 27.9% YoY to INR58.26 cr, but EBITDA margin fell from ~22.3% to ~19.8% on war-driven material and labour cost hits; no capacity or capital-cycle signals.

calls.name: Uniparts India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: a couple of percentage points above FY26 growth of 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR347 crore (+27% YoY), EBITDA INR90 crore (~26% margin); no capacity additions discussed beyond maintenance-type capex of INR12 crore, growth driven by construction and new wins, with FY27 growth guided a few points above FY26's 21%.

calls.name: Senco Gold Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores: 12-15 more in FY27 (remainder FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 67% with retail +50% and SSSG ~39%, but reported EBITDA fell to 7.0% (from 10.1%) and management retained 7.5-7.8% guidance; supply-side signals (inventory days ~152, hedging held at ~50%) are mixed.

calls.name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year growth: around 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 45% to INR586 crore with EBITDA margin 6.82%, but volume growth only ~15% and no supply-side disclosure (capacity, capex quantum, grams sold withheld); management guides 25-30% growth and 5,000 crore by 2030.

calls.name: Happy Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: Industrial share of revenue (medium term): Industrials to double in 3-4 years; PV 12-15%; industrials+PV 45-50% of revenue (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs449cr (+27%) and EBITDA margin 31.3%, but forging utilisation only 59% with 4,000t press added; price hikes of ~4.5-5% on domestic book start from Q2.

calls.name: Travel Food Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Travel F&B operator grew system-wide sales 18% and PAT 35.6% on flat traffic, but LFL slowed to 0.8% (7% ex-disrupted markets) and EBITDA margin fell to 35.8% on pre-opening costs for 87 new outlets.

calls.name: GNG Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% (raised from 25%)
calls.thesis: Refurbished-PC reseller posts 32% revenue growth and 24.65% gross margin on inventory built ahead of price rises; supply-side evidence is thin and margin gains rest on stockpiling and unverified trust-premium claims.

calls.name: Physicswallah Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,054 crore (+24% YoY) with pre-Ind AS EBITDA -INR44 crore; management reiterates FY27 30% revenue and 100% EBITDA growth but NEET shift cut Q1 offline growth to 14%.
calls.top: NEET shift cut offline growth to 14%

calls.name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: ~25% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

calls.name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.
calls.top: Order book Rs.982 cr, ~2x last year

calls.name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Iron ore third-party sales: 8 million tonnes target (FY27)
calls.thesis: SAIL Q1 FY27 EBITDA up over 50% to INR4,356 crore (INR10,464/t) on better NSR and cost, despite crude output down to 4.8 Mt from 4.9 Mt due to advanced repairs; inventory rose 0.2 Mt.

calls.name: Ester Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 debt repayment: around INR100 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 103% to INR58.9 crore with film EBIT margin 9.8% and utilisation 84%, but management withheld firm FY27 guidance and Specialty Polymers revenue fell; other income flatters PAT.

calls.name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (ESOP-adjusted): ~7% today, 12% by FY30 target (3 years)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% YoY with EBITDA steady near 7% (ESOP-adjusted ~5.7%); growth is demand and investment-led, with no capacity or supply-discipline signal, and a 12% FY30 margin target that is aspirational.

calls.name: Max Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Axis Max Life VNB margin rose to 23.2% (from 20.3%) and VNB grew 33%, driven by protection mix and yield curve, while solvency sits at 198% after Axis's ₹381 crore infusion.

calls.name: NIIT Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 FY27 revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% to INR957m with EBITDA near breakeven at -INR14m (vs -INR63m); no capacity metric, supply side is a skilling investment cycle, guidance is qualitative for Q2 (double-digit growth, near-breakeven EBITDA).

calls.name: ACC Ltd
calls.thesis: Ambuja cut low-margin non-trade volume (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY, total -7%) to chase value; net cost fell to INR4,241/t and FY27 cost target INR4,250 held, but utilisation is ~65%.

calls.name: Castrol India Ltd
calls.thesis: Castrol India Q2 CY26 revenue INR1,871 crore (+25% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~26%, helped by one-off benefit from cheaper inventory; management says costs hit P&L more in Q3 and pricing is the lever, with a 21-24% EBITDA band.
calls.top: Old low-cost inventory flattered Q2 margin

calls.name: Sagar Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY28: double-digit (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up ~13% but EBITDA/tonne fell to ₹451 on West Asia energy costs; management still reiterates ₹500–550/t for FY27 and 7 Mt volumes, with no new capex through FY28.

calls.name: TIL Ltd
calls.gLine: Turnover growth: Significant jump this year; tripling in 5-7 years (FY27 and 5-7 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR117.1 cr (+86%) with partial Tulip consolidation; standalone EBITDA margin 4.3% and management sees no margin fix for six to eight quarters, with no capex beyond bridging.
calls.top: Debtor days stressed after March billing

calls.name: Triton Valves Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~15 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 group sales up ~38% YoY to ~186.5 cr with tax-credit-boosted PAT, but EBITDA margin compressed on copper pass-through and climate control is weak; no capacity discipline, capex raised to ~15 cr.

calls.name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Gold loan AUM: INR5,000 crores by FY27 end
calls.thesis: Cholamandalam Q1 FY27 shows 22% disbursement and 23% AUM growth with net credit cost down to 1.5% from 1.8%, but Stage 3 rose to 3.29% and management has no supply-side or capacity signal, so it is a credit-quality and growth read, not a capital-cycle read.

calls.name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Collections growth FY27: similar 25% to 30% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 20% to INR787 crores and EBITDA margin 35%, but collections (INR409 crore) and revenue (INR191 crore, +2% YoY) show a cash-led story; FY27 presales guided 25-30% growth, Dubai launch deferred.
calls.top: Presales up 20% YoY to INR787 cr

calls.name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 launch pipeline: around INR3,000 crores (Wadala boutique office ~INR3,600 crores single phase)
calls.thesis: Mumbai luxury/mid-market developer with Q1 revenue up 23% to INR320 crores and debt down to INR680 crores (D/E 0.47x), but Q1 sales of only INR146 crores and launches slipping, so supply-side evidence is thin.

calls.name: Vishnu Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Strontium utilisation: 65% to 75% by year-end (FY27 end)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 24.9% to INR433.4 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 15.1% from 16.1%; South Africa chrome mine still not producing, gross margin 44-45% vs 50% target by year-end.
calls.top: Freight cost ~20% of revenue in Q2

calls.name: Timken India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR929 crore (+15% YoY), PBT margin 16.2%, gross margin 39.9% up 100bp YoY; Bharuch ramp slow at ~INR50 crore quarterly revenue, near breakeven, with utilisation 40-45% on SRB lines.

calls.name: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: ₹1,500-1,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zydus Q1 FY27 revenue ₹80.2bn (+22% YoY), EBITDA margin 24.1%, FY27 guided at 24%+ margin and strong double-digit growth, with Saro launch costs and acquisition-driven opex rising in H2; supply-side signals are thin.

calls.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethanol capacity utilisation: 100-110% of existing capacity by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs91cr at 14.2% margin on strong ethanol realisations, but management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 10-11% and says Q2 is seasonally weak; capacity debottleneck to 100-110% by FY28 with no major capex until FY28.

calls.name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +24% to INR1,070 cr and EBITDA +57%, but standalone EBITDA flat at INR60 cr as India wage inflation squeezed ICM margin from ~15% to 13%; management calls it timing and guides held.

calls.name: Petronet LNG Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 and FY28 capex: INR 9,064 crore FY27; similar for FY28
calls.thesis: Petronet's Q1 FY27 profit rose 33% on trading and inventory gains (INR 301 cr and INR 193 cr) while Dahej utilisation fell to 66% on an expanded 22.5 MMTPA base, with Qatar force majeure still in place.
calls.top: Dahej utilisation 66% vs 92% a year ago

calls.name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Margin-led beat: NIM 3.20% (vs 3.07% Q4) and CD ratio 78.45% (vs 71.93% a year ago) show balance sheet turning, but management's answers on SMA-2 build-up (INR750 crore) and mid-corporate growth were evasive.

calls.name: R Systems International Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue Rs 601.7 cr (+30.2% YoY, +4.7% QoQ) with adjusted EBITDA margin 20.1%, but organic growth is muted and management gives no numeric guidance; growth is largely acquisition and rupee aided.

calls.name: DCB Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record PAT of INR 213 crores (+36% YoY) on cost-of-deposit down 14 bps and GNPA 2.43%, but CASA slipped to 21.65% and management admits growth relies on gold loans and a slow MSME ramp.
calls.top: Cost of deposit down 14 bps QoQ

calls.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
calls.thesis: Power Grid's Q1 FY27 PAT was flat at Rs 3,598 crore despite Rs 5,277 crore capitalisation; a Rs 560 crore regulatory drag and lower one-off interest weighed, with capex and capitalisation guidance intact.
calls.top: Regulatory drag Rs 560 crore on profit

calls.name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 realisation: similar to Q1, slight correction (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on ~80,000t output and ~INR120,000/t realisation, but FY27 volume guidance cut from 400,000t to ~380,000t on transformer and gas-cleaning constraints at KNR-2; Q2 prices guided flat to slightly lower.

calls.name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
calls.gLine: Store openings Q2: 28-30 stores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +13% to INR178.8 cr with SSG 4.04% and 667 stores; no supply discipline signal as store adds accelerate to 30 in Q2, and management reiterates INR1,000 cr FY27 target that needs ~18-19% growth.
calls.top: Q2 volume growth muted, H2 stronger

calls.name: JTL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Mangaon capacity addition: ~1 million tons by end H1 FY27
calls.thesis: Record Q1 volume of 118,513 t (+17.8% YoY) and company utilisation of 55% rising to ~65% by year-end, but EBITDA/t of ~INR4,954 includes a ~INR200 Defence boost; capacity goes to 2 Mt by FY28-29.

calls.name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
calls.gLine: Launch booking value FY27: INR3,000-3,500 crore across 6 launches
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 147% to INR432 crore and revenue jumped on one OC, but the read is a real-estate developer with no capacity or utilisation data; guidance held, OCF of INR81 crore vs full-year INR400-500 crore target.

calls.name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens rather than early teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19.1% to Rs 798 crore with EBITDA margin 31.0%, driven by CGHS price pass-through (2-3%) and mix; no supply-side capacity signal as management says capacity is never a constraint.
calls.top: Margin guide tilts to mid-teens growth

calls.name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
calls.gLine: ALOS: 3.9-4.0 days (not specified)
calls.thesis: Narayana Q1 FY27 shows India hospital margin expansion (~400 bps ex-clinics) on no new beds, but insurance, clinics and UK losses dilute consolidated margin; no numeric capex or guidance changes given.

calls.name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: AdTech platform reports Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 728m (+56.9% YoY) and PAT margin 16.1%, but no supply-side data; growth is company-driven with limited capacity or pricing disclosure beyond revenue per outcome of Rs 49.94.

calls.name: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Radiology PAT: INR6 crores PAT for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 24.3% to INR240 crores with EBITDA margin 32.2%; no capacity additions or capex cuts discussed, and specialty build-out is capex-light so far.

calls.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: A&P as % of sales FY27: similar to last year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.8% to Rs 2,235 cr and EBITDA margin +20 bps to 10%, but management admits ~Rs 200 cr primary sales lost to supply disruption; pricing covered ~80% of inflation and Q2 start is strong.

calls.name: Regency Fincorp Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended cost of borrowing: 11.5% to 12% for the year; ~12.5% by year end per one answer (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small Tier-2 MSME/digital NBFC; Q1 FY27 PAT ₹7.0 cr, secured book ₹230 cr, cost of funds guided down from ~13.25% to 11.5–12%, FY27 PAT target ₹25–30 cr, with no supply-side or capacity data disclosed.

calls.name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd
calls.thesis: Store adds targeted at ~15% of base annually with 15 of 85 FY26 openings leased; SSSG seen holding at FY26 level (7-8%) as quick commerce erodes metro throughput; DMart Ready cut to 11 cities.
calls.top: Metro SSSG saturation and quick commerce drag

calls.name: SIS Ltd
calls.gLine: Labour code EBITDA/PAT impact: accretive over next 3-4 quarters
calls.thesis: SIS Q1 FY27 revenue INR 4,604 cr (+29.7% YoY) with consolidated EBITDA margin 4.5%; flat QoQ, and labour-code wage pass-through is the main tailwind, but no supply or capacity signal.

calls.name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Direct distribution share: 70% to 72% in 1-1.5 years (1-1.5 years)
calls.thesis: MAS Financial Q1 FY27 shows steady 21% AUM growth and a 25% PAT rise, but credit cost has drifted up to about 1.6% and management is guiding to a wide 1.25–1.75% range rather than a firm number.
calls.top: Eligible demand dipped on energy-linked tightening

calls.name: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Base business EBITDA margin: 25% +/- 1% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Base business revenue INR307 cr (+24% YoY) with gross margin 51.3% and EBITDA INR72 cr, but ~INR30 cr of revenue is solvent cost pass-through and Ibuprofen still loses INR10-15 cr EBITDA each quarter.

calls.name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
calls.gLine: Depreciation FY27 increase: INR100 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes +9% YoY and EBITDA/ton up 3% QoQ to INR1,055 despite fuel shock, but absolute EBITDA fell 11% QoQ and Jaypee adds 5.2 Mt with a 7–8 quarter path to Dalmia-average margins.

calls.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% against 20-30% expected, PAT down to INR95 crore from INR111 crore as depreciation and interest hit before IPP revenue ramps; margins under geopolitical cost pressure at KP Energy.
calls.top: PAT margin FY27 guide to be lower

calls.name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: ARPOB growth: 4-5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,196 crore (+36% YoY) with IP volumes +26.6%, but Kondapur ramp, new-unit losses and a 50% occupancy base keep supply absorption the key test; ARPOB guided to 4-5% growth.

calls.name: Shriram Properties Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PBT margin: 8-9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 presales of INR484 cr (+10% YoY) and Rs1,560 cr handover pipeline, but Q1 revenue only INR271 cr (+4%) with PAT INR11 cr; FY27 is back-ended and margin recovery rests on handovers.

calls.name: Global Health Ltd
calls.gLine: Noida EBITDA breakeven: earlier than previous expectations
calls.thesis: Medanta Q1 FY27 shows volume-led growth (IP +28%, ARPOB +5%) and Noida EBITDA loss cut to INR49m from INR236m, but no capex cut, no numeric guidance and a 3,350-bed pipeline keeps supply expanding.

calls.name: Cyient DLM Ltd
calls.gLine: Book-to-bill ratio for FY27: 1.5x for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR2,598 cr order book and 1.5x book-to-bill with revenue up 34% YoY, but working capital days rose to 161 from 145 and free cash flow is negative.

calls.name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Iodinated intermediate commercial batches: positive trend by end Q2 or beginning Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR293 cr (+25% QoQ) on PI/API restart, but contrast media fell ~40% QoQ on ~INR30 cr goods-in-transit; plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent with capex ~INR250 cr in FY27.
calls.top: Goods in transit up ~INR30 cr QoQ

calls.name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 150-200 bps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth 32% with 30.5% volume growth, EBITDA near INR110 cr; inventory discipline (distributor stock under 30 days) and calibrated price hikes, but margin lift partly one-time and seasonal.

calls.name: INOX India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow: slightly above INR450-500 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR532 cr order inflow and INR1,686 cr order book, but Q1 revenue of INR382 cr missed the INR410-415 cr target and EBITDA grew only 1.4%; mgmt reiterates 18-20% FY27 growth.

calls.name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Store break-even: capex break-even in a year or less
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR121 crore (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 14.9%, but factory runs at ~50% utilisation and management is expanding stores (INR10 crore Surat capex) and shifting to gold metal loans, with EBITDA margin pressure and no segment profit disclosure.
calls.top: Gold metal loan shift to hedge inventory

calls.name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue: INR2,700 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 revenue up 20.7% to INR460 crores with EBITDA margin flat at 8.6%; capacity additions (Gujarat, heavy structure, Andhra Phase 2) ramp into FY27-28 while order book rose to INR1,864 crores and FY27 revenue guidance held at INR2,150-2,200 crores.
calls.top: Capex ~INR250 cr over 2 years, QIP upsized

calls.name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
calls.gLine: Bio-chem quarterly revenue: INR190 crore next quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Bio-chemicals revenue up 19.4% to INR168.7 cr with EBITDA up 53%, but consolidated EBITDA fell to INR2.6 cr (0.5% margin) as sugar/ethanol loss widened to INR14.6 cr.

calls.name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: at least 100 bps by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +23% to INR 3,708m and group EBITDA +29% to INR 2,238m (60.4% margin), with growth driven by LGD volumes; supply-side evidence is growers expanding capacity, but no IGI capex discipline discussed.

calls.name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: Mehru EBITDA margin: around 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins strong (gross 47.2%, EBITDA 25.2% reported, 28.3% ex-Ind AS 29) but capacity is ramping slowly: Sangli trials only this month, approvals ~six months, FY27 guidance held at 20% growth with no raise.

calls.name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: IoT revenue share FY27: 15% to 18% of revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 21.1% YoY but down 6.9% QoQ with gross margin 41.7% (from 44.5%) as COMC rose to 58.34%; management reiterates 8–12% revenue growth and H2-weighted margin recovery without numbers; capacity utilisation 65–70%.

calls.name: Advit Jewels Ltd
calls.gLine: B2B/B2C mix target: 40% to 50% on B2B, B2C also
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 37.9% to INR8.19 crore at 23.1% margin, but call is promotional with no capacity, utilisation or pricing data; B2C/store capex and franchise model still unformed.

calls.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: approximately INR950 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

calls.name: Banswara Syntex Ltd
calls.gLine: Garment revenue run-rate: about INR100 crore per quarter for next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4% with yarn utilisation at 70% and garment dispatches slipped; management holds FY27 INR1,450-1,500 crore guidance and a 12% EBITDA target, with INR140 crore capex sanctioned, while Q1 consolidated EBITDA was 9%.

calls.name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
calls.gLine: ESSEKAN premium PP yarn revenue: Rs 10 crore in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 59% YoY to Rs 22.19 cr on 31% price rise vs 18% raw material rise, but FIBC volume fell to 3,000 t versus 3,500 t a year earlier and four-week order visibility limits confidence.

calls.name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth: 23% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone sales up 21.2% YoY to INR 846 cr on volume, with EMD exports rising, but Abrasive margins are squeezed by oil-linked and fuel cost push and Foskor and Awuko exits remain unresolved.

calls.name: Heritage Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: high single digits (long term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18% to INR13,381m but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% as milk procurement rose 7% to INR46.61/l; no supply relief visible until the October flush, and pricing is being passed on.
calls.top: Milk price up 7% YoY to INR46.61

calls.name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: Alkaline market share: 25% to 30% exit share in 2 years (2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR407.7 cr (+9% YoY), EBITDA margin 15.1% on price actions, but alkaline Jammu plant just commissioned and management flags zinc inflation and possible further price/margin corrections.

calls.name: Saregama India Ltd
calls.gLine: New music content spend FY27: Rs 300-350 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 263.6 cr (+27% YoY), adjusted EBITDA Rs 112.4 cr (+69%); music vertical guidance of 20-23% growth and 60-65% EBITDA margin held, but no supply-side discipline evidence and content spend rising to Rs 300-350 cr.
calls.top: Music growth 20-23% and EBITDA margin 60-65% held

calls.name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 23% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR13,100 crore Q1 order intake (1.7x FY26 total) and INR18,618 crore order book (2.4x QoQ), but capacity is now the constraint, with utilisation said only to be "improving" and no numbers given.
calls.top: Q1 orders INR13,100 cr, 1.7x FY26 total

calls.name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
calls.thesis: Capex largely done (~Rs 350 cr FY27 guide), utilisation ramp to 75-80% before next capex; net debt cut to Rs 1,900 cr with Rs 500 cr reduction targeted this year, but margin gains partly offset by unpassed energy and shipping costs.

calls.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Tier 1 capital: No capital raise needed for at least 6 to 8 quarters
calls.thesis: Asset quality at an 8-year low (GS3 3.45%, credit cost 1.5%, ROA 2.4%) with AUM growth 13%, but wheels only ~11-12% and management is holding a ~INR 5,500 cr liquidity buffer and overlays against El Nino risk.

calls.name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR200-250 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 best-ever Q1 with EBITDA up 19.7% to INR170.58 cr, but gross margin fell ~140 bps on commodity costs; management pushed ~10% cumulative price and is still building a 1,000-crane tower capacity decision pending September.
calls.top: Full-year growth guidance deferred to September

calls.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Job Hai revenue: more than double from ~Rs.15 crores last year
calls.thesis: Naukri billings up ~17% (about 15% normalised) with pricing and new AI products carrying growth, but Shiksha billings fell 23% and 99acres is only near break-even; no capacity lens applies to this asset-light platform.

calls.name: Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Scaffolding volumes next two quarters: maintain or better Q1 volumes
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike is partly volume and rupee-driven; management refuses to raise sustainable margin guidance (Drum 30%, Scaffolding/Engineering 15%), and capex is maintenance-only this year, a supply-discipline positive.

calls.name: Redington Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 FY27 revenue: Expect good strong quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 34% to INR34,966 cr and PAT up 77%, but management says ESG growth is largely price-led stock-and-sell with channel holding 2-3 months of inventory, and Arena losses persist.

calls.name: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Capital markets FY27 growth: growth for FY27 as a whole
calls.thesis: Asset and private wealth now 55% of operating PAT (vs 42% FY25) with AMC AUM crossing ₹2 lakh crore, but wealth TBR revenue fell sharply YoY and alternates saw negative net flows in the quarter.
calls.top: AMC AUM ~₹1.9 lakh crore, up 34% YoY

calls.name: Jai Balaji Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Ferroalloy capacity utilisation: 80% to 90%
calls.thesis: DI pipe utilisation only ~30% on 5.5 lakh TPA with prices down 25-30% and no volume guidance, while ferroalloy utilisation above 80% and capacity expanding to 1.9 lakh MT, to be commissioned by Q3 FY27.
calls.top: DI pipe utilisation ~30% on enhanced capacity

calls.name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
calls.gLine: Keys exited FY27 (further): 300 to 400 keys over next 3 quarters (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Mahindra Holidays Q1 FY27 shows resort revenue up 10% to INR126 crores and occupancy 86.7%, but profit down about INR22 crores YoY, with ~400 keys offline and a loss-making European unit under strategic review.

calls.name: Quess Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Net headcount addition FY27: 30,000 plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Quess Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 4,182 cr (+15% YoY) with EBITDA margin 2.02%, but the Rs 176 cr Labour Code pass-through and Rs 261 cr tax refund flattered headline PAT; underlying General Staffing EBITDA ~1.5% margin, and capital-cycle signals are weak as this is a staffing business with no capacity to cut.
calls.top: Labour Code: Rs 176 cr one-time pass-through

calls.name: Sheela Foam Ltd
calls.gLine: Overseas EBITDA: combined EBITDA around INR120 crores; revenue above INR1,000 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin fell as raw-material volatility hit gross margin, but management leaned on foam volume and overseas gains; standalone volume only ~6% and no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating margin: 25% (not specified)
calls.thesis: Cable/broadband MSO with margins flat-to-down: consolidated EBITDA ₹109 cr (10.7%) and PAT ₹2.3 cr as D&A and finance cost rose ~₹6 cr; management guides HITS-driven margin uplift and ~₹400 cr capex with no hard ACT deal contribution numbers.

calls.name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Bank grew loans 23% and deposits 24% YoY with NIM 5.9% and credit cost 0.8%, but no capacity or supply signal; the quarter is demand-led growth in a bank, not a capital-cycle read.

calls.name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
calls.gLine: Astec revenue growth FY27: at least more than 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crop Care revenue fell 16.2% on a dry June and cotton herbicide weakness, while Oil Palm and Animal Nutrition grew; management still targets double-digit consolidated PBT growth, though it defers the number to end-September.

calls.name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty share of revenue: 45% from 40% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR 450 cr on volume (patients +10%, tests +11%) with no price hike; EBITDA margin 25.2% (+210 bps), but supply-side discipline is mostly absent as 500+ net centres are being added.

calls.name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth YoY: around 5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: CAMS Q1 FY27: EBITDA up 18% to INR183 cr with margin 46.4%, but non-MF margin fell to 13% on KRA price cut; management guides ~13% revenue and ~16% EBITDA growth for FY27 with cost growth held under 10%.

calls.name: Stove Kraft Ltd
calls.gLine: Induction cooktop share of revenue: at least 20% and a little above
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41.3% to INR480.6 cr and EBITDA margin 11.2% (+71bp), but growth is driven by a demand spike in induction cooktops; management is guiding to a 2x induction year and gross margin up at least 1% YoY with no capacity-discipline evidence.

calls.name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: ~INR300 cr FY27; INR200-250 cr FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 32.7% to INR2,423 cr but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 11.02% from 12.65%; FY27 growth guide held at 15-20% and margin at 10-11%, with order book ~INR25,300 cr.

calls.name: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 capex: INR950-1,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 realisation up INR320/t QoQ versus cost up INR230/t, EBITDA up INR90/t; management guides Q2 cost inflation near INR100/t, capex held at INR900 crore, and says East capacity is not needed until FY28.

calls.name: Brand Concepts Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~11% but PBT loss widened; management says PC plant at 80%+ utilisation, PP plant ramping, and sees inventory cut to ~130 days, with capex pause for two years.

calls.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
calls.gLine: OSAT + PCB FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR946 crore (+40% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.6%, but operating cash flow was negative INR259 crore on inventory build of ~INR177 crore and metering receivables rising to INR1,311 crore; margin pressure flagged as a multi-quarter issue.

calls.name: Landmark Cars Ltd
calls.gLine: Normalised EBITDA margin on new car sales: 1.5% (analyst framing, not confirmed by management) (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Auto retailer with a strong Q1 (revenue up 22%+, PAT nearly doubled) but no capacity discipline or numeric guidance; growth is volume-led, with a gross-margin definition shift and EV aftersales claims that management did not quantify.

calls.name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: 22.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Entero's Q1 FY27 shows EBITDA margin at 5.0% (+143bp YoY) and organic growth of 19.6% like-for-like, but it is a pharma distributor with no capacity-cycle signals; supply-side metrics are absent and the call leans on guidance reiteration.

calls.name: JNK India Ltd
calls.gLine: Chemdist revenue share FY27: 10% to 15% of JNK India revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 80.6% to INR 186 cr with EBITDA margin 11.8% after Chemdist JV loss; order book INR 1,801 cr, but Q1 is seasonally 10-15% of FY revenue and the Chemdist-driven margin dip plus a cancelled export order temper the read.

calls.name: Indegene Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 19% to 20% in H2 FY27; back by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Indegene Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.5% YoY in USD to $112.5m with EBITDA 16.9%; management reiterates 19–20% margin recovery by Q4 FY27, but this is a services firm with no capacity data and it is a services/pharma commercial business, so the capital-cycle read is thin.
calls.top: Margin recovery to 19–20% by Q4 FY27
themes: Gen AI in pharma commercial ops

calls.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost to income reduction: 30-40 bps a year (annual)
calls.thesis: Aadhar's Q1 FY27 is a steady housing-finance print: AUM up 18% to ₹31,364 cr, spreads held at 5.8%, but a cheque-realisation accounting shift cut disbursement growth to about 19% on a like-for-like basis and Q1 credit cost rose seasonally.

calls.name: Manba Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Two-wheeler NBFC grows AUM 22% YoY to INR1,731 cr with disbursements +37%, but QoQ AUM rose only ~1%, GNPA 3.41%, and management guides 35-40% AUM growth plus a planned INR100 cr preference-share raise.
calls.top: CAR fell from ~29.8% to 24.4%; INR100 cr pref raise

calls.name: Black Buck Ltd
calls.thesis: Platform growth steady (revenue from ops +42% YoY, adj EBITDA ₹55 cr +16%), but supply-side signals are absent; super loads still in heavy investment phase and fuel recovery uncertain.

calls.name: All Time Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: approximately 75% on 41,000 metric tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% QoQ to 6,323 t with utilisation 65% vs 52%, but gross margin fell to 39.5% from 41.9% on polymer cost spike; FY27 utilisation target 75% on 41,000 t.

calls.name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
calls.gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% within about two years
calls.thesis: Small-cap AI/ERP SaaS story with Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 689 lakh, EBITDA Rs 344 lakh; no capacity or pricing data, ZeroTouch has only pilot orders and 150 machines built, and the Rs 75 crore order book is unverified.

calls.name: Piramal Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Growth-book AUM up 32% with Growth RoAUM 1.9% (vs 1.5%) and PAT up 67% to Rs 461 cr; reads as a lender scaling without supply-side capacity signals, with early IT-salary stress flagged.

calls.name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 500+ crore, ~35-40% growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA 20.59%, +855bp) came from services mix shift, not volume; revenue up only 11% with order book ~INR 373 cr and FY27 target of INR 500+ cr (35-40% growth).

calls.name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: Own GPU deployment: ~1,500 GPUs by Jan/Feb 2027 (mid-to-end Q4)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.
calls.top: Sharon AI GPU billing slipped to Q3

calls.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.
calls.top: Acquisitions INR353 crores, down ~INR150 crores YoY

calls.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue FY27: USD 300 million internal guidance (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 25% to INR 5,533 crore with order book INR 72,258 crore, but Q1 inflow only INR 3,754 crore; management reiterates FY27 inflow above INR 55,000 crore, 15% growth and 28% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 revenue of INR 2,582 crore (+26%) with standalone EBITDA margin squeezed to 4.6% by war-led oil and forex costs and e-waste accruals; management gave no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Supreme Petrochem Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit rose on wide styrene-to-polymer deltas while volumes fell 24.5% to 70,842 t; management gave no volume guidance and is adding ~80,000 t of PS capacity by Dec 2028 (~INR 450 cr, internal accruals).

calls.name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
calls.gLine: Tractor industry FY27 volume: mid-single-digit growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume strong (domestic tractors +22.9%, share +36bp) but EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% from 13.1% on ~5% commodity cost hit; price hikes lag cost, Q2 cost pressure of 1.5-2% more, FY27 industry guided mid-single-digit growth.

calls.name: Novartis India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue doubling in 4-5 years (organic base): ~2x in 4-5 years
calls.thesis: Post-takeover Novartis India is rebuilding its commercial model: M&A-led growth, ~INR40–50 crore extra quarterly costs from Q2 and a margin dip, with no supply-side capacity signal.
calls.top: Incremental cost INR40-50 crore per quarter

calls.name: Flomic Global Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Momentum for 3-4 quarters, no number
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.4% to INR120 cr and EBITDA margin up 275bp to 9.34%, but management attributes most growth to freight rates (volume only +6-7%) and gives no capacity or capex data, so the read is cyclical freight-rate tailwind rather than supply-side evidence.

calls.name: Shriram Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Growth next quarter: more than 15% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Shriram Finance Q1 FY27 is a lender with excess post-capital liquidity, not a supply-side story; NIM 9.04% guided to fall to ~8.5% medium term, AUM growth 15.26% YoY, full-year 18% growth guidance held.

calls.name: Ugro Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Closing AUM FY27: flat
calls.thesis: Opex cut to ~INR 119 cr/qtr (from 217) and ~INR 2,551 cr disbursements, but on-book interest income fell 13% QoQ and co-lending/DA income halved to INR 75 cr; capital-cycle reset is real yet earnings quality still in transition.

calls.name: Greenply Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak debt / D/E: ₹710-730 cr; 0.75x at FYE then 0.65-0.7x (FY27)
calls.thesis: Greenply Q1 FY27 volumes grew double digits (ply +13.8%, MDF +24.7%) but utilisation fell to 92-93% and management admits lost sales; new MDF flooring line started 20 July with ply/MDF capex ~₹500 cr this year.

calls.name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
calls.gLine: Bauxite EBITDA per ton: USD 5.5-6 near term (Next 1-2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Guinea bauxite volumes fell to 2.34 Mt from 3.16 Mt in Q4 as freight shock hit; EBITDA/t rose to $6.3 from $5.9, but management guides ~$6 near term and expects no capex-led supply response.
calls.top: Bauxite volumes 2.34 Mt, down from 3.16 Mt

calls.name: City Union Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: NIM: 3.65%-3.70% next few quarters (next few quarters)
calls.thesis: Secured-lending bank with GNPA down to 1.73% and PCR 85%, but supply-side signals are absent (no capacity lens); credit growth 25% QoQ-headline with utilisation falling 73%→70% and NIM guided 3.65–3.70%.

calls.name: Apar Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 profit on oil-division inventory gains (INR94 cr provision still left INR329 cr EBITDA), while conductor volumes fell 6.7% on customers deferring clearances; supply discipline and guidance not discussed.

calls.name: Tips Music Ltd
calls.gLine: Content budget FY27: INR90-100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR106.51 cr (+21% YoY) but PAT down 4% to INR43.89 cr as full new-release content cost (up 90%) was expensed upfront; management holds 20% revenue/PAT growth and 65-70% annual EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year revenue growth: exceed guidance significantly
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated volume +9% and revenue +19%, but India gross margin fell ~450 bps on LPG/kerosene/LABSA cost spikes; management says India normative margins return by H2 and guidance is held or exceeded.

calls.name: Punjab National Bank
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 47%-48% by end of FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: PNB Q1 FY27 shows NIM recovery (domestic 2.61%→2.64%) and cost-to-income down to 50.31% from 55.31%, but growth is supported by shedding low-yield IBPC and corporate loans, and no supply-side capacity signal applies.

calls.name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
calls.gLine: P&A volume growth FY27: over 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Radico posted record Q1 FY27 volume of 10 million cases and 20.7% EBITDA margin, with P&A volume up 36% and FY27 P&A guidance raised to 25%+, but no capacity addition is planned and the ENA supply position is comfortable.

calls.name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Express pre-Ind AS operating PBT margin FY27: 5% to 6%
calls.thesis: Allcargo Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.2% to INR546 cr with Express yield up 6.4% and volume up 6.7%, but the supply side is unchanged: no capacity addition or capex cut, just INR10-15 cr express upkeep and ~INR20 cr CL capex.

calls.name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +12.3% cc YoY with margin 12.4% but a healthcare BPaaS deramp (~1-1.5% of revenue) and INR717m exceptional charges; FY27 guidance held, no capacity signals.

calls.name: JSW Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt / EBITDA: below 5x by 2030 (FY30)
calls.thesis: JSW Energy added 873 MW organic-plus-acquired capacity in Q1 (about 1.1 GW YTD) toward a 3 GW FY27 target, with net debt/TTM EBITDA at 4.95x, but hydro generation fell about 26% YoY and PAT declined.

calls.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: Apollo 8 mt EBITDA per ton: INR6,000 per ton (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~20% QoQ to 745,000 t, but EBITDA/ton held ~INR5,500 on price discipline; management reiterates 20% FY27 EBITDA growth and 15–20% volume growth, with July volume ~300k t.

calls.name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 14% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue fell 9% to INR282 crores on West Bengal election labour disruption; management held FY27 30% growth and 14–15% margin guidance, which needs ~INR1,400 crores in the next nine months.

calls.name: NBCC (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue: INR 13,000-14,000 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA up 62% to INR 160 cr (margin 8.77%) on marketing fees, but revenue grew only 10% and order inflow of INR 1,700 cr lags the INR 18,000-20,000 cr targeted for next 2-3 quarters.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethnic portfolio revenue growth FY27: 20% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,026 cr (+11%) and EBITDA margin 8.2%, with TCNS like-to-like only ~2% and a sizeable TMRW loss; no capacity or supply-side signal, and cost inflation of ~4% is flagged to hit Q2–Q3 margins.

calls.name: Skipper Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 order inflow: INR7,000 crores plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Skipper Q1 FY27 revenue +4.5% to INR1,310 cr with exports weak and 75,000 t capacity slipping to H2; reiterates 15% FY27 growth and INR7,000 cr order inflow, which needs a sharp H2 ramp.

calls.name: PNC Infratech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 34% to Rs1,518 cr with 24.7% EBITDA margin, but NHAI show-cause notice on Lucknow-Kanpur toll road, weak highway awards (107 km) and 110 NWC days temper the read.
calls.top: NHAI show-cause notice on toll road

calls.name: Gujarat Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Morbi minimum volume: 1.8-2 mmscmd floor (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gas-trading EBT of INR726 crores on Brent-linked contracts and Morbi volume surge; management holds INR1,100 crore FY27 trading guidance, which looks conservative against the quarter.

calls.name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: Quarter-on-quarter growth similar to recent quarters (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 16.29% (from 5.87%) on mix and efficiency, but management still guides 10–12% sustainable; utilisation 64% in FY26 while a 3,550 MTPA expansion is announced, with cost pass-through of raw materials.

calls.name: Varun Beverages Ltd
calls.thesis: Volume up 19.8% and India up 14.4% in H1-quarter, but management gave no capacity-discipline signal; margin cushioned by early raw-material stocking and a Twizza mix drag of 76 bps.

calls.name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT of INR 25.4 cr (INR 21.4 cr ex tax-refund interest) on 23% revenue growth; contract logistics gross margin diluted 46 bps on start-up and manpower costs, with management guiding Express EBITDA breakeven this year.
calls.top: Contract logistics GM down 46 bps YoY

calls.name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year EBITDA per MT: INR 24,000 to INR 25,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA hit INR 252.5 cr, EBITDA/MT INR 35,458, but management guides the rest of the year to INR 21-22k/MT, implying a sharp normalisation; volume guidance held at 6-8%.

calls.name: Synergy Green Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation of new 45,000 t: 80% for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 utilisation of new 45,000 t capacity at 66% and PBDIT margin 7%, with FY27 guidance of 500 cr revenue (33% growth) and +300 bp margin resting on a sharp Q2-H2 ramp.

calls.name: AAVAS Financiers Ltd
calls.gLine: Disbursement growth: 22-23% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 disbursements +41% Y-o-Y and NIM up 22 bps to 7.70%, but management now expects spread to fall below 5% for the year on PLR cuts and a home-loan push; no capacity or supply signal in a lender.

calls.name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR 20,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 9.62% YoY to INR 4,300 crore and EBITDA margin 3.99% vs 2.08%, but order inflow of INR 5,417 crore is thin against a INR 93,492 crore book and management guides ~15% revenue growth with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
calls.gLine: Business disbursements FY27: INR6,000-6,500 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 microfinance recovery: AUM up 11% QoQ to INR4,887 crores, annualised credit cost 2.1% vs 3.2%, NIM 12.5% vs 9.9%, PAT INR12 crores vs INR5 crores; no capacity or supply signal in the call.

calls.name: 360 ONE WAM LTD
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 49-49.5% in Q4; ~100-150 bps improvement for FY27 (Q4 FY27 / FY27)
calls.thesis: Wealth flows strong at Rs 13,379 cr and CTI guided to 49-49.5% in Q4, but asset management net flows negative on one institutional outflow and retention down to 74 bps from 78.
calls.top: Wealth flows Rs 13,379 cr vs Rs 6,957 cr

calls.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ROA: 1.8% to 2% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ujjivan SFB Q1 FY27: PAT Rs317 cr, ROA 2.2%, ROE 18.2%; FY27 ROA guidance raised to 1.8-2% and credit cost trimmed to 0.9-1%, but opex deferral and rising ticket-size and pricing pressure make the lift partly timing.

calls.name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR248 crores (+18% YoY) with CDMO +29% to INR207 crores, but Trade Generics fell to INR30 crores after codeine exit and management gave no numeric guidance; Plant 6 due end-H1 with ~INR1,100 crores revenue capacity claimed.
calls.top: Trade Generics INR30 crores after codeine exit

calls.name: Tarsons Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Panchla/Amta contribution to standalone revenue FY28: 20-25% of standalone revenue (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +21% YoY to Rs 86 cr standalone with gross margin down to 67.1% on 25-50% input cost spikes; capacity still commissioning with debt at Rs 380 cr gross and no major capex planned.

calls.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Fresh order inflows FY27 over and above negotiated: around INR2,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR116 cr (+17% YoY) and EBITDA margin 27% against 35-40% guidance; order book INR920 cr with INR1,726 cr negotiated but unconverted, so supply-side visibility rests on unsigned orders.
calls.top: Order book INR920 cr vs negotiated INR1,726 cr unconverted

calls.name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year SSG: high single-digit SSG for balance 9 months (analyst framing, management said 'fair understanding')
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

calls.name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS EBITDA margin (supply phase): 6% to 8% (initial phase)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA crossed INR100 crores at 10% margin on war-driven export price premium; utilisation fell to about 66% as 48,000 t Bhiwadi XLPE capacity ramps slowly, with FY27 volume growth guided at 15%.

calls.name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
calls.gLine: Advantek revenue: Rs 140 cr plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated engineering supply Rs 421 cr (+21% YoY) with EBITDA Rs 69.8 cr, down from Rs 77 cr QoQ on a raw-material pass-through lag; capacity expansion at Bhayla and China continues.
calls.top: Raw material up ~8% YoY, pass-through lagged

calls.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 small finance bank with 22% advances growth, NIM up to 4.21% and PAT up 29%, but no supply-side levers; growth is loan-led and profitability gains rely on deposit repricing that management says is largely done.

calls.name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
calls.gLine: Garmenting EBITDA margin: no firm guidance; double-digit is an endeavour
calls.thesis: Garmenting grew 50% to INR296 crore with EBITDA margin 7.3% and plants full till December, but branded apparel grew only 4% and EBO network shrank 34 net stores; no capacity added, store cuts ongoing.

calls.name: Arkade Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 new launches GDV: ~INR 3,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with pre-sales up 9% YoY to Rs 155 cr and FY27 launches of ~Rs 3,000 cr; no capacity/supply metrics, and margins guided to fall to 25-26% EBITDA from ~19%.

calls.name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

calls.name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak FY27 borrowing: around INR130 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32% to INR78.4 cr with 15.3% EBITDA margin, but receivables of INR149 cr and borrowings rising from INR68 cr to INR91 cr make working capital the swing factor against the INR1,000 cr FY28 target.

calls.name: Glottis Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Exceed FY25 revenue (FY27)
calls.thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder whose revenue rose 39.5% YoY to Rs 2,345m while TEUs fell to 21,841 from 26,278, so growth is price/mix-led, with EBITDA margin 6.9% and no capacity-discipline evidence beyond its own fleet build.

calls.name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR350-450 crore (indicative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 VAR up 18.4% to INR13,816m but EBITDA margin fell to 17.9% on non-indexed commodity inflation; capacity tight (ART above 90%, CAPT above 80%) with capex INR350-450 crore indicative.

calls.name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Ltd
calls.gLine: Hub breakeven: within 3 months (per hub)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.1% to ₹19.4 cr while EBITDA margin fell to 12.5% from 29%; management reiterates 30% FY27 growth and a 10-hub build-out, with no volume or pricing split given.

calls.name: OnEMI Technology Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of borrowing: minimum 100 bps reduction over next three quarters (next 3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Kissht AUM up 61% YoY to INR 8,001 cr with credit cost cut to 6.80% from 8.85%, but revenue margin fell 249 bps and management leans on unverified 40% ROA-style delivery and falling cost of funds.

calls.name: Cipla Ltd
calls.thesis: Cipla Q1 FY27 revenue INR7,119 cr (+2% reported, ~4% adjusted for presentation change); EBITDA margin 16.7% vs FY27 guide 18.5–20% held, with US exit-rate $1bn dependent on new launches.

calls.name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 deco price increase: additional ~3% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 paints call: pricing ~5% consolidated with industrial price hikes still under negotiation, deco volumes low single digit by choice; FY27 margin 13-14% guided to be held, capex INR601 crore over ~2 years with ROCE target ~18%.

calls.name: India Glycols Ltd
calls.gLine: IGL Spirits EBITDA FY27: >INR500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated net revenue up 9% to INR1,130 crore and EBITDA up 13% to INR170 crore, but a Clariant-dividend-free quarter, a demerger-driven restructuring, and unquantified aspirations make supply-side evidence thin.

calls.name: Century Enka Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: over Rs 100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.5% flattered by Rs 46.24 cr one-time inventory gain; management reiterates 7-10% normalised margin, capacity flat until FY28, utilisation 85-90%.
calls.top: Inventory gain Rs 46.24 cr flatters quarter

calls.name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Trade sales share: upwards of 75% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 cost per tonne fell INR206 to INR4,241 and FY27 cost guidance of INR4,250 held, but volumes fell 7% y/y with capacity utilisation near 65% as management chose price over volume.

calls.name: EIH Ltd
calls.thesis: Hotel supply additions are slow; Q1 RevPAR rose ~13% and EBITDA margin fell to ~29% on Rajgarh ramp-up, renovations and marketing, while Kolkata and Grand timelines slipped.

calls.name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Exports share FY28: 35%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR242 crore (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity-discipline signal, margin pressure from steel/aluminium and wages, and forging guidance cut from ~INR400 crore to ~INR340 crore.
calls.top: Forging FY27 revenue cut to ~INR340 crore

calls.name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
