calls.gLine: Deliveries FY27: 2,500 units by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 15% YoY to INR 173 crore on flat INR 7,500/sq ft pricing, while blended margin fell to ~9% and management guides only modest growth with no new land buys.

calls.name: TANFAC Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6% to INR187 cr with EBITDA margin 15.3% squeezed by sulphur and power costs; HFC-32 (20 kt) commissioning targeted Q3 FY27 with 65% of capacity contracted, but no supply-side discipline evidence beyond a planned INR1,500-1,700 cr capex runway.

calls.name: Onward Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Time and material mix: 80% to 90% T&M for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue hit a record INR 151.2 crore (+11.5% YoY, +8.7% QoQ) and EBITDA margin rose 113bp QoQ to 12.3%, but there is no capacity or utilisation disclosure and management reiterated only double-digit growth.
calls.top: Order book/ACV exceeds last year's revenue

calls.name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: Tariff/price recovery: Price correction to flow towards end of Q2 and fully in Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~23% (7pts FX) and EBITDA up 28%, with growth mostly volume-led; raw material up 5-6% vs 3-4% assumed, with price correction only from late Q2 and fully in Q3.

calls.name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
calls.thesis: Blue Dart's Q1 FY27 growth was mostly yield-led: tonnage up ~7% and shipments ~2%, with management citing GPI and loss-lane price corrections, while air volume grew only ~2.6% and no capacity guidance was given.

calls.name: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: good double-digit (~10-11%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 6.8% from 10.9% on ~20% RM spike; management guides 10-11% FY27 margins and 8-9% further price hikes, but supply-side discipline is absent given Rs.4,980 crore expansion and Rs.500-700 crore debt rise.

calls.name: Indian Overseas Bank
calls.gLine: Credit cost: 0.35% to 0.40% full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 profit of INR 1,659 crore (+49% YoY) helped by PSLC and recoveries; GNPA 1.33% and NIM 3.37%, but corporate book fell 10% QoQ after pricing exit.
calls.top: Yield on advances up ~10 bps QoQ

calls.name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone EBITDA margin: double-digit for the year (aiming)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin rebounded to 10.3% from 3.8% on 26% fewer batches and headcount cuts, but COGS up ~2pp from war-driven input inflation, US sterile plant still unaudited, and Europe/emerging primaries slipped.

calls.name: Sasken Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Borqs break-even: about 12 million quarterly revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹339 Cr up 24% YoY with software services margin up 240 bp to 30.6%, but Product Solutions margin fell to 5.9% and operating cash flow stayed negative; no supply-side signal.

calls.name: Central Bank of India
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: reduce by 1.5% to 1.6%; target below 56% (next year)
calls.thesis: Bank-level growth is strong (advances +28.6% YoY on a low base, NIM 3.06%, GNPA 2.60%), but quarter-on-quarter advance growth was only 2.85% and no bank-industry supply discipline is evidenced; the read is demand and underwriting, not supply.

calls.name: Renaissance Global Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital release: approx INR250 crores in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +30% to INR690 cr and PAT up ~280%, but management is deliberately exiting INR300-400 cr of low-return customer-brand revenue to cut working capital by INR250 cr; growth guided lower.
calls.top: Revenue run rate to fall INR400 cr

calls.name: TD Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order inflow INR7.34bn (+87% QoQ) and FY27 guidance raised to INR2,600 crore, but capacity for FY28 is only ~INR22bn plus ~INR0.5bn debottlenecking, with the expansion timing for FY29-30 explicitly left undisclosed.

calls.name: TCI Express Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: 11% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Volumes up 7.5% to 2.5 lakh tonnes and EBITDA margin 11.7% vs 11.5%, but the price-hike story is fuel-led and only one month (June) lands in Q1; FY27 guidance of 100–150bp margin expansion and 20–25% PAT growth is management-set, not supply-side evidence.

calls.name: Prime Fresh Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15.7% to INR81.71 crores and EBITDA margin 9.83%, but management itself flagged one-offs, guides EBITDA 7-7.5%, and receivables are about a third of sales with INR7-8 crore slow-moving debtors.

calls.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 VoNB up 29% to INR14.1bn but margin fell to 26.2% on a one-off GTI group contract (about 60bps drag per management); IRP growth 14% and management reiterated 26–28% margin guidance.

calls.name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 APE +9%, VNB +9% to INR 879 cr at 25% margin; growth prioritised over margin, guidance held (industry-in-line growth, VNB ~ APE growth) with HDFC Bank channel share recovering but channel still subdued.
calls.top: Competitive intensity in bank channel mellowed

calls.name: Orient Electric Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 23.5% with EBITDA margin 7% (+102bp YoY) despite gross margin falling to 29.8%; management refused a gross margin guide beyond the 32-34% aspiration amid commodity inflation.

calls.name: Indostar Capital Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Vehicle-finance NBFC with disbursements up 44% YoY to INR1,235 crore and PPOP flat at INR93 crore, but PAT of INR11 crore rests on the old book running off over 2-3 quarters rather than on current-book evidence.

calls.name: MSTC Ltd
calls.gLine: TReDS platform operationalisation: Within FY27, subject to RBI approval (FY27)
calls.thesis: MSTC's Q1 FY27 e-commerce revenue rose to Rs 89.49 crore (vs Rs 70.03 crore), but no supply-side capacity signal exists; the asset-light auction platform's growth relies on scrap cycles and unapproved new verticals (EPR, TReDS) awaiting regulatory go-aheads.
calls.top: E-commerce revenue Rs 89.49 cr vs Rs 70.03 cr

calls.name: Laxmi Organic Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej Phase 2 capitalisation: 85% of Phase 2 capex capitalised in Q2 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR9,683m (+40% YoY) and EBITDA INR1,143m (+272% YoY) on price/mix and ~10% volume, but Essentials margins are cyclical and Dahej Phase 2 ramp slips to Q4 with working capital rising.

calls.name: Rolex Rings Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 21% to 22% (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4.3% to INR304 cr on labour-constrained output (utilisation 63-65%), with export auto components up ~30% and FY27 guided to mid-teens growth, EBITDA margin 22.6%.

calls.name: Devyani International Ltd
calls.gLine: KFC SSSG (medium term): 5% to 6% (medium term)
calls.thesis: QSR franchisee Devyani posted record Q1 FY27 EBITDA of INR 255 crore (16.1% of revenue on its KFC/own-brand basis per call), with KFC SSSG +3.3% but Pizza Hut still shrinking (-2.2%) and no capex or capacity signal; supply-side read is neutral with store additions modest at 11 net KFC.

calls.name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
calls.gLine: PVC-VCM spread: EBITDA neutral at $120-130; PBT positive another $20-30
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss of INR115 crores on high-cost VCM; management sees PVC-VCM spread near $160 from September but gave no numeric profitability guidance, with CMCD order book and R32 ramp as offsets.

calls.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Insurance revenue growth: 15-16% through the year, rising in FY28
calls.thesis: Star Health Q1 FY27 shows underwriting profit Rs 111 crore (vs Rs 16 crore) and CISR 97%, but management gave no loss-ratio guidance and the story rests on retail pricing and claims levers rather than any supply-side signal.
calls.top: Underwriting result Rs 111 cr vs Rs 16 cr

calls.name: Medplus Health Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~22% but EBITDA margin fell to 3.5% on private-label mix, provisions and labour cost; capex put on hold while store additions held at 800 net.

calls.name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens to ~16%+ growth, delivered quarter-on-quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue grew ~12.5% on 7.7% volume, but a 3-4 day plant/dispatch outage and labour exodus hit April-May, EBITDA margin ~13.5%, and management guides FY27 margin 13-13.5% with no new price hikes until Diwali.

calls.name: KFin Technologies Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: 17% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY (ex-Ascent ~10%) but EBITDA margin fell to 34.2% with Ascent (39.4% ex-Ascent); yield down ~2% QoQ on debt-to-liquid shift and a provisioned renegotiation.

calls.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order execution cycle: 16 to 20 weeks
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR8,197m (+172% YoY) and PAT margin 10.3%, but inventory days jumped 86→110 and management declined to guide new capex, with a possible enabling resolution for working-capital equity or debt.

calls.name: SBFC Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Branch additions: 10-15 branches in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: SBFC held spreads at 9.48% (+39 bps QoQ) and ROE at 14.73%, but AUM growth slowed to 6% QoQ, 0+ DPD rose 70 bps, and management is cautious on sub-10 lakh borrower leverage.

calls.name: Cello World Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 527 cr with 22.2% EBITDA margin on price hikes of 12-13%, but volumes fell in Consumer Ware, steel SKUs cut from ~150 to ~20, glassware utilisation stuck at ~60%, and no FY27 guidance given.

calls.name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Paramount claims migration: balance claims and operations on Medi Assist stack within Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 20.3% (up from 17.1% in Q2) with revenue up 24.1% and retention at 90.2%, but no capacity or capex angle; margin recovery to ~23% is pushed to end-FY27.

calls.name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Hotel keys by end FY27: 3,149 keys (12 hotels, 472 keys pipeline) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator with 92% occupancy and 8% revenue growth, but PAT fell 14% on finance costs and tax regime; supply is expanding via owned capex (~Rs 1,140 cr) while ADR growth is only 2% and pressure from West Asia disruption.

calls.name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt by end Q2 FY27: close to INR 1,450 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +22.8% to INR 2,580 cr with international +34.2% carrying growth; India only +10.2% and management guides India acceleration without capacity or supply-side signals.

calls.name: Sagility Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 organic growth 14.9% cc with low double-digit FY27 guidance held, but margin guidance 24-25% held despite 120bps minimum-wage hit; no supply-side capacity data, so read is demand-led with cost pressure.

calls.name: VMS TMT Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% annually (annual)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% y/y to INR247.88 cr but EBITDA fell about 41% on imported scrap cost and forex; TMT utilisation near 80%, with management guiding margin recovery only from Q3.
calls.top: EBITDA down ~41% y/y on scrap costs

calls.name: Shiprocket Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset-light shipping and D2C enabler: core transactions +31% with core EBITDA margin 12.8% (+50bps YoY) and emerging EBITDA improving to -24% from -38%, but no capex or supply lever to read.

calls.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Bajaj Finance Q1 FY27 was strong: record ₹37,000 cr AUM addition, ROE 20.4%, and loan loss to AUF 1.54% (1.31% ex ₹296 cr overlay), but management held guidance and no capital raise is planned.
calls.top: Record ₹37,000 cr AUM added in quarter

calls.name: John Cockerill India Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating expenses (other expenses): slightly less than current quarter's ~INR70 crore
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue ~INR149 crore (+82% YoY) but down sequentially; order book ~INR4,500 crore consolidated after ~INR1,200 crore wins, with margins hit by early-stage project costs.

calls.name: RSWM Ltd
calls.gLine: Power & fuel savings FY27: ~₹40 Cr from efforts; ~₹100 Cr target (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 10% QoQ to ₹94 Cr (8.0% margin) on gross margin expansion to 39.8%, with utilisation in the mid-90s for yarn but fabric demand and margins weak and export volumes down.

calls.name: Ashok Leyland Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: rising over next 2-3 years; INR900-1,000 cr in last 2 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record revenue of INR9,634 cr (+10% YoY) but EBITDA flat at INR970 cr and margin down 100bp to 10.1%; inventory buffer masked commodity hit, Q2 guided as peak cost quarter.
calls.top: Commodity cost hit ~50% offset by price

calls.name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable growth in general medicines and vaccines: 8% to 10% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15% to INR924 cr (about 9-10% underlying ex-CMO base), PAT up 24% (17% ex one-off), volume +3-3.5%, price ~6%; opex spike to be front-loaded and moderate.
calls.top: Innovation sales 7% of revenue vs 4% last year

calls.name: Tata Consumer Products Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +12% to INR5,349 crores with EBITDA margin 13.6% (+70 bps), but India tea volumes +2% amid 7-10% tea cost inflation and India margins contracting on timing mismatch; growth portfolio +36% and FY27 margin guidance of 50-70 bps reiterated.

calls.name: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail revenue (ZECODE+DEVO): INR160 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 16.4% to INR466 crore and PAT up 144% to INR11 crore, but retail build-out (ZECODE/DEVO) drags FY27 EBITDA ~150 bps, with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.
calls.top: Inventory build ahead of festive season

calls.name: IFB Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Engineering capex: INR110 crore for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.65% to INR 1,529 crore with PBDIT margin 5.79%, but management could not pass through commodity or forex costs, and gross margin fell about 160 bps.
calls.top: Commodity and forex not passed on

calls.name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Mid-teens annual volume growth: mid-teens over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Tilaknagar's Q1 FY27 volumes and NSR rose, but EBITDA margin fell to 14.5% adjusted on glass inflation, with net debt rising to Rs 2,100 crore and a March 2027 target of Rs 1,700 crore.

calls.name: Nava Ltd
calls.gLine: 100MW solar commissioning: by end of September 2026
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record consolidated income of INR1,269 crores led by Zambia power (MEL 89.3% PLF), but Phase 2 thermal slipped to Q2 FY28 and metals sales dipped on Orissa shutdown.
calls.top: Phase 2 commissioning slips to Q2 FY28

calls.name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt: gross debt to ~INR1,000 crores, net ~INR800 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Volumes up ~20% and EBITDA up 22% to INR197 crores, but capacity utilisation sits at only 65-70% and management says no major capex for 2-3 years, so the supply-side picture is loose-to-balanced.
calls.top: Utilisation 65-70%, no new capacity for 2-3 years

calls.name: JM Financial Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ex-provisions after minority was flat at INR302 crores; Private Markets revenue doubled to INR462 crores on lumpy ARC resolutions while Capital Markets revenue fell to INR115 crores from INR182 crores.

calls.name: Hikal Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 14% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr, EBITDA margin 9.2%, Pharma EBIT margin 3.2% at ~55-60% utilisation; crop volumes recovering but China pricing pressure persists and FY27 guide of 14-16% growth and 25-30% EBITDA growth is back-half weighted.
calls.top: Crop pricing under pressure from China

calls.name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Eugia FY27 revenue: around 500 million plus, single-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Solid Q1 FY27 with revenue up 16% to Rs 9,150 crore and EBITDA margin 21%, but supply signals are mostly investment-phase expansion (TheraNym, Lannett, China) with revenue from biosimilar CMO only from 2028.

calls.name: Seamec Ltd
calls.gLine: ANANT acquisition and deployment: Acquisition by end of Q1; deployment in Q3 (ONGC contract) (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 41% to INR 297 cr consolidated with ~42% EBITDA margin, but growth rests on Seamec ANANT acquisition (USD 70m, 50-50 equity/debt) and redeployment, with no fleet-addition capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.
calls.top: Fleet growth via USD 70m vessel buy

calls.name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
calls.gLine: Tax rate: Normalise around 25%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR469 cr (+43% YoY) and 30% EBITDA margin, but management gave no numeric guidance, gross margin dipped on raw material costs, and capex is being held back in Biologics and Albumin for three years.
calls.top: No significant Biologics/Albumin capex for 3 years

calls.name: Zydus Wellness Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: about 25% including deferred; cash 12-15% of 25% this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales INR 14,299m (+66.7% with Comfort Click consolidation); domestic grew only 4.6% as seasonal brands fell 12% and Nycil was hit by rain, with no supply-side or capacity signals discussed.

calls.name: ICICI Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT ex-treasury up 20.9% to ₹18,975 crore with NIM 4.36% and net NPA 0.35%, but management gave no loan or deposit targets and FCNR(B) leverage remains undisclosed.

calls.name: Jindal Steel Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt to EBITDA: below 1.5x (Q2FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 consolidated adj. EBITDA INR 2,667 cr (INR 11,937/t, +INR 1,843/t QoQ) on 15% lower volumes; ASP up INR 7,500/t and value-added share 61%→66%, but Q2 long-product prices falling and FY27 volume guide held at 10.5–11 Mt.
calls.top: NSR up INR 7,000/t flats, INR 4,500/t longs QoQ

calls.name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
calls.gLine: Q4 operating margin: upwards of 15% (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +6.6% cc YoY with margin at 14.4% and FY27 target of 15%; but Q1 was flattered by a one-time European auto pull-forward (~1–1.3% hit next quarter) and no capacity signal, so it is a demand-and-execution read rather than supply-side tightening.

calls.name: Vodafone Idea Ltd

calls.name: Lupin Ltd
calls.gLine: US revenue FY27: USD 1.1-1.2 billion
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record quarter (revenue INR 8,277 cr, +32%) but management guided US sales to USD 250-280m per quarter and FY EBITDA margin to 24-25%, signalling a sharp step-down from Tolvaptan and Mirabegron generic competition.

calls.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% to INR11,337 cr with EBITDA margin 4.80%, but growth is largely price-led (foods pricing ~12% vs volume ~5%), no capacity signal, and staples EBITDA negative at INR-59 cr.

calls.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
calls.gLine: India PV volume growth FY27: higher double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tata PV volumes up 46% to 182k with 14.3% share, but India EBITDA flat at ~4% as 4.5% commodity hit offsets gains; JLR PBT fell to GBP109m and Q2 commodity hit guided at 3%.
calls.top: Commodity hit 4.5% in Q1, ~3% more in Q2

calls.name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP annual PLF / generation: better than FY26 (415 crore units)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹478 cr (+9.4% YoY) flattered by ₹110 cr one-off regulatory benefit; no FY27 guidance given, with management pointing to better July power prices (₹5/unit IEX vs ₹4.20) and hydro recovery.

calls.name: Supreme Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~14% to 1,57,536 t on polymer-driven channel destocking, yet management reiterated 12–13% FY27 volume growth and 14–14.5% EBITDA margin, with July described as "excellent growth".

calls.name: Centum Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: EMS margin: about 10-11% EBITDA
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 11% to INR205 cr with order book ~INR1,800 cr (+31%) and Q1 margin soft at 11.3% EBITDA; overseas exit done, but supply-side evidence is thin and the FY27 25%+ growth target is reiterated without numbers for the quarter.
calls.top: BTS order inflow +150% to INR120 cr

calls.name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: at least 20%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (~19-23% EBITDA, ~15% PAT) rests on MES cost cuts and automation, with Beryl still near break-even; FY27 Rs 240-250 cr reiterated and FY28 Rs 300-350 cr targeted contingent on an unannounced acquisition.
calls.top: Work on hand Rs 4.5m civil vs 3.7m

calls.name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
calls.gLine: Brand-building spend FY27: INR 85 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.5% on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% (vs 13.1%); management attributes ~4.35pts to one-offs and reiterates 13.5–14% FY27 margin and 18–20% growth, with sanitaryware utilisation at just 61%.

calls.name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
calls.gLine: Other income: around Rs. 30 crores annualised (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 279 cr (+19% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 52 cr (+29%, margin >19%) on 24% volume growth, but standalone slowing, no capacity signals, and cotton inflation flagged as a margin headwind.
calls.top: Cotton inflation may hit GP margins

calls.name: KNR Constructions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,200–2,300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of 15% was flattered by a one-off ~INR46 crore cash-surplus claim; ex-one-off margin ~5.5%, with receivables stretched (Telangana ~INR1,300 crore) and FY27 revenue guided INR2,200–2,300 crore.

calls.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: US generics growth FY27: mid to high teens (INR) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Alembic Q1 FY27 revenue up 26% to INR2,150 cr with US generics guidance raised to mid-to-high teens, but US branded Pivya drag caps margin near high teens and no capacity additions were discussed.
calls.top: US generics guidance raised to mid-to-high teens

calls.name: AvenuesAI Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR 11,000 to 13,000 crores (~35%+ growth) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Payments-to-AI-fintech pivot: gross revenue up 109% but net revenue down 3% on take-rate compression, with EBITDA margin gains driven by expense cuts and FY27 EPS guided flat at INR 8.75–9.5 as incremental cash is reinvested into AI.
calls.top: Take rates compressed; net revenue down 3%

calls.name: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue: INR1500 crores (FY30)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 sales above INR700 crores at 26-27% EBITDA margin, but the case rests on unfiled-to-approved registrations, a 208-day debtor cycle and hormone/biologics revenue not in guidance; supply-side evidence is thin.

calls.name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
calls.thesis: Life insurer VNB up 24.9% to ₹5.71bn with margin 26.7%, but growth is protection-led while non-par and agency lag; management gave no guidance and called margin 'not a fixation'.

calls.name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex FY27: Rs350 Cr for TI; Rs100 Cr Shanthi Gears; Rs600-700 Cr group
calls.thesis: Standalone margins squeezed by steel inflation in Q1 FY27, with management expecting full recovery via lagged price pass-through; engineering volumes up 17% and standalone PBT down to Rs213 Cr from Rs222 Cr.
calls.top: Steel price recovery lagged, full catch-up expected

calls.name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
calls.gLine: Debtor days: 30 days target (next couple of years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes fell 7% YoY to 40,729 MT with utilisation only 52-53%, but margin rose to 13% on mix; management says channel restocking resumed and capacity is ahead of demand.

calls.name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of funds rest of FY: around 7.5%
calls.thesis: Microfinance credit cycle turning with slippages down to INR92 crores (from INR106 crores) and CGFMU claim of INR387 crores lifting coverage; PSL one-off (~INR46 crores) flatters Q1 ROA of 1.6%, which management guides lower for Q2-Q3.
calls.top: Slippages INR106 cr → INR92 cr QoQ

calls.name: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: double-digit (10-12%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Radiant's standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on manpower costs, with price revisions of unspecified size only under IBA negotiation (targeted Q2); no capacity signal, and the cash-in-transit peer pricing remains unproven.

calls.name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit cost: 3% to 3.5% (as we go along)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 net loss narrowed to INR34 crore with GNPA 5.9% and credit cost 2.3%, but JLG growth of 5% YoY and the 25-30% loan growth target keep the recovery unproven.

calls.name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: Current level or around it, for most of the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on a one-off spread spike: gross spread INR 28,145/KL vs INR 8,274 normal, with management hoping margins hold for 1-2 quarters; supply-side signals absent, capex plan pending.

calls.name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: approx INR100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR465 cr and PAT INR9 cr on domestic volume growth of 37%, but EXIM freight spikes, 111 working-capital days and an unchanged 4.1% EBITDA margin show pricing has not been passed through.
calls.top: EXIM freight 3-4x; no price hike discussed

calls.name: Swiggy Ltd
calls.gLine: Quick commerce contribution margin: 0 to -100 bps (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Swiggy traded contribution margin for growth: CM guided to 0 to -100 bps from -0.2% last quarter, with 4-week NOV growth of 10% versus 1% prior, while monetisation lifts take rate; supply-side signals (store adds) are growth-driven, not discipline.

calls.name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR359 crore (+49% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 21.07% from 26.65%, and management cut FY27 margin guidance to 21-22% while working capital remains "bloated"; no capacity-discipline signal.

calls.name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 3.3% and PAT was a Rs7.9 cr loss as new Dahej capacity sits idle ahead of commercial ramp; management gave no FY27 numbers, deferring guidance to calendar year-end.
calls.top: Dahej capex ~Rs265 cr of Rs270 cr capitalised

calls.name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin FY27 and FY28: 12-13% (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 17% on raw-material spikes and Remember India consolidation, with management guiding 25-27% for FY27 and FY27 revenue of 350-400 crore, unverified against an 87.6 crore first quarter.

calls.name: Meesho Ltd
calls.thesis: Meesho says logistics cost per delivered order fell about a rupee QoQ despite fuel and wage hikes, but NMV growth slowed to 2% QoQ and NMV per seller is down about 25% YoY.
calls.top: Cost per delivered order down ~Rs1 QoQ

calls.name: Bata India Ltd
calls.thesis: Bata Q1 FY27 turnover Rs979 cr (+4%) with 130bp gross margin gain, but management flagged 5-6% raw-material cost push, a 2,000-store EBO base and A&P rising to 3-3.5% of sales; no numeric forward guidance given.

calls.name: Exide Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +17.6% and EBITDA margin 12.4% (+20bp YoY) on broad volume growth; lithium-ion ramp is the main capex story with utilisation guided at 25-30% and Rs1,400 cr FY27 capex approved.

calls.name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: Strive for double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue +13% to Rs11,049m but EBITDA margin 11.8% on SPP UK services drag; standalone revenue +9% with management reiterating double-digit FY27 growth, while inventory build and 5.4% standalone order growth temper the read.
calls.top: Stock adjustment Rs82 crore in Q1

calls.name: Nestle India Ltd
calls.thesis: Volume-led FMCG growth story with ad spend up ~40% and capex on MAGGI/Munch lines; no numeric guidance, management declined to forecast and said margins will be maintained, a soft read on near-term outlook.
calls.top: Capacity short: ran out, adding more

calls.name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: low double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +11.9% to INR521 cr with consolidated order intake +23% and open book INR1,518 cr, but MHE margin fell and FY27 guidance is only low double-digit revenue growth as input-cost pass-through slows conversion.

calls.name: WPIL Ltd
calls.gLine: JJM receivables realisation: Substantial inflow in Q2
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue INR501 cr (+32% YoY) and 15% EBITDA margin, but standalone domestic projects starved of Jal Jeevan funds: INR43 cr revenue and 5% standalone EBITDA margin, with INR300-350 cr receivables unpaid in Q1.

calls.name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy Sudarshan growth: 12% to 13% (FY2027)
calls.thesis: Acquired Heubach/Clariant pigment group posted business EBITDA of Rs128 Cr (6-7% margin) with guidance of EUR700m turnover and EUR35m EBITDA held, not raised, pending Q2; volume growth unclear and supply discipline not discussed.
calls.top: Working capital stretched by safety stock

calls.name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethanol revenue FY27: same as last year
calls.thesis: Branded IMFL volumes up 40% to 0.79m cases, but ethanol realisations fell to ~INR54 (breakeven INR57-60) amid oversupply, dragging consolidated EBITDA margin to 11% from 14%.

calls.name: Pennar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue and profit growth Q1 to Q2: double-digit growth (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 3.6% to INR884.55 cr while PBT rose 16% to INR46.8 cr; mix improving but PEB India margin hit, legacy steel/rail shrinking, and cash tied up in working capital.
calls.top: PEB India margin drop >200bps, steel pass-through lag

calls.name: Emami Ltd
calls.gLine: Start-ups revenue FY27: INR750-800 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% to INR1,039 cr and EBITDA +6% to INR226 cr, but input costs up 360bps and management guides to offset via pricing; no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: INR5,000 crores in three years (FY29) (FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37.9% to INR859 cr and volumes up 57.6%, but EBITDA margin ~9.6% on ~10% YoY raw-material and realisation squeeze; capacity build (0.5 GW, 2.2 GW) with utilisation at 63%.
calls.top: EBITDA impact ~10% YoY from costs and realisation

calls.name: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Realisation per kg (Q2 FY27 range): Above 700, possibly 720-750
calls.thesis: Capacity-constrained egg powder exporter at near-full utilisation; realisation ~Rs770/kg (vs Rs722 prior), but management sees no volume growth until new capacity and feed costs squeeze margins for two or more quarters.
calls.top: Utilisation near full, no volume room

calls.name: Vaibhav Global Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue: INR5,000-5,500 crore
calls.thesis: Reported growth flattered by INR25 crore US tariff refund and FX; constant-currency revenue broadly flat, with Q1 EBITDA margin 11% helped by one-off. FY27 guidance of 9-11% reiterated.

calls.name: Engineers India Ltd
calls.gLine: Consultancy turnover growth FY27: at least 10% growth on INR3,850 crore base
calls.thesis: Consultancy-led margin story: Q1 FY27 PBT up 55% to INR145 crore on consultancy segment profit of 24%, but turnkey revenue fell to INR302 crore from INR449 crore and order inflow was only INR514 crore against an INR8,000 crore annual target.
calls.top: Q1 order inflow only INR514 crore

calls.name: Yes Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year advances growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Clean Q1 FY27 with NII up 17.5% and ROE 8.3%, but supply-side read is thin: no capacity framing, the capital raise is only an enabling resolution, and NIM at 2.7% is still far below the 3%+ aspiration.

calls.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA per kg: INR44-45 for full year (aiming), exceed INR42-43 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per kg rose to INR46.7 (vs ~INR40.7 FY26) on Hyderabad unit consolidation and mix, while volume grew only ~6% as lube fell 17% on base-oil shortage; price pass-through of raw material held.

calls.name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
calls.thesis: Domino's LFL slowed to 2.5% in Q1FY27 with price hikes and LPG/cheese inflation absorbing margin; supply-side capex held at INR750-900 crore with supply chain investment past peak.

calls.name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin trajectory: 10-15 bps blended improvement every quarter as Ahmedabad ramps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth and margin improved (EBITDA +26.7%, margin 12.07%, +99bps) on micro-irrigation volumes and solar pump orders, but polymer costs up 30-35% and working capital is stretched into H2.

calls.name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: more than 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR945 crore (+11% value, +3% volume) with EBITDA margin 7.4% vs 7.7%; no capacity-discipline signal, core flagship volumes down 2% and B2B pricing pressure acknowledged.

calls.name: CL Educate Ltd
calls.gLine: VIRSA revenue growth FY27: 45-50%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell about ₹17.5 crore on a full-quarter basis while cost cuts of about ₹18 crore lifted EBITDA margin to 16.6%, but PAT stayed negative and test prep volumes are still churning.

calls.name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: RTE share of volume: at least 20% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 7.1%) came from price, not volume: realisation ~INR930/kg (+15%) while shrimp volume fell to 2,624 MT from 3,015 MT and utilisation stayed ~38%.

calls.name: Matrimony.com Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 Matchmaking billing and revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Matchmaking EBITDA margin rose to 26.9% and PAT grew 127% YoY to Rs 19.1 crore, helped by deferred revenue from 1-year plans; Q2 guided to double-digit billing and revenue growth and similar-to-slightly-higher profit.

calls.name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year EBITDA margin: around 20% (management said 15% and 20% in different answers)
calls.thesis: Software vendor, not capital-cycle relevant: Q1 FY27 revenue +11% to INR357 cr, PAT +26%, but implementation revenue fell ~25% Y-o-Y on delayed project starts, and India growth stalled with a 4-5% cost base rise.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
calls.gLine: Alternate (PMS/AIF) revenue contribution: similar range, ±1-2% in coming quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 AMC shows average AUM up 42% to ₹6.28 lakh crore on EPFO/ESIC mandates, while equity yield guided at 63-64 bps and ESOP lifts employee cost by ~₹10 crore a quarter.

calls.name: One 97 Communications Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term EBITDA margin: 15-16% terminal margin cited by CEO; 15-20% range referenced (medium term)
calls.thesis: Paytm's Q1 FY27 call is a consumer and fintech growth story with no capacity or supply signals; management cites 8% EBITDA margin, 15-20% medium-term target, and cash build to ~INR 13,500 crore, with no hard numbers on UPI MDR.

calls.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
calls.gLine: Solvency: 2.42% pre-dividend; ~2.32% after dividend
calls.thesis: LIC's Q1 FY27 VNB margin jumped to 22.9% (from 15.4%) and VNB rose 61% to ₹3,136 crore, but ~2.9% assumption gains and a GST input-credit expense hit (−1.9%) flatter the margin, and APE grew only 8.2%.

calls.name: Updater Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Facilities and BSS services business with 9% revenue growth to INR764 crores and 5.5% EBITDA margin; no capacity or capex story, growth is labour-led and pass-through, with weak IFM margin of 4.5%.

calls.name: Tata Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue $175.4M (+4.3% QoQ, +25.2% YoY cc) with EBITDA margin 16.1%; management reiterates double-digit FY27 growth but gives no supply-side (capacity or capex) signals and margin ambition is softened.

calls.name: Mach Travel Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR144.33 cr (+538% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 6.09% from 7.17%, management admits markup cuts for aggressive market share and working-capital strain requires bank OD.
calls.top: Working capital strain, bank OD being sought

calls.name: Carraro India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: up to 10% YoY if situation stabilises (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to INR5,447m but EBITDA margin 10.4% on unrecovered commodity and freight costs; management guides pass-through over 12 months with no quantified margin target beyond ~50bp uplift.
calls.top: Commodity cost gap not yet recovered

calls.name: Belrise Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (company): mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing revenue +20% YoY to INR21,979m but EBITDA margin 11.5% and mgmt offers no supply-side data; capacity expansion (four new facilities) and INR17,000m QIP deployment point to a capex-heavy, acquisition-led growth phase.
calls.top: Four new facilities ramping, fixed costs ahead of revenue

calls.name: HDB Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Business loan book growth: turn positive from Q2, growth from Q3
calls.thesis: Consumer-led NBFI with record Q1 PAT ₹785 cr (+38% YoY) and Stage 3 down to 2.34%, but book growth 11.3% YoY and Asset Finance growth still weak; management refuses to guide credit cost beyond ~2.3%.

calls.name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross sales up 5.7% to INR 641 crore with PAT up 52%, but growth is lumpy and management reaffirmed 20% FY27 growth without supply-side evidence; ILM down about 60% as budgets shifted to DCI.

calls.name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with revenue up 20% YoY to INR116.2 cr on yield gains (TER-to-BER shift, cost control) while quarterly average AUM grew only 7% and management sidestepped flows, SIP attrition and market share.

calls.name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
calls.gLine: TMT sequential growth next quarter: healthy sequential growth (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 20% YoY but only 9% in constant currency, with TMT down 22% and growth ex-TMT at 37%; margins expanded (adj. EBITDA 16.8%) but there is no capacity or pricing signal, and the CFO is exiting.

calls.name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 20% (plus or minus 5%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.
calls.top: Capex INR200-250 cr per year for 2-3 years

calls.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +22.2% on 11.3% underlying volume growth with price hikes of 2–12%; gross margin fell 90bp to 52.5% yet EBITDA margin rose to 26.4%, flattered by low-cost inventory that management says will unwind in Q2.
calls.top: Low-cost inventory benefit to unwind in Q2

calls.name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
calls.thesis: HUL delivered 10% USG (5% UVG) with EBITDA margin ~23% inside guided range, but capacity and supply signals are absent; growth is demand-led with palm-oil-driven soaps volume down and no capex commentary.

calls.name: Britannia Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 9.5% with volume near 9% and June exit in mid-teens after dual-pricing disruption ended; but LPG, palm oil and sugar inflation only half offset by price, so margin defence is uncertain.
calls.top: Price offset only half of inflation

calls.name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
calls.gLine: GNPA retail FY27: sub-4%, NNPA sub-2% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Vehicle NBFC shifting to retail with co-lending wound down; GNPA cut to 3.94% via ARC sale of INR203 crore at ~45.6% valuation, while AUM guidance of INR4,000-4,200 crore for FY27 is reiterated and pre-tax ROA of 2.5% is far above the ~1% now.

calls.name: Praj Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Praj GenX EBITDA breakeven: by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Praj's Q1 FY27 shows order intake of INR 10 billion and backlog of INR 45.9 billion, but first-gen ethanol greenfield slowdown, funding delays and rising material costs keep conversion and margins weak.

calls.name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic market growth FY27: flat to 6-7% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 38% to INR18.4bn and EBITDA 25.1% held in mid-20s guide, but order intake fell 30% to INR11.4bn and two large RPT orders (INR3,000cr on hold, INR1,300cr unbooked) slipped.

calls.name: DCM Shriram Ltd
calls.gLine: Caustic soda ECU price: INR30,000 or higher
calls.thesis: Chemicals revenue up 33% with ECU up 7% and utilisation at 82%, but PVC volumes fell 25% on a duty waiver and Chinese imports; Q1 PAT ex one-offs up 28% to INR147 crore.

calls.name: Vimta Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 13.7% YoY to INR1,129m with EBITDA margin 36.4%, but flat QoQ, food testing hit by Middle East trade disruption, and management declined to give utilisation numbers.
calls.top: Food testing hit by trade disruption

calls.name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA: 1.25% plus
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit fell to INR424 crore on higher standard-asset provisions and costlier bulk deposits used to fund competitive corporate lending; management kept FY27 guidance (NIM ~3.5%, GNPA <2.25%) but signals credit growth of 18-20% and a 1.25%+ ROA.

calls.name: Datamatics Global Services Ltd
calls.gLine: 3-year revenue target: About INR 3,000 cr over 3 years, from ~INR 2,000 cr (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.9% to INR 513.9 cr and EBITDA margin up 343 bps to 19.7%, but no capacity or capex signals; growth tied to AI deal wins and management reiterates high-single-digit FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Page Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +7.9% and PAT -4% on ~3 days of undelivered billing and input costs; management reiterates double-digit FY27 volume and 19-21% EBITDA margin, with a May price hike (2.2%) only partly covering input inflation.

calls.name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
calls.gLine: Services export growth: around 7.5% growth, expected to remain at this level
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 CV brake-systems maker grew sales 9.3% with CV>6T volumes +8.6% and aftermarket +15.6%, but reported PAT fell 14.7% on a prior-year FX gain; margins squeezed by aluminium and pass-through lags.

calls.name: Globus Spirits Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing ran at a record 89% utilisation with no capacity adds planned, and margin guided at INR5–7/litre; growth in ENA and P&A is funded from internal cash flow.

calls.name: D. B. Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Newsprint price outlook: Up in Q2; expected to fall from Q3 and Q4
calls.thesis: Print ad revenue up ~10% to INR 4,320 mn and EBITDA margin up 250bp to 26.1%, but circulation fell to ~38 lakh copies and realisations are flat while newsprint rose ~13% YoY.

calls.name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to ₹218 cr and PAT up 29% to ₹72 cr, but Q1 pre-sales only ~₹290 cr against a ₹5,000 cr two-year target; no capacity or supply metrics apply.

calls.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Combined leverage (Net Debt/EBITDA): 1.9x-2.5x at close, to 1x by FY2030
calls.thesis: Persistent is buying Nagarro for EUR1.27bn EV (9.12x EBITDA) on debt, plus a ~$125m annual net-new deal; no capacity or supply signal, so this is an M&A and deal-wins story, not a capital-cycle one.

calls.name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin trajectory: Tough in Q2, easing over Q3 and Q4 (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR341 cr (+28%) with EBITDA margin 24.7%, but management guided gross margin under more stress in Q2 from high-cost inventory and gave no numeric guidance; supply-side signals are thin.

calls.name: Rushil Decor Ltd
calls.gLine: Jumbo laminate utilisation FY27: 55% to 60% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 7.9% on resin and freight inflation; MDF utilisation 66% and jumbo laminate utilisation only 29%, with management pointing to 55–60% for the year but no numbers in the guidance box.

calls.name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
calls.gLine: US subsidiary break-even: break-even in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT margin fell to 15.7% from 23.5% on weak domestic mix, freight-delayed exports and low-margin NTPC CO2 storage order; order book up only 5.1% to ₹21.8bn, management guides full-year growth but no numbers.

calls.name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 orders hit a record INR 915 crore but EBIT fell to INR 32 crore on commodity-driven gross margin squeeze from legacy fixed-price orders; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing actions are yet to fructify.
calls.top: Gross margin hit by legacy fixed-price orders

calls.name: Repco Home Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 disbursements: Rs1,200-1,250 Cr (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Housing finance lender (Repco) with Q1 disbursements flat YoY at Rs843 Cr and spread guided down 10-12bp on BT-out defence; supply-side signals absent, asset quality improving only slowly.

calls.name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: Rs 1,250 cr, possibly Rs 1,350-1,400 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 280 cr on 25% lower chemical volumes and fertiliser volume down 13%; management guides FY27 Rs 1,250 cr (possibly 1,350-1,400) while Unit 5/6 capacity is added and acid plants are run at low load.

calls.name: Maximus International Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: above INR 200 crore (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

calls.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Telecom revenue FY27: INR6,700-7,000 crore
calls.thesis: Dixon's Q1 FY27 revenue rose to INR15,557 crore but margins compressed on PLI-1 expiry and input pass-through; management guides no margin recovery this fiscal, with recovery pushed to FY28.

calls.name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 non-cash ESOP cost: INR79 crores to INR80 crores
calls.thesis: HDFC AMC Q1 FY27: QAAUM up 13% to INR9.35tn with share 11.2%, but debt outflows and a TER-to-BER shift held yields and margins flat-to-up; no capacity or capex lever applies to this asset manager.
calls.top: Debt QAAUM outflows, debt AUM down 6% QoQ

calls.name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Non-convenience fee: return to INR150 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.1% to INR1,370 crore led by catering (+34%), but EBITDA fell 2.8% to INR386 crore and margin dipped to 28.2% on one-offs, HR cost and a 30% resin-driven squeeze in Rail Neer; no supply-side capacity signal from IRCTC itself.

calls.name: Borosil Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27 (ex other income): about 18%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9% to INR253.6 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 14.6% from 17.8% on West Asia fuel/packaging inflation (~INR10 cr hit); price pass-through lags into Q2, and FY27 capex guided INR125–150 cr.

calls.name: Epigral Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term growth: 15% to 20% CAGR over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +15% to INR709cr and EBITDA margin 25% (vs 27%), but chlor-alkali ECU fell to ~INR31-32k from INR35-36k and CPVC utilisation ~50-55% with new CPVC capacity coming, while management adds epoxy and MPP capex of INR600cr.

calls.name: CMS Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: about 27% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 services revenue INR625cr, INR25cr short of plan from a cash supply squeeze (currency fulfilment ~70% then ~80%); FY27 revenue guide trimmed but EBITDA margin guide raised to ~27%.

calls.name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
calls.gLine: A&SP spend growth: ahead of revenue growth in FY27
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15.3% to INR701 cr on volume-led water purifier growth, but service bookings softened after 3–12% AMC price hikes and adjusted EBITDA margin fell 46bp to 10.5%.

calls.name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 2,072 crore (~90% YoY) and PAT INR 31.9 crore, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing disclosure; growth attributed to buffalo meat exports with unexplained other income surge.

calls.name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 revenue growth YoY: 9% to 11% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported growth of 25% is mostly acquisitions and a lapping RECO contract; organic constant-currency growth is 5% YoY and 2.9% QoQ, with FY27 high-single-digit guidance and margin 18-20%.

calls.name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
calls.gLine: DICE revenue: INR15-16 cr FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zaggle Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 28% to INR423 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 8.2% from 10.1% as capitalisation was reversed into P&L; cash-flow fix is a 15-18 month story with no numbers.
calls.top: Capitalisation moderated, costs pushed to P&L

calls.name: TBO TEK Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from operating leverage on a travel platform with no capacity cycle; Middle East flat, Europe +24%, and management gave no hard numeric guidance beyond "QoQ and YoY growth" aims.
calls.top: Take rate lower in tough quarter

calls.name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT: INR40 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹7.6 cr on payments GP ₹77 cr and lending GP ₹43 cr, but payments revenue dipped as card-linked categories were paused; UPI GMV is non-monetised.
calls.top: Net payments take rate 12-14 bps guided

calls.name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +18.7% to INR 3,727 cr with 10% SSG and gross margin up 28.4%→28.7% on lower promotions, but no capacity-discipline signal; store adds (27) and small-format rollout keep expanding.

calls.name: Allcargo Global Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost base (employee and admin) in USD terms: flat over coming couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.
calls.top: LCL and air volumes up about 5% QoQ

calls.name: Park Medi World Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Rs.2,080 crores (+24%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity is ramping to 4,740 beds by FY27 and 5,740 by FY28 while occupancy fell to 56% from 68%, so supply is outrunning demand; FY27 guidance of 24% revenue growth and ARPOB +10-12% is management's case.

calls.name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: INR130-150 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 159% to INR45.18 crore with PAT up 42% to INR6.3 crore, but management gave no capacity data and receivables rose to about INR100 crore, with EBITDA margin falling from 40% to 20% year-on-year.

calls.name: Kusumgar Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: similar to FY25-FY26 levels, moving a few percentage points (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.

calls.name: Laser Power & Infra Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest saving on debt repayment: ~INR40 crore per year at PBT level
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +15% to INR5,215m and EBITDA +26% to INR659m, but finance cost absorbed 55% of EBITDA; capacity utilisation cited at 62% (manufacturing), with no new capex guidance and a stated focus on utilisation.

calls.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

calls.name: Titan Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 jewellery margin of 10.9% was flattered by ₹407 cr customs-duty gain and 75-80 bps MTM gains that will reverse; management held the ~11% centre-of-gravity margin and double-digit growth targets without new numbers.

calls.name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Casting volume growth: 15%+ overall; castings 17-20% (remaining 3 quarters of FY27)
calls.thesis: Casting volumes up 19% and pig iron output up 5% with pricing improving, but tube sales down 14% and power-cost regulation hurting; supply additions are heavy and capex guided to Rs 600-700 crore this year.

calls.name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
calls.gLine: EBIT margin: Sequential ramp toward Q4, no numeric target
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,021 crore, up 6.5% YoY constant currency, but EBIT margin fell 330 bps QoQ on one-offs and onshore ramp costs; management guides to recovery over four quarters without a number.

calls.name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Record quarter on Hormuz-driven tanker spike, but management is holding cash, replacing rather than expanding fleet, and says new orderbook is rising (crude tankers 27%) so supply risk is building.

calls.name: Zuari Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Zuari Agro ICD repayment: INR258 crore in current quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell to INR31.3 cr from INR36.9 cr and PAT was a loss of INR9.5 cr; profit depends on Dubai repatriation (INR142 cr received of ~INR900 cr guided) and a sugar price rally that is not yet in the numbers.
calls.top: Sugar prices up 10% in a month

calls.name: Schaeffler India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q2 revenue up 17.5% YoY to INR 2,681 cr with EBITDA margin 19.1%, but working capital rose to INR 2,029 cr on planned inventory build and FCF weakened; capex held at ~INR 500 cr CY26 plan.
calls.top: Working capital up to INR 2,029 cr

calls.name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: around 19.5% for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursements beat at INR 2,609 crore (+29% YoY), but rundown rose to INR 1,857 crore, so AUM growth stayed ~10.8% against a 14% FY target; spread 2.83%, NIM 3.81%.

calls.name: Himatsingka Seide Ltd
calls.thesis: Home-textile maker pivoting to yarn, fabric and apparel verticals while Sheeting utilisation sits at 52% and revenue fell to INR634 crores from INR661 crores; no numeric guidance, so the read is a transition with volatility ahead.

calls.name: Bank of Baroda
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 underlying profit ~5,528 cr ex a USD 600m NMC settlement that cut reported PAT to 1,278 cr; guidance held but full-year ROA guidance withdrawn, ECL transition ~110 bps CRAR hit ahead.

calls.name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Seaways EBITDA margin Q2: 25-30% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~9% with standalone ~7% and EBITDA margins flat; supply-chain growth slowed, Seaways bunker costs compress margins, and guidance (10-12% freight, 12-15% supply chain) rests on H2 pipeline.

calls.name: Birlasoft Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 effective tax rate: 29% to 30%
calls.thesis: Birlasoft Q1 FY27 revenue flat in USD ($145.2M, +0.3% cc QoQ) with TCV up 20% YoY to $168.7M, but management refused any numeric guidance and pricing pressure is squeezing revenue conversion.

calls.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry tariff architecture: ARPU growth of 4-5% a year over 5-7 years (5-7 years)
calls.thesis: Telecom pricing is still the lever: ARPU Rs.264 with no tariff hike, but capex is rising into data centres and homes FWA churn is hurting quality of adds.

calls.name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000 crore to INR10,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft at INR774 crore on execution delays, with 22.9% EBITDA margin and INR1,800 crore cash; management targets about 15% growth, closer to 15% than 20%, and order book slipped to INR18,700 crore.
calls.top: Q1 revenue soft; order book declined

calls.name: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: ICONIQA annualised revenue break-even: ~INR 85 cr (FY27)

calls.name: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest outflow FY27: about INR75 crores (FY27)

calls.name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM, income and PAT: approximately double in 3 fiscal years (3 fiscal years)

calls.name: Maan Aluminium Ltd
calls.gLine: Pithampur Italian line contribution: significant contribution by mid of next year
