calls.name: Gravita India Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper capacity: double to around 60,000 MTPA in next 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Lead volumes fell YoY as Gulf supply disruption left utilisation near 50%, yet copper ramp and margin mix drove revenue +42% and EBITDA +29%; new lead capacity sits idle on scrap shortage.

calls.name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Core EBITDA margin: 1.2% to 3% in 1-3 years (1-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR753 crore on weaker freight car execution, with EBITDA margin 10.8% and order book INR9,923 crore; supply-side signals are mixed, with freight car output of 1,054 units and no capacity commentary.

calls.name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Digital apparel retailer with no capacity-discipline signal; Q1 revenue +22% to INR 66 cr with EBITDA margin 13.07%, but growth was bought via marketing and wholesale aggregator sales, and a fire-insurance claim keeps debt elevated.
calls.top: Finance cost ~3x YoY on working capital

calls.name: Sharda Cropchem Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 5%-10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +9% to Rs1,074 cr with volume -1.6% and FX +12.7%; Europe volumes fell on distributor destocking, while gross margin rose 120 bps to 36.7% and FY27 guidance held.

calls.name: Ceinsys Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR158 crore (+1% YoY) with margin up to 24.4%; order book INR990 crore but management refused all forward guidance and UBR/cash conversion remains weak (164-day working capital cycle).

calls.name: S Chand and Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs1,145m (+12% YoY) with EBITDA loss Rs97m; management reiterated 10–15% growth and 17–19% EBITDA margin guidance, while stockpiling ~25% of annual paper needs ahead of price rises, lifting working capital.

calls.name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
calls.gLine: RTM volume growth: 25-30% CAGR (CEO gut feel) (medium term)
calls.thesis: IEX Q1 FY27 volume rose 16% to 37.5 BU and PAT 134.8 crore (+12%), but the Grid India market-coupling order threatens the core DAM franchise and management gave no timeline.

calls.name: CSB Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Wholesale growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit up 27% YoY to Rs150cr with NIM 3.66% and ROA 1.09%, but management guides FY27 NIM ~3.75% and ROA 1.3-1.5% while gold stays ~50% of book and bulk deposits ~52% of term deposits.

calls.name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Credit-card cycle turning: gross credit cost down 301 bps YoY to 6.5% and PAT up 20% to INR664 crores, but receivables only +3% YoY and management gave no numeric guidance.
calls.top: Gross credit cost 6.5%, down 301 bps YoY

calls.name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Sunbeam Q4 EBITDA margin: mid-teens (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Capex rising to ~INR 1,500 cr (standalone ~1,000 + DR Axion 430 + Sunbeam maintenance) with Powertrain at ~70% utilisation and Aluminium above 80%; supply expansion is management's own call, with Hosur capacity pending orders.

calls.name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: NODWIN organic growth FY27: 30%+
calls.thesis: Gaming revenue up 14% to INR 275 crore with 19.5% EBITDA margin, but margins are deferred by UA spend and Bluetile margin fell to ~11%; the $303m all-cash Bluetile deal and a funding gap make this a capital-allocation story rather than supply-discipline.

calls.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 20%-25% per year over 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager reports 24% PAT growth (ex-fair-value) to INR116 crores with 1.1 lakh crore AUM, but supply-side levers are absent and about a quarter of the FY27 guidance is a function of mark-to-market gains.
calls.top: AMC licence application approved by Board

calls.name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 128% YoY to Rs 23.14 cr with 55.4% EBITDA margin, but no capacity or supply metrics; pipeline flat at ~$80m after $15.3m conversion and debt-funded working capital raises balance-sheet caution.

calls.name: Redtape Ltd
calls.gLine: New store openings FY27: 150+ stores (aspiration)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 19.4% to INR47 crore on 3.7% standalone revenue growth, driven by no price hikes and retail mix; e-commerce fell to 22% of sales from 30% as management refused deeper discounting.

calls.name: National Securities Depository Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Operating leverage to normalise margins: normalised margins over medium term
calls.thesis: NSDL Q1 FY27 standalone PAT up 7.9% to INR89.1 crore while EBITDA margin moderated to 57.8% on front-loaded tech and headcount spend; incremental demat share rose to 17.6% from about 14%.

calls.name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with market share steady at 13.4% and equity share 14%; growth is mark-to-market led, SIP flows flat QoQ at ~INR 31,781 cr in June, and no supply-side capacity signals since AMCs have no capex cycle.
calls.top: SIP rebound in June vs May

calls.name: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume outlook / margin range: none quantified
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 55% YoY to INR424 cr with EBITDA margin ~14%, but management attributed margin gains to mix without quantification, volumes flat, and no capacity or capex discipline evidence.

calls.name: Saksoft Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at ~INR 249 crore with muted Q2 outlook; management holds FY27 INR 1,200-1,250 crore guidance (~25% growth) but pipeline claims rest on unquantified deal conversion.

calls.name: Rallis India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 7% to ₹1,022 cr with volume only ~2% and price ~5%; EBITDA up 23% to ₹184 cr, but exports fell 28% and channel stuffing/returns risk rose with the delayed monsoon.
calls.top: Channel inventory elevated; returns to be provisioned more

calls.name: Cummins India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 18% to INR3,375 crore on data-centre gensets, but PBT fell 0.7% as commodity inflation squeezes margins; utilisation only 70–75% and capex kept in line with past years, so supply discipline is not the story.
calls.top: One price hike taken into Q2

calls.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
calls.gLine: Market growth: 4% to 5% industry growth; company aims to grow in line with market
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 (June quarter) sales up 23% with EBITDA margin 10.5% vs 8.3%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation number and part of the sales lift is customer inventory build ahead of price rises.

calls.name: Symphony Ltd
calls.gLine: Australia capital deployment: No further capital allocation
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol EBITDA ex one-offs up 39% to ₹53 crore with channel inventory cleared, but management warns of near-term margin pressure from elevated input costs and only partial price pass-through.

calls.name: PI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: ETR: around 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 17,023 mn, EBITDA margin 22%, export value down 12% on 8% volume decline despite ~13% rupee tailwind; no capacity cut, capex Rs 700-800 cr held, FY27 growth guided low single digit.

calls.name: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Sugar season 2026-27 operating performance: Significantly better operating season; Shamli bounce back expected
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBIT up on sugar and distillery margins, but distillery volumes fell 19% and crush fell 9%; sugar closing stock 3.59 lakh MT vs 4.45 lakh MT a year ago supports prices.

calls.name: Union Bank of India
calls.gLine: Advances growth: industry plus 1% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Union Bank's Q1 FY27 call stresses CASA/RTD stability and NIM defence at 2.80%, but credit growth is soft, bulk deposits are being shed, and ECL transition (about INR11,300 crore) remains unquantified on run-rate.

calls.name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
calls.gLine: Product launches: about 10 launches by 31 March 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% with Ex-US up 17% but Ex-US sequentially down to $63m from $70m on shipment delays; US flat, FY28 $375m target reliant on unapproved launches and quota-limited controlled substances (~5% of revenue).

calls.name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs203 cr (18% margin, Rs8,787/t) flat QoQ but down YoY on pellet shutdown and coal; 0.23 mt expansion guided H2 FY27, mines FY28, no supply cut or deferral.
calls.top: TMT prices corrected sharply in Q1

calls.name: Embassy Developments Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales ₹868 cr (+338% YoY) and collections ₹496 cr (+54%), but no launches in Q1, operating cash flow negative ₹285 cr and reported EBITDA −₹106 cr; supply-side ramp rests on Q2–Q4 launches.
calls.top: Operating cash flow −₹285 cr in Q1

calls.name: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +10% YoY to INR559 cr with Changodar and Moraiya utilisation at 60-65%, inventory built ahead of CRGO risk, and FY27 guidance of 25% growth and 16% EBITDA sits against a 6,630 cr order book.

calls.name: Shemaroo Entertainment Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA: positive for the year at least (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue down 6% to ~INR 132 cr with EBITDA loss narrowed to ~INR 2 cr (INR 20 cr new-initiative spend); management targets EBITDA positive for FY27 and a debt reduction plan, with no hard numbers.

calls.name: Best Agrolife Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (FY27, indicative): 13%-14% sustainable
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 70% to Rs 78 cr (20% margin) on mix and pricing, but revenue grew only 4% and management withdrew near-term growth guidance, with capex on hold and ~Rs 60 cr sales-return provision.

calls.name: Mahanagar Gas Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR1,500-1,800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: MGL's Q1 FY27 volumes rose 7% YoY to 4.766 mmscmd and EBITDA jumped to INR343 crore, but management admits gas costs may spike and margins will be under pressure for 1-2 months.

calls.name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 revenue: better than Q1 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR 401 cr with margin up to 15.3%, but utilisation fell on order slowness; management holds INR 2,000 cr FY27 guidance, leaning on H2 and a 750-machine India ramp.
calls.top: Utilisation down on US order slowness

calls.name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth acceleration: growth to accelerate from here (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% YoY to INR 88.4 crore but management admits a soft quarter and ADTO dip in F&O; growth acceleration is promised without numbers.

calls.name: Angel One Ltd
calls.thesis: Angel One Q1 FY27 revenue ₹14.3bn (+25.4% YoY, -2.3% QoQ) and PAT +102% YoY, but volumes softened, MTF client book hit record ₹71.5bn and management declined to quantify July trends.

calls.name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: IRFC is a rail-linked lender whose Q1 FY27 disbursement was only about INR2,000 crore and AUM slipped; management still guides ~INR5 lakh crore AUM and NIM above 1.6%, with no capacity or supply signals.

calls.name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: Net interest margin: Grow gradually over coming years
calls.thesis: Broking-led growth with consolidated revenue up 21.2% to ₹515.1 cr and PAT ₹36.7 cr, but NBFC AUM fell to ₹1,025 cr from ₹1,118 cr and the prior 25% AUM growth guidance was missed.
calls.top: NBFC AUM down QoQ to ₹1,025 cr

calls.name: Latent View Analytics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 USD revenue fell 3.5% QoQ to $30.3M, below the guided 1.5–2% decline, while FY27 growth guidance of 12% was held; margin guided 20–21% for the quarter and 21–22% for the year is not being raised.
calls.top: USD revenue -3.5% QoQ vs guided -1.5 to -2%

calls.name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental cost of borrowing: 8.5%
calls.thesis: Consumer/MSME lender Five-Star Business Finance: Q1 FY27 disbursements record INR 1,496 cr and collections improving, but guidance is on credit cost and gross NPA, with cost-to-asset rising and no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Sula Vineyards Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt trend: lower by end FY27 vs FY26
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 3% to INR121 cr but gross profit down 5%; grape-mix (~150bp) and geographic-mix (~200bp) hit margins, with management guiding recovery from Q4 FY27 and normalisation by Q1 FY28.
calls.top: Gross profit down 5% on 3% revenue growth

calls.name: Global Surfaces Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 65 crore (+44%) with EBITDA Rs 8 crore, but utilisation only 27% and management gave no numeric guidance, so the recovery rests on cost cuts and a Dubai shipping reopening.

calls.name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Consumer Healthcare growth (Q2 onwards): high single-digit to double-digit
calls.thesis: Mankind Q1 FY27 revenue up 12.9% to INR4,031 cr with EBITDA margin 26.3%, but a gross-margin hit is flagged next quarter from commodity and dollar costs and working-capital days rose to 52 on inventory build.

calls.name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: 70% overall by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Utilisation at 62% on 20,936 MT capacity with volumes of 1,292 MT, while revenue rose 36% on price pass-through; management guides FY27 utilisation to 70% and EBITDA margin above 10%.
calls.top: Polymer drum price Rs160 → Rs140 expected

calls.name: Globe Civil Projects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27 on existing order book: 10% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: EPC civil contractor reports Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~17% and PAT up 40%, but receivables and inventory rose faster than revenue and management guides only 10-15% growth on a ~INR700 crore order book.
calls.top: Receivables and inventory up in FY26

calls.name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% in next one year (next one year)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes +22% YoY but revenue only +15% and EBITDA margin 7.62% (below 8.01% a year ago); Mahad at 50-60% utilisation with unsold inventory building, and management gave no margin or Mahad timeline.

calls.name: NCC Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR 22,000-25,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue up 12% to INR 5,842 cr with EBITDA 9.4%, but FY27 guidance of 8-10% growth and 8.5-9% margin implies slower rest of year; debt rising to INR 4,020 cr consol on smart-meter loans.

calls.name: Birla Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Total incentive FY27: INR130-135 crores
calls.thesis: Realisations fell about INR40/t sequentially and Q2 cost is seen up INR70-80/t, with Central India prices soft and no capacity deferral despite flagged competition; EBITDA/t outlook left unquantified.
calls.top: Trade prices flat; realisation down INR40/t

calls.name: Automotive Axles Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin band: 7.5%-8.5% (next few quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin hit 13.6% (vs 12.4% QoQ, 9.7% YoY) on mix and one-offs, while management now sees the industry 5-10% lower for FY27 and capacity was added ahead of a peak Q4.

calls.name: KRBL Ltd
calls.gLine: Masala annualised revenue run rate: approximately INR25 crores by end FY27 (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit was a record on price hikes and investment MTM gains, not sustainable; Middle East exports fell about 50% to INR244 crore while guidance was held and FY27 gross margin is pegged at about 30%.

calls.name: Sonata Software Ltd
calls.gLine: International EBITDA trajectory: positive traction every quarter this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sonata's international utilisation fell to 88.5% from 91.8% and EBITDA to 15.4% from 20.2%, with management giving no quantified margin or growth guidance and no capacity signal, leaving the Q2 recovery unproven.

calls.name: Subex Ltd
calls.thesis: Subex Q1 FY27 revenue INR 79.45 cr (+8.9% QoQ, +19.7% YoY) with 21.2% EBITDA margin, but management is signalling margin reinvestment, no numeric guidance, and Middle East order slowdown.

calls.name: Biocon Ltd
calls.gLine: Syngene FY27 revenue: single-digit revenue degrowth in rupee terms (FY27)
calls.thesis: Biocon Q1 FY27 shows generics margin recovery to 7% and biosimilars EBITDA at 25%, but Syngene revenue fell 16% and working capital and net debt rose ~INR1,100 crores on inventory build for H2 launches.
calls.top: Inventory build ahead of H2 scale-up

calls.name: HT Media Ltd
calls.thesis: Print yield-led growth lifted consolidated revenue 15% to INR 497 cr and EBITDA ~3x to INR 90 cr, but a dilutive preferential issue at ~INR 24.7 and newsprint at $650-700/t cloud the quality of the recovery.

calls.name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual installations: more than 10 GW near term, 15 GW by FY31 (FY31)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 deliveries hit a record 506 MW and ASP rose to INR6.3 crore/MW, but EBITDA was flat at INR595 crore on one-off Suzlon 2.0 costs and 1,257 MW erected awaiting commissioning.

calls.name: Hindustan Media Ventures Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 15% to INR 497 crore and EBITDA near 3x to INR 90 crore, but the quarter is flattered by treasury and asset-sale gains, digital is shrinking, and a below-book preferential issue is dilutive to minority holders.
calls.top: Preferential issue to retire 30-50% of debt

calls.name: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book target by FY27 year-end: Rs 2,500 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 20.2% YoY to Rs 110.79 cr on a Rs 1,600 cr order book, but management gave no capacity or capex data and cash conversion and OCCPS overhang remain unresolved.
calls.top: Order book Rs 1,600 cr+ over 18-30 months

calls.name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: India growth FY27: close to 12%
calls.thesis: Alkem's India growth of 10.3% lags peers as Trade Generics stalled (flat in Q1), while Daman US plant OAI and a US CDMO drag of about INR60 crores a quarter weigh on the outlook.
calls.top: Daman plant OAI; 45% of US revenue

calls.name: Dollar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 11% to 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Dollar Industries Q1 FY27: margin up on a 4-5% price hike, but volume fell 1.6% and management is protecting margin over share, with FY27 guidance of 11-13% growth and 11.5-12.5% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: RITES Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue FY27: not less than INR 300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: RITES order book grew to INR 9,450 crore with 128 orders worth INR 670 crore, but ~70% of fresh inflows are competitive and EBITDA margin held at 22% against a 20% red line amid pressure from mix, travel and pay revision.

calls.name: Polycab India Ltd
calls.thesis: Polycab Q1 FY27 revenue +39% YoY with domestic volume only low-to-mid single digit on a high base; price cut of 3-4% in early July and weak channel stocking signal softer near-term cycle, while FMEG and margins carry the print.

calls.name: Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.3% YoY in rupees but only 6.7% in constant currency; margin flat at 17.5% reported, with management still targeting 12.5% FY27 growth needing ~5% QoQ CAGR in remaining quarters.
calls.top: Merger: HM into ITC Infotech, 15-month timeline

calls.name: Samhi Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt-to-EBITDA: 2.5x (FY2028)
calls.thesis: Same-store RevPAR up 9.6% on occupancy (79.3% vs 74.2%) while ARR is flat-to-soft; supply is growing via 1,660 committed rooms and a Rs 750 cr enabling equity resolution, with EBITDA down 4% reported.

calls.name: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin recovery: margins to stabilise from Q2 or Q3
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 19% YoY to INR251 cr but EBITDA down 38% to INR28 cr (10% margin); management attributes ~INR18 cr to upfront RFP mandate costs and says normalised margin ~17.2%, with no capacity or supply-side signal.

calls.name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Uniware revenue growth: 15%+ from Q4 FY27 onwards (Q4 FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.3% to INR51.4 cr but adjusted EBITDA down 14.5% to INR8.1 cr as management front-loads growth spend; no supply-side or capacity signals since it is a software business.

calls.name: Concord Enviro Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (2 years): 15-20% then 20-25% growth (next two to three years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR853m from INR1,024m with EBITDA at minus INR149m on Middle East supply disruption; management guides growth from H2 on a INR699 crore order book, with no hard numerical FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Orkla India Ltd
calls.thesis: Orkla India Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.5% with volume only 1.7% (4.4% ex-Kerala) as spice inflation of 32.8% was passed through; pricing contributed 11.4%, EBITDA margin 17.5%.

calls.name: State Bank of India
calls.gLine: FCNR(B) mobilisation: $10 billion (about ₹1 lakh crore) (near term)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 profit of ₹21,121 crore with domestic NIM ~3% held for FY, but deposits +0.5% QoQ and advances +0.32% QoQ, credit guidance cut to 14-15% and fresh slippages up to ₹7,046 crore.

calls.name: Electrosteel Castings Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: 12% to 13% in Q3 and Q4 FY27 (Q3-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 DI pipe volumes fell 27% YoY to 1.20 lakh tons; management sees FY27 volume near 5.75 lakh tons (vs 6.5–7 lakh earlier) with H2-weighted JJM recovery and realisations up to Rs 55,000/t.
calls.top: Q1 volume ~1.0-1.1 lakh t vs 1.8 lakh t LY

calls.name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental revenue from projects under execution: INR1,200-1,500 crore (post project completion)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit second-highest in company history after Q1 FY22 on war-driven realisations, but offtake weak, 15% of June inventory liquidated by July, and plants shut for viability.
calls.top: June inventory only 15% liquidated by July

calls.name: Sanofi India Ltd
calls.thesis: Diabetes growing ~14% in Q2 FY27 with insulin share strong, but partnership-channel sales are flat at 2% growth and management does not expect industry growth in 2026, so the top line is weak and mainly diabetes-driven.
calls.top: One-off safety stock base effect in Q1

calls.name: Finolex Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell 27% to ~68,000 t on channel destocking and PVC price volatility, though EBITDA margin rose to 12% (from 9%); management held sub-15% margin guidance and gave no full-year volume view.

calls.name: Wipro Ltd
calls.gLine: IT services sequential revenue growth (cc): -1.5% to +0.5% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Wipro Q1 FY27 IT services revenue +0.9% YoY cc at $2.61B, margin 16% (down 120bp YoY), Q2 guide -1.5% to +0.5% QoQ; headcount ex-Mindsprint down 2,500 and deal slippage noted.

calls.name: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Aequitas EBITDA: Rs.10 crore by year two (two years post-integration)
calls.thesis: Jagsonpal Q1 FY27 revenue up ~9% to Rs.82 crore with EBITDA up ~21%, but no capacity or utilisation data; the Aequitas hospital push (Rs.10 crore EBITDA target in year two) rests on management assertion.
calls.top: Aequitas Rs.10 crore EBITDA by year two

calls.name: Avanti Feeds Ltd
calls.gLine: Feed sales FY27 (MT): around 5,85,000 MTs (FY27)
calls.thesis: Feed volumes up sharply (Q1 FY27 feed sales 1,93,852 MT vs 1,23,725 in Q4) but feed PBT margin fell to 7.06% from ~13% as fish meal and soya prices spiked; a ~10% price hike taken in June-July is the only offset.

calls.name: Sumeet Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT margin: 3.5% to 4% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin collapsed to 3.24% (EBITDA INR8.85 cr) on PTA/MEG volatility and a 15-day maintenance shutdown; management guides FY27 revenue +30%, EBITDA ~6%, PAT 3.5–4%, with Nakoda CP plant now slipping to next FY.

calls.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Organon acquisition close: Q4 FY27 / early 2027
calls.thesis: Sun Pharma Q1 FY27 sales up 10.1% with India formulations +16%, but US generics fell 9.7% on Lenalidomide erosion; no capacity or capex signals, so supply-side read is neutral.

calls.name: Virat Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Lord Walker domestic volume: approximately 1 million pairs in calendar 2027 (CY2027)
calls.thesis: Investor-meet call is mostly promoter-led diversification into a Brahm lifestyle platform via Rs95 cr primary investment; socks pricing up to Rs63/pair but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure, and forecasts are unsupported.
calls.top: Rs95 cr primary investment in lifestyle unit

calls.name: HCL Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue down 0.5% QoQ with ERS down 3.7% QoQ; record $2.4B TCV and guidance held at 1-4% organic, with AI datacenter capex of INR3,500 crore the new capital call.

calls.name: Geojit Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR160.4 cr (+11% YoY) and PAT INR19.8 cr, but management is still investing ahead of returns, slowed hiring to replacements only, and says profitability payoff needs "a couple of more quarters."
calls.top: Middle East NRI business under pressure

calls.name: GE Power India Ltd
calls.thesis: Management is demerging the underutilised Durgapur plant (about INR 27 crores average annual loss, 2023–2025) to JSW Energy, with services order bookings up to INR 734 crores in FY26; no quantified Q1 FY27 numbers given.

calls.name: Religare Enterprises Ltd
calls.thesis: Religare's insurance arm Care grew GWP 37% with combined ratio 102.6% and RBI rejected the demerger, so value unlock is stalled while Care's solvency sits at 1.58% against a 1.7x target.

calls.name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: US growth: 8-10% (about 8% by year end)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,898m (+2% YoY, -7% QoQ) and EBITDA margin fell to 27% from 30%; management guides ~30-32% margin and double-digit growth for the year, with US growth only 8-10%. No supply-side discipline signal.

calls.name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days year-end: about 120
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 10.32% and order inflow only Rs 268 crores; management holds FY27 order guidance of Rs 10,000-12,000 crores and debt cut of Rs 600-800 crores, while standalone net debt rose to Rs 2,106 crores.

calls.name: General Insurance Corporation of India
calls.gLine: Domestic combined ratio: ~103 (medium term) (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 combined ratio improved to 104.88% from 106.94% on lower claims, but management flagged rising reinsurance price competition, a Gujarat flood provision of INR440 crores, and a foreign book still under repair.

calls.name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR79.3 crores at 19.3% margin with Dombivli drag INR9.5 crores; occupancy diluted to 59.6% by new beds, guidance on Dombivli loss held at INR2-3 crores per month with no raise.
calls.top: Occupancy diluted to 59.6% by Dombivli beds

calls.name: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR375 cr vs INR379 cr with SSSG down 7.5-7.8% and EBITDA margin down ~1%; management holds FY27 revenue growth guidance of 12-15% despite the weak start.

calls.name: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd
calls.gLine: Minimum ADR growth at Kochi Courtyard: at least 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 hotel RevPAR +9% on rate (ARR +7% to INR7,241, occupancy 75.7%), profit more than doubled on debt repayment; supply is growing with 1,700 keys in pipeline, but Q1 F&B/MICE hit ~INR14 crore and management is leaning on a H2 recovery.

calls.name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
calls.thesis: Discount-broker/platform call with no supply-side content; growth driven by MTF (book adds ~INR600-700 crores a quarter at 14.95% yield) and cash yields up ~5% YoY, but management gave no numbers on new products, Fisdom, or wealth and was evasive on the data questions.

calls.name: Amagi Media Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Non-financial AI-in-media webinar with no company numbers, guidance or capex; management explicitly declined company-specific questions, so no supply-side or pricing read is available.

calls.name: GSP Crop Science Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): around 15% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue steady at INR386 cr (vs 377 cr) with PAT up ~16% to INR26.4 cr, but growth aided by a one-off land sale (~INR5.7 cr other income) and management gave no numeric capacity-discipline signal; utilisation of technical plants 70-75%.

calls.name: Runwal Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Pre-sales growth: 20-25% YoY endeavour
calls.thesis: Mumbai residential developer, Q1 FY27 revenue fell to ~Rs 3,400m from Rs 4,462m on OC-based recognition, while management guides 20-25% pre-sales growth and debt cut to ~Rs 1,900m external post-IPO.

calls.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 call shows CASA and margin pressure persisting with no near-term fix; management pins recovery on FCNR(B) flows and acquisition quality, but gave no numeric guidance and deferred margin and CEO-reappointment answers.
calls.top: Cost of funds flat QoQ, down ~40-50bp YoY

calls.name: KSB Ltd
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 sales were subdued, up only 2-3% on export delays, solar slippage and supply-chain issues, with management still aiming for double-digit FY27 growth and valves EBITDA margin in single digits.

calls.name: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: 2-3% improvement over two years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up ~30% to 28,372 MT with TMT doubling, but stainless volumes fell 10-12% and EBITDA margin stays ~4%; utilisation only ~51-52% in FY26, guided >60%.

calls.name: GMM Pfaudler Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt repayment: EUR 7 million by end Q2 FY27; 12-18 months for further reduction
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR 925 crore but EBITDA down 7% YoY to INR 94 crore on pricing pressure and organisation investment; no capacity signals, margin recovery deferred with no numeric timeline.

calls.name: Mastek Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 performance vs FY26: better than FY26 (directional, no numeric guidance)
calls.thesis: IT services read is positive on backlog (12-month backlog $310M, +13.3% USD YoY) and revenue +1.8% cc QoQ, but Middle East bench costs, ESOP drag and aggressive pricing cloud margins; no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Ashiana Housing Ltd
calls.gLine: ROE: floor of 15%, likely 20% this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR107 crore from INR293 crore on handover timing, but management reiterated about INR2,000 crore FY27 revenue and INR2,200 crore presales, with Senior Living pivot and 15% ROE floor.
calls.top: Q1 bookings INR358 cr, units 407→234 YoY

calls.name: Natco Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic volume growth: about 25% in volumes (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR794 cr from INR1,391 cr on lower Lenalidomide; margin 30.9% was lifted by a seasonal Adcock flu-season bump, and management reaffirmed ~INR750 cr PAT guidance with no supply-side change.
calls.top: Brazil revenue up 180% to INR178 cr

calls.name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 business momentum: notably better than Q1
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 134.6 cr and EBITDA Rs 29.2 cr hit by West Asia shipping costs and delayed pass-through; utilisation only 60-65% in Q1, with 7,500 MVA existing capacity guided to near-full use and Phase-3 (6,500 MVA) on track for April 2027.

calls.name: Linc Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins squeezed by polymer costs (EBITDA margin 8.7%, down 89 bps YoY) with management withholding all guidance and pricing only ~50% passed through; no capacity or capex signals.

calls.name: Allied Digital Services Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 10% to 11% currently; 12-13% after large deals (a couple of quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19% YoY to Rs 260 crore but EBITDA margin ~10% under pressure; management cites hardware price spikes, pricing competition and a Rs 180-200 crore railway order walked away from; no supply-side discipline signal and guidance is a vague 20% CAGR aspiration.

calls.name: J. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue target FY28: INR7,500 cr at 14–15% EBITDA (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 2% to INR1,511 cr with EBITDA margin down to 14.1% from 14.6%; FY27 15% growth and 8,000–10,000 cr order target rest on delayed projects and pipeline conversion, not yet visible.
calls.top: FY28 revenue target pushed out a year

calls.name: Rupa & Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Athleisure growth FY27: more than double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.1% to Rs 202.4 cr on volume, but price hikes of 4-5% were passed on as schemes; EBITDA margin 7.8% missed the prior 9-10% guide, with guidance reiterated at 9-10% for next quarter.
calls.top: Q1 price hike 4-5% passed to trade

calls.name: Indus Towers Ltd
calls.gLine: Africa rollouts: commence next quarter; no financial or unit economics guidance
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 tower adds ~3,100 with tenancy ratio flat at 1.62 but incremental tenancy ratio ~1.3-1.4; EBITDA +3% YoY, energy margin -4.6%, management offers no numeric guidance beyond a 3-4 quarter order book.
calls.top: Tower supply disruption eased into Q2

calls.name: Inox Wind Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹872 cr with flat YoY growth as Inox Wind pivots from turnkey EPC to equipment supply; management reiterates 75% FY27 revenue growth and 20–22% EBITDA margin, H2-loaded, with little Q1 evidence.

calls.name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Sanand yearly turnover: Rs 40 crore minimum
calls.thesis: Mallcom Q1 FY27: revenue fell 25% QoQ to Rs 110 cr on export and port disruption, but margin rose to 12.51% on price pass-through; no capacity cut or capex discipline signal, and Rs 1,000 cr FY28 target kept despite admitted stretch.
calls.top: Revenue down 25% QoQ to Rs 110 cr

calls.name: IIFL Capital Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Flat QoQ operational revenue at INR631 crore; FPD income fell 31% QoQ on seasonal insurance and lumpy income, while INR2,000 crore Fairfax preferential infusion remains unreceived pending approvals.
calls.top: Fairfax to take 51% via INR2,000 crore preference issue

calls.name: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Adjusted EBITDA margin: Near prior-year margin for FY27, accelerating from FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was the trough: consolidated revenue INR4,223m (-23% YoY), adjusted EBITDA margin 2.2%, with management guiding sequential recovery in Q2 and YoY growth only from H2.

calls.name: Sigachi Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: MCC realisation jumped to INR241/kg from INR216 but utilisation is only 76.8% and Q1 revenue of INR121 cr is far short of the INR650-675 cr guidance, which management says is unchanged.

calls.name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 GTV up 19% to Rs 5,524 cr and PAT up 81%, but adjusted EBITDA fell 7% as management reinvests in hotels and AI; flights volume hit by airline capacity cuts.

calls.name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin benefit from backward integration: ~300bp by FY28, further 100bp by FY29 (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +6.2% and gross margin +277bp to 46%, but reported EBITDA flat at ₹120cr due to ₹24cr supply-chain hit; FY27 margin guided flat to FY26 with price hikes only hoped for, not confirmed.
calls.top: Margin guide FY27 flat to FY26

calls.name: Bajaj Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (ballpark, not commitment): 8% to 10% annually, assuming industry grows 6-7% (2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue grew only 2.3% with EBIT margin up to 6.6% from 2.5%, driven by pricing and cost savings; management targets 8-10% growth and 6-7% margins for two years, with fans losing share and PCB/gas supply constraints.

calls.name: EID Parry India Ltd
calls.gLine: CPG quarterly breakeven: 4-5 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sugar crush fell to 1.47 LMT from 2.12 LMT as TN/AP cane supply shrinks, with PSRIPL refinery shut and Rs 665 crore infused; the quarter is seasonally weak and the fix is still a plan.

calls.name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 revenue and cost: significant portion of FIFA revenue and cost in Q2
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell to INR 789 mn (4.1% margin) as ad revenue dropped 11% YoY and FIFA/sports spend ramped; management gave no margin guidance and cited no capacity signals.

calls.name: Cemindia Projects Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 6% to Rs 2,721 cr with 9% EBITDA growth; Rs 31,000 cr order book is ~50% related-party, and Rs 5,000 cr QIP is capex-heavy enabling resolution with unclear deployment timing.

calls.name: Xtglobal Infotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Soft IT-services quarter: consolidated revenue +1.1% YoY to ₹93.30 cr, with EBITDA margin up to 7.6% on offshoring mix shift; no supply-side or capex content, and US public-sector and Ireland entry are early-stage.

calls.name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Space and Weather entity FY27 revenue: INR300-plus crore with at least 18% to 20% PBT margin (FY28 standalone entity)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue of INR182 crore was soft on customer-approval and technical delays, but a ~INR2,205 crore HAL Uttam Radar order lifts standalone order book to INR2,156 crore and FY27 revenue guidance is held at INR1,350 crore.

calls.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating margin exit: 25% plus exit rate for the year (Exit FY27)
calls.thesis: IT services demand is soft with client deferrals, and margins fell 130 bps to 24% on wage hikes, but management still reads the call as an AI-led deal-win recovery in Q2; no capacity signals as this is an IT services business.

calls.name: Entertainment Network (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Radio ad softness and event cancellations cut domestic revenue 1.9% to INR111 cr; EBITDA up 42% to INR8.8 cr on cost cuts, with Gaana losses narrowing to INR8.3 cr. No numeric guidance.

calls.name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth excluding Pril and FA: double-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross margin fell 950bp to 38.5% and EBITDA margin to 8.4% as crude-linked input inflation outran ~3% price hikes; management guides H2 better than H1 but gives no margin number.

calls.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 16% to INR1,461 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.2% from 13.5% on commodity costs and lagged price realisation; management guides to 3-6 month recovery with no numeric guidance.

calls.name: UFO Moviez India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 3% YoY to ₹1,118m but EBITDA flat at ₹189m; ad revenue +33% YoY offset by ~₹70m international product sales shortfall tied to Dubai import delays, with no capacity or supply-side signals.

calls.name: Precision Camshafts Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone camshaft business reports Q1 FY27 PAT of INR14.88 crores and a ~1,500 crore order book spread over 4-5 years, while European EMOSS revenue fell to INR13.8 crores from INR29 crores and management is cautious on it.

calls.name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 11% to Rs 414 cr with 35% EBITDA margin, but paying suppliers fell by 1,850 in the quarter and unique enquiries are flat-to-down, so the marketplace is leaking supply.

calls.name: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with flat standalone revenue (Rs 308 cr, flat Y-o-Y) and flows pressured in flexi-cap; capital-cycle supply signal is absent, and cost discipline plus a Rs 40/share dividend (95% payout) carry the quarter.

calls.name: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd
calls.gLine: IPO listings in current quarter: minimum 3 to 4 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Capital-markets merchant banker with no quantified Q1 FY27 results, guidance or capacity commentary; mainboard IPO activity slowed sharply versus FY26, and the only numeric outlook is 3-4 IPO listings this quarter.

calls.name: Meghmani Organics Ltd
calls.gLine: Pigment revenue: INR500-600 crores annualised
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit rose on margin and cost gains while volumes fell ~17% and crop protection utilisation sat at 63%; pigment at 39% with overcapacity admitted and TiO2 suspended.

calls.name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd
calls.gLine: Home broadband quality acquisition recovery: growth to return to old rates in next quarters
calls.thesis: Hexacom Q1 FY27 revenue Rs2,510 Cr (+4% QoQ), EBITDAaL margin 48.2%, but mobile net adds only ~210k and home net adds cut to 75k as acquisition quality is tightened; no supply-side signal in a telecom where capex is not a discipline lever.

calls.name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days March 2027: 120-150 days
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 76 cr (+38% YoY) with EBITDA margin 8.55%, but operating cash flow still negative (INR 16 cr), receivables INR 231 cr, and the Jhajjar BESS plant is delayed to H1 with FY27 utilisation capped at 20-25%.

calls.name: Oswal Pumps Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 operating EBITDA margin: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 7.9% YoY to INR474 crore and operating EBITDA margin fell to 15.7% on Magel Tyala price cuts of 9%; receivable days jumped to 229 and FY27 growth of 20-25% rests on PM KUSUM 2.0 timing.

calls.name: NIS Management Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 consolidated revenue: INR630-640 crores, crossing INR650 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 15.7% to INR115.44 cr with EBITDA margin 7.99% (+121 bps), but capital-cycle signals are thin: no capacity or capex discipline evidence, management reiterates INR500 cr FY27 and INR650 cr FY28 targets, and rejects a buyback.

calls.name: Fabtech Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Top line by 2030: Rs1,000 crore plus (2030)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs74.98 cr and PAT turned to Rs4.21 cr from a loss, but the EPC model is H2-weighted, receivables rose to ~Rs215 cr, and capacity and supply signals are absent.
calls.top: Receivables ~Rs215 cr vs Rs211 cr in March

calls.name: Onida Electronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Consumer electronics turnaround with Q1 revenue up 29.5% to Rs 182.4 cr but loss widened to Rs 14.2 cr; no numeric guidance, capacity being scaled down and management calls the balance sheet "slightly stressed".
calls.top: Washing machine margins hit by competition

calls.name: Mphasis Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 sequential cc growth: best sequential growth in three years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue $471M, +8.3% YoY cc, net new TCV $461M (fifth straight quarter above $400M), but EBIT margin fell 60bps and DSO sits at 95 days; capacity is being added ahead of demand.
calls.top: Utilisation dropped ahead of Q2 ramp

calls.name: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: R&D expense as % of revenue: 10.5% to 11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 358 cr (+6.3% YoY) with EBITDA margin 17% and no FY guidance; management blames MEA disruption, capacity diverted to product build-outs, and data-centre ramp timing, with conversion expected to improve from Q2 and accelerate in H2.
calls.top: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance

calls.name: Music Broadcast Ltd
calls.thesis: Radio revenue down 10% YoY to INR44.5 crores but EBITDA rose to INR8.9 crores on cost cuts; management says pure radio ad spend is subdued and Q2 has begun softer.

calls.name: Cochin Shipyard Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: ~14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT fell to INR 151.45 crores from 187.82 crores while management guides ~12% revenue growth and 14% blended EBITDA, with capex rising to ~INR 6,000-6,500 crores across ISRF JV, Vadinar, BF and Tuticorin projects.
calls.top: Operating cash flow negative in FY26

calls.name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT fell 46% to ₹4.03bn on a ₹1.65bn Motor TP judgement reserve and ₹0.63bn Fire large losses; ex-items PAT down 23% and management is hedging on run-rate and price hikes.
calls.top: Fire rates: industry Fire de-growth 27.8% in Q1

calls.name: C.E. Info Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.9% to INR139.7 cr with 40.2% EBITDA margin, but Map-led flat (INR98.2→98.7 cr) and growth came from IoT hardware; no supply-side data, and receivables/write-off and order-book visibility remain the watch points.

calls.name: Transrail Lighting Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 5% to INR1,736 cr with EBITDA margin 11.7% and order intake only ~INR1,000 cr vs INR10,000 cr annual target; supply-chain disruption and receivable delays weigh on cash conversion.
calls.top: Net debt up on delayed collections

calls.name: AJC Jewel Manufacturers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 standalone India revenue: Rs 450 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 101.4 cr with EBITDA margin 4.6%, but management gave no utilisation or capex-cut discipline, Kerala capacity being expanded to 120% while utilisation is ~25%, and CFO has been negative for six years.

calls.name: Meenakshi India Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: close to 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Reported profit driven by Rs 711 lakh other income (incl. Rs 373 lakh unrealised fair value gain); core garment EBITDA margin only ~3.4% on flat revenue of Rs 3,224 lakh, with tariff-driven US discounts still weighing.
calls.top: US discounts given to retain customers

calls.name: Infosys Ltd
calls.gLine: Onsite mix excl. acquisitions reduction: 75 bps to 1%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue only 2.4% CC Y-o-Y and FY guide cut to 1.5–3% on softer volumes and pricing; AI services 8.2% of revenue is the bright spot, but AI-led deflation is a visible headwind.

calls.name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone growth of 14% and 88% PAT rise, but consolidated revenue fell 8% on Nepal and Africa, and management gave no numeric guidance; utilisation is about 60-65%, so no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: PTC India Ltd
calls.gLine: Power demand growth: 4%-6% annually (long term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume rose 12% to 25.8 BU but standalone PBT fell 32% to Rs 96 crore as surcharge and rebate income shrank on better Discom liquidity; no new long-term contracts expected.
calls.top: Standalone PBT down 32% to Rs 96 cr

calls.name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM target: INR1,600-1,700 crores for profitability inflection (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 MFI-to-secured pivot: disbursements fell to INR77 crores from INR92 crores, NIM fell to 12.3% from 14.36%, and PAT was INR0.21 crores, with a Q4 FY27 normalisation promised but unproven.

calls.name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 cc revenue growth only 0.1% YoY and -3.6% QoQ with Europe OEM programme cancellations; management guides H2 better than H1 and growth returning by Q4, with no numeric recovery targets, and margins to improve only incrementally.

calls.name: Dreamfolks Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR39 crore from INR52.6 crore QoQ and INR348.9 crore YoY, with adjusted EBITDA at negative INR16.4 crore; management pins the drop on Middle East war and targets breakeven by next year, with no capacity or capex signal.
themes: Middle East conflict impact on travel

calls.name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 10.3% (from 12.0% a year ago) on ETS price competition; FY27 margin guidance cut to around 10% from 11–13%, while revenue guidance held at 15–18%.

calls.name: Jinkushal Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 15.9% to INR56.57 cr but PAT fell to INR2.2 cr from INR6.51 cr, with INR96.8 cr inventory (INR84.4 cr overseas) and no supply discipline signal, so this is a cash-stretched growth read.
calls.top: Inventory INR96.8 cr, INR84.4 cr overseas

calls.name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: India sustainable EBITDA margin: ~18%
calls.thesis: Soda ash oversupply (China inventory at record 1.73 mn mt) keeps export margins at breakeven; India EBITDA margin of ~28% flattered by coal inventory and throttled soda ash output, management sees ~18% sustainable, capex capped near depreciation (~INR 1,200 cr).
calls.top: China soda ash inventory all-time high 1.73 mn mt

calls.name: Coromandel International Ltd
calls.gLine: Crop protection capacity expansion: commissioning by September
calls.thesis: Phosphatic volumes cut, production moderated to 6.9 lakh t (72% utilisation) to protect inventory; EBITDA down 3% to INR761 cr as input costs outran NBS subsidy, with crop protection EBIT up 44%.

calls.name: Transpek Industry Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 6.5% to INR155.1 cr and EBITDA fell 32.4% to INR24.1 cr (15.6% margin); management guides ~15% FY27 revenue growth and a INR250 cr Odisha/pilot capex plan, with the key DuPont/Arclin contract renewal unresolved.

calls.name: Foods & Inns Ltd
calls.gLine: Frozen segment revenue: USD30-plus million in 3 years; 20%-plus growth this year (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 exports slowed by vessel shortage and freight spikes with delayed call-offs but no cancellations; frozen segment grew about 20% in Q1 and management sees domestic volume growth of 20%.

calls.name: BCL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Distillery and overall EBITDA margin: around 10% - 12%
calls.thesis: Distillery margin rose to 12.41% but ENA realisation fell to INR58/l from INR70 on oversupply, with the 200 KLPD plant shut after a fire and the 250 KLPD Fatehabad expansion put on hold.

calls.name: Patel Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 24.5% to Rs 93.5 cr on 4% revenue growth, mostly from lower finance costs; order book Rs 14,636 cr (~3x book-to-bill) with FY27 growth guided at ~10%, but no capacity or capex discussion.

calls.name: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd
calls.thesis: Order book rose to INR 1,244 crore (from 1,044) but Q1 revenue only INR 210.4 crore (+3.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin collapsed to 3.6%, with DSO up to 63 days.

calls.name: Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at Rs 1,050.4 cr (-3.2% QoQ) and EBITDA margin fell to 9.7% from 15.7%; management guides only to margin recovery "before the end of the year" with no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Greenpanel's Q1 FY27 margin gain came from a ~15% price hike now largely rolled back, with MDF capacity utilisation at 50–60% and no guidance given; OEM down 14%, exports zero.
calls.top: Price hikes rolled back across industry

calls.name: Route Mobile Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: 10% to 15% in next couple of quarters (next 2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Route Mobile Q1 FY27 revenue up 9.6% YoY but gross margin fell to 20.9% and adj. EBITDA margin to 9.5% on account-specific disruption; management calls it transient, with no quantified bridge.

calls.name: Nirlon Ltd
calls.thesis: Office landlord of NKP and Nirlon House at 99.8% occupancy with contracted escalations only; no new supply, capex or lease-up drivers, and the REIT and redevelopment talk is stalled.

calls.name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd
calls.gLine: Motor OD loss ratio target: below 80% over time; immediate goal high-70s
calls.thesis: Chola MS general insurance Q1 FY27: GWP up 6.7% to Rs 2,130 cr, combined ratio 120.4% with motor OD loss ratio elevated (80-86%) and no clear recovery timeline; industry fire pricing still soft.

calls.name: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR313 cr from INR328 cr (about -5% YoY) blamed on OEM lead-times; order book ~INR3,104 cr is claimed but no supply-side or capex-discipline evidence, and management gave no numbers on recovery.

calls.name: Vascon Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Real estate annual booking value: INR1,200-1,500 crores by FY31 (FY31)

calls.name: Platinum Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Oleo revenue FY27: INR 65-70 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 108.9 cr (from 115.4 cr) and consolidated PAT to INR 11.1 cr (from 13.1 cr) as new Palghar capacity ramps from 21 May with utilisation guided at only 30-35%.

calls.name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Cell ramp-up / utilisation: about 80% utilisation by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume collapsed to 334 MW sales (from 1,050 MW in Q4) and EBITDA fell to INR 425 mn; capex of ~INR 1,000 mn spent with cell ramp only from Sept, so supply discipline is offset by weak utilisation and no cell output until late FY27.

calls.name: Jindal Saw Ltd
calls.gLine: Seamless Nashik monthly run-rate: 70,000-80,000 tons per quarter from October (Q3 FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell about 40% to INR341 crore on MENA export shipments suspended since March 2026; management guides FY27 volumes flat to FY26 and H2 better than H1.

calls.name: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Small IT services firm with Q1 FY27 revenue INR 316 cr (~7% YoY), EBITDA 11.1%, but receivables stretched at 100+ DSO and management gave no forward numeric guidance.

calls.name: Cyient Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year ETR (DET): 27% to 28% (FY27)
calls.thesis: DET margin up to 13.2% EBIT on cost levers while USD revenue fell 0.9% YoY in constant currency; 15% EBIT target pushed to FY28 as revenue ramp lags.
calls.top: EBIT 15% target slips beyond Q4 FY27

calls.name: Insecticides (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Granuvia FY27 sales: ~INR20 crore gross
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 12% to INR612 cr on a 13% volume decline; gross margin rose to 31.6% but EBITDA margin fell to 11.1%, with June inventory elevated and no major price hikes sticking.

calls.name: Star Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Fuel cost per kcal: ~INR1.45 in Q2 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA/t fell to ₹1,497 from ₹1,774 on lower Assam subsidy, fuel at ₹1.55/kcal and a kiln shutdown; management guides ~₹1,400 in Q2 and ₹1,500–1,600 for the year, with cement volume growth cut to 8–9%.

calls.name: Capacite Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR193 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7% to INR629 crore with EBITDA down 3% on a INR10 crore commodity provision; management leans on a 20% FY27 growth guide that rests on delayed project starts and a labour recovery.

calls.name: Dhruv Consultancy Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR15.55 cr with operating loss ~INR3 cr; management calls it a paper correction and says a INR300 cr unexecuted order book converts over ~3 years, with billing only from Q3 and no numeric guidance.
calls.top: Q1 operating loss ~INR3 cr on INR15.55 cr sales

calls.name: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross debt FY27: close to INR3,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell ~20% YoY to INR2,727 cr and PAT to INR30 cr on stalled work fronts and stretched client payments; management gave no numeric revenue guidance, only a debt and capex target.

calls.name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue with existing capacity: Rs 1100-1200 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 11% YoY to Rs 168.5 cr on monsoon-delayed demand and price pressure, while gross margin rose to 28% from 22%; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and finance costs rose ~19%.
calls.top: Prices under pressure, China supply elevated

calls.name: Blue Star Ltd
calls.gLine: Segment II EBIT margin FY27: over 6.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Blue Star's RAC segment margin fell to 2.9% in Q1 as it held share by discounting; management guides Segment II margin above 6.5% for FY27 while cutting pass-through to 5% of an intended 13%.

calls.name: Camlin Fine Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 EBITDA margin: 12-14%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin collapsed to about 4% from 45% last quarter on raw-material and freight spikes; vanillin plant ran at roughly 25% utilisation, and FY27 vanillin volume guidance cut to about 3,000 tons from 3,600-4,000.
calls.top: FY27 EBITDA guide cut to 10-12% margin

calls.name: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Cash on books at Q2 end: close to Rs 300 cr (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to Rs 815 cr (from 945) on El Nino-hit Kharif, with inventory up ~Rs 200 cr and management promising lower production next year; cotton margins at ~15% EBITDA.

calls.name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR6,000 to 8,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue flat at INR1,320 crores, FY27 growth guide cut from 20% to 10-15% and margin guide cut 0.5pt, with domestic highway awarding muted and order book INR15,251 crores.

calls.name: Tejas Networks Ltd
calls.gLine: Path to profitability: Positive EBITDA and EBIT first, then PAT; 12 to 18 months is a reasonable time to expect
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR402 cr (+20% QoQ) with PBT still negative INR271 cr; inventory eased only to INR2,358 cr from INR2,438 cr while net receivables rose to INR2,232 cr, and the BSNL add-on order remains unawarded.
calls.top: Net receivables INR1,905 cr → INR2,232 cr

calls.name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store revenue growth FY27: mid-single-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 5% to INR125.3 cr with EBITDA margin down to 21.2% and PAT 1.8%, as marketing rose to 8.5% of revenue; management gave no numeric growth visibility beyond the next few quarters.

calls.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Hi-Tech revenue growth FY27: double digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue down ~2.5% to ~Rs 1,500 cr with EBITDA down on unabsorbed fixed costs; adjusted PAT ~Rs 3 cr vs Rs 30 cr, and ~Rs 680 cr NCDs due this fiscal with refinancing still unsigned.

calls.name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: Andhra Pradesh go-live: first week of September
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was a disrupted quarter: MP brewery suspended ~6 months, ~INR250-260 crore revenue lost, EBITDA INR15.2 crore; UP brewery (10m cases) commissioned but management guides FY27 revenue down to INR1,000-1,100 crore.

calls.name: AJAX Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Non-SLCM revenue growth: 10-15% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.7% to INR475 cr and EBITDA margin down 70bp to 12.5%; management calls Q2 'fairly challenging' and says 12% full-year margin looks challenging, with no capacity or capex signal.
calls.top: Industry SLCM registrations down 27%, AJAX down 21%

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 construction cost: Rs 1,200-1,300 cr
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with net debt near zero post ITC sale; Q1 collections Rs 713 cr (+31% YoY) but net sales only ~Rs 329 cr with no launches and cancellations; BD still lagging against Rs 10,000-15,000 cr FY27 target.
calls.top: Net debt near zero post ITC sale

calls.name: DCW Ltd
calls.gLine: Basic Chemicals breakeven: breakeven in Q2 if normalcy holds
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PVC disruption drove Basic Chemicals EBITDA to -INR14 crore, while Specialty EBITDA rose ~20% YoY; management now frames steady-state EBITDA at ~INR300 crore versus prior INR400 crore target.
calls.top: Basic Chem EBITDA negative INR14 crore

calls.name: Dr Reddys Laboratories Ltd
calls.thesis: Semaglutide scale-up API batch failed impurity spec, halting supply to OneSource until ~late Oct/Nov; 6-7 million pens guided for Nov–Mar, vs earlier plan; no recall, no penalties expected.

calls.name: HFCL Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40% and above (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs1,915cr (+120% YoY) and EBITDA margin 23.25%, with OFC capacity going 28→34 mn fkm and FY27 growth now guided at 40%+ versus 20% earlier; order book Rs26,665cr.

calls.name: Ion Exchange India Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty chemicals capacity: At least 50% increase over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 49% YoY to INR 32 crore (4.54% margin) as Treatment Solutions stayed loss-making on legacy UP project; Roha capacity ramp is slower than the 25% first-year utilisation guided.

calls.name: Shree Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Depreciation FY27: INR2,400-2,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol EBITDA/t fell to Rs1,111 from Rs1,339 as fuel shifted to coal (1.95/kcal) and trade mix fell to 62%; management guides 40 MT FY27 and calls Q1 abnormal.

calls.name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: closer to 16.5%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated turnover up 20% to INR1,618 crores with ~13% tonnage growth; capex guidance reconciled to roughly INR400 crores with no capacity cuts, while margin guided up to ~16.5% EBITDA as indirect-cost negotiations flow through.

calls.name: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: DEI normal-year EBIT margin: 6% to 7% (normal year)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PBT fell 21% to INR 885m on Middle East exposure (Desert Adventures revenue -89%, DEI EBIT loss), while India forex, MICE and Sterling grew; management gave no FY27 guidance and Middle East recovery is sub-20%.
calls.top: No FY27 guidance; double-digit EPS growth in doubt

calls.name: Marathon Nextgen Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Acquisition capital deployment: About INR 200 crores deployed in new projects in FY27
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales of 46,000 sq ft (booking INR 108 cr, collections INR 146 cr) with no capacity metrics; growth via redevelopment GDV and a pending merger, but no supply-discipline or pricing evidence.
calls.top: Versova and Sewri redevelopment GDV INR 900 cr

calls.name: Styrenix Performance Materials Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike (EBITDA margin 26.1%) came from a transient pricing gap while volumes fell ~26% YoY; management refused to give volume or margin guidance and called Q1 margins non-sustainable.

calls.name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR300 crore +/- INR50 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 carbon black EBITDA/t ~INR22,900 lifted by low-cost inventory (~INR70 cr, INR40-50 cr to reverse); management held FY27 EBITDA/t guidance at INR16,500-17,000 and Q2 volumes soft on timing.

calls.name: Birlanu Ltd
calls.gLine: Parador profitability: more than breaking even this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 11.6% to Rs 1,174 cr and EBITDA up 35% to Rs 80 cr, but Pipes volumes fell 27% on PVC resin whipsaw and Parador swung to a Rs 13 cr EBITDA loss.

calls.name: SG Mart Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR400-500 crore FY27; INR1,500 crore over 2-3 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes of 160,000 t service centres and 30,000 t profiles/solar at ~INR2,000 and INR3,000-4,000/t EBITDA, with an unquantified EBITDA trajectory; capex plan of INR1,500 cr over 2-3 years versus INR700 cr on books, and a 50% CAGR target.

calls.name: Salzer Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Q3-Q4 FY27 EBITDA margin: 9% to 9.5% (Q3-Q4 FY27)
