calls.name: Havells India Ltd
calls.gLine: A&P spend FY27: around INR700-800 crores (management said 'somewhere around that number') (FY27)
calls.thesis: Havells Q1 FY27 shows price hikes of about 7-8% absorbed and channel kept lean, but switchgear fell 4% and cables are flat in volume, with A&P more than doubling and margins down.

calls.name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue ~INR117 crore with 20.1% EBITDA margin, but FY27 INR700 crore guidance held on an H2-weighted assumption with only ~INR485 crore closing order book and 3-4 projects slipping.
calls.top: FY27 INR700 cr held despite Q1 INR117 cr

calls.name: Control Print Ltd
calls.gLine: Core Coding & Marking standalone growth: 10%-15% by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone coding & marking steady but Q1 FY27 operating revenue up only ~5% (₹105cr vs ₹100cr) while subsidiaries V-Shapes/Track & Trace keep burning cash; breakeven pushed to H1 FY28.
calls.top: Packaging breakeven slips to H1 FY28

calls.name: Orchid Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Jammu 7-ACA ramp-up: 80% to 100% utilisation by end of first year (first year post start)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR304 crore (+15% YoY) and gross margin 33% (from 30%), but management calls the industry overcapacitated with cutthroat competition and gives no FY27 numeric guidance.

calls.name: Premier Explosives Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue Q2: INR150-200 crores (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 28% to INR102.6 cr and EBIT margin to 4.7% on export and import delays; order book INR1,393 cr (94% defence) and FY27 INR600 cr target rests on export licences arriving, with no new capacity capex quantified.

calls.name: NRB Bearings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY31 revenue vision: INR3,000 crores aspirational; INR2,700 crores on trailing growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.2% to INR370 crores and PAT up 15% to INR38 crores; capex of INR270 crores (INR60 crores spent) with a INR130 crore capacity from INR110 crore Unitec JV, but no utilisation or pricing data.
calls.top: Capex INR270 crores; INR60 crores spent

calls.name: Goodluck India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex FY27-28: INR100-150 crore
calls.thesis: Standalone volume +8.8% to 122,718 t at 98% utilisation, but management pushed Defence expansion 6-9 months and gave no numbers on the cut-off; the consolidated EBITDA +46% is Defence-led and the capital story is diluted by subsidiary stake sale.

calls.name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 AUM up 36% YoY to INR2,925 crores with PAT INR45 crores, but management stresses caution, volumes below expectation and credit cost guidance of 3-3.5% not formally given.

calls.name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd
calls.gLine: Bajaj Finance retail financing share: 15% to 20% of retail this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to ₹313.4 cr but operational EBITDA margin fell ~45bp to 12.85% on raw-material inflation; tractor volumes weak and FY27 outlook explicitly withheld.

calls.name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY28: INR65,000 crores, 30%+ CAGR (FY28)
calls.thesis: Capri Global Q1 FY27 shows strong growth and ROA above 4%, but gold-loan Stage 2 jumped INR385 crores and the company raised FY28 AUM target to INR65,000 crores with no prior guidance list to check against.

calls.name: Century Plyboards (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Particle board EBITDA margin: close to 15% (next year)
calls.thesis: Plywood volume and revenue surged on a 7% April price hike and pre-buying; management withdrew guidance, cited no large capex, and is tracking MDF margin toward 15%+ and particle board toward ~15% next year.
calls.top: No large capex planned near term

calls.name: AIA Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR350-400 crore FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume 64,644 t (vs ~60,000 a year ago) with no guidance on FY27 volume; management held status quo on tonnage, margin and realisation while capex guidance was raised to INR350-400 crore.

calls.name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
calls.gLine: Captive ore full use: 100% captive in FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pellet plant shut on gas cost up 40-45% and merchant ore buying; Q2 pellet output guided ~500 kt, mining ramp deferred to Q3-Q4, steel plant put on hold.

calls.name: Hubtown Ltd
calls.gLine: Pre-sales FY27: ~INR6,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 17% YoY to INR156 cr under project completion accounting; pre-sales INR535 cr and collections INR320 cr, with FY27 pre-sales guided at INR6,000 cr back-ended to Q3–Q4.

calls.name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Central Vista billing FY27: INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 4.29% from 8.59% on AIIMS Jammu bill cut (2.6pp), NCR labour wage hikes and staff costs; double-digit margin for FY27 ruled out and inflow guidance cut.

calls.name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Bed additions: ~400 beds in remaining 3 quarters of FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hospital margin fell to 21.5% from 22.1% as ESOP, ramp-up units and legal costs weighed; management holds 25% FY28 target while occupancy stays ~69%, with no supply discipline signal, just more beds (400 more in FY27).

calls.name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak debt: INR760-770 crore max; under INR300 crore in 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA flat at INR40 crore (13.2% margin) as cost rose INR4,200/t against NSR gain of INR3,400/t; guidance trimmed to INR1,300 crore+ revenue, with EBITDA margin target 16-18% pushed to year-end.
calls.top: FY27 revenue cut to INR1,300 crore+

calls.name: Kiri Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper tube plant start: 35 KT operational June 2027 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Dyes realisations drove standalone revenue up 63% to INR 295 cr and material margin to 31.9%, but PAT of INR 270 cr was mostly treasury/other income; copper project remains capital-heavy and pre-revenue.
calls.top: FY28 INR 20,000-25,000 cr revenue guidance dropped

calls.name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 13% to 14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 887 crore (+20.8% YoY) and order book INR 19,400 crore (over 4x revenue), but EBITDA margin is guided only 13-15% and capex is not a constraint since the model is asset-light.

calls.name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM by end FY27: around INR 5,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement just INR 117 crore with loan book INR 2,946 crore and Stage III INR 190 crore, 187 crore in one NCLT account; growth recovery is promised but not yet evidenced.

calls.name: Rhi Magnesita India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin gain (EBITDA 14.5% vs 10.8%) rests on price and mix with no capacity signal; capex run-rate at INR8 crore vs INR150 crore guide is unexplained, and management reiterated 13% margin and 7-8% volume guidance.

calls.name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
calls.gLine: Walters QSR store additions: 10 to 15 in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Restaurant chain reports 11.35% same-store sales growth and gross margin up to 71.1% from 69.9%, but gives no numeric guidance on revenue or store count; store-opening plans are vague and capital cycle signals are mostly qualitative.

calls.name: PDS Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15% to ₹3,444 cr and EBITDA margin up to 2.8% (from 1.7%), with order book up 23% to ₹6,095 cr, but guidance stays qualitative and the order-book growth is not yet capacity-led.

calls.name: Monte Carlo Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Home textile growth FY27: 20-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to INR149 crore with EBITDA loss of INR13 crore as sales returns pulled forward (~INR180 crore provision cited); management guides low double-digit growth and ~100bp margin dip for FY27.

calls.name: SG Finserve Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM target: INR10,000 crore by FY30 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Nil-NPA supply-chain NBFC posts record Q1 PBT of INR72 crore and loan book INR4,552 crore; management guides FY27 PBT ~INR300 crore, but no capacity or supply-side cycle signal since this is a lender, not an industrial.

calls.name: IDFC First Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year NIM: ~5.8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit INR1,075 crore (+132% YoY) on credit cost falling to 1.53%; management now guides FY27 ROA about 1% and credit cost 150-160bp, with NIM guide lifted to 5.8%.

calls.name: TeamLease Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Staffing EBITDA margin: Flat for Q1-Q2, expansion from Q3-Q4 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Staffing volume growth has slowed to mid-single digits with business EBITDA up 18% YoY but group EBITDA only up 3% on higher corporate cost; management guided no EBITDA margin expansion until Q3 and dropped FY27 20% EBITDA growth confidence.

calls.name: K.P. Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP capacity by end FY27: 100 MW (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~126% to Rs 521 cr but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4; order book cut to Rs 2,250 cr and FY27 growth guided to 30-40%, with no margin guidance.

calls.name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA FY27: around 2.4% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement optics distorted by check-realisation switch (reported +18% YoY vs 56% on handover basis), NIM down 19bps to 3.50% with management calling bottom and guiding ROA ~2.4%, FY27 book growth 18-20% held.

calls.name: Laurus Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR2,000 crores (from INR1,500 crores; FY27-28 earlier INR3,000 crores) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Laurus raised FY27 capex to about INR2,000 crores (from INR1,500 crores) with Q1 capex of INR394 crores, while Q1 revenue grew 29% to INR2,026 crores and EBITDA margin hit 31.8%; capacity is being built ahead of customer demand.
calls.top: Capex guidance raised to INR2,000 crores

calls.name: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 disbursement: ~INR65,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: HUDCO guides FY27 disbursement of about INR65,000 crore and a INR3 lakh crore loan book by 2030, with spreads held near 2%, but the call offers no hard supply-side evidence and sanctions are being chased with lengthy project timelines.

calls.name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28-29 revenue growth: more than 10% YoY; EBITDA margin closer to 25-26% (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% to INR 6,776m and EBITDA to INR 600m on a deferred order; management guides single-digit FY27 growth, with capacity utilisation and capex not discussed.

calls.name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
calls.gLine: Overall operating expenses growth (ex-ESOP, one-offs): 18% to 20% for 6-8 quarters (6-8 quarters)
calls.thesis: AMC gaining share: MF market share 9.04% (highest since June 2019) with QAAUM up 22.7% YoY; opex guided to grow 18-20% ex-ESOP for 6-8 quarters as tech and brand spend ramps.
calls.top: MF market share 9.04%, up 54 bps YoY

calls.name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
calls.gLine: Hofmann Ceramic losses: breakeven by end FY27
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA fell 17% YoY to INR31 crore as gross margin slid to 43% from 47% on raw material and LPG costs; consolidated EBITDA flat at INR40 crore, with price hikes only partly recovering input costs.

calls.name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Bandhan cut its Q4 FY27 ROA aspiration to 1.2–1.4% from 1.6–1.8%, citing funding costs and tech costs; Q1 PAT ₹502 cr (+35% YoY) with NIM held at 6.2% and credit cost 1.8%.

calls.name: Yasho Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue: >Rs 1,600 crore (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jumped to 24.2% on 42% volume growth and utilisation near 65%, but management is capex-raising (Rs 125cr to Rs 250cr), working capital stress surfaced in Q&A, and guidance is loosely quantified.

calls.name: Varroc Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~30% YoY to INR2,634 crore but EBITDA margin fell to 8.5% from 9.5% on war-related costs and low-margin tooling; management guides 20-25% FY27 growth as an "ambition", not guidance.

calls.name: Sky Gold And Diamonds Ltd
calls.gLine: Advance Gold share: 15% FY27, 20% FY28, 25% FY29, 30% FY30 (FY27-FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,013 cr (+78% YoY) and gross margin 9.3%, but utilisation is only ~55-60% with capacity added only after 2028, and management declined to revise FY27 guidance until after Diwali.

calls.name: Manorama Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Fractionation utilisation FY27: ~80% (management internal target 80-85%) on 52,000 t (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39.5% YoY to INR 404 cr, volume-led (~85% YoY volume growth); utilisation guided ~80% on 52,000 t capacity after 4,500 t debottleneck due Q3, while management declined to quantify most numbers.

calls.name: Affle 3I Ltd
calls.gLine: Larger M&A closing: early 2027 (early 2027)
calls.thesis: Affle Q1 FY27 revenue up 20.4% y-o-y to INR 7.47bn with EBITDA margin flat at 22.4%; no capacity signals, and management guides ~20% organic growth with a large M&A targeted for early 2027.

calls.name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: O&M revenue: INR400 crores to INR450 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR1,590 crores (down YoY and QoQ) as new orders slipped; UOV hit a record INR13,000 crores, but domestic awards only INR6,400 crores vs ~INR20,000 crores expected, and FY27 growth guide cut to 10-15%.
calls.top: Q1 revenue INR1,590 crores, down YoY

calls.name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: >60% YoY (potential) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR115.41 cr (+138% YoY) and ~64% EBITDA margin on dredging spillover; management guides FY27 growth above 60% from 30-40%, but Q1 margins are called non-repeatable and the order book is mostly charter.
calls.top: Dredging order book INR750 → INR240 cr

calls.name: United Foodbrands Ltd
calls.thesis: Restaurant demand is volume-led with SSSG 28.7% and no price hikes, but no supply discipline signal: 300-store target and capex of INR140 crores imply continued expansion, and the company is a restaurant operator, not a supply-constrained industry.

calls.name: Deep Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 18-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR278.92 cr (+40% YoY), EBITDA margin 43.6%, order book INR3,047 cr; growth hinges on PEC ramp from H2 and offshore fleet adds, with capex only against firm orders.

calls.name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA positive: Q2 FY27
calls.thesis: Krsnaa Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% to INR2,355m but EBITDA margin fell to 25% from 27% on Rajasthan ramp costs; management guides EBITDA-positive by Q2 with no hard numeric margin guidance, and receivables from Himachal and Karnataka remain uncollected.

calls.name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Deposit growth: 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total business up 23% to ₹1,21,715 cr and record net profit ₹412 cr, but growth is gold-led and funded by term deposits, with CASA down 2.95% QoQ and FY guidance raised.

calls.name: Ksolves India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 guidance: to be revisited (March 2027)
calls.thesis: Revenue fell 3.7% QoQ to Rs 41.4 cr after two large T&M clients cut headcount and guidance was withdrawn; margin guided 25–30% holds, with EBITDA at 30.3% and revenue growth now capped at 4–5% for FY27.

calls.name: Yatra Online Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross bookings up 17% to INR21,007m but adjusted EBITDA fell 39% to INR151m (12.3% of gross margin) on MICE disruption and Kanoo cost build; management gives no FY27 guidance and expects only a H2 recovery.

calls.name: Max Estates Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales Rs 1,100 cr (5x YoY) with Rs 13,500 cr contracted portfolio, but management withdrew sales guidance and consol PBT was only Rs 11 cr, so the read is cash-backed pipeline rather than hard earnings.

calls.name: ASK Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: high-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +52% headline but only ~25% ex alloy pass-through and wheel-assembly exit; EBITDA Rs 164 cr at 12% margin, capex raised to ~Rs 700 cr with debt rising.

calls.name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of funds: 7.3% to 7.4% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT Rs155 crore with NIM 7.5% and credit cost 0.45%, but MFI stress is easing rather than gone; cost of funds guided flat at 7.4% and deposit growth flat QoQ.

calls.name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej EBITDA margin (consolidated target): 14-15% (FY29)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR315.7 cr (+44.8% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, with utilisation in early 80s and Dahej capacity (15-17k t Phase 1) slipping to November; part of margin tied to inventory gains.

calls.name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR8,200-8,300 crores (~20-25% growth)
calls.thesis: Dealership (auto retail) with reported revenue +44% to INR1,890 cr and EBITDA margin 3.8%; organic growth strong but no supply discipline signal, and capacity/acquisition growth is debt-funded with PAT still marginal.

calls.name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store growth for mature stores: 15% to 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 9,935 lakhs from 10,861 (about -8.5%) on B2B freight disruption and delayed residential handovers; utilisation 68-70% and store network being reshaped, with no capacity addition signalled.

calls.name: Jungle Camps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Mathura hotel opening: FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Small wildlife-camp operator with flat-ish ADR (+5% YoY) and occupancy 45% in Q1 FY27; EBITDA fell to 27% from 32% and growth depends on debt-funded Mathura and Sheopur projects, a weak supply-side signal.
calls.top: New capacity debt-funded: ₹32 cr HDFC loan

calls.name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross block by end FY27: approximately double current (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR108 cr (+71% YoY) with 58% plant utilisation, yet management is pulling capex forward and gross block to double by FY27 on Saudi JV, aerospace qualifications and Hobel; supply is expanding ahead of confirmed demand.
calls.top: Capex pulled forward; gross block ~2x by FY27

calls.name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue FY28: exceeding 1100 crore (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike (PAT +79% to ₹18.57 cr) is partly one-off: management says ~50% came from inventory gains and called the quarter "special"; R32 plant slipped from Dec-26 target and FY27 contribution cut from ₹250 cr, with new equity/debt raise now under consideration.

calls.name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: International revenue share: around 50% in about 2 years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about INR 61.4 crore, down quarter-on-quarter from about INR 68 crore, yet management reiterated 60-70% annual growth and about 30% EBITDA margin with no numbers on supply or capex.
calls.top: Q1 revenue down QoQ to INR 61.42 crore

calls.name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Normalised quarterly D&A: INR55-57 cr per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR775 cr (+5.3% YoY, -3.1% QoQ), EBITDA margin 9.9% with TCV down to INR205 cr; management self-selecting out of low-margin accounts and targeting 200 bps margin expansion in FY27.

calls.name: Crizac Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% YoY to INR2,012m on a less favourable university mix despite enrolments up 15%; management now guides FY27 flat with FY26 after Q2 hit, versus earlier 15-17% growth view.

calls.name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA: 3.5% to 3.75% target (end of FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 NBFC print strong on margin (NIM 11.36%, cost of borrowing 10.66%) but credit cost rose to 0.95% from 0.58%, driven by vehicle finance and a 10% extra provision on up-money cases; PAT +70% YoY.

calls.name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd
calls.thesis: Ayurveda hospital and products operator reports 29% YoY revenue growth and 41% EBITDA margin, but management's answers were evasive on the revenue-to-volume gap, with ~INR14cr other income and ~INR7cr one-offs flattering PAT.

calls.name: JSW Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: North EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 at EBITDA level (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 15% to 3.81Mt with North ramp, but consolidated EBITDA fell 7.5% YoY to INR299cr on fuel costs and INR33cr North marketing; North utilisation 55%, company guides high-teens FY27 volume growth.
calls.top: GGBS growth cut to high single digits

calls.name: Vikram Solar Ltd
calls.gLine: DCR volume growth: 2 to 2.5x every quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume record 1,006 MW but EBITDA margin fell to 8.06% (INR1.25/W) as non-DCR pricing failed to pass through costs; management withdrew FY27 guidance pending H1 results.

calls.name: Anand Rathi Share And Stock Brokers Ltd
calls.gLine: MTF book by FY27 end: ₹1,750-1,800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% YoY to ₹2,461m and PAT pre-exceptional up 71% to ₹391m, but a ₹210m fraud restoration charge cut reported PAT growth to 2.35%; MTF book ₹13,318m up 55%.

calls.name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
calls.gLine: Underlying margin after one-offs: around 12%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales Rs9,708m (+18.3% YoY on assumed comparison, +2.6% QoQ) but PBT margin ~9% on FX loss (~Rs147m) and ~Rs150m demerger IT costs; management guides 12% underlying and capacity-constrained until new Pune plant in 2028.
calls.top: Capex INR900-950cr for new Pune plant

calls.name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Organic growth FY27: ~17% full-year organic after ~6% FX (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR256 crore (+43% reported, ~17% organic, ~6% FX) and adjusted EBITDA INR44 crore (~17%); no capacity or capex signal, so the read rests on NRR 111%, new ACV and margin mix.

calls.name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR350-360 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR802.63m with EBITDA margin down to 16.24% from 18.02%; management guides 24-25% FY27 EBITDA margin, a cut from the earlier ~30% view, and FY27 revenue of INR350-360 crore.

calls.name: Navneet Education Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic Stationery revenue growth FY27: 15-17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue slipped to Rs 785 cr on late state textbook release; management guides Publication growth ~10% and Export Stationery -5%, with 26% domestic stationery growth offset by a 30%-utilised polymer plant and margin pressure.

calls.name: ZEN Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to Rs141.6 Cr (down 11% YoY) and order book net-shrank to Rs1,239 Cr; management blames demand timing, with simulator tenders still pending and no capacity signals.

calls.name: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd
calls.thesis: Go Digit chose profitability over growth: GWP down 8% (about -2% ex inward health/crop), motor OD loss ratio rising, combined ratio 107.2% with DAC, and management declined to give guidance.

calls.name: Fino Payments Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Net interest margin for SFB: 8% to 9% (post-SFB)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was weak: EBITDA fell to INR 43.1 crores from INR 56 crores in Q4 FY26 after the UPI P2M B2B pause, with throughput down 10% year-on-year and no B2B relaunch before Q4 FY27.

calls.name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: ~Rs 700 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft with Unit 2 utilisation near 50% and customer deferrals; management keeps full-year growth "intact" without a number, while Unit 4 (Rs 1,200 cr) adds capacity ahead of demand.

calls.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
calls.gLine: Hi-Tech revenue growth FY27: double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about flat near Rs 1,500 crore but EBITDA fell on lost fixed-cost absorption; NCD repayments of about Rs 680 crore due in FY27 hinge on refinancing and internal accruals.

calls.name: Jindal Drilling & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Pioneer refurbishment completion and deployment: completion by first week of September; deployment in October 2026
calls.thesis: Offshore jack-up contractor faces H2 FY27 revenue decline as three of six rigs dehire with 4-6 month refurbishment gaps; new ONGC contract at ~INR45 lakh/day fixed, well below the $62k bid, and redeployment of the other three is unconfirmed.

calls.name: Orient Green Power Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Quarterly interest cost: around Rs. 13 crores per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue down 7% to Rs 81.43 cr and EBITDA down 9% to Rs 60.01 cr on weak wind; management guides FY27 only "equal to or better than last year" and 1 GW plan has no funding yet.
calls.top: Q1 wind availability weak, revenue down 7%

calls.name: India Pesticides Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: lower single-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 9.2% to INR 256 crore on a ~13% volume drop, with inventory building to ~200 days and FY27 top-line guided only to lower single-digit growth.

calls.name: Solex Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 module utilisation assumption: around 55% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.8% to INR265.6 crore and PAT margin fell to 3.1% as ALMM-2 delays pushed module offtake into H2; FY27 guidance held at 5-6% PAT margin with 55% utilisation assumed.

calls.name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej FY27 revenue: Rs 65 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 12.56% to Rs 461.93 cr on weak monsoon and price reversal; management cut FY27 guidance to small single-digit growth and no supply cut, with Rs 200 cr Nagpur plant adding capacity.
calls.top: FY27 guidance cut to single-digit growth

calls.name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Business recovery: Q2 slowdown, Q3 and Q4 good
calls.thesis: Management denies a Rs 400 crore siphoning report and says NHB red-flagged the account with no reasons given; disbursements slowed, credit rating under watch, and no audit findings disclosed on a Rs 1,100 crore book.
calls.top: NHB red flag on account, reasons undisclosed

calls.name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue invoicing: INR360-400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Transformer bushing maker guides FY26 EBITDA margin held near 24-25% and FY27 revenue of INR360-400 crore on a 15,000-bushing capacity, with utilisation of 75-80% in FY26 and 65-70% guided for FY27.

calls.name: Stove Kraft Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: upwards of 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 32.4% to INR414.5 cr on induction and small-appliance surge, but EBITDA margin only 9.5% and management leans on unquantified capacity and margin promises; capex cycle largely complete.

calls.name: Afcom Holdings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: minimum double FY26 (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR191.88 cr (+87.8% YoY) on two-aircraft dry-lease fleet with charter-driven yields; FY26 PAT INR121.90 cr, but FY27 growth hinges on unproven 777 induction and fuel pass-through.

calls.name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
calls.gLine: Punjab revenue FY27 (from Q2 onwards): ~INR 2,600 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated Q4 EBITDA ₹94.4 cr at 8.1% margin as Punjab ramps, but FY27 target of >₹500 cr EBITDA implies a big step-up; Phase 2 capex (end-FY27) and high working-capital build make execution the key test.

calls.name: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Tire-crush capacity: 235,000 tons per annum by FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tinna expanding tire-crush capacity 9% to 185,000 t with a 235,000 t target by FY27 and ~INR100 cr capex over FY27-28, while margins held at ~17% and FY27 revenue guided up 20-25%.

calls.name: Asahi Songwon Colors Ltd
calls.gLine: Blue EBITDA run-rate: Rs 50-55 crore standalone EBITDA peak (analyst-framed, management 'goal')
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin jumped to 15.6% (from 8.58% in Q3) on price pass-through and partly one-off gains, while FY26 revenue fell 4.78% to Rs 535 crore; capacity discipline is stated but no new capex is planned for Blue.

calls.name: JSW Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: RE capacity addition FY27: ~3 GW (35-40% wind) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity 13.45 GW after 2.6 GW added in FY26, with ~3 GW RE additions guided for FY27 and 14 GW under construction; Q4 EBITDA up 72% YoY to ₹2,602 crore, but commissioning delays and curtailment remain the swing factor.

calls.name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Coworking & allied revenue growth FY27: 25% to 27% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Awfis FY26 coworking revenue +35% to INR1,237 cr with EBITDA margin 36.8%, but seat adds fell to ~22k net from 30k gross and guidance is now a 22-25k gross seat target with capex flat, so supply discipline is strong but growth is slowing.

calls.name: NGL Fine Chem Ltd
calls.gLine: Phase-II capex: ₹210 cr total (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 57% YoY to ₹149.23 cr with EBITDA margin 14.35%, but Phase-II commissioning slipped to early Q2 FY27 and margins are only partially price-recovered; China pricing is turning.

calls.name: Borosil Renewables Ltd
calls.gLine: Rooftop solar first-year sales: INR75 crores (first year)
calls.thesis: Solar glass pricing near peak at ~INR150/mm with supply gap; new 600 TPD furnaces targeted in FY27 (+60% capacity), but Q4 sales flattered by Ind AS timing and management guides run-rate ~INR400-410 cr/quarter.

calls.name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Co-lending share of AUM: 20% by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold loan NBFC grew AUM 149% YoY to INR 1,096 crore with 0.13% GNPA, but cost of borrowing is held at about 11.2% with no capex or pricing disclosure beyond branch rollout.

calls.name: Seamec Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Seamec's FY26 record year (consol revenue Rs1,000cr, +47%; EBITDA Rs447cr) rests on DSV charters, but management guides ~15% FY27 growth with 40-42% margins, Paladin idle and no fleet capex beyond ANANT (~$70m).
calls.top: Paladin idle in Dubai, Q4 and Q1 lost

calls.name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt reduction FY27: Rs 400-500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 28% YoY to Rs 1,216.78 cr with EBITDA margin 17.1%, but forging utilisation near 70% and management guides capex only Rs 300-400 cr with Rs 400-500 cr debt cut in FY27.
calls.top: FY27 capex capped at Rs 400 cr

calls.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 80%+ (±5%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: MTAR guides FY27 revenue growth to 80%+ (±5%) and EBITDA margin ~24%, backed by INR250-300 crore two-year capex and a clean-energy build-out; margin delivery is the unproven leg after FY26 margin slipped to 19.5%.

calls.name: Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem Ltd
calls.gLine: SDA revenue FY27: INR250-300 crore, growth at least 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 214% YoY to INR281m (~21% margin) with management holding FY27 guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin; capacity is still bottlenecked at ~80-85% utilisation, with Jolva capex only from FY28.

calls.name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Export share of consolidated revenue: 14% to 15% by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR2,601.2m (+29.7% Y-o-Y) with EBITDA margin 30.3%; capacity additions are in commissioning and the company guides 1.5x–2x industry growth for FY27, with capex of about INR260–270 crore over three years.

calls.name: ACME Solar Holdings Ltd
calls.gLine: Commissioning of generation capacity FY27: 1.5 GW (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 59% to INR2,507 crore with ~90% EBITDA margin, but growth is now BESS merchant arbitrage (2.3 GWh, ~INR2.2 crore/day) and capex timing is being deferred around transmission delays; no numeric prior guidance was supplied to test against.
calls.top: Solar capex deferred until CTU ready

calls.name: Atlanta Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Vadod utilisation: 65% in FY27, 100% in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 81.7% YoY to INR747.6 cr with EBITDA margin near 20%, but Vadod ran at ~39% utilisation and management is preparing a capex-led EHV build-out with working-capital needs rising to 80-90 days.

calls.name: Lords Chloro Alkali Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: 80% to 85% (next one year)
calls.thesis: Caustic soda volumes up 29.7% to 84,690 t in FY26 with EBITDA margin 16.89%, but Q4 margin slipped to 14.03% on grid power repricing; capacity expansion to 360 TPD is on track, with 80–85% utilisation and no North India capacity additions announced.

calls.name: HEG Advanced Materials Ltd
calls.gLine: Price increase on unbooked orders in H2: Quantum undetermined; targeted for H2
calls.thesis: Graphite electrode maker at >90% utilisation with H2 price hikes planned, but Q4 volumes fell ~1,000 t and FY27 H1 EBITDA guided only ~17–20% versus 22% prior.

calls.name: PVR Inox Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 gross screen additions: over 100 screens (120 visibility) (FY27)
calls.thesis: PVR INOX shifted to capital-light expansion with net debt cut to INR161 crores and FY26 FCF of INR790 crores; FY27 capex guided INR375-400 crores, 120+ screens planned, occupancy 26.2% FY26.
calls.top: Net debt INR161 crores; gross debt to INR500 crores

calls.name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approximately INR 670 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Education company (not a capital-cycle business) posts FY26 PAT of INR 130 crores vs loss of INR 252 crores, with FY27 guidance of INR 670 crores revenue and INR 144 crores PAT; capacity build-out is opex-led and the commerce demerger is pending.

calls.name: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA FY27: INR700 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue Rs1,477 cr (+56% YoY) and FY26 operating EBITDA Rs545 cr at 11.3%, but FY27 margin guided down to 10.5–11% and PCB capex of ~Rs800 cr adds a supply-side build-out.

calls.name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs6,000-6,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Own-brand share reached about 45.4% with 2.5m unit capacity and FY27 guidance raised to Rs6,000-6,500cr revenue and 14-15% EBITDA margin, but Q4's 31.8% gross margin was partly one-off low-cost inventory.

calls.name: KSH International Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: at least last year's growth rate of ~21%
calls.thesis: Capacity-led growth: installed capacity 43,445 t rising to ~59,000 t, utilisation ~70% in Q4, EBITDA/ton ~INR 74,000 in Q4 and ~67,600 for FY26, with 65-70k guided as sustainable.

calls.name: HFCL Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: HFCL's Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin was 18.47% on Rs1,824 crore revenue, with management guiding to a 3-4% blended margin gain and 20-25% revenue growth for FY27, though most of this is unquantified and hinges on price rises and the NFS contract turning to AMC.

calls.name: GEE Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue CAGR: 25-30% till FY29; INR 1,000 crore by FY29-30 (FY29)
calls.thesis: GEE's utilisation rose from 48% to about 57% with management guiding to 25–30% revenue CAGR and 10%+ EBITDA margin, but capacity additions are small and the story rests on unverified targets and a land monetisation.

calls.name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY28: INR57,000 crore (revised up ~INR2,000 crore) (FY28)
calls.thesis: Capri Global's Q4 FY26 shows record PAT of INR283 crore and gross Stage 3 down to 0.9%, but the read is growth-led, with gold mix rising to 46% and a 350-branch gold expansion, so supply-side discipline is absent.

calls.name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume: 2,30,000 tons annually (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rose to 15.9% on NSR of INR3,700/t, but management admits price hikes partly reversed in May and PM3 upgrade slipped; FY27 guided lower revenue of INR1,400-1,500 crore.
calls.top: Price hike partly reversed in May

calls.name: Greenlam Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Laminate revenue growth FY27: 10-12%
calls.thesis: Greenlam FY26 revenue crossed INR3,046 cr (+18.6%) but PAT fell 18% to INR56 cr; laminate utilisation 86% with 2 MMSF capacity due late FY27 and management says no further capacity needed, with ~20% headroom.
calls.top: No new capacity beyond 2 laminate lines

calls.name: Epigral Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue record INR736 cr with utilisation above 80% and EBITDA margin 23%, but management gave no FY27 value or margin guidance and war-driven price gains are expected only in Q1.

calls.name: Sirca Paints India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-30% CAGR (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +33% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.08% (vs 18.05%), but Sirca is pushing 2 price hikes (~10%) to offset crude-linked RM spikes, and working capital is stretched (inventory and debtors up).

calls.name: Happy Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: late-teen % (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume +20.6% and gross margin 59.4%, with 2 years of capex (~Rs.800 crores) and a Rs.950 crore order book at Rs.340-350/kg versus Rs.245/kg today; FY27 margins guided flat.

calls.name: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Second line availability: next quarter (Q2 FY27) (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue rebounded 47% QoQ to INR4,282m on Semaglutide launches, but capacity is fully committed and a new line only comes online next quarter, with FY28 guidance of $400m and ~40% EBITDA margin reiterated.

calls.name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light materials platform: Contract Manufacturing utilisation 39%→50% YoY and FY26 revenue +39% to INR 1,068 cr, but Q4 EBITDA was flattered by a non-cash INR 5 cr unwinding gain and a INR 5 cr extra ECL, and PAT came off a low base.

calls.name: Fineotex Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: CCT revenue: US$200 million (FY28 (pulled forward from 2030))
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 162% to INR314 cr and PAT up 118% to INR44 cr on acquired CrudeChem (CCT); supply-side evidence thin, Ambernath utilisation only 60-62%, and management gave soft targets (US$200m by 2028, 18-20% EBITDA) without hard numbers.

calls.name: Sportking India Ltd
calls.gLine: Top line growth (next three quarters): 7% to 10% (next 3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Cotton yarn spreads near 3-year highs (~$1/kg vs $0.65–0.70 prior) with Chinese demand and consolidation; management guides top line up 7–10% and QoQ margin expansion of 15–20% over next 2–3 quarters, with greenfield 150k spindles only from Q3.

calls.name: Modis Navnirman Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: return to prior levels in FY27
calls.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with revenue up 84% to INR189 cr and EBITDA margin compressed (EBITDA INR38.5 cr, ~20%); management calls margin dip temporary, with no capacity or capex discipline evidence, and debt-free.
calls.top: Raw material cost hit on two projects

calls.name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: ~75% over FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Inox Green's FY26 Q4 EBITDA of INR57 crores rests heavily on about INR40 crores of acquisition-linked other income; management guides FY27 EBITDA above INR600 crores contingent on pending acquisitions closing.

calls.name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: surpass 36% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue INR 3,416m (+47% YoY) and occupancy 71%, but group is in heavy bed expansion (3,200 beds, target 5,000) with 70% of new beds via acquisition and ramp-up losses at new hospitals.

calls.name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity-constrained niche consumables and wear-parts maker: standalone wear plates, wear parts and heavy engineering at 85-90% utilisation, new capacity from Q1 FY27 supports guided >20% growth, with margins guided up 80-100bp and debtor days (98) the watch item.

calls.name: Krishival Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue INR304.41 cr (+48%), EBITDA margin 13.78%, PAT 7.59%; nuts plant utilisation ~70% in FY26 rising to ~90%, ice cream utilisation ~25% with capacity expansion phased to Q1 FY29.

calls.name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Pen capacity by end FY27 / FY28: 40-60 million pens at ~30 months (FY28)
calls.thesis: Healthcare pen-injector capacity is ramping: 25M pens added in March running ~45% efficiency, FY27 target 36M pens, while consumer fell 31% in Q4 and utilisation rose to 47.6%.

calls.name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per wheel FY27: close to INR 300 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 EBITDA/wheel near INR 300 (vs INR 262 FY26 reported) and EBITDA INR 650 crore+, with INR 500 crore Bhuj capex adding aluminium capacity; utilisation target 95% is the key test.
calls.top: Bhuj capex INR 500 crore, 2.3m units added

calls.name: Sanghvi Movers Ltd
calls.gLine: Crane yield: 2.1% +/- 5% deviation
calls.thesis: Crane rental utilisation 79% and yield 2.12%/month on a 474 cr FY26 capex plan vs 639 cr planned, with 165 cr carried into FY27; KSA capex and EBITDA breakeven timing slipping with West Asia shipping disruption.
calls.top: Fresh capex 190 cr India + 200 cr KSA

calls.name: V2 Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Store additions FY27: 170-200 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +60% to Rs 797 cr with SSSG 7.74% and FY26 EBITDA margin 14.9%, but management guides 50% growth with 50-60% new area, so margins stay flat and no operating leverage until FY28.

calls.name: Godrej Properties Ltd
calls.gLine: Residential bookings FY27: over INR39,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 bookings of INR10,163 crore and FY26 bookings INR34,171 crore (105% of guidance); FY27 guided to over INR39,000 crore, a 20% rise, with launch-led growth and cautious Middle East-related demand commentary.
calls.top: FY27 bookings guided over INR39,000 crore

calls.name: Pritika Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: around 15% a year for next two years; INR600 crore medium-term revenue target (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Utilisation ~73% of 72,000 t capacity with 7,800 t added in H1 FY27; Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 12.02% on raw-material and gas cost spikes, with management guiding a return to 15-16% if the war does not disrupt further.
calls.top: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.02% on RM spike

calls.name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Inverted front fork monthly sales: 75,000 by June 2026; 100,000 by end FY27
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 14.5% and standalone revenue up 31% YoY, but ₹73.7 crore aluminium/steel cost inflation is unrecovered and standalone margin would be 13.3% ex-impact.

calls.name: Sansera Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue record INR 9,987m (+28% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.3%, but new order booking soft and capex held at ~INR 5,097m for FY27 with forging capacity the binding constraint.

calls.name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 total revenue growth: about 35% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Aeroflex FY26 EBITDA INR99.7 crore at 22.6% margin, with skid assemblies only 5% of sales; the 15,000-unit skid expansion is targeted at 60% utilisation by March 2027, against a 2,000-to-6,000 capacity ramp that is still gated by design and customer audits.

calls.name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA FY27: INR150-160 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rishabh's FY26 margin recovery is real (consolidated EBITDA ₹1,264m, 16.3% margin), but FY27 guidance is EEI 20-25% growth at 20-22% margin and Alucast revenue below ₹200cr with no loss, while capacity is doubling at Nashik.

calls.name: R R Kabel Ltd
calls.gLine: FMEG value growth: 20%-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +33.7% to INR2,964 cr with volume only ~10% and price-led growth; inventory days rose ~8 and April demand called "normal" despite Middle East disruption and capex of INR1,200 cr FY26-28 still rising.

calls.name: Platinum Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: >40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue INR 132 cr (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.6%, but FY27 guidance of 40%+ growth rests on a new Palghar CPVC additive line and an Egypt plant starting Q3 FY27, with capacity and utilisation largely undisclosed.

calls.name: Shree Refrigerations Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 20% to 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue roughly 50%+ higher with H2 EBITDA margin 26.3% on operating leverage, but a 250-day receivables and 370-day working capital cycle still tie up cash; FY27 guidance is 20-24% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: DSM Fresh Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 70-80% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up ~69% to ~INR 221 crore with EBITDA ~INR 31 crore, but H2 EBITDA margin fell to 13% from 17% on B2B mix shift; FY27 revenue growth target 70-80% is unquantified in profit terms.

calls.name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA/PBT margin: ~13% near term; ~15% by FY29-30; 16-18% aspiration (FY29-30)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 sales up 9.8% QoQ to INR 9.5bn with OEM mix rising to 50% and margin ex one-offs at 11.5% (down from 13.1%), guided back to ~13% near term and ~15% by FY29-30 with ~INR 800 crore capex, new Pune plant by end-2028.

calls.name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Hyperlocal growth: 45% to 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Shadowfax grew FY26 revenue 69% to INR 4,200 crores+ with adjusted EBITDA near INR 159 crores, but management is raising capex and guiding 100–120 bps margin gains to FY28 with no supply discipline evidence.

calls.name: Hero MotoCorp Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry volume growth FY27: high single digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hero FY26 record year (EBITDA ₹6,871 cr, +17%) but commodity shock from March: ₹2,000/unit cost inflation vs ~2% price hike, medium-term 14-16% margin guide held without FY27 number.

calls.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Exit savings run rate: $200 million (FY26 exit)
calls.thesis: Hindalco's India aluminium upstream EBITDA of $1,756/t and record copper EBITDA of INR907 cr ride on a West Asia supply shock, but management expects copper to fall back to INR600-700 cr a quarter and India capex to rise to INR12,000 cr in FY27.

calls.name: Shalibhadra Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM: 500 crores by FY29 (FY29)
calls.thesis: Rural two-wheeler lender guiding AUM 220cr to 500cr by FY29 with branch expansion, while ROA is guided down from 8.65% to about 7% and yields fell from 25.4% to 20.8%.

calls.name: EFC (I) Ltd
calls.gLine: Design & Build revenue growth: ~40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flexible-workspace operator with strong FY26 growth (revenue +58%, PAT +67%), but working-capital build and right-issue funding raise cash-conversion questions; no capacity cut, capex stated as light.
calls.top: Working capital build in receivables, inventory

calls.name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Iron ore production FY27: 26 million tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Iron ore volume doubled to 22Mt with pellet plant at 100% utilisation and FY27 guided to 26Mt ore, 7.75-8Mt pellets; capex still rising to ~INR15,000 crore consolidated, with 49% Chemaf debt consolidated.

calls.name: KEI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 10.5-11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity-led volume ramp: FY27 volume guided +17-18% from Sanand and Chinchpada, with Q4 volume only ~2% due to capacity constraint and Sanand delayed six months.

calls.name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Paracetamol utilisation on new 10,800 MT plant: 70-75% in FY27; full in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 17.4% to INR619 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2% on price uptick and utilisation near 90%; management guides FY27 mid-teens growth and 14-14.5% EBITDA margin, with a 100-acre greenfield site and INR1,200-1,400 cr outlay.

calls.name: KDDL Ltd
calls.gLine: Watch components growth (medium term): slightly below 25% CAGR; 11-12% dials growth
calls.thesis: Standalone Q4 EBITDA margin hit 25.1% and FY26 revenue rose 31.9% to INR506 crores, but management gave no volume data, flagged a currency-driven margin tailwind, and guided margins flat; bracelet utilisation is 75-80%.

calls.name: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Lead volume FY27: 125,000-130,000 t (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 with EBITDA ₹218 cr (7.4% margin) and PAT ₹139 cr, but copper cathode capex (₹200 cr, Dec-26 Phase 1) is funded from internal accruals against negative operating cash flow from ₹265 cr receivables.

calls.name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue uplift from new capacity and yarn normalisation: 30% to 35% over existing revenue (post capex)
calls.thesis: Yarn spread up to ~INR120-125/kg from ~INR110 with spinning at 98%+ utilisation and ~INR1,100 crore capex (fabric +35m m, spinning +22k t) commissioning H2 FY27 — supply adds ahead, demand and spreads firm.

calls.name: Solar Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR14,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 FY26 revenue INR3,053 cr and EBITDA margin ~28.5% led by defence (INR1,008 cr, +134%); FY27 guide INR14,000 cr revenue at current margins, with working capital days rising to build inventory.

calls.name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue after INR 3,000 cr capex: INR 5,300-5,400 crore (post-expansion)
calls.thesis: FY26 volume growth only 1.7% and revenue up 3.95%; EBITDA/ton rose to INR 8,785 from 8,300, but management offers no capacity utilisation data beyond 88% and no peer capacity commentary, with 1.0→1.3 Mt expansion and INR 3,000 cr capex underway.

calls.name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
calls.thesis: Captive iron ore and pellet ramp (new 2 Mt pellet plant at 70%, pellet capacity 4.7 Mt) drove Q4 EBITDA up 91% QoQ to INR 439 cr, but FY27 mining guidance was cut to 3.4 Mt usable ore from ~4.5-5 Mt.

calls.name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ferrochrome output: about 400,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT rose to INR103 crore from INR47 crore on realisation of ~INR109,000/t vs ~INR87,000/t; KNR 1 and 2 ramp to ~400,000 t in FY27 with management guiding Q1 FY27 prices firmer and sales ~80,000 t.

calls.name: Globus Spirits Ltd
calls.gLine: Bulk volume: well over 20 crore litres (FY27)
calls.thesis: Globus Q4 FY26: bulk EBITDA INR8.3/l and 80% utilisation, but Q4 volume dented by ENA inventory build; capacity now 334 MLPA with no fundraise needed, net debt INR627 cr.
calls.top: Q4 ENA inventory build, liquidates Q1

calls.name: Monte Carlo Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Home textile share of revenue: 13% to 14% (FY27)

calls.name: Puravankara Ltd

calls.top: Collections INR82 cr vs revenue INR308 cr

calls.top: New West India shock absorber plant

calls.name: NRB Bearings Ltd

calls.name: V-Mart Retail Ltd

calls.name: Regency Fincorp Ltd

calls.name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd

calls.name: Shriram Properties Ltd

calls.name: Kalpataru Ltd

calls.name: Adf Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Ashoka brand growth: 30-35% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue INR196.7 cr (+23.7%) and standalone EBITDA margin 24.3%, but utilisation of 70-75% and a Surat greenfield ramping, with GCC (under 15% of revenue) shut since March; FY27 guide of INR925-1,000 cr now conditional on Middle East reopening.

calls.name: GE Vernova T&D India Ltd
calls.gLine: Export order from RPT: close to INR1,400-1,500 crores (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 orders INR86.1bn (+188% YoY) and backlog INR214.6bn (+49%) with EBITDA margin 27.2%, but management guides only to mid-20s margins and capacity adds run through 2028.

calls.name: Somany Ceramics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: at least 150 bps from FY26 9.3% base (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gas-cost shock from the March 2026 war lifted tile prices 15-17%, Morbi capacity is shut and 10-15% may never restart, and management guides EBITDA margin up 150 bps+ from 9.3%, though April demand was slow and utilisation only ~79%.

calls.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
calls.gLine: Kagal capex and capacity: INR1,400 cr over next two years for 20,000 engines; asset turn 4-5%; peak revenue INR5,000-6,000 cr (2 years)
calls.thesis: Standalone Q4 sales up 24% to INR1,522 cr with EBITDA margin 12.6%, but capacity push of INR1,400 cr over two years and INR700 cr already underway; management withheld volume/price split and RM pass-through quantum.
calls.top: Capex INR1,400 cr over two years

calls.name: Punjab & Sind Bank
calls.gLine: NIM: 2.65% to 2.70% by end of FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 profit of Rs1,322 Cr (+30%) and business +14.94%, but NIM a low 2.55% and Q4 slippages rose to Rs355 Cr; management guides NIM 2.65–2.70% by year-end.
calls.top: Q4 slippages Rs355 Cr vs Rs168 Cr

calls.name: Indiabulls Ltd
calls.gLine: Real estate profit FY27: at least 2x FY26 level (FY27)
calls.thesis: Former fintech/broking group now real-estate-led; Q4 PAT INR194 cr mostly one-off-like first real-estate revenue recognition, with 2x/3x profit targets unsupported by quarterly guidance and no capacity/supply discipline data.

calls.name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15%, top line closer to INR600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Restaurant chain with asset-light-ish growth: 32 new outlets planned in FY27 (INR37 cr capex), SSG 2.25% in Q4 and 11.57% in April, but ~4% price hike only and LPG-to-induction switch under way.

calls.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Mobile volume FY27 (ex-Vivo): flat / similar to FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue flat on smartphone demand and memory-cost headwinds; management guides FY27 non-Vivo volumes flat with 12-15% price-led mobile revenue growth, PLI roll-off trims margins ~50-70bps, and display/camera backward integration is the margin lever for FY27-28.

calls.name: Sandhar Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15%+ (excluding price re-trigger) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sandhar guides 15%+ FY27 revenue growth excluding price re-trigger, capex 5-7% of revenue (INR 275-310 cr), but margins flat-ish: +0.25% EBITDA target, with aluminium pass-through lag and April manpower shock dragging near term.

calls.name: Indostar Capital Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Disbursement CAGR FY26-FY29: 35% (FY29)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 disbursements up 17% QoQ to INR1,306 cr and an INR326 cr SR provision reset the balance sheet, but Stage 3 rose to 4.8% and FY29 targets (35% disbursement CAGR, INR450-500 cr PAT) are aspirational.

calls.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: NGC contract signing: current quarter (June 2026)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 7,002 crore (+38%) and PAT INR 748 crore, but order book fell to INR 15,324 crore, with NGC (~INR 33,000 crore, L1) contract signing still pending and no revenue before FY28.
calls.top: Order book down to INR 15,324 cr

calls.name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Gurgaon revenue growth (3-4 years): 15% to 17% YoY (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Gurgaon occupancy 64.6% with 546 beds; Raipur 300-bed capex INR 110-120 crores and INR 18-20 crores loss in first 18 months, ROCE target 16-18% on new capital. Supply additions are company-led, with no peer capacity commentary.

calls.name: India Pesticides Ltd
calls.gLine: Shalvis revenue FY27: INR 70-80 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue +27.9% to INR 1,078 cr with 18% EBITDA margin; management guides 15–20% growth and 18–20% margin, but the capex plan is mostly in a subsidiary and utilisation of the key PEDA/Pretilachlor block is only 70–75%.

calls.name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
calls.gLine: Beauty margin direction: each business to keep improving margin profile; similar trajectory in coming years (FY27+)
calls.thesis: Nykaa Q4 FY26 shows GMV and revenue growth of 28% with EBITDA margin 8.4% and fashion breakeven; capex is light at about 1% of revenue, but no capacity or supply-side metrics were disclosed.

calls.name: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores: at least 20 in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Fashion jewellery retailer grows stores fast (32 added in FY26, 126 touchpoints) with zero debt and ~INR78 cr cash; capital-light FOCO model, guides ~35% revenue CAGR but supply signals are retail expansion, not industry capacity.
calls.top: Stores added 32 in FY26, 18 in Q4

calls.name: GHCL Textiles Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 15% to 18% within next 3 years (FY29-FY30)
calls.thesis: Yarn spreads rose to INR148/kg in Q4 from INR123 in Q3 and management expects Q1 FY27 to hold, but 120 days of cotton inventory and a 15-18% EBITDA margin target by FY29-30 leave execution and working-capital risk.
calls.top: Spread INR123 → INR148/kg Q3 to Q4

calls.name: R K Swamy Ltd
calls.thesis: Integrated marketing services firm with consolidated income up ~15% and EBITDA margin ~15.5% vs 13.5%, but no numeric forward guidance, CX utilisation ~83% and capacity expansion (~50%) noted, zero debt.

calls.name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Gujarat plant utilisation: 35% to 40% in first six months; 65% to 70% in FY28
calls.thesis: Zinc oxide utilisation in the late 70s (~77%) with Gujarat capacity due in H1 FY27; FY26 record revenue of INR972.9 cr but Q4 EBITDA margin only 10.26% as March raw-material and energy spikes hit before pass-through from 1 April.
calls.top: Dahej capacity add; Naidupeta debottleneck by Dec 2026

calls.name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin FY27: 7% to 7.5% net (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity-constrained PEB maker: FY26 revenue Rs 1,898 cr (+31%) with full utilisation, order book Rs 1,700 cr, and five plants adding ~20,000 tons by Aug, but EBITDA margin flat at 9.3% and operating cash flow turned negative.
calls.top: Gujarat PEB plant commercial production July

calls.name: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Operational area (sq ft): More than 1,000,000 by end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex-workspace operator guiding to ~10 lakh sq ft operational by FY27 end (from ~3.5 lakh), but gave no revenue numbers, and fixed assets up 160% with debt-funded expansion and thin disclosure quality.

calls.name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Organic revenue growth FY27: 15% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Facility-services margin rose 3.1% to 4.2% in FY26 on pricing discipline and collections, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity or utilisation data, and the STEAG and LSG acquisitions reset the story.

calls.name: Raymond Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 blended EBITDA margin: 16%-18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pre-sales-led growth with JDA mix now 54% of FY26 bookings and FY26 EBITDA margin ~16%, guided 16-18% for FY27; management expects cash-negative operations for two years and Thane pre-sales flat at INR1,300-1,500 crore.

calls.name: Anthem Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: about Rs 700 crore, then about Rs 500 crore
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue grew about 15% to Rs 2,124 cr with EBITDA up 31% to Rs 990 cr; management refused FY27 guidance but disclosed Unit 4 capex of about Rs 700 cr next year, lifting capacity sharply.
calls.top: Unit 4 capex ~Rs 1,200 cr over two years

calls.name: GNG Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Refurbished-PC seller reports Q4 PAT up ~3x and FY26 revenue +34%, but inventory swelled to INR743 crore and debtors rose to INR206 crore, so margin gains rest on a bet on rising component prices.

calls.name: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Ltd
calls.gLine: Mangalsutra sales growth FY27: 33% to 35% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mangalsutra maker guides ~30% value CAGR for 2-3 years, but FY26 capacity use was 87% on a mid-year expansion to 4,000 kg, while working capital absorbed cash and FCF was negative.
calls.top: Working capital absorbs cash, no FCF

calls.name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Prefab revenue FY27: 30% growth, INR1,920-1,950 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity rising from 147k to ~220k MT by FY27-end with order book ~INR1,100-1,127 cr and 30% FY27 growth guided; Q4 utilisation 83% but sandwich panel line ran ~25% and margins fell 70-80 bps on steel costs.

calls.name: Studds Accessories Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 17%-18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity rising ~33% to over 12 million units by FY28 with 8-9% price hikes offsetting near-term raw material inflation, but management guided EBITDA margins flat and cut the 22-23% margin path this year.

calls.name: Aequs Ltd
calls.gLine: Aerospace revenue growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consumer capacity is ramping into 23% utilisation with INR500 crore more capex in FY27 and Hasbro exit, while aerospace grows 27% with 20% margin guided; supply side is expanding ahead of demand.

calls.name: Aegis Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex by March 2027: $1.2 billion aggregate (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 with LPG distribution margin ~INR7,000/t vs ~INR4,000 prior year, but management attributes it to a war-driven price spike and guides capex up sharply (~$1.2bn by Mar-27, ~INR5,000cr in FY28) with no numeric utilisation disclosed for terminals.

calls.name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: TAN production FY27: 1,60,000 - 1,70,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA up 56% to Rs 255 crore on urea mix and ammonia, but receivables jumped to Rs 2,075 crore and TAN capacity ramp (240,000 tpa) is the main new supply-side driver.

calls.name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
calls.gLine: India raw material cost change Q1 FY27: mid to high teens sequential increase
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 India volumes up high teens with capacity utilisation at 90%, but raw-material basket up mid-to-high teens forces 6-8% price hikes; Europe margin still 14.6% versus historic 16%+.
calls.top: Utilisation at 90% across India and Europe

calls.name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Vehicle Finance asset growth: approximately 18%
calls.thesis: Vehicle finance recovery showing up in April collections: early defaults and non-starters lower than April 2025, with FY27 credit cost guided to ~1.5% from 1.6% pre-overlay and a INR200 crore overlay held as buffer.

calls.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue above INR 1.25 lakh crore (+11%) and leverage at an all-time low 0.8x, but capex of INR 6,000 crore planned for FY27 keeps supply expanding; the consumer electronics ramp is still unproven, with GF3 the key test.

calls.name: RACL Geartech Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue vision: 1000 cr in 3-5 years, possibly by 2029 (2029-2030)
calls.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue ₹512 cr (+20%) with EBITDA margin 25.2% and debt down to ₹221 cr; supply side shows capex of ₹77.45 cr planned for FY27 with no capacity cut, while management reiterates ~20% growth and a ₹1,000 cr vision by 2029-2030.

calls.name: NTPC Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capacity addition (group): 9,557 MW (thermal 1,070; hydro 250; RE 8,237) (FY27)
calls.thesis: NTPC added a record 9,618 MW in FY26 and plans 9,557 MW in FY27 and 10,039 MW in FY28, with coal PLF at 72.04% against the rest-of-India average of 63.20%.

calls.name: Suzlon Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry installations FY27: 8 GW (plus/minus leeway) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 deliveries of 2,456 MW (+58%) and Q4 commissioning of 332 MW, but order book flat at 5.9 GW and FY27 delivery guidance left to trend language; capex run-rate guided to about INR600 crore.

calls.name: Paisalo Digital Ltd
calls.thesis: Paisalo, a last-mile NBFC, posted record Q4 PAT of Rs.722 million (+56% YoY) and reaffirmed doubling AUM in three years, but there is no supply-side or capacity signal and the call is management-led with little hard data.
calls.top: Doubling AUM and profit in 3 years reaffirmed

calls.name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Residential pre-sales FY27: at least 20% growth on FY26; aiming for INR 9,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Residential pre-sales fell 5% to INR 7,424 crore on launch slippage (8.3 mn sq ft vs 12 mn plan); FY27 guided to at least 20% growth to INR 9,000 crore, leaning on H2 launches and approvals.
calls.top: FY27 pre-sales ≥20% growth to INR 9,000 cr

calls.name: NHPC Ltd
calls.gLine: Subansiri Lower units commissioned by Mar'27: Remaining 4 of 8 units (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 1,460 Cr was inflated by a one-off Rs 1,156 Cr DTL reversal (about Rs 900 Cr net), so adjusted earnings are weaker; FY26 generation up 16% but PAF down to 74.75%.

calls.name: Oil India Ltd
calls.gLine: Oil and oil-equivalent production: 4 MMT with 100 wells (FY27)
calls.thesis: Upstream volumes near record (80k+ bpd, 74 wells, 100-well plan) but FY27 capex rollover at ~₹10,000 cr and NRL 3→9 MMTPA expansion on track for March 2027 with ~₹46,000 cr combined capex; gas uplift depends on pipeline authorisations.

calls.name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 disbursements: ~INR 600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small-ticket housing lender growing AUM 37% to INR 1,042 cr with GNPA 1.77% and CRAR 38.6%, but no capacity or supply-side signal; guidance of ~INR 600 cr disbursements and INR 1,300-1,400 cr AUM is management's own demand read.
calls.top: Mgmt contradicts itself on cost of borrowing

calls.name: Steel Exchange India Ltd
calls.gLine: Quarterly finance cost: around INR 12-13 crore (coming quarters)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA jumped to INR 50.10 cr (17.41% margin) from INR 22.97 cr in Q3, with rebar volume 49,760 t, but management gave no formal guidance and sustainability rests on an unfunded 1 mt green steel plan.

calls.name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15%-20%
calls.thesis: Passive telecom tower IP with 6,008 towers and Vodafone 5,000-tenancy order unconfirmed; FY27 growth guided only 15-20% and revenue per tower steady at INR31,000-32,000, so the capex cycle is still pending.

calls.name: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 incremental revenue from new capacity: INR300-500 crore over FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Manaksia added 36% alu-zinc capacity (132k→180k t) and is ramping, with Q4 EBITDA margin squeezed to 6.84% by energy and raw-material shock; management says new orders pass through full cost increases.

calls.name: Aster DM Quality Care Ltd
calls.gLine: Bed additions: ~2,500 beds over coming years; capacity to 8,150+ beds (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Aster Q4 FY26 revenue up 18% to INR 1,182 cr with operating EBITDA up 26% and margin 20.7%; capacity adds are disciplined (~2,500 beds over 4 years, INR 2,700 cr) with no sign of supply glut in the sector.

calls.name: Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost drag (renovation, tech, GST) as % of revenue: 3.7% by FY28, from 5.8% in FY26 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Hotel margins fell 126 bps to 48.1% in FY26 on renovation, tech and GST costs; management expects 3.7% of revenue cost drag to ease by FY28, but occupancy-led pricing in Q4 left ARR flat.
calls.top: Q4 ARR flat; occupancy over price

calls.name: Sigachi Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 650-675 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-accident MCC capacity loss keeps utilisation near 75-82%; supply rebuild via 12,000 t Dahej MCC (COD end-FY27) drives FY27 guidance of INR 650-675 cr revenue and 18-20% EBITDA margin, which is unproven against Q4's 12.6% margin.

calls.name: Uniparts India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: in line with FY26 (~21%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +31% YoY to INR339 crore and EBITDA margin 24% on volume recovery; management guides FY27 growth in line with FY26 (~20%) with capex held at 2.5-3.5% of revenue, though Q4 margin included warehousing mix and FX gains.

calls.name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA FY27: 75-80 crore (per Q&A)
calls.thesis: Capacity up 22% to 76,931 MTPA with utilisation at ~69% and capex falling to ~20 crore in FY27; Q4 EBITDA up 68% to 20 crore, but margin gains are partly inventory-driven and utilisation remains well below 80%.

calls.name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth (ex new acquisitions): 23% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Entero is a pharma and MedTech distributor guiding FY27 revenue +23% (about 11% from calendarisation) and 5% EBITDA margin, with margin expansion driven by gross margin and commercial-role MedTech contracts rather than capacity.

calls.name: JNK India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order book Rs 1,961 cr (~2.3x FY26 revenue of Rs 838 cr) with management guiding 25–30% FY27 growth and 14–15% EBITDA margin; utilisation not disclosed, capacity constrained by manpower and working capital, not plant.

calls.name: Manba Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 25-30% annually; AUM INR 2,300-2,400 cr by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small two-wheeler-led NBFC growing AUM 29% to INR 1,713 cr with NIM 13.63% and ROE 11.65%; supply-side signals are thin, and it is raising equity at a discount to its prior trading level.

calls.name: Dr. Agarwals Health Care Ltd
calls.gLine: Facility additions: 60 (40 surgical, 20 clinics) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Dr. Agarwal's is still expanding aggressively: 60 greenfield openings planned for FY27 (40 surgical, 20 clinics) and capex of INR 380-400 crores, with new facilities dragging ~INR 30 crore losses; supply is growing, not disciplined.

calls.name: Zelio E Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 unit volume: more than 125,000 units (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zelio claims FY26 revenue INR313 cr (+81.8%), EBITDA margin 12.2%, capacity 72k→240k units and FY27 guidance of 125k+ units, but supply-side claims are unaudited management assertions with thin disclosure on utilisation, pricing and receivables.

calls.name: Midwest Ltd
calls.gLine: Granite organic volume/revenue growth: 10-12% p.a. (FY27 and 3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Granite core steady at 27.6% EBITDA, but consolidated margin slipped to 27.0% as new Quartz plant runs at low utilisation; management targets 60% of 250-300kt capacity this year.

calls.name: Park Medi World Ltd
calls.gLine: Acquired-asset revenue contribution / CGHS uplift: CGHS net impact 5-6% of revenue; ~7-7.5% rate appreciation for nine months of FY27
calls.thesis: Network occupancy rose to 64.1% for FY26 (Q4 62.5%) while capex is guided at ~INR500 crore over two years for 1,500 beds, a capital-light expansion with debt near zero.

calls.name: Nephrocare Health Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Dialysis platform grew revenue 32% to INR998.8 cr with 17% treatment growth and margin up 100bp to 23.8%, but Q4 margin dipped to 20.9% on a INR10 cr one-time ECL provision and capex rose ~50% to INR165 cr.

calls.name: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 150 crore plus; 160-165 crore possible (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs 5.16 cr (+122.5% YoY) on 93.8% income growth, but FY26 gains come from new states and e-commerce; management guides FY27 Rs 150 cr with capacity headroom and no dividend.

calls.name: Kiaasa Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Store network: 250 EBOs by 2028; 300 by FY30 (per analyst) (FY28)
calls.thesis: Kiaasa is a small SME-listed ethnic-wear EBO roll-out story with FY26 revenue of Rs134.63 cr and EBITDA margin of 17.8%, but no supply-side evidence (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a 35% revenue CAGR vision to FY30 that management did not tie to capex.

calls.name: Omnitech Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30-35% (historical range) (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 49.1% to INR 511.3 cr with PAT margin 15.5%, but working capital rose to INR 294 cr, receivable days 153, and Q4 gross margin fell ~450 bps; supply-side capacity is expanding with no peer-capacity read.

calls.name: Eicher Motors Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 material cost headwind: 3% to 3.5% of material costs (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Eicher Q4 FY26 PAT of INR1,520m on 6,080m revenue at record volumes, but Q1 faces a 3–3.5% material-cost headwind with only ~50% recovered via a 1.75% price hike; Royal Enfield capacity to rise 1.4m→1.6m/yr via INR958m Cheyyar brownfield.

calls.name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 pre-sales growth: 25% to 30% CAGR
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with Q4 revenue Rs 181 cr (+18.5% YoY) and FY26 pre-sales Rs 977 cr, but no capacity or supply discipline evidence; margin pressure and rising debt (net debt/equity 1.81x) with FCF negative for four years.

calls.name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: double-digit to low double-digit volume growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 42% to INR 55 cr on Nitrile latex margin spike that management calls partly a March war blip; NBR at 100% utilisation, no major capacity until FY28, ADD not notified.

calls.name: Stylam Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: New plant commercial production: end June to mid July 2026 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Third greenfield laminate plant delayed again to end-June/July; management guides FY27 revenue up 20-25% and new plant ~INR250-300 crore, with capex of INR334 crore already spent and no prior numeric baseline to test against.
calls.top: New plant delayed again to June/July

calls.name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
calls.gLine: Guinea bauxite volume FY27: 10 to 12 million tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR5,237 crores (+91%) but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to about 11% as freight and bauxite prices corrected; management guides Q1 similar or worse and FY27 Guinea volume 10–12 Mt versus 15 Mt target.
calls.top: FY27 Guinea volume 10–12 Mt, below 15 Mt

calls.name: Asian Energy Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Kuiper top line FY27 (full year): $60M to $65M (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 57% to INR338 crore, but management admits it missed prior FY26 guidance on timing; FY27 standalone growth 30–40% and Kuiper $60–65M rest mostly on existing INR1,750 crore order book.
calls.top: Prior FY26 guidance missed on timing

calls.name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 margin improvement: couple of percentage points Y-o-Y (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management says tariff shock is behind them and guides FY27 margins up a couple of points, but capacity adds are small (~INR300-odd crore each at steady state) and working capital rose ~INR200 crore, so the supply-side read is neutral-to-positive.
calls.top: Tariff burden share gone from mid-Feb

calls.name: Sobha Ltd
calls.gLine: Launches FY27: close to 10 million sq ft (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sobha FY26 presales hit record INR8,136 cr (+30%) with net cash INR800 cr, but Q4 EBITDA of INR194 cr and margin recovery pushed to FY27 H2 on delayed occupancy certificates.

calls.name: SMS Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue growth of 15% with EBITDA margin above FY26's 20%, citing ibuprofen backward integration and an 800 MT/month capacity build by FY27 end; a Middle East-driven solvent cost squeeze already dented Q4 gross margin by 2%.

calls.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per kg FY27: 42.5 (range 42-43) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity utilisation is only about 68% (43,000 of 63,000 tonnes) with FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 crore, while EBITDA/kg guidance rises to 42.5 from 40.7 and EBITDA is targeted at INR210 crore from INR173 crore.
calls.top: FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 cr

calls.name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Internal net debt to EBITDA ceiling: 2.5x (medium to long term)
calls.thesis: Oncology chain reports FY26 revenue up 15% to INR2,545 crore and adjusted EBITDA margin up 70 bps to 18.5%, but Q4 growth slowed to 11.3% as management deliberately pruned low-margin volume.

calls.name: Sheela Foam Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated FY27 capex: INR125-150 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 11.5% (+400bp) on 24% revenue growth and 15% FY26 volume growth, but no capacity additions tied to demand; supply side is not the story.

calls.name: Mufin Green Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY27: minimum ~₹2,500 crore (FY2026-27)
calls.thesis: Mufin pivots from EV/solar lending to Mediclaim premium financing (39% of AUM, ROA 7-9%), targeting PAT ₹80-90 cr in FY27 from ₹28.21 cr, with no supply-side or capacity evidence and heavy reliance on management projections.

calls.name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~30% YoY for FY27 and FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹256 cr (vs ₹201 cr) and EBITDA ~₹97 cr at ~38%, but ~₹60 cr of Q4 revenue slipped to Q1 and capex of ₹400–500 cr is planned against ~₹300 cr free cash.

calls.name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: NODWIN fundraise: $100-200 million, mix of primary and secondary
calls.thesis: Gaming is now 90% of EBITDA (FY26 gaming EBITDA ₹265 cr, 24.7% margin); no hard FY27 guidance, only qualitative growth and margin expansion claims with Bluetile pro forma EBITDA "at the least would double".
calls.top: Bluetile acquisition consolidates from Q1 FY27

calls.name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: New launches FY27: >INR150bn (FY27)
calls.thesis: Presales fell YoY to INR82.5bn and supply is pipelined at 6.5m sq ft; guidance calls for >INR150bn launches, INR100bn sales and INR50bn revenue, with net debt near zero.

calls.name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (5-year CAGR): high-teens CAGR (next 5 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 28% YoY to INR682 crore with EBITDA 11.3% and PAT INR69 crore, but growth is demand-led brand execution with no supply-side or capacity disclosures; FY27 guidance is a 5-year high-teens CAGR.

calls.name: ASK Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.1% hit by alloy pass-through lag (80 bps, Rs 5 Cr loss); management guides mid-teens FY27 growth and ~Rs 400 Cr capex, with Karoli utilisation only 65%.

calls.name: DOMS Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR250-275 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +18.7% to INR604 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 16.7% on a 15-20% raw-material inflation against only 4-5% pass-through; Q1 margins guided slightly under pressure.

calls.name: Jana Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross loan portfolio growth FY27: 19% to 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 credit cost fell to 0.47% with slippages at INR334 crores and SMA at 3.66%; management guides FY27 gross loans +19-21%, deposits +23-25%, PAT +80%+ but no credit cost guidance beyond "same range or slightly better".

calls.name: Juniper Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Westin Bengaluru Phase 1 opening: Q2 FY27, 238 keys
calls.thesis: Hotel owner-operator with FY26 revenue up 11% to INR1,047.7 crores and EBITDA margin up 400bp to 42%; supply pipeline of ~1,400 keys by FY30 with capex ~INR1,800 crores, so capital discipline and returns are the test.
calls.top: Pipeline cut: ~4,000 keys FY29 to 3,320 FY30

calls.name: SRM Contractors Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 45%–55% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹1,026 cr (+94%) with 8.1% EBITDA margin, but management guides FY27 margins of 16–18% and ~₹250 cr capex funded partly by project debt, with a messy call on order book definitions.

calls.name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 15% to INR1,810 crore with EBITDA up 53%, but no numeric FY27 guidance; management calls FY27 a 'Year of Consolidation' with net 30-40 store adds and double-digit growth targets.

calls.name: Srigee Dlm Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR100 crores (management's personal target) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Srigee DLM says existing capacity is over 100% utilised and growth is space-capped until a new 10,850 sq m Greater Noida plant (~INR25cr capex plus land) is commissioned around August 2026; FY26 revenue INR72.31cr, PAT INR6.87cr.

calls.name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 capex: close to INR5,000 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Aegis Vopak is scaling storage ahead of demand: liquid capacity up 3.75x and a ~USD5bn capex plan to 2030, with JNPT's 318,100 cbm expansion starting next month and FY26 revenue up 17% to INR923.1 crores.

calls.name: Indiqube Spaces Ltd
calls.gLine: VAS share of revenue: 17-18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex-office operator adding 1.5-2.0 mn sq ft a year at ~INR 1,650/sq ft capex with guided 25-30% revenue growth; Q4 end-month occupancy fell to 81% while management blamed timing and cited an 84% full-year average.

calls.name: JSW Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: UAE grinding unit commissioning: April 2027 end
calls.thesis: JSW Cement Q4 volume +7% to 3.99 Mt and operating EBITDA +46% to INR365 cr, but April demand soft; Nagaur ramp and Punjab delay shift grinding capacity to Rajasthan, with the FY30 43.5 Mtpa target kept.
