calls.top: April demand soft, volumes recovering May

calls.name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue rose 40% QoQ to INR110 crore but utilisation fell to 60-65% from ~80% a year ago, with FY27 guidance withdrawn and Dahej phenol lines held back on raw-material costs.

calls.name: CMR Green Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: similar to FY26 (~25%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Recycled aluminium leader with FY26 volume up 24% to 80,381 t and EBITDA up 50% to INR449 cr, but no quantified guidance and capex of about INR200 cr for FY27 with capacity rising to about 7 lakh t.

calls.name: Uflex Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 performance: better than FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin hit 15.3% (highest in 14 quarters) on March spread spike, but management says spreads have since fallen significantly; FY27 margin guidance withheld, consolidated leverage 4.35x.

calls.name: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: just above 12.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pig iron volumes fell 3% in Q4 and Hiriyur BF was idle 3.5 months, but management sees pig iron prices recovering (+INR4,000/t since December) and targets 1.85 lakh t castings in FY27.
calls.top: Pig iron prices up INR4,000/t since Dec

calls.name: Birla Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume: mid-single digit growth
calls.thesis: Capacity held near 21.5 Mtpa until Maihar Line-II (6 Mtpa total to 27.5 by FY29) with ~INR4,300 crore net capex; utilisation near 99% ex-Mukutban, but FY26 EBITDA flagged flat-ish and cash flow weakened on incentive receivables and fuel stock build.

calls.name: Sagar Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volumes: ~7 million tonnes (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA/tonne ₹445 vs ₹218 a year ago on cost savings; FY27 volume guided ~7 MT (+15%) with ~₹25/bag hike sticking in South but flat-to-negative in Central/East.

calls.name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Marelli Talbros revenue growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 EBITDA margin 18.7% and FY27 guidance of 15-20% revenue growth, but capacity and order conversion are back-loaded; forging margin dipped on pass-through lag and capex is rising to INR 103 crore in FY27.

calls.name: Gufic Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: ~18% in FY27; above 20% by 2030 (FY27 to FY30)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR252cr (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.7% vs 13.2%, but FY26 PAT fell to INR63cr and management guides ~15% revenue growth and 18% EBITDA margin for FY27 with debt flat near INR400cr.

calls.name: Ashiana Housing Ltd
calls.gLine: Pre-sales FY27: Rs 2,200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ashiana FY26 booking value Rs 2,421 cr (+25%) and EAC +30% to 226.19 lakh sq ft, but supply signals are mixed: land pipeline ~96 lakh sq ft and mgmt says no capital returns, with Gurugram/Pune oversupply signs and a class action risk.
calls.top: Gurugram unsold inventory rising two quarters

calls.name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (standalone): ~20% in coming year (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue +22% with ~6.5% volume and ~8% price; capacity rises to 54,000 MT after Phase 1 by June 2026, guidance of 20% growth and 20%+ EBITDA margin, but Q4 gross margin dipped and capex ramp is calibrated.

calls.name: Orient Bell Ltd
calls.thesis: Orient Bell took ~20% cumulative price hikes in March–April on gas-cost pass-through, with Q4 EBITDA up 66% and utilisation near 65%; management refused numeric FY27 guidance.

calls.name: IIFL Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Gold loan AUM growth FY27: 20-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold loan AUM ₹52,581 cr (+150% YoY) with 62 t tonnage; FY27 gold AUM growth guided at 20–25% and credit cost to fall to 1.5–1.7%, but tax assessment overhang and no capacity-discipline signal.

calls.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ₹37,000 crore initial (FY27)
calls.thesis: Transmission capex delivered ~₹40,000 cr in FY26 vs ₹28,000 cr initial guide, capitalisation ₹28,206 cr; FY27 capex guide ₹37,000 cr and capitalisation up to ₹30,000 cr, with growth-led execution rather than supply discipline.
calls.top: FY26 capex ~₹40,000 cr vs ₹28,000 cr guide

calls.name: Renaissance Global Ltd
calls.gLine: US D2C revenue: INR375 crores by end FY27 (organic growth 35-40%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Jewellery D2C-led growth with FY26 revenue up 29% to INR2,572 cr and net debt cut to ~INR200 cr, but no supply-side data (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a retail-expansion capex story with no dividend.

calls.name: Minda Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: at least 1.5x industry growth, 15%+ if industry ~10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 revenue INR 1,704 cr (+29% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA INR 721 cr with 11.7% margin; capacity utilisation is only 75-80%, so supply discipline is not the story, and capex rises to INR 400-450 cr in FY27.

calls.name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 bookings growth: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 bookings of INR1,550 crore (+22%) and BD of ~INR3,140-3,200 crore, but revenue fell to INR564 crore from INR713 crore on OC deferrals; FY27 revenue growth left unquantified.

calls.name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
calls.gLine: Net PAT margin: 8-8.5% in Q1 FY27 (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Management has deliberately stopped sales since mid-March and deferred Unit 5/6 start-up (Rs 1,500cr FY27 target cut to Rs 1,250–1,300cr) as ammonia and sulphur prices roughly tripled; no Kharif revenue from new capacity.

calls.name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Double-digit growth aspiration: Double-digit growth aspired to
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% YoY to INR 2,034m with EBITDA margin steady at 31%, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, capacity expansion is deferred to September, and US demand is weak.
calls.top: Pricing constant; cost pass-through from New Year

calls.name: Share India Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: MTF book: INR 650 odd crores by FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 standalone PAT up 368% to INR 75 crore on prop/MTF growth, but management concedes RBI curbs on intraday prop limits could cut limits ~20%, and no capacity or supply discipline is discussed.
calls.top: RBI bars intraday limits for prop

calls.name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
calls.gLine: TI Medical growth: 20% YoY growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Engineering volume tracking revenue growth with no major Q4 price moves; Q4 consolidated PBIT-type profit up ~8% on revenue up 21%, while EV three-wheeler supply was disrupted by a body-in-white supplier and CDMO plant nears commercial output next quarter.
calls.top: Western tube utilisation ~30%, target 100% by mid-FY27

calls.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Advances growth FY27: around 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Microfinance book rebuilt to INR20,709 cr with growth guided to high single digits and secured mix rising to ~56%; FY27 ROA guided to 1.6% from exit ~2.1%, with NIM held near 8.5%.

calls.name: Acutaas Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue INR1,339cr (+33%) and PAT INR356cr; management guides 25% FY27 revenue growth and similar EBITDA margin (~35%), with capex falling to ~INR100cr-odd and utilisation of key plants at 31-75% in Q4.

calls.name: Medplus Health Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Net new stores FY27: 800 including franchisee outlets
calls.thesis: MedPlus adds 218 net stores in Q4 (800 planned for FY27) with store-level margins of 13.1% and mature-store SSSG of 17.8%, but management refuses margin guidance and is shifting growth to franchisees.
calls.top: Franchisee model launched, 310 stores in FY26

calls.name: Bondada Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 60-70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ~INR2,843 crore with order book INR7,147 crore and 1.5 GW commissioning target; management guides 60-70% FY27 growth but gives no capacity-discipline signal and leans on a new 120-130 crore plant plus data-centre and defence diversification.

calls.name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Steady-state credit cost: 2% (FY28)
calls.thesis: Credit-led recovery at a microfinance-heavy SFB: Q4 PAT only INR 24 crore, GNPA 5.4% and credit cost 1.08% in the quarter, with management guiding to 2% steady-state credit cost by FY28.

calls.name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high double-digit top line growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin only 3.3% with FY26 PAT still a loss of INR12.5 crores; management guides FY27 EBITDA to 4.8–5% but acquisitions and cess are eroding margins and debt rose on acquisitions.

calls.name: KRN Heat Exchanger And Refrigeration Ltd
calls.gLine: New facility utilisation: 50% FY27, 80% FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: New Neemrana HVAC plant only ~15% utilised last year; management targets 50% in FY27 and 80% in FY28, but Q4 inventory ~3x YoY and receivables up, with a Rs 500 cr QIP enabling resolution pending.

calls.name: Carraro India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue: ₹3,500cr to ₹4,000cr (FY30)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to ₹2,255cr and EBITDA margin 10.8% (vs 10.2%), but FY27 guidance softened to 4–8% growth from 8–12% amid West Asia energy and supply risk; capex ₹130cr held.

calls.name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
calls.gLine: Merchant capacity: 900 to ~1,130 tpd in next 12 months (12 months)
calls.thesis: Capacity additions are the growth lever: merchant capacity to ~1,130 tpd and on-site to ~1,000 tpd in 12 months, with Q4 EBITDA 30% reported (35% adjusted) and argon still below H1 FY26 levels.

calls.name: Tipco Engineering India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY26-27 (incl. Pune): INR180 crore plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tipco's FY26 revenue rose about 10% to INR146 crore with H2 up 66% and EBITDA margin 26.6%, but a debtor-days jump (72 to 169) and a Pune capex plan of INR60 crore offset the supply-side read.

calls.name: Ester Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: BOPET margin sustenance: 18 to 24 months (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: BOPET film margins look to have troughed: Q4 consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin 15.5% and Filmtech utilisation 85%, but Specialty Polymers volumes softened and reported EBITDA ex-MTM was still only 12.6%.
calls.top: Anti-dumping duties on China BOPET imports

calls.name: John Cockerill India Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: ~3% now, >10% within three years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue INR2,000m (+162% YoY) and order book INR13bn (+101%), but EBITDA only INR114m; consolidated EBITDA margin 1.4% with management targeting ~3% and >10% in three years.

calls.name: Ganesh Benzoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin recovery post rental reset: recovery over 2 to 3 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: JNPT tank utilisation near 95% with a ~50,000 kL expansion due by calendar year-end, but a 30-year rental reset cut margins and Goa is near zero utilisation.

calls.name: Tata Power Company Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: about INR25,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tata Power FY26 capex came in well below the earlier ~INR22,000-25,000 crore guide, with FY27 reset to about INR25,000 crore on a 2.5 GW commissioning plan, while Mundra SPPA settles and Odisha loss reduction runs.

calls.name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
calls.gLine: Shunt revenue from US key customer: Return to prior peak levels in FY27, surpass in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue +12.3% to ₹570.9 cr and EBITDA margin 22.9%, but much of the contacts growth is silver pass-through and utilisation is only ~60%, so supply discipline is strong while volume is flat.

calls.name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt-to-equity: 1.00x (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 presales of INR1,701 cr (+57%) and collections INR1,103 cr (+71%); FY27 presales target INR2,200 cr with debt-to-equity guidance rising to 1.00x from 0.53x actual.

calls.name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: above INR3,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rico FY26 revenue INR2,477 cr (+12%) and adjusted EBITDA margin 10.25% before INR19 cr lag and INR11 cr labour-code hits; management guides revenue above INR3,000 cr with no capacity-discipline evidence, only utilisation of 65-75% on ferrous and aluminium.

calls.name: BCL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: 150 KLPD Bathinda unit utilisation: at least 75% from Q2 FY27; rated capacity by first week of July (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 ethanol volumes rose ~74% to 53,000 KL as diversion to ENA/SBF offset lower OMC allocation; realisations under pressure, but 150 KLPD Bathinda unit adds ~INR300 crore revenue at full run-rate, with ~75% utilisation targeted from Q2.

calls.name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: north of 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Aurobindo's Q4 FY26 was flat YoY on lost Revlimid, with FY27 EBITDA margin guided north of 21% against rising solvent and freight costs; Pen-G backward integration is the main supply-side story, with output of 11,300 tons in March.

calls.name: Premier Explosives Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR600-700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR1,569 cr order book (4.04x FY26 revenue) but FY26 revenue fell 7% to INR388 cr on raw-material and plant-accident delays; FY27 guided INR600-700 cr, a 50-80% jump that depends on unproven alternate materials and Katepally commissioning.
calls.top: Katepally commissioning slipping to Q3 FY27

calls.name: Rishi Laser Ltd
calls.gLine: Malur plant revenue FY27: ₹60 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹160 cr (+7%) and PAT down 55% to ₹3.67 cr as Malur commissioning ran late; management now targets ₹60 cr from Malur in FY27 and an EBITDA band of 8–11%, with little evidence yet of supply discipline.

calls.name: India Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Efficiency programme: higher than INR300 per ton by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Document is UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call, not India Cements' own call; India Cements' EBITDA/t reached INR497 in Q4 with INR1,000 target by FY28, while sector pricing rose ~2.5% and bag costs hit INR90 crore in March.

calls.name: Jindal Steel Ltd
calls.gLine: Production FY27: 11–11.5 Mt (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity ramp to 15.6 Mt with capex program essentially finished; FY27 guide 11–11.5 Mt production, Q4 ASP up ₹4,743/t sequentially, but value-added mix fell and Australia written down ₹1,433 cr.

calls.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 2,600-2,800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ethanol allocation fell to 18 crore litres from 21 crore, about 50% fulfilled, yet management guides FY27 revenue INR 2,600-2,800 crore and 10-12% EBITDA margin with 26 crore litre capacity idle.

calls.name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
calls.gLine: P&A volume growth FY27: 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin 48% (+450bp) and EBITDA margin 19% on premiumisation; guides FY27 P&A volume +20% and 120–125bp margin expansion, with capex only INR 150–175 crores and no supply constraint flagged.

calls.name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR 275-300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 4,870 crore (+34%) and EBITDA margin 14.5%, but no capacity cut or deferral; management is adding capex of INR 275-300 crore and guiding to 20% CAGR, with a 3-6 month pass-through lag on input costs.

calls.name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital revenue growth FY27: 15%+ (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hospital margins rose to 22.2% in FY26 and management reaffirmed 25% by FY28, but occupancy slipped to 68% and CGHS/ECHS onco price caps are cutting volume in Punjab, with capex guided at about INR900 crores a year.
calls.top: Onco price cap hits Punjab volumes

calls.name: Refex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Ash & coal handling revenue: double-digit growth FY27
calls.thesis: Refex's ash & coal handling service mix lifted Q4 EBITDA margin to 20.1% on revenue of INR701 crores, but FY26 revenue fell to INR2,039 crores from INR2,259 crores and wind is only just ramping (EBITDA ~8%).

calls.name: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA per ton (FY27): INR8,000–11,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 EBITDA/ton to INR8,000–11,000 (up from 7,000–10,000) and rolled volume to ~250,000 t on a 270,000 t rolling capacity after reheating furnace commissioning; capex to ~INR2,600 cr committed through FY30.

calls.name: Bansal Roofing Products Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 26.8% to Rs45.89 cr but EBITDA margin only ~9%; management leans on unbuilt solar MMS capacity (25,000 t/month claim) with thin 2.5–3% net margins and 30–45 day credit, while utilisation of existing lines is low (roofing 50.7%, PEB 81%).
calls.top: Solar credit 30–45 days, receivables to rise

calls.name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 10-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Volumes up 40% in Q4 but EBITDA margin only 7.36% and FY26 net loss ~INR 9 crore; management says pricing pass-through is lagging raw-material costs up 5-15%, with utilisation at 78% in Q4 and no capex committed.

calls.name: BLS International Services Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20%-25% on increased base (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 37% to INR2,998 crore and Visa EBITDA margin up to 40.1%, but Q4 Visa revenue grew only 7% and management guides FY27 growth of 20-25% on internal targets, with no price or capacity signals.
calls.top: Net revenue per application INR2,903 → INR3,302

calls.name: Aditya Vision Ltd
calls.gLine: Store additions: around 25 stores per year (when asked) (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 18% to INR2,672 crore despite weak summer; Q4 revenue +28% and PAT +36%, but Q4 EBITDA margin 8.1% and inventory swelled to ~INR840 crore ahead of a summer that management says is cold-starting.

calls.name: NDR Auto Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Bharat Seats revenue FY30: INR3,500 crore (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin record 11.90% and order book INR650 crore (up from INR450 crore) mostly Maruti, but capex is own-program, no capacity-discipline signal; FY30 INR3,000 crore target lacks INR1,000 crore visibility.

calls.name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd
calls.gLine: Lucknow Gomti Nagar capacity: 426 to 570 beds over next 2 quarters (2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Q4 network EBITDA margin fell to 26.8% (vs 27.2% a year ago) as chemo-drug discontinuation cut oncology share to 21% and ALOS rose 9%; capacity adds are phased, with ~INR 1,400 crore Lucknow greenfield approved.

calls.name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 operating growth: close to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 22% YoY with EBITDA up 33%, but management is adding a fresh INR2,700 crore capex plan (stainless downstream, long wire mill) and guided ~30% FY27 growth; working-capital days were stretched via 130 payable days and 123 inventory days.

calls.name: Devyani International Ltd
calls.gLine: Net new stores FY27 (DIL standalone): 200 to 225 (FY27)
calls.thesis: QSR operator with KFC SSSG +4.9% and brand contribution up ~20%, but Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7% and net store closures in Q4 leave supply discipline and pricing unproven; no capex-per-store change guided.

calls.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 40% (more than 40% expected) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Vijaya Diagnostic Q4 FY26 revenue up 26.6% on 18.5% volume, EBITDA margin 43.5%; capex guided INR 140-150 crore for FY27 with 4-5 hubs and 10-12 spokes, a volume-led expansion rather than a supply-discipline signal.

calls.name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Engineering revenue up ~14% in FY26 to INR1,444 crore with EBITDA INR264 crore; management guides mid-teens India growth and only maintaining margins, with Advantek still loss-making and Romania EBITDA negative.
calls.top: Europe demand slowly improving, cost still negative

calls.name: Insolation Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 module revenue growth: 50-60% / at least FY26 growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Solar module maker scaling to 4.5 GW cell line (COD Q3/Q4 FY27) with FY27 module volume guided ~2 GW; margins guided 14-15% FY27 and 20%+ later, but receivables up 156% and FCF deeply negative.

calls.name: Global Health Ltd
calls.gLine: Mature hospital margin: 24%–25% range
calls.thesis: Medanta FY26 supply build-out continues: 623 beds added, ~2,700 greenfield beds and FY27 capex INR 800–900 crore; mature-hospital margin 24.4% and Noida losses narrowing (Q4 loss INR 236m vs Q3 INR 320m).

calls.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (organic): 35% to 40% over next couple of years (2 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 86.6% to INR7,737m with 13–14% EBITDA margin guided, but inventory days jumped 60→86 and management gave no quantified capacity or supply-side detail; base order book only ~INR800-900m ex-strategic orders.

calls.name: Tata Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth: double-digit cc, ex ES-Tec
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12.4% QoQ cc (8.8% organic) with EBITDA margin 16%; management guides double-digit FY27 cc growth and 18%+ exit margin, but no supply-side capex or capacity data disclosed.

calls.name: Flair Writing Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Inventory days reduction: 5 to 7 days in next 2 quarters (2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margins held (EBITDA 17.9%, GM 51.2%) on pre-stocked raw material, but management guides ~4% Q1 margin hit from crude-linked inputs (~35% of RM) and 15% FY27 revenue growth.

calls.name: GPT Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mature hospitals earn 23.06% EBITDA margin ex-Raipur, but Raipur's FY26 EBITDA loss of INR13.8 crores drags the reported margin to 18.84%; guidance hinges on Raipur breakeven by Q3 FY27.

calls.name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 incremental sales delta: Rs 330-350 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gopal Snacks Q4 revenue Rs 409.6 cr (+29% YoY) with Rajkot plant back and Modasa integrated; FY27 EBITDA guided 8-9% while palm oil/packaging inflation of 4-4.5% is being offset via grammage cuts and price hikes.
calls.top: FY27 capex Rs 40-45 cr, mostly maintenance

calls.name: Waaree Energies Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA FY27: INR7,000-7,700 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 but Q4 margin fell to ~18.6% on commodity, freight and mix; FY27 operating EBITDA guided to Rs7,000-7,700 crore on 10 GW cell ramp, with capex of ~Rs30,000 crore raising supply risk.

calls.name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
calls.gLine: Medium-term revenue growth India: low-teen revenue growth and high-teen EBITDA growth (medium to long term)
calls.thesis: Hospitality-led growth with rate-led India (ADR +13%) and Maldives occupancy gains, but Q4 EBITDA growth was 8% ex-FX gain and management gave no numeric guidance, with April–May Maldives traffic data contested.

calls.name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 1,007 crores (+157%) and order book above INR 1,400 crores, but supply is the binding constraint: insulators at 18–24 month lead times and capacity arriving only from July–December 2026, so FY27 growth guided at 15–20%.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Store expansion capex: INR 250-300 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +12% to INR 2,174 cr with EBITDA margin 17.2%, but growth is demand-led with capex trimmed to about INR 300 cr and store net adds guided stronger; supply discipline is mixed, not a capital-cycle signal.

calls.name: Neetu Yoshi Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 peak revenue: INR350 crore approx (FY28)
calls.thesis: FY26 PAT of INR25 crore (up 53%) on INR101 crore income; management guides INR210-220 crore FY27 revenue at ~25% PAT margin, with new bogie plant only starting in June and working-capital-heavy track expansion funded by INR29 crore warrants.

calls.name: Solarworld Energy Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from order book: ~INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Solar EPC-plus-module integrator guides FY27 revenue near INR2,000 crore (70% of INR2,800 crore order book) with margins 8–11%, but module line utilisation is only ~40–45% on captive orders and the cell line is not until June 2027.
calls.top: Margin range cut to 8-11% from prior 11% PAT

calls.name: Infinity Infoway Ltd
calls.gLine: ZeroTouch share of revenue: 20% to 22% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small-cap SaaS/ERP firm guiding ZeroTouch to 20-22% of revenue and FY27 growth of 60-70%, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing data backs it; supply-side evidence is absent.

calls.name: Rubicon Research Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: close to INR300 crores over next couple of years (two years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 44% YoY to INR5,140m with EBITDA margin ~23%, but management is outsourcing more manufacturing as internal capacity is constrained and Pithampur ramp is pushed to CY27; capex deliberately lagging demand.
calls.top: Outsourcing up as internal capacity short

calls.name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 net new store additions: around FY26 levels (542 India net adds in FY26)
calls.thesis: Lenskart Q4 FY26 revenue up 41% to ₹2,516 crore with pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin 12.8%, but management gave no capacity or supply-discipline signals and is opening stores at FY26 pace (~542 India net adds in FY26).
calls.top: Eye tests up 45% YoY in Q4

calls.name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: RE Power Sales capacity addition FY27: at least 1,500 MW (FY27)
calls.thesis: CleanMax added about 1,400 MW in FY26 with 5.7 GW contracted and guides at least 1,500 MW for FY27, but a 525 MW CTU project in Rajasthan faces 30% curtailment at Bikaner 2, and DSM rules are an unquantified risk.

calls.name: Om Power Transmission Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Maiden call of a T&D EPC: FY26 revenue INR 449 crore (+61%), order book INR 621 crore (book-to-bill 1.38x), EBITDA margin steady at 12.7%, with management guiding 50% growth in FY27 and 12-13% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR15,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: SAIL's Q4 FY26 volumes rose 4% to 5.3Mt with PAT up 43%; management guides FY27 sales to 22Mt and capex to Rs15,000 crore, with NSR up about Rs4,000/t since Q4 — but the capex ramp to Rs20,000-25,000 crore is a supply-side warning.

calls.name: SPML Infra Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue and PAT growth: >25% minimum (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue INR868 crores missed the INR900-1,000 crore guidance; management blames fund-availability-led execution pacing and promises >25% growth in FY27 with EBITDA margin near 10%, while NARCL dues remain INR380 crores against INR700 crores agreed.

calls.name: Tata Steel Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~Rs 20,000 crores, >60% India
calls.thesis: India EBITDA up 17% to Rs 34,272 cr at 24% margin; 1QFY27 India realisations guided ~Rs 6,000/t higher QoQ, but Netherlands coke-oven closure and UK grid delay add execution risk.

calls.name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
calls.gLine: Excel Controlinkage stake: Final 20% acquisition in Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Core standalone revenue up 22% and FY26 EBITDA margin up 40bp, but Q4 gross margin fell on commodity costs, capex is undefined for the year, and the EV subsidiary remains loss-making with no break-even path disclosed.
calls.top: Q4 gross margin down on commodity costs

calls.name: Triton Valves Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27 (four auto and metals verticals): 10-12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 volumes +10-12% and brass tonnage above 7,000 t, but admits commodity pass-through lag cost ~₹1.75 cr EBITDA and climate control is under Chinese dumping pressure.

calls.name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 carbon black volume: high single-digit volume growth
calls.thesis: Carbon black volume up 8% YoY to 161,865 MT but EBITDA/ton flat and cost pass-through lags to Q2 FY27; management guides double-digit FY27 EBITDA growth with no hard numbers beyond high single-digit volume.
calls.top: Spot price hikes taken from March

calls.name: Black Rose Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Top line: Increase over previous year at current market prices (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 38% and EBITDA up ~90% on distribution stock-and-sell gains; management says margins are price-driven and refused any FY27 EBITDA number, so the quarter's sustainability is unproven.

calls.name: Jyoti Resins & Adhesives Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: 15%-20%
calls.thesis: Q4 volume grew ~16% but VAM costs roughly doubled, price hikes cover only 60-70% of raw-material inflation from May, and receivables stretched to ~150-160 days, so margin and working-capital risk sit ahead of any capacity-led growth.
calls.top: Receivables ~150-160 days, up from INR 125 cr to INR 160 cr

calls.name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross debt FY27 closing: ₹1,100–1,200 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume growth 18–20% with utilisation ~65% annual (70% in Q4) and no big capex for two years; FY27 guided to ~15% volume and EBITDA growth, with net debt cut by over ₹750 crores.

calls.name: Batliboi Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line and bottom-line: improved, no numbers
calls.thesis: Batliboi FY26 revenue up 7% to INR440 cr with PAT about INR7 cr; order inflow INR990 cr and backlog INR593 cr, but no numeric FY27 guidance and backlog-vs-revenue gap is unexplained.
calls.top: Order inflow INR990 cr in FY26

calls.name: Timken India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Outgrow market, no percentage given
calls.thesis: Timken India FY26 standalone revenue hit a record INR3,148 crore (+8.6%) with 15.5% PBT margin, but cost pass-through is only 10% achieved and the Bharuch plant is near breakeven, targeting 70% utilisation by July.

calls.name: Genus Power Infrastructures Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR6,000-6,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Smart-meter AMISP with FY26 revenue INR4,738 cr (+94%) but working capital still 274 days, net debt up to INR1,573 cr, and FY27 EBITDA guided down ~2.5pp to 18% on fixed-price contracts.

calls.name: Paramount Communications Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 15-20%, assuming current metal prices hold (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity-constrained cable maker at full utilisation; FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 6% on US tariffs, with Narmadapuram greenfield (INR 300 cr, FY28) the main supply expansion and FY27 guided at 15-20% top-line growth.
calls.top: Narmadapuram greenfield INR 300 cr by FY28

calls.name: Apar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Conductor EBITDA per MT (medium to long term): INR35,000 to INR36,000 plus tailwinds
calls.thesis: Apar's Q4 operating PAT ~INR285cr (ex INR31cr one-offs), but management flags near-term volume and margin drag from Middle East war, polymer shortages and freight; FY27 capex raised to ~INR1,500cr.

calls.name: Jindal Stainless Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 sales volume growth: 7% to 9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Jindal Stainless guides FY27 volume +7-9% and H1 EBITDA/ton of INR18,000-20,000 despite gas cost spiking 2.5-3x; Indonesia melt shop (1.2 Mt) adds capacity while Maharashtra capex is still in land acquisition.
calls.top: QCO suspended; imports of substandard product

calls.name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow: INR8,000-10,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 consol revenue +14% to INR1,199 cr and FY26 revenue INR3,615 cr hit guidance, but FY26 revenue fell 2% and FY27 growth guided 15-20% with order book ~INR20,000 cr and no capex discipline signal.

calls.name: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd
calls.gLine: Keys added in FY27: >1,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Holiday-club operator: standalone Q4 EBITDA margin 34.9% (+180bp) and resort utilisation ~81%, but a INR234 crore standalone impairment on Finland/HCRO and weak member-acquisition cash flow temper the read.
calls.top: INR234 cr impairment on Finland book

calls.name: Health X Platform Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin at Rs 6,000 cr revenue: around 5% (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue Rs 356 cr (+22% YoY) with EBITDA margin -5.5% and FY26 capex plan of Rs 234 cr for new warehouses; supply is expanding, not disciplined, with no peer capacity commentary.

calls.name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 27% to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 order inflow record INR2,422 cr and order book INR4,476 cr (3.5x revenue), but Q4 standalone revenue grew only 1.3% and FY27 guidance of 27-30% growth rests on catch-up from West Bengal election disruption.
calls.top: Contract assets INR336 cr → INR514 cr

calls.name: Sharda Motor Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR90 crores to INR110 crores, plus new facility capex over and above (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 30% to INR971.8 cr but gross profit up only 13% and FY26 gross profit up 8% vs revenue 20%; management gave no volume or margin numbers and capex guided up to INR90-110 cr.
calls.top: FY27 capex guided INR90-110 cr, raised

calls.name: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue CAGR long term: ~30% (long term)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 12.5% to INR264 crores with EBITDA margin 20.6%, but supply deferrals missed the 20-25% growth target, working capital ballooned on pre-buying, and a INR100 crore capex plan adds new verticals on a 66% PVC extrusion utilisation base.

calls.name: Gujarat Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: CGD EBITDA per scm: INR5.5 to INR6.5 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-merger GEL Q4 EBITDA rose to INR943 crore (from INR790 crore) on Morbi ceramic gas demand and CNG growth, but FY26 PAT was flat at INR2,299 crore and management gave no quantified margin guidance beyond CGD INR5–6/scm.

calls.name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: AdTech platform reports FY26 revenue INR218.5 crore, EBITDA margin 20.8% and revenue per outcome up to INR48.44 in Q4, but no capacity, utilisation or peer-supply data; capital-cycle read is not applicable.

calls.name: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY28: ~28% at INR800-850 crore revenue (FY28)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue INR650-700 crore and PAT INR100 crore, but supply side is expanding: FY27-28 capex of ~INR180-190 crore (oncology, hormones, biosimilars, BE) with a working-capital stretch from Middle East receivables.

calls.name: SIS Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: around 5% to 6.5%
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue and margin in security and FM, but the call offers no capacity, utilisation or pricing-discipline data; wage-driven pass-through and Labour Code tailwinds are the main supply-side story.

calls.name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd
calls.gLine: CDMO / group revenue CAGR (3 years): ~15% CAGR (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 19% to INR 851 crore and FY26 EBITDA margin 19.3%, but Q4 was hit by INR 50-odd crore onerous-contract provisions, and no capacity additions are planned beyond partner-funded co-investment.
calls.top: No major capex; partner funds co-investment

calls.name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of borrowing: 9.20% to 9.25% over next 2-3 quarters (2-3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Consolidated PAT up 21% to INR379 crores and AUM up 19% to INR15,304 crores, with standalone net Stage 3 steady at 1.70%, but cost of borrowing down only 42bps and credit cost guided 1.0-1.25% alongside a 1.5-1.6% watch.

calls.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 20.0-25.0% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT INR 340 Cr (ROA 4.4%) on NIM 14.2%, but FY27 guides credit cost 3-4% vs FY26 6.74% and NIM down to 12.8-13.2%; MFI growth only 10-12%, retail carries growth.

calls.name: Kranti Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Plant-4 (Jaipur) revenue FY27: ₹12-14 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone FY26 revenue up 30% to ₹93.88 cr and EBITDA margin 10.5%→13.3%, but Pune utilisation only ~65% and new Jaipur plant under 40% utilised, so capacity is running ahead of demand.

calls.name: Arvind Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: mid-double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Branded apparel retailer guides mid-double-digit FY27 growth and 30-40bps EBITDA margin expansion with ROCE above 23%; supply-side signals are limited, with inventory days up about 18 days and a 30% inventory rise flagged by analysts.

calls.name: Gland Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27 (constant currency, ex-GLP-1): 12-13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% to INR17,428m with base-business EBITDA margin 41%, but supply-side expansion continues: INR2,000 crore capex over three years and 140m GLP-1 cartridge capacity ahead of contracted demand.

calls.name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
calls.gLine: Free cash flow neutral: over next 4 to 6 quarters (4-6 quarters)
calls.thesis: India QSR SSSG hit 6.3% in Q4 with restaurant EBITDA 11.6% and GM exit 70%, but Indonesia impairment of INR120 crore and an unresolved promoter change weigh on the story.

calls.name: Indigo Paints Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin: down 200–250 bps; EBITDA margin broadly unchanged (FY27)
calls.thesis: Indigo Paints Q4 revenue +8.4% with gross margin 48.6%, but management is deliberately trading 200–250 bps of gross margin for faster growth and says no major capex until FY29.
calls.top: Gross margin down 200–250 bps for growth

calls.name: Electronics Mart India Ltd
calls.gLine: NCR (Delhi) revenue FY27: INR800-plus crore, 25-30% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 15% to INR1,913 crore with EBITDA margin 6.7% (vs 5.6%) and SSSG 12.2%; retailer with no capacity-cycle signal, growth driven by GST cut and summer, store adds slowing.

calls.name: Sula Vineyards Ltd
calls.gLine: Own brands production / sales growth FY27: scale up four launched wines' production ~40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +7% to INR 142 cr on own brands recovery, but grape-mix shift cut gross margin 350-400 bps; capex to fall below FY26's INR 25 cr, inventory being run down.
calls.top: Capex cut to below INR 25 cr

calls.name: AVG Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin expansion was flattered by a one-time Ind AS 116 lease reversal gain of about INR21 crores, and management guided FY27 growth of 15-20% with capex of INR50 crores-plus, with no capacity-discipline commentary.
calls.top: One-time INR21cr lease gain treated as recurring

calls.name: Allcargo Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: Farrukhnagar PFT-ICD completion: PFT April 2027; ICD ~2 quarters later (FY27-28)
calls.thesis: CFS/ICD operator in capacity-build mode: FY26 volume 723,035 TEUs (+6%), EBITDA +26%, with Farrukhnagar PFT-ICD and ~INR400cr capex plan; EBITDA/TEU ~INR2,300-2,400 held, no capacity-cut signal.

calls.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: DA income growth: 10% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Affordable housing lender guides to repeat 20% AUM, 20% PAT and 17-18% disbursement growth, with cost of funds flat for 2-3 quarters and spreads seen contracting 8-10 bps; no capacity-supply signal.

calls.name: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: CDMO volume growth H1 FY27: double-digit (H1 FY27)
calls.thesis: CDMO volumes grew double digits with Q4 EBITDA margin at 13.1% group level, but API still loses INR40 crore in FY26 and FY27 guidance is only directional; capex rises to INR300 crore from INR222 crore.

calls.name: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margins rebounded to 38.5% gross on low volumes, but Q4 revenue was weak and recovery depends on unproven demand ramp, Gigafactory scale-up and capital raise at the cell subsidiary.

calls.name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Hedging FY27: 75% to 80% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 gross margin fell to 9.7% as bars and coins hit 40% of sales (vs 28%), yet management held FY27 guidance of INR13,500 crore revenue, 7-7.5% EBITDA and 4% PAT with no numeric update on the margin.
calls.top: Q4 gross margin 9.7% on bars and coins

calls.name: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper normalised EBITDA per ton: INR30,000–32,000/t steady state (forward)
calls.thesis: Q4 copper EBITDA/ton collapsed to about INR14,000 from INR42,000 in Q3 on formula mismatch and war costs; management guides normalised INR30,000–32,000/ton, but the reset rests on management's own assertion, with copper utilisation only about 65%.

calls.name: Pine Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 21% to 23.5% YoY (FY2027)
calls.thesis: FY27 revenue guided at 21–23.5% (hard guide) versus ~19% in FY26, with Q4 hit by POS chip-shortage delays of ~2 lakh machines; capex run-rate Rs180–190 Cr, contribution margin 73–74% in Q4.

calls.name: Corona Remedies Ltd
calls.gLine: Acquired brand revenue growth: 25% (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Corona Remedies is a branded-India specialty pharma with no capacity-cycle signal; FY26 revenue +17% on 3% volume and 7.8% pricing, Q4 EBITDA margin down ~90bps to 17.6% on growth-investment costs, and FY27 guided at 15% organic revenue growth and 20%+ PAT growth.

calls.name: RSWM Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 EBITDA direction: current quarter slightly better or equivalent to last quarter (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell 9.1% YoY to ₹1,142 cr, but FY26 EBITDA rose 40.5% to ₹327 cr on margin 7.1%, with capacity cut at Chhata and utilisation guided up 7–10% from Q4 levels.

calls.name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail rental growth FY27: mid-to-high double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Retail rentals up 10% to Rs 2,157 cr against consumption up 21%, with ~36-50% of area up for renewal; no new retail capacity added in FY26, so supply discipline is strong and rent growth is the lagging catalyst.

calls.name: TANFAC Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: 15% to 18% from existing business
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR711 crores (+27%) but EBITDA margin fell to 16% from 23%; INR495 crores capex for 20,000 t HFC-32 depends on a quota still undecided by government, with 65% of capacity pre-booked.
calls.top: HFC-32 quota undecided; capex INR405 crores

calls.name: Cosmo First Ltd
calls.gLine: Film top-line growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Film utilisation 80-85% with 15-20% headroom, BOPP/BOPET spreads flat-to-up YoY but management flags 7-8 new Indian lines and BOPET oversupply; capex cycle done, net debt guided below 2x in 12-18 months.
calls.top: Seven to eight lines coming in India

calls.name: Lumax Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin: 10.5% to 11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 4,184 crore (+23%) and EBITDA margin 9.8%, with a FY27 double-digit 10.5–11% margin target and capex guided to INR 100–150 crore, but input-cost pass-through lags about one quarter.

calls.name: Orchid Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Base business EBITDA margin FY27: around 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR238 crores and EBITDA INR42.3 crores, with margins recovering as cephalosporin price erosion eased; FY26 EBITDA fell to INR101 crores from INR155 crores, and management guides base-business margin of about 12%.
calls.top: Pricing up in April on war

calls.name: Jubilant Pharmova Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: low double digits (FY2027)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell 272bp to 15.7% on Montreal under-absorption and SPECT shortage; capex held at about Rs.1,668 Cr-level for FY27 with H2 FY27 margin guided at 17-18%.

calls.name: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: High teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zydus closed FY26 with record margins (31.2% EBITDA) and guides FY27 high-teens revenue growth and above 24% margin, but net debt rises toward ~1x on acquisitions and capex steps up to ₹1,500 crore.

calls.name: MPS Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA: comfortably cross INR 300 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA INR 236 crore (30.7% margin) and FY27 guided to cross INR 300 crore EBITDA, but no capacity or capex signal; Q4 ex-AJE research margin softened and no dividend declared.

calls.name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth with acquisitions (3-year CAGR): 20% (3 years)
calls.thesis: Apparel brand owner with FY26 revenue up 20.9% to INR 1,212 cr and EBITDA margin 19.6%, but growth target lifted to 20% CAGR via acquisitions; no capacity signal, mostly outsourced manufacturing.

calls.name: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA: expand meaningfully on FY26 base; profitability return (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 5.3% (up from 0.8% in Q1) on 3% lower FY revenue, but yarn price pass-through only protects margins and no capacity discipline is quantified; FY27 guidance is directional only.
calls.top: Yarn prices passed through, margins protected

calls.name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: ~10% full year, 10–12% range thereafter (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 group EBITDA 9.3% (10.3% ex-tariff and ramp-up losses) on revenue ₹5,025 crore; capacity now 101m pieces with FY28 target 125–130m and ₹200–250 crore FY27 capex, but no hard demand visibility on new capacity.

calls.name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue recognition growth FY27 vs FY26: 35-40% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Real estate-led Mumbai developer with no capacity or utilisation data; FY26 revenue flat at ~INR630 crore, sales ~INR1,800 crore, management targets INR5,000 crore presales over FY27-28 and 35-40% revenue growth, with little hard disclosure behind it.

calls.name: Rushil Decor Ltd
calls.gLine: Value-added MDF share of volume: 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rushil Decor Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 12.4% on flat revenue, but MDF oversupply looms with three plants coming this year and the 15% price hike is only cost recovery, not margin gain.
calls.top: Three new MDF plants in FY27

calls.name: Sammaan Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 disbursements: approximately INR30,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-IHC takeover, management guides to PAT of INR1,400 crores, NIM rising from 3.5% to ~8% and cost-to-income falling to 26%, but the story rests on rating upgrades and cost of funds falling 270 bps, with no supply-side evidence.

calls.name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
calls.gLine: Micro-irrigation revenue growth: 20-25% CAGR over next three years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue hit a record INR142 crore (+80% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 9.96% on March raw-material spikes; working capital rising, with no capacity-discipline or peer-supply evidence on the call.

calls.name: PNC Infratech Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue FY27: ~30% growth, ~INR 6,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 standalone revenue fell short on delayed HAM appointed dates; management guides ~30% FY27 revenue growth to ~INR 6,000 crore and ~12% EBITDA, but FY26 execution misses weigh on credibility.

calls.name: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin steady state: 73% to 74% (steady state)
calls.thesis: Asset-light franchise diagnostics growing early-20s with 10,800 franchisees, 40 labs at ~65% utilisation and maintenance-led capex of about INR40 crores; no supply-side tightness, growth is volume-led.

calls.name: Fratelli Vineyards Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~30% over FY26 (about INR240 crore) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 13% to INR36 crores and EBITDA turned near breakeven (INR1.06 crore FY26), but FY26 revenue was flat at INR184 crores and management's FY27 30% growth target rests on RTD and luxury momentum with no capacity signal.

calls.name: Synergy Green Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Foundry capacity expanded 30k→45k tpa but FY26 revenue grew only 3.5% and PBDIT margin fell to 13.1%; FY27 guide ~33% growth to ₹500 cr and 300bp margin expansion, with utilisation ramp of 4–5 months still unproven.

calls.name: Sky Gold And Diamonds Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR8,100 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sky Gold is shifting to advanced-gold (job-work) model, cutting working capital days to 59 from 71 and targeting 50%+ debt reduction in FY27, but utilisation is only ~55% and margin claims rest on mix shift and guidance credibility.

calls.name: BMW Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Bokaro project ROCE: 15%+ blended (Steady state)
calls.thesis: Legacy tube/CRM conversion runs at ~34% utilisation with no new capex; Bokaro greenfield (~INR803 crore) starts phased commissioning Q1 FY27, with management guiding ~75% revenue CAGR FY25–FY28 and blended EBITDA margin 12–13%.
calls.top: Bokaro ~INR803 cr greenfield, phase one Q1 FY27

calls.name: Antony Waste Handling Cell Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue CAGR: 15% to 20% over next 5 years (5 years)
calls.thesis: Waste management company with Rs.18,000 crore order book (60% processing) and Rs.650-750 crore capex for AP WTE projects; volumes up strongly but underlying non-CIDCO revenue growth only ~8%, EBITDA margin ~22% and PAT growth tied to interest and depreciation.

calls.name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: NBFC AUM growth: 15% to 20% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +22.6% YoY and EBITDA margin 17.4% (+250bp) on broking and insurance leverage, but FY26 EBITDA fell 10.3% and PAT 29.9% as NBFC AUM shrank to INR 1,119 crore and finance costs rose to INR 221.3 crore.

calls.name: Laxmi Organic Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej Phase 2 chemical charging: Q1 FY27 (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Acetic-acid-driven ETAC spreads spiked to ~$250 in April then eased to $150–160, with FY26 revenue down 6% and Specialties recovery dependent on Dahej and Hitachi ramp-ups in H2 FY27.

calls.name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
calls.gLine: Plant 6 commercialisation: H1 FY27 (H1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Windlas grew FY26 revenue 19% to INR904 crores with a CDMO-led mix, but codeine loss hit trade generics and the company is not planning organic capex beyond Plant 6 until FY27-28.

calls.name: Hariom Pipe Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 volume growth fell short of the 30% guided last quarter; management now guides FY27 volume of 350,000–360,000 t (~20–25%) with blended EBITDA/t near ₹7,200–7,800 and no firm margin target. Capacity is not the constraint, and the Perundurai closure is a freight and sourcing issue.

calls.name: eMudhra Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth: ~18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Software/PKI firm, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 PAT ₹1,100m (+26%) with FY27 guided at 18% top line and 25–30% PAT growth, but Q4 PAT rose only 21.6% and no capacity discipline is discussed.

calls.name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: ~20% (18–20% range over 2–3 years) (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 collections recovered (slippage 1.9%→0.7%, UCCE 98.1%) but credit cost guided up to 1.7–1.75% for FY27 and 1.5–1.6% steady state; FY27 AUM growth ~20% on disbursement push of INR6,500–7,000 cr.

calls.name: Dharmaj Crop Guard Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 1,138 cr (+20%) and EBITDA margin 9%, but technical plant only at PBT breakeven with 65-70% utilisation, and inventory build of Rs 2,074 mn stretched cash cycle to 87 days.

calls.name: Landmark Cars Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: around INR 50 crore (ballpark) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Dealer Landmark Cars posts record FY26 EBITDA of INR 283 crore but in a consolidation year; inventory was held near 30-36 days ahead of price hikes, and capex guided to roughly INR 50 crore.

calls.name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
calls.gLine: Components annual revenue from newly secured programs: nearing INR100 crore (not specified)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue hit a record INR375 crore (+56%) and Q4 hit INR113.8 crore, but the EV unit runs at only 25-30% utilisation and management gave no capacity discipline or capex figures.

calls.name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: double-digit, early teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light 3PL with Q4 revenue Rs 3,032 cr (+21.3% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA margin 7.3%; GFS margins stay thin at 2.4% and management guides FY27 margin flat at 7.3-7.4%.

calls.name: Innova Captab Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth at group level: 20% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 31% to INR1,630 cr and Q4 up 42%, but PAT up only 10% to INR140.9 cr; Jammu ~INR300 cr FY26 near EBITDA breakeven, with management guiding 20%+ volume growth for FY27 and a new Baddi block of INR150-170 cr capex.
calls.top: New Baddi block capex INR150-170 cr

calls.name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: EM Bypass cash flow improvement: close to 70 crores this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator with FY26 revenue ₹707 cr (+12%) and PAT margin 9.21%, but Q4 ARR growth slowed to 3% on Middle East cancellations in Delhi and Hyderabad; capex expansion via asset-light and owned keys adds to capital demand.

calls.name: Rossell Techsys Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: similar to FY26 (~87%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 87% to INR485 crore with EBITDA margin compressing to about 13.6%, management attributes it to qualification investment and guides FY27 growth similar to FY26 with a QIP planned, no numeric margin guidance beyond 17-22% band.
calls.top: EBITDA margin down: FY25 ~15% to FY26 ~13.6%

calls.name: International Gemological Institute Ltd
calls.thesis: Diamond certification volumes up 16% in Q4 with LGD certification revenue up 35%, but no supply-side or capex data; growth framed around LGD capacity build in Surat and ND jewelry softness from gold prices.

calls.name: B.R.Goyal Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: 20% to 25% growth rate (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 61% to INR820 crore and EBITDA margin 9.13%, but order book fell to INR1,235 crore from INR1,313 crore and no capacity or capex discipline signals were given.
calls.top: Order book down to INR1,235 cr

calls.name: Capitalnumbers Infotech Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: gradual recovery towards 33% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Services firm with no capacity cycle: FY26 revenue up ~5% to INR105 crore, EBITDA flat at INR35.8 crore, and FY27 guidance of minimum 35% growth rests on acquisition plus unproven organic adds.
calls.top: H2 contract closures slipped into FY27

calls.name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 city hotel occupancy: mid-70s (FY27)
calls.thesis: Luxury hotel operator: FY26 PAT Rs403cr with 49% EBITDA margin, but Q4 RevPAR up only 6% on March war disruption to international occupancy; 966 new keys in pipeline add supply, not yet tested by demand.

calls.name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: ~INR430 crore (INR336 cr order in hand + ~INR100 cr channel), minimum 25% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue fell 35% QoQ to INR105 cr as execution slipped into Q1 FY27; management guides FY27 ~INR430 cr (INR336 cr order-in-hand plus ~INR100 cr channel) and EBITDA 12–13%, but working capital days jumped to 185 from 68.

calls.name: Travel Food Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Passenger traffic FY27: about 5% (industry expectation cited) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Travel F&B concessionaire grew system-wide sales 25.4% to INR32.1bn in FY26 on 1.2% airport traffic, but Q4 PAT was flattered by a one-time reclassification and a INR212m litigation provision pulled in, with INR1bn receivables build from EATS.

calls.name: Vikram Solar Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 production: 7.5-8 GW (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR4,800 crores and 3.3 GW shipments, but per-watt EBITDA falling from ~INR6 toward INR1.75–2 on non-DCR volumes as cell costs rise and captive cell is delayed to FY28.

calls.name: Karbonsteel Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Production volume: about 40,000 tons annually (FY26)
calls.thesis: Heavy fabricator guides to 40,000 tons and 12-13% normalised margin on a 54,000-ton expansion, but the expansion slipped from March to October and FY25 revenue missed the 340-crore target.

calls.name: Urban Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Urban Company is a demand-led marketplace story, not a capital-cycle one: no capacity or capex signals, NTV up 42% YoY in Q4, and InstaHelp losses of ₹119 Cr drive the reported loss.

calls.name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,000-1,050 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: SaaS loyalty platform, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 revenue INR734 crores (+23%), 110% NRR, adjusted EBITDA margin ~14.7%, plus debt-free M&A roll-up (SessionM closed at ~0.5x revenue).

calls.name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 industry & company growth: mid to high single digit
calls.thesis: Lead-acid core growing ~12% with 4W OEM volumes up 30%+, but raw-material inflation (lead ~₹2 lakh/t) squeezes margins; FY27 capex ₹1,500–1,700 crore, mostly New Energy, with ₹2,000 crore-plus cell plans still unproven on returns.

calls.name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR2,000 crore over 2-3 years plus ~INR500 crore annual normal capex (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Record 11.71 MMT throughput (112% of 10.5 MMT capacity) and Q4 GRM $13.75/bbl, but management concedes ~$10.3 core and export duties/RTP cap are pressuring net cracks; capex modest at INR2,000 crore over 2-3 years.

calls.name: EPL Ltd
calls.gLine: Tax rate (steady state): 18% to 22% (steady state)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +17.6% and FY26 EBITDA margin 20.4% with capex of INR 480 crore+ ahead of demand, but management gave no numeric Middle East cost-recovery figure and guided only 11-13% growth long term.

calls.name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 18% to 19% (current scenario)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume +11% and EBITDA margin 19.19% (vs 10.01%) as Morbi gas shutdown removes a key competitor's supply, but Morbi restart from 1 May and gas-price pass-through add uncertainty; no volume guidance given.

calls.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: UVG FY27: about 100 bps higher than FY26 (~11.1%) planned (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone UVG 15.3% and EBITDA margin 23.4% (+280bps), but management is passing through 40–50% raw material inflation with VAM-driven price hikes of ~12–15% on Fevicol and no FY27 volume guidance.

calls.name: Cummins India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 sales growth: moderate growth across segments (FY2026/27)
calls.thesis: Cummins India FY26 sales up 18% to INR11,950 crore with data centres at 30-35% of domestic power gen, but management guided only moderate growth, flagged commodity and supplier cost pressure, and gave no new capacity; utilisation about 70%.
calls.top: Data centre share 30-35% of power gen

calls.name: Voltas Ltd
calls.gLine: RAC industry growth FY27: 15-20%
calls.thesis: Voltas RAC channel inventory cut to under 45 days (near 30) and April ran close to record March, but UCP margin fell to ~3.2% in FY26 from 8.4% and management gave no hard margin number.

calls.name: Styrenix Performance Materials Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA ₹128 cr at 15.3% margin on mix and opportunistic pricing, but India GPPS volumes fell and management gave no numeric guidance and no new PS capacity timeline, with ABS capacity "second half" unchanged.
calls.top: Profit lift partly opportunistic, not sustainable

calls.name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin: ~15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Own-brand IMFL grew 32% in FY26 with 22% Q4 margin, but management guides FY27 EBITDA to ~15% and IMFL margin to 15–17%; ethanol volumes fell 35% on industry oversupply.

calls.name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated sales growth FY27: 4% to 4.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone sales up 8.6% to INR 3,024 crore with H2 up 14%, but consolidated PBIT fell 25% on VAW, Foskor and Awuko losses; FY27 guide is 4–4.5% consolidated growth with capex stepping up to about INR 400 crore.

calls.name: Centum Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR 40-45 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone FY26 revenue up 25% to INR 973 cr and Q4 EBITDA margin 13.22%, but FY26 margin of 12.42% missed the 13-15% target and the BTS order book is the key swing factor.

calls.name: DCM Shriram Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR1,000-1,200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Chemicals capex cycle concluded with FY27 capex guided at INR1,000-1,200 crore, but PVC and sugar margins are squeezed; caustic utilisation ~85% with ECU INR32,000-33,000/MT.

calls.name: NMDC Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 production (incl. NSL): 60 Mt (FY27)
calls.thesis: NMDC guides FY27 to 60 Mt (from 53 Mt FY26) via existing mines, capex stepping to ~INR6,000 cr with EBITDA held at 42-43% and prices range-bound; execution risk on 100 Mt by 2030.

calls.name: Saregama India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 new content budget: INR 300-350 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Music-catalogue company, not a capacity business: Q4 revenue INR 287 cr (+19% YoY) and record adjusted EBITDA INR 133 cr, but management concedes content spend is ramping and FY27 content budget INR 300-350 cr with no step-up after.
calls.top: New content spend FY27 INR 300-350 cr

calls.name: TVS Motor Company Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 industry growth: strong single-digit
calls.thesis: TVS Motor posted record FY26 (volume 5.9m, +24%; EBITDA margin 12.9%) and is adding 1.5m units of capacity to ~8.3m, but Q1 faces 3-5% commodity inflation and supply-chain disruption that channel stock is absorbing.

calls.name: Balaji Telefilms Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: close to INR800-odd crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Balaji's FY26 revenue fell to INR210 crore from INR453 crore with an EBITDA loss of INR65.8 crore; management guides FY27 to ~INR800 crore on a motion-pictures and OTT order-book ramp with no supply discipline evidence.

calls.name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Group revenue growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Restructuring-led margin story: SCS turned EBITDA positive in Q4 FY26 and management guides FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 12-13.5% with GCM at 10-12%, but tariff leakage and Middle East commodity risk are unresolved.

calls.name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: 7% to 8% per annum sustainable (FY27 and beyond)
calls.thesis: UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call shows pricing and cost-efficiency gains with 200 Mt capacity, but supply is still expanding (242.5 Mt by FY28) and management pushes shareholder returns over capacity discipline; West Asia cost headwinds are being offset by price hikes.

calls.name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
calls.gLine: Cash EBITDA margin: north of 35% in next 3-4 years (ambition) (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Vi's Q4 FY26 is a capex-led recovery story, but the headline profit is an AGR one-off (Rs 55,622 Cr exceptional gain); cash EBITDA grew only 4.8% and FY26 cash EBITDA was flat at Rs 9,217 Cr.
calls.top: AGR dues cut to Rs 64,046 Cr

calls.name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: at least 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +14.1% and EBITDA +19.3% on volume, but FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 8.8% from 9.2%; ~75% of an 8–13% input-cost pass-through landed, with the balance pending as high-cost inventory arrives.

calls.name: SJVN Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capacity addition: Buxar 660 MW thermal, Dhaulasidh 69.5 MW hydro, ~1,555 MW solar by March 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: SJVN's FY26 PAT was flat at INR 1,008 crore, with Q4 lifted by a one-off INR 679 crore tariff true-up; new Buxar thermal and solar are loss-making until PLF and CUF ramp, and management has put its 25 GW target under review.

calls.name: L&T Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit cost exit Q4FY27: 2% to 2.2% (Q4FY27)
calls.thesis: Retail NBFC with supply-side discipline in credit: Cyclops underwriting, prime mix at 90%+ in two-wheeler, and credit cost guided down to 2–2.2% by Q4FY27, but ECL Stage 1 provisioning raised to 80bps.

calls.name: Sharda Cropchem Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 effective tax rate: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin 37.3% (+750bp) and FY27 guidance of 10-15% revenue growth with 18-20% EBITDA margin; FX and price-led gains flatter the base, and management sidestepped the ex-FX margin question.

calls.name: VRL Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 tonnage volume growth: 6% to 7% full year; at least 2% sequential growth per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Volume decline narrowing: Q4 tonnage up ~3% YoY after FY26 down ~7%, management guides 6-7% FY27 growth, but relies on fuel pass-through and a fleet adds plan of ~500 vehicles, not a capacity cut.

calls.name: TCI Express Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 10%+ (10-11%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 6% to INR 327 crore with volume up 4% and PAT margin 6.3%; FY27 guidance of 10%+ volume and 100-150bp margin recovery rests on fuel pass-through, with April-May softness flagged.

calls.name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: early double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume-led growth with Crop Care guided to recover from Q2 FY27 after co-marketing inventory overhang; FY27 guide is early double-digit revenue and mid-teens PBT growth, with capex about INR350 crore and ~INR100-125 crore surplus.
calls.top: Crop Care co-marketing inventory clears by Q2

calls.name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 closing AUM: ~₹6,500 cr (Mar-27)
calls.thesis: Spandana returned to profit (PAT ₹5 cr vs ₹95 cr loss) with AUM up 12% QoQ to ₹4,420 cr and X-bucket CE 99.7%; FY27 exit AUM target ₹6,500 cr needs disbursals to rise to ₹550-600 cr/month.

calls.name: Dodla Dairy Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: low to mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 5% as milk procurement rose to INR41/l vs INR37.4 a year ago and prices lagged; management guides 50-100bps gross margin recovery in FY27, but adjusted FY26 PAT is only ~INR215 cr after one-offs.

calls.name: Hi-Tech Pipes Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 volume up 27% to 1.47 lakh tons and FY27 volume guided at 6.5–7 lakh tons, but capacity build (to 1.4 mn tons by FY27) and ~₹700 cr of low-margin trading cost in two quarters dilute the read.

calls.name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin: at least hold FY26 margin (12.2%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +11.6% to INR 684 cr with 13.2% adjusted EBITDA margin, but management guided only to holding FY27 margins amid 6-7% price hike and rising input costs; no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Delhivery Ltd
calls.gLine: New initiatives investment FY27: 130-160 crore
calls.thesis: Express volumes up ~72% with FY26 FCF turning positive at ₹89 cr and ROIC 16%; capex intensity down to 4.7% from 7.8%, but supply-side discipline is management's claim rather than a verified industry supply cut.

calls.name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
calls.gLine: Core market growth FY27: about 13% plus/minus
calls.thesis: Bikaji reports ~18% Q4 top-line growth and FY26 revenue of ~INR 2,994 crore at 9.5% volume growth, but management flagged a 3% price rise, packaging cost spikes and a supply disruption, with no capacity added in FY26.

calls.name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20-22% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 47% YoY to INR165 cr and FY26 EBITDA margin ~13%, but management guides FY27 growth of 20-22% with working capital stretched and no order book; supply-side evidence thin.

calls.name: Shelter Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual revenue: around INR 200 Cr by FY2030 (FY2030)
calls.thesis: Herbal pharma with FY26 revenue ₹73.13 Cr (+44%) and EBITDA margin 17.39% (down from ~20%+); working capital cycle 234 days and operating cash flow of -₹12.48 Cr signal growth funded by credit to distributors, not capacity discipline.

calls.name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt FY27 year-end: INR600-650 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with no capacity-cycle signal; FY26 presales up 23% to INR615 crore but net debt rose to INR579.91 crore, weighted cost ~13%, and FY27 guidance deferred.
calls.top: FY27 presales guidance deferred to next call

calls.name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 12% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Muthoot Microfin is pivoting from monoline JLG to diversified retail: FY26 AUM ₹14,005 cr (+13%), GNPA 3.89%, credit cost 3.5%, and a ₹30,000 cr AUM by 2030 target needing ~21% CAGR.

calls.name: Emmforce Autotech Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 automotive revenue: INR165 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue to INR195 crores (auto INR165 crores plus agri INR30 crores) on a single US export order, while automotive utilisation sits at only 50-55%, so supply is idle and the growth case rests on one customer.

calls.name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin FY27: ~33% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Diagnostics roll-out keeps adding centres (68 at FY26 end, ~14 more in FY27) but new-centre margin is -5.5% and blended EBITDA margin fell to 31.7% from 33.8%; patient growth slowed to low single digits in Q4.
calls.top: FY27 capex ~INR70 crores for new centres

calls.name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue CAGR: 70% for next three years; INR 850-900 crore by FY29 (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ~INR 209 crore with EBITDA margin falling to about 31-33%, negative operating cash flow from longer TSP credit periods, and a 70% revenue CAGR target with no capacity or capex data.
calls.top: Negative operating cash flow in FY26

calls.name: Patel Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Store additions: 8 to 10 stores per year
calls.thesis: Retail-plus-processing story with weak supply signals: utilisation only 50-55%, Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 6.7%, working capital ballooned to INR259 crore inventory and INR161 crore receivables, and management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 8-9%.
calls.top: Inventory INR259 crore, receivables up to INR162 crore

calls.name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue run rate: INR330-350 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flexible workspace operator (DevX) FY26 revenue INR226 crore (+42%) with standalone EBITDA margin 60.5%, but supply is expanding via debt/preferential funding; mature-centre occupancy metric was redefined, flattering the trend.

calls.name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
calls.gLine: Steel volume FY27: 1.2 million tonnes (~20% growth) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Steel-led distributor with 30% FY26 revenue growth and EBITDA margin up to 3.35%, guiding FY27 volume +20%, non-steel +25% to INR 750 cr, and margin ~3.3–3.5%; Q1 demand softening from price hikes.
calls.top: Q1 FY27 demand softening from price hikes

calls.name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Short-term gross margin on gross sales: around 10% (short term)
calls.thesis: FY26 gross sales up 19.5% to INR 2,914 crore and PAT INR 102.3 crore pre-exceptional, but no capacity or supply-side signal; management guided FY27 at 18-20% top line and 20-22% PAT, with Q4 gross margin of 12.5% flattered by Q4 rebates.

calls.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 20% to 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bajaj Finance guides FY27 AUM growth 20-24%, credit cost 145-160 bps (down from 175 bps FY26 on new presentation), ROA 4.4-4.6%, ROE 19-20%, with no NIM expansion needed; MSME and captive 2W/3W drag winding down.

calls.name: Blue Star Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual capex: Rs 250-350 Crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Blue Star's FY26 cost pass-through is only ~8% of a 13% required price rise, with management guiding UCP margin 8-8.5% and Sri City RAC plant at ~100% utilisation, with the next line decision deferred to October.
calls.top: Sri City RAC plant at 100% utilisation

calls.name: Exide Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Core business growth FY27: high single-digit to early double-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +9.4% YoY with gross margin down ~90bp to 30.1% on a Rs 150 crore commodity hit, offset by cost control and 3-4 rounds of price hikes totalling ~5-6% plus ~3% in April; Rs 1,400 crore FY27 lithium-ion capex with no cell revenue yet.

calls.name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue up 10% to Rs14.15bn but FY26 flat at Rs45.38bn; UK SPP margin mix hit EBITDA, while domestic order book up 30% to Rs24.68bn with no numeric FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
calls.gLine: JLR cost savings: GBP1.7 billion over two years (two years)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 India volumes of 6.42 lakh (+15%) with Q4 above 2 lakh, but commodity headwind of 5-6% of revenue is largely unpassed and JLR cash breakeven still high at ~GBP2.2bn FY26 cash loss.

calls.name: Birlanu Ltd
calls.gLine: Pipes FY27 recovery: stronger recovery in FY27
calls.thesis: Pipes margin jumped ~1,300 bps in Q4 on a March resin spike, but FY26 pipes revenue fell 8% on volumes flat; Parador impaired and debt still Rs 851 crores.

calls.name: Ugro Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Opex, combined annualised: INR 490-500 cr in FY27 (from ~INR 750 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ugro is shrinking its high-volume prime DSA book (~15-20% run-down a year) to swap into higher-yield branch LAP and embedded finance; AUM flat, opex cut to INR 490-500 cr, FY27 a transition year with no ROA guidance.

calls.name: Nava Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 35-40%
calls.thesis: Standalone PAT up 116% to INR 911 crore on overseas dividends and buyback proceeds, not operations; ferro-alloy prices under pressure while power PLF guided higher on cheaper Singareni coal.
calls.top: Ferro-alloy pricing pressure from surplus supply

calls.name: Frontier Springs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 gross revenue: ~₹500 crore, ~30% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 39% to ₹322 crore with EBITDA margin 26.8%, but management guides ~30% FY27 growth to ₹500 crore gross and sees margin drifting to 23-24%, with capacity utilisation only ~70%.

calls.name: Menon Bearings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR360 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides ~25% annual growth toward INR500 crore by FY28 and 20-22% EBITDA margin, with utilisation rising (Bi-Metal 85%, Alkop 65%) but no hard capacity expansion beyond modest capex of about INR35 crore over two years.

calls.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27 growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 record quarter (revenue INR856 cr, EBITDA margin 22.8%) with petroleum-linked raw material inflation of 20-30% partly buffered by 5-6 months inventory; FY27 margin guided flat at 20-21%, growth 15-20%.

calls.name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 11% to at least 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs2.3 cr despite Rs4 cr FX MTM hit; BIW/MES team cut 160→60 and Beryl acquisition adds ~Rs23 cr 5-month revenue, but FY26 EBITDA fell to Rs20 cr (11% margin) and management guides 15% margin without a numeric FY27 revenue commitment.

calls.name: Greenply Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Plywood volume growth: 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 12% (+150bps YoY) on MDF operating leverage and price hikes of 4-10% from April, but part of the volume was channel stocking in late March and MDF capacity is still being added.

calls.name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin 35%: aspirational, not immediate (1-2 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR439 cr (+30% YoY) and FY26 EBITDA INR445 cr at 29% margin, but no numeric FY27 guidance and capex flat versus FY26 INR361 cr; supply signals are muted.
calls.top: Q4 revenue +30% YoY to INR439 cr

calls.name: Balaji Amines Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 22% to 23% sustainable (FY27 end)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 25% on 12% revenue growth, but supply-side is expanding into weak utilisation (DME, DMF, butylamines, battery chemicals at 20-25%) while management guides 25-30% volume growth by FY27 end.

calls.name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Enterprise and data centre share of revenue: 30% of revenues in current fiscal (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,441 crore (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.1%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation numbers and declined to comment on spot pricing or hyperscaler contracts.

calls.name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
calls.gLine: Sanitaryware volume growth FY27: 7% to 8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Cera's Q4 volume recovery and Morbi gas disruption support near-term share gains, but margins fell to 15.2% from 18.3% on brass costs and trade discounts, and sanitaryware utilisation is only 70%.

calls.name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 sales booking: INR1300 crores to INR1400 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Defence electronics firm guides FY27 revenue growth of 15-20% (INR1,300-1,400 crore) with INR2,141 crore standalone order book; capex stays at INR40-50 crore a year, so the read is execution and cash, not capacity expansion.
calls.top: Operating cash flow INR370 crore vs -INR99 crore

calls.name: Alldigi Tech Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Alldigi is an HR/payroll and BPM outsourcer, not a capacity-driven business: FY26 revenue +9.6% to INR598.7 Cr, EBITDA margin 27.1%, with BPM headcount falling as management exits low-margin work and no capex expansion signalled.

calls.name: Yes Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Advances growth FY27: 13% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Yes Bank exits FY26 at ~1% ROA with NIM 2.7% and GNPA 1.3%, but advances growth of 11% and a 14-15% FY27 target are the swing factors; RIDF rundown to ~INR 28,000 cr is a margin tailwind.

calls.name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA and PBT growth vs revenue: EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue in coming quarters (next quarters)
calls.thesis: Express volumes flat for FY26 and Q4 revenue flat YoY at INR514 crore; margin gains come from pricing actions and cost cuts, not volume, with no capacity or capex signals.
calls.top: RPKG up via GPI and surcharges

calls.name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: FY27 constant currency revenue growth: 10% to 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4FY26 CC growth 11.6% YoY with a 3% QoQ rise, EBIT margin 12.2%, and FY27 guided to 10–13% CC growth and 12.25–12.75% EBIT; a BPO with no supply-side capacity signals, so the read rests on demand and margin.

calls.name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 margin: flattish with single-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹4,302 cr (+9.2%) and Q4 PBT +16.4%, but Q4 margins fell ~230 bps QoQ on aluminium and Middle East cost pressure; FY27 capex ₹180–190 cr with margins guided flattish.

calls.name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustaining capex FY27: INR35-40 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Amusement-park operator with no new park capex in FY27 (only INR35-40 crore sustaining capex) and a 5-park base; Q4 volume growth came from Chennai, while Hyderabad footfall fell 7% in FY26 and Q1 is only "pretty okay".

calls.name: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated AUM by 2030: INR32,000 crore (from INR25,000 crore) (FY30)
calls.thesis: Satin's MFI stress is easing: FY26 credit cost 3.8% (down 77bp) and Q4 consolidated 2.2%, but management gave no supply-side signals and guidance is standalone AUM growth of 15–20%.

calls.name: TeamLease Services Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: over 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Staffing volume fell on one NBFC insourcing, but PAPM rose to INR689 from INR669 and management guides FY27 EBITDA growth above 20% on operating leverage, with a 10,000-head low-margin exit in H1.
calls.top: PAPM INR669 → INR689 in general staffing

calls.name: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Solar portfolio revenue ambition: Rs 2,000 Cr in 3-4 years
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 11% to Rs 2,283 Cr with EBIT margin exiting near 10% from 6.8% in H1, but management flagged April material cost inflation with no numeric guidance and no supply-side or capex disclosure.

calls.name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: minimum 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin hit 16.45% but management calls 10% sustainable; FY26 margin 9.90% on 5.4% revenue growth, with a 30% FY27 growth target that is a planning figure, not order-backed.

calls.name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
calls.thesis: Broking-platform read: F&O premium up 22% QoQ to INR 1,336 crore and client funding book up 8% to INR 410 crore, but PAT fell to INR 44.3 crore on tech and HR spend and no capacity signal is given.

calls.name: Affle 3I Ltd
