calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (combined entity, over time): close to 23% to 25%
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 20.3% y-o-y to INR 7.24bn with EBITDA margin 22.3%, but management is deliberately investing in data and inventory costs, pushing gross margin down, and is raising INR 11bn via warrants for M&A.

calls.name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 11% to 13% full year (annualised) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 volume +23% and EBITDA margin 13% came from price pass-through of inventory gains and no Q4 inventory loss; April destocking and 52% utilisation argue against a clean cycle turn.

calls.name: Advait Energy Transitions Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue INR228 crore (+18% YoY) with EBITDA margin 12.6%; order book record INR1,304 crore (+159%), but no capacity-discipline evidence and capex stepping up to INR300-350 crore with equity dilution flagged.

calls.name: Lodha Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 presales: about INR240 billion (FY27)
calls.thesis: Lodha guides FY27 presales ~INR240bn (mid-teens growth) with 32-34% embedded EBITDA margin, shifts focus to PAT (20% CAGR to >INR85bn by FY31) and cuts BD spend; supply discipline strong but Middle East shock caused March closure deferrals.

calls.name: Meghmani Organics Ltd
calls.gLine: Crop Protection top-line growth FY27: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crop Protection FY26 EBITDA margin 15% with Q4 at about 9% as raw-material pass-through lagged; TiO2 suspended and no capex, but management reiterated 15-17% Crop Protection margin for FY27 without numbers on volume.

calls.name: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry volume growth FY27: 7% to 9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 volume of 6 Mt and EBITDA of INR590 crore, but a fuel and packaging cost shock of about INR200/t against only partial price hikes of INR8-15/bag leaves margins under pressure for 1-2 quarters.
calls.top: Price hikes INR8-12 trade vs ~INR200/t cost rise

calls.name: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rainbow added ~500 beds yet FY26 revenue grew only 12% and mature-hospital occupancy slipped; management targets ~20% growth and 56–58% blended occupancy, with ~900 beds funded internally.

calls.name: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Ltd
calls.gLine: Micro-drama share of revenue: below 10% (next year)
calls.thesis: Content producer pivoting to IP; FY26 revenue INR118.45 cr (+32%) and PAT INR7.95 cr, but Q4 PAT only INR2.08 cr, with cash-heavy IP build and no capacity-discipline evidence.
calls.top: Other financial assets INR104 lakh → INR1,198 lakh

calls.name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd
calls.gLine: Commercial real estate fund: INR3,000-3,500 crore target, launch H2 FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wealth and private growth carries the firm: wealth and private now 55% of revenue, operating PAT about INR1,050 crore, with MPIS net flows about 30% of opening assets and capital markets moderating.
calls.top: MPIS net flows about 30% of opening

calls.name: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 17.5% to 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sai Silks FY26 revenue up 13.1% to INR1,654 crore with SSSG only +3% and Q4 growth slowing to 5.1%; FY27 target ~1 lakh sq ft retail addition, EBITDA guided to 17.5–18% from 15.76%.

calls.name: IRM Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume FY27: 250+ MMSCM, double-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: City gas distributor guides FY27 volume above 250 MMSCM (up from 223.67, 30%+ growth) and EBITDA/SCM up 10-15% from above INR 5, but Q4 PBT fell to INR 17.7 crore with NGT-linked industrial curbs unresolved.

calls.name: Vibhor Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: New products share of revenue: 25-30% this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Vibhor is diversifying from ERW pipe into higher-margin transmission towers, poles and guardrails, with 2,300-2,400 t tower orders and Maharashtra/Hyderabad pipe capacity running at 74%/67%.

calls.name: D.P. Abhushan Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 6% to 6.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Jewellery retailer growing on value (+23% FY26 revenue) while volumes fell ~20%; Q4 EBITDA margin 5.45% and inventory days rising to ~100, with FY27 store additions cut to 3-6 and QIP shelved.

calls.name: Indegene Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 margin: Margin recovery to earlier levels in H2 FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Indegene is a life-sciences commercial/medical outsourcing services firm, not supply-capacity driven; Q4 revenue crossed ₹1,000 crore (up 32.8% YoY) but management gave no formal FY27 revenue guidance and margin recovery rests on investment payback.

calls.name: Northern Arc Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 22% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Northern Arc's Q4FY26 PAT of INR133 crore (up 251% YoY) is flattered by FLDG-driven ECL releases; management guides FY27 AUM growth 22-25% and credit cost 2.7-2.8%, with ROA target above 3%.

calls.name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
calls.gLine: Bio-based chemical market outlook: stronger outlook from this quarter onwards
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA rebounded to INR92 crores (16.2% margin) on sugar crushing, but bio-chem and ethanol commentary is qualitative with no capacity-utilisation or pricing numbers; the 60 million litre grain distillery is still unproven and maize economics are undisclosed.

calls.name: Sagility Ltd
calls.gLine: Surge/seasonal revenue share FY26: around 6% of full-year revenue (FY26)
calls.thesis: Healthcare BPO beat FY26 guidance on seasonal revenue (6% vs 5.5% guided); FY27 guided to low double-digit cc organic growth and 24-25% EBITDA margin, with AI compression rising to ~2%.

calls.name: Belrise Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 manufacturing revenue up 21% and FY26 EBITDA margin 12.1%, but no supply-side evidence: capex guided up to 6-6.5% of manufacturing revenue and a INR2,000 crore QIP enabling resolution with acquisitions continuing.
calls.top: Aerospace acquisitions: SDM and Chester Hall

calls.name: Swastika Castal Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: stronger than FY26, unquantified (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up ~17-19% on volume, but operating cash flow turned negative from deliberate working-capital build (inventory, advance payments to vendors) and capex commissioned only in March; no numeric FY27 guidance.
calls.top: Operating cash flow negative in FY26

calls.name: Piramal Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Total AUM growth FY27: ~25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Piramal Finance Q4 FY26: Growth RoAUM rose to 2.1% (from 1.7% a year ago) with AUM up 25% and FY27 guidance of ~25% AUM growth and ~2.5% exit RoAUM; capital consumption only 50 bps in the quarter.

calls.name: Workmates Core2Cloud Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 210 crore (+45%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Cloud/AI services firm guides FY27 revenue to INR 210 cr (+45%) with INR 190 cr visibility, but FY26 margins fell (EBITDA 16.2% vs 17.7%) and no supply-side capacity data is given.

calls.name: Wakefit Innovations Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 20%+ aspiration (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 13.5% to INR344 crore with operating EBITDA at 6.3%; management says input costs up up to 30% in COGS basket, taking ~15% price hikes, and only expects 20%+ growth aspiration with 1-2pt EBITDA risk.

calls.name: INDO SMC Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order book ~INR237 cr at March 31 plus ~INR125 cr added since April; management targets INR450-500 cr FY27 revenue and EBITDA above 15%, but H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+ from INR250 cr and resin supply is strained.
calls.top: H1 inflow target cut to INR200 cr+

calls.name: PAN HR Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue (turnover) growth FY27: ~40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Manpower outsourcer's H2 FY26 revenue up 28% to INR126.57 cr and PAT up 158% to INR4.32 cr, but FY26 growth is moderate, with no capacity, utilisation or pricing data and a vague INR1,000 cr FY29 target.

calls.name: Cipla Ltd
calls.gLine: US revenue run-rate: $1bn run-rate by end FY27 (FY27 exit)
calls.thesis: Cipla guides FY27 EBITDA margin 18.5-20% and a US$1bn run-rate by FY27 end, excluding Lanreotide; supply-side signals are limited to capex plateauing after 'built enough capacity', with a war-driven cost headwind flagged.

calls.name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (double-digit, next 2 years): double-digit (2 years)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 7% to INR 5,612 cr and PBT before exceptionals up 12% to INR 750 cr, but exports fell ~8% for the year and capex is revenue-growth driven at 70% with no capacity cut or deferral.
calls.top: Class 8 orders nearly double YoY in Q1

calls.name: Thomas Cook (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Sterling resorts: 95+ resorts and 4,500 rooms in 2027 (2027)
calls.thesis: Q4 group revenue fell 10% to INR 17,707 mn on Middle East war and MICE timing; India ops and Sterling grew, but DEI and Desert Adventures losses and long-haul weakness drove FY26 EBT down 14% to INR 3,268 mn.

calls.name: Black Box Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue organic: INR12,000 crore (~$1.3bn) (FY30)
calls.thesis: Capital Markets Day sets FY30 target of INR12,000 crore organic plus INR6,000 crore inorganic (~$2bn) with order book $800m and management targeting 1.3-1.4bn by March 2027, but no capacity or supply-discipline data, and working-capital days are stretching.

calls.name: Ashok Leyland Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR750-1,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 with Q4 EBITDA margin 14.6% and net cash ₹5,899 cr, but management flags steel-led commodity headwinds for Q1 and no FY27 volume number; capex guided ₹750–1,000 cr.

calls.name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Record FY26 profit on spot-heavy tanker, LPG and offshore exposure; management gives no earnings outlook, sees crude-tanker order book near 20% with supply arriving CY27-28, and is holding cash rather than buying at current yields.

calls.name: Asian Paints Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: high single-digit, 8-10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 volume +12.4% and FY26 decorative volume ~9% on price-led margin gains, but management guides high single-digit to 8-10% volume with ~11% price hikes against ~20% cost inflation and discounting unchanged.

calls.name: IFB Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Home appliances revenue growth: 20%+ aspiration (FY27) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 PBDIT margin 5.5% vs 5.3% with INR 84 cr FY26 commodity/forex hit only partly offset (INR 67 cr via cost programme); Q1 FY27 commodity and forex still a INR 49 cr drag, so margin recovery is unproven.

calls.name: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.thesis: Pharma branded-generics player (Jagsonpal) grew 14.2% in Q4 vs IPM 10.5% but FY26 revenue only ~7%; supply-side signals absent (MR count flat, asset-light), with ₹66 crore cash return and no capex discussion.

calls.name: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd
calls.gLine: Jonnagiri gold production FY2027: 600 kg (FY2027)
calls.thesis: Promoter-led gold and critical-minerals story with no reported capacity discipline; Jonnagiri ~100 kg refined to date, FY27 guide 600 kg, and a Rs.60–100 Cr funding gap for Kyrgyzstan.

calls.name: Steelcast Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume/revenue growth FY27 and FY27-29: 20%+ per year (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Steelcast FY26 revenue ₹423.17 cr (+13.3%) with EBITDA margin 30.64%; management now guides 25–26% sustainable margin and 20%+ volume growth, with capex decision pulled forward to end-July 2026 at ~63–64% utilisation.
calls.top: Capex decision pulled forward to July 2026

calls.name: TTK Prestige Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin recovery: back to 13-14% (after investment phase (~2 years))
calls.thesis: Q4 domestic growth 14.4% and company 12.5% helped by cooktop replacement demand; management says price hikes lag into Q1, input costs up ~10%, and margin guide is a 13-14% return after ~2 years of investment.
calls.top: New entrants in cookware on pricing

calls.name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: about 200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Elgi FY26 sales up ~12% with volume only 3-4% and pricing thin; management plans a 2.5-3% price correction in June as ~80% of projected material cost inflation already hit in Q1, while capex is modest at ~200 crore.

calls.name: Venkys (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Layer chick sales volume: 5 crore+ chicks in FY27 (from 4.57 crore) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 margin spike driven by broiler realisation; April broiler prices ~INR97-100 falling to ~INR90-93 by May, chick prices fell from ~INR55 to ~INR35, so Q1 trend is softer despite oil-seed utilisation rising to a targeted 80%.
calls.top: Broiler prices falling from Q4 peak

calls.name: Vimta Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: Biologics margins: Around current region, a percent or few percent here and there
calls.thesis: Vimta's Q4 FY26 revenue rose 16.6% YoY to INR1,120m with 37.6% EBITDA margin, but management gave no capacity or capex discipline signals and flagged utilisation ramp, war-related cost pressure and weaker electronics.

calls.name: Natural Capsules Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated FY27 revenue: Rs 274 crore (gelatin 170, HPMC 20, domestic API 70, Fermbox CMO 14)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 2.28% on deferred dispatches; FY26 EBITDA loss Rs 1.56 cr; FY27 guidance Rs 274 cr revenue with API at ~Rs 70 cr and no PLI assumed, but debt stays Rs 100-110 cr.
calls.top: Indian steroidal API prices below cost

calls.name: Patel Integrated Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Rajpat Logistics revenue: adds another 25% to the ~INR400 crore base (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit rose on margin and cost control, but the call gave no capacity, utilisation or inventory data; management leaned on promotional claims and a Rajpat subsidiary with no numbers beyond an unsupported 25% revenue add.

calls.name: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: Business development FY27: north of ₹10,000 crore
calls.thesis: Resi pre-sales FY26 ₹3,405 cr with FY27 guidance ₹4,500–5,000 cr held; PAT ₹298 cr vs ₹61 cr on IC leasing and OCs, but management cited war-driven footfall slowdown and affordable drag.

calls.name: IZMO Ltd
calls.gLine: izmoMicro revenue FY27: INR45-50 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue spike (INR109 cr, +82% YoY) was partly a one-off pass-through project with inflated other expenses; izmoMicro guided to ~INR50 cr FY27 on a INR40 cr order book, with capex of INR125 cr still unfunded.
calls.top: Q4 margin hit from pass-through project

calls.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
calls.gLine: Net working capital days FY27: 75-80 days
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 80% to INR321 crore at 34.2% margin, driven mainly by capacity coming on stream and volumes; new capacity (R32, Chemours, Dahej debottleneck) is due in FY27 with 30% margin guided ±1-2%.
calls.top: R32 competitor capacity ~120,000 MT by FY27

calls.name: Biocon Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt: Hover between $1.1 billion and $1.2 billion, subject to working capital (FY27)
calls.thesis: Biosimilars EBITDA up 33% to INR720 crores on 26% margin, but management guides no numbers, capex is largely done and Syngene's CRDMO grew only 2% with a single-client drag.

calls.name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27 total: ~INR200 crore incl. land
calls.thesis: Action Construction is still capacity-heavy at ~60% utilisation, with management pushing 9-10% price hikes (targeting 11-14% total) against steel up 20-22%, while guiding FY29 revenue of INR6,000-6,200 crore and pausing a INR400 crore tower-crane plant.

calls.name: Fiem Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: 4-wheeler revenue: INR100-150 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR2,790.65 cr (+16%) and EBITDA margin 14.09%, but supply-side signals are mild: capex ~INR200 cr over two years with capacity utilisation ~75%, and no capacity expansion beyond debottlenecking.

calls.name: DLF Ltd

calls.name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
calls.gLine: Dombivli EBITDA burn: INR2-3 crore per month average for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capex-heavy expansion to ~2,900 beds funded by accruals and debt capped at 3x EBITDA; Dombivli opened early but Indore occupancy only ~45-50% and Dombivli burns INR2-3 crore a month, so supply is rising while utilisation is still ramping.

calls.name: Samhi Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest cost: INR 135-140 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Samhi FY26 same-store RevPAR +9.5% and net debt/EBITDA ~3.07x, but supply is expanding with 2,200 crore capex pipeline; Q4 EBITDA margin flat ex-one-offs and GST drag is permanent.

calls.name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 25% to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zaggle is a fintech spend-management platform, not a capital-cycle story; FY27 standalone revenue guided 25-30%, consolidated ~40%, EBITDA guidance withheld, and operating cash flow still negative at about INR6 crores in Q4.

calls.name: INOX India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR1,632 crore (+21.2%) and order book INR1,514 crore, but operating cash flow has lagged sales as project contract assets build; management guides 18-20% FY27 growth without numeric capex or capacity changes beyond Kandla.

calls.name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 51% to INR4,489 crore with price hikes ~20-22% of H2 growth; management plans 20% CAGR but PES units may degrow 5-10% in CY26 and inventory days were not cut.

calls.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Advances growth FY27: 22% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 NIM rose to 4.06% and cost of deposits fell to 5.75%, but credit cost guided 0.15–0.25% with agri NPAs sticky at 2.76% and PCR raised to 51.89%.

calls.name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: low to mid-teen (FY27)
calls.thesis: Emcure FY26 revenue +16.6% to INR9,204 cr with EBITDA margin 19.4% (+80bps), but Q4 domestic growth slowed to 5.2% on Zuventus restructuring; FY27 guided low-to-mid teen growth and 75-100bps margin expansion.

calls.name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
calls.gLine: Hobel revenue growth: 15% to 17% over next 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Acquisition of Hobel Bellows for about INR450 crore (~25% pre-tax EBITDA yield on price, 50%+ margins, INR129 crore revenue) with core utilisation at 50-60%; organic business described only qualitatively.

calls.name: Crizac Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crizac is an asset-light student-recruitment platform with strong FY26 growth (revenue +22.7%, PAT +41%), but FY27 guidance was withheld amid geopolitical uncertainty and margin gains were partly FX-driven.
calls.top: FY27 firm guidance deferred to next quarter

calls.name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR 380-400 Cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue INR 380-400 Cr and ~24-25% consolidated EBITDA margin, but Q4 margin compressed on raw-material inflation, receivables run 130-140+ days and FCF stays negative until FY27 end.
calls.top: Q4 EBITDA margin compressed on raw materials

calls.name: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approx Rs.500 Cr
calls.thesis: Rail interiors maker guides FY27 revenue ~Rs.500 Cr at 12-13% PAT, but FY26 PAT margin fell and receivables reached Rs.214 Cr with capacity at ~90% and expansion still unbuilt.

calls.name: Tata Capital Ltd
calls.thesis: Tata Capital FY26 book grew 20% (28% ex-motor finance) with Q4 credit cost down to 0.9% and cost-to-income 38.3%; FY28 targets of 23-25% growth and ~2% ROA reiterated, but no quantified capex or supply signal.

calls.name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: 20% to 25% overall (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 16% to Rs812m but EBITDA margin fell to 30.3% (from 40.5%) on a one-off ~Rs8.5cr/quarter US nearshore consultant cost; no capacity or pricing signal, growth guidance of 20-25% is a verbal recovery target.
calls.top: UK examination body contract goes live

calls.name: Nanta Tech Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40-50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Nanta Tech's H2 FY26 margin jump (EBITDA 17.3%) and 52% H2 growth coincide with rising working capital and receivables, with FY27 guidance of ~40-50% revenue growth lacking supply-side evidence.
calls.top: Working capital rising, invoices not raised

calls.name: Dabur India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high single to low double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 India volumes strong (HPC +17%, domestic +9.5%) but RM/PM inflation near 10% forces 4% price hikes; management guides high-single to low-double-digit revenue and margin expansion, with international hit by Middle East.

calls.name: India Glycols Ltd
calls.gLine: Performance chemicals growth: in excess of doubling this year (hoped, not projected) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mixed quarter: group EBITDA margin up to 15.5% on Bio-Fuels and Chemicals, but Chemicals sales fell 10.4% and Q4 had a catalyst shutdown; no capacity-discipline or pricing-cycle signal beyond management commentary.

calls.name: Banswara Syntex Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,450–1,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Yarn utilisation fell to 77% on labour shortages while Fabric and Garment carry growth; FY27 revenue guided to INR1,450–1,500 crores with EBITDA margin 10.5–11%, but net debt rose to INR483 crores with no long-term debt reduction until FY28.

calls.name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd
calls.gLine: Sellable thermal units FY27: about 400 crore units vs 375 crore in FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Energy-led integrated miner: FY26 thermal generation up 84% to 4,155 MU and EBITDA INR2,025 crore, but Q4 EBITDA INR352 crore was hit by planned shutdowns, and the 600 MW IPP expansion slips to FY31 with capex unannounced.

calls.name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
calls.gLine: Restaurant openings: 60+ per year (FY27 onward)
calls.thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India, West & South) delivered 1.5% SSSG on mid-single-digit guest count, but supply-side signals are expansion-led (60+ openings FY27) with no capacity discipline; pricing held, margins guided lower to ~67%.

calls.name: Coromandel International Ltd
calls.gLine: Crop protection standalone revenue growth: 20%-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA up 16% to INR 494 crores despite fertiliser margin compression; subsidy receivables fell to INR 2,199 crores from INR 3,785 crores in September, but Middle East raw-material spike leaves Q2 margins unclear.
calls.top: Fertiliser EBITDA/t below INR 3,500 in Q4

calls.name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: 15% annual growth possible over 5 years (5 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA crossed INR200 crore (21.7% margin) on merger synergies, but capital-cycle signals are thin: no capacity cut, management plans R&D and capex build and quotes INR800 crore FY27/28 EBITDA-style targets loosely.

calls.name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Lamination sales volume FY27: 78,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pitti announces INR290 crore casting capex (capacity to 36,000 t, more than doubling) while FY26 utilisation was only 71% for casting and Q4 export shipments slipped about INR20 crore, so supply is expanding ahead of demand.

calls.name: Hindustan Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Footwear FY27 sales: INR700-800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY27 PAT guided at INR200-220 crores (vs FY26 INR149 crores) while footwear margins are hit by 50-60% polymer cost spikes and working capital is stretched; sales guidance withdrawn and the GST gross-to-net shift has slipped to Q2-Q3 FY27.

calls.name: Sharat Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual export revenue FY27-28: up to Rs 1,000 crore (FY27-28)
calls.thesis: Q4 hit by Middle East war rerouting (about 20 containers, half rerouted) and fishmeal cost spike; FY26 revenue up 38% to Rs 524.7 crore but no capacity discipline or utilisation figure disclosed.

calls.name: HLE Glascoat Ltd
calls.gLine: Consol EBITDA margin FY27-28: 14-15% consolidated; 15%+ India; Omeras to double-digit margin in FY27
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 11% (Omeras loss INR15.3 cr); management says ongoing business ~13.5% and GLE India utilisation near 75%, but Q4 EBITDA only grew with a sub-15% margin and the June quarter faces gas-cost and deferral headwinds.

calls.name: Control Print Ltd
calls.gLine: CP Italy/V-Shapes loss: about EUR1.5 million this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Core coding and marking India is steady but FY26 consolidated profit is being absorbed by CP Italy/V-Shapes losses (EUR1.5m target vs EUR2-2.5m prior), with no firm breakeven timeline and a new Guwahati capex outlay added.

calls.name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 record revenue was lumpy and FX-aided; FY26 revenue INR2053.1 crores (+37.1%) but FCF negative INR49.4 crores as working capital days rose to 137, with capex INR397.1 crores and no formal guidance.

calls.name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost to assets (MFI): around 7% this year, from ~9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Microfinance lender exiting credit stress: Q4 disbursements INR738 crores (+88% YoY) and PAT INR41 crores, but opex/asset near 9% and FY27 credit cost guided around 3%.

calls.name: Sanjivani Paranteral Ltd
calls.gLine: Base business revenue FY27: INR 80-85 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 base-business revenue fell as March exports to the Middle East were lost to the Iran conflict; management guides FY27 base at INR 80-85 crore and Pune IV at INR 60-65 crore, with no capacity or capex signals.

calls.name: City Union Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA FY27 exit: 1.65% to 1.67% (FY27 exit)
calls.thesis: Bank grew advances about 26% YoY to INR66,698 crore with gross NPA down to 1.91% and CASA at 28%, but management flagged it was pushing growth and margin commentary is guidance-driven, not supply-side.

calls.name: South Indian Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Advances growth FY27: 15% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bank posted record FY26 profit of INR1,455 crore (+12%) with GNPA down to 1.43% and Q4 credit cost of 3bp, but management flags credit cost troughed and guides FY27 loan growth of 15-16%.

calls.name: Petronet LNG Ltd
calls.gLine: Petchem project capex FY27: about INR 7,500 crore
calls.thesis: Dahej utilisation fell to about 53% in March on Qatar supply disruption, with Jan-Feb near 108%; management says April-May are at the same depressed level, so volumes at risk persist into FY27.

calls.name: UNO Minda Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: approximately INR 1,750 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 margin 11.3% held up on debit/credit settlements, but management flagged sizable commodity and labour cost hits ahead; FY27 capex ~INR 1,750 crore and 11% ±50bp margin guide, with pass-through still under negotiation.
calls.top: Gross margin down ~1%; commodity hit ahead

calls.name: JK Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Gray cement volume growth FY27: 2.5 mt incremental volume, maybe more
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA ₹670 cr (18.5% margin) with 2.5 mt added volume guided for FY27 and ₹10/bag price hike passed on; capacity still ramping into a competitive Central/Rajasthan market, with Jaisalmer capex ₹3,630 cr on track for H1 FY28.

calls.name: Embassy Developments Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 own presales: INR6,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 presales INR2,632 cr (+89% QoQ) and FY27 presales guide INR6,000 cr own plus INR2,000 cr DM, but FY26 PAT was -INR872 cr and net debt guided to stay near 0.3x with little near-term reduction.

calls.name: J. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~15% (above INR6,500 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR5,723 cr with Q4 down 3%; order book of INR18,554 cr plus ~INR6,300 cr year-to-date inflows and a FY27 guide of ~15% top-line growth, but bid discipline has left FY25-26 inflows weak.

calls.name: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd
calls.gLine: Distribution growth: 10-15% urban and rural (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 record volume (45,000 KL, ~14% growth) and EBITDA of INR 135 crore, but input-cost surge from Middle East crisis is being passed through via multiple price hikes; margin band 12-14% held with caveats.
calls.top: Multiple price hikes to pass on crude costs

calls.name: Ceinsys Tech Ltd
calls.gLine: Subsidiary (VTS) revenue FY27: more than INR 20 crore with positive EBITDA (FY27)

calls.name: Inox Wind Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: ~75% over FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Inox Wind Q4 FY26 revenue flat at INR1,306 crore with FY26 top line INR4,600 crore vs INR5,000 crore guidance; FY27 guided up ~75%, but working-capital slippage and PSU receivable delays persist.
calls.top: FY26 revenue INR4,600 cr vs INR5,000 cr guide

calls.name: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd
calls.gLine: CASK ex fuel ex forex growth: mid- to high single digits (coming quarters)

calls.name: Quess Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (immediate term): 2%+ margin; medium term 2.4% (FY27 / 3-year)
calls.thesis: Quess FY26 EBITDA up 19% to INR 312 cr on margin mix shift (Professional Staffing 12%, General Staffing 1.5%), but revenue grew only 2%; General Staffing supply-side growth still muted.

calls.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Deferred annuity launch: go live by June (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Life insurer with VoNB margin 27.5% (GST-hit; 29% ex-GST) and guided 26–28% range for FY27, growth held near 14%; no capacity or pricing-discipline signal, opex ratio rose to 6.1% from 5.3%.
calls.top: VoNB margin 26–28% range held for FY27

calls.name: Inflame Appliances Ltd

calls.top: Q4 revenue INR35-37 crore vs INR55-60 expected

calls.name: Adani Total Gas Ltd

calls.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest/ROE recovery: ROE back to earlier levels next year (FY27)

calls.name: Spencers Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Spencer's store EBITDA: 8% target in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Spencer's Q4 sales up 8% YoY to INR380 crore on same-store growth after FY25 footprint exits, but consolidated FY26 EBITDA only INR15 crore and management is targeting operational EBITDA breakeven in FY27.

calls.name: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Ltd

calls.top: Q4 revenue flat QoQ at INR10.8m

calls.name: IIFL Capital Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 operational revenue up 20% YoY to INR644 crore, but operational PBT fell 22% for FY26 on employee costs; no capacity or supply signal, and management was evasive on the fundraise and Fairfax stake.

calls.name: Rossari Biotech Ltd

calls.top: Capex rephased Rs 192 cr → Rs 50–75 cr FY27

calls.name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
calls.gLine: Biscuits revenue growth FY27: low to mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Biscuit and bakery demand soft but guided to low-to-mid-teens FY27 growth; ~3% input inflation covered by pricing and Project IMPACT, with EBITDA margin improvement targeted QoQ from Q4's 12.7% bakery margin. Capacity added, no capex discipline signal.

calls.name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd

calls.name: Softtech Engineers Ltd

calls.name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 presales: INR5,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Presales up 33% to INR4,022 cr with FY27 guide of INR5,000 cr and INR10,000 cr by FY30, but reported margins still carry legacy low-margin projects and revenue recognition is shifting, so cash and margin delivery remain unproven.

calls.name: KFin Technologies Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries

calls.name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT growth: 35% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Jewellery wholesaler-retailer reports FY26 EBITDA margin 6.19% and H2 margin 6.67%, but supply-side evidence is absent: no capacity or utilisation data, inventory days rising to 70-75 and a new showroom adding stock.

calls.name: Redtape Ltd
calls.gLine: Inventory days: 150 days target, 'near future'
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA 19.4% and FY26 revenue INR2,415 crore (+19.6%), but inventory still ~170 days, payables fell sharply and management was evasive on payables, margins and apparel economics.

calls.name: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Gandhar runs India plants at ~125% of 2-shift nameplate (4,58,853 KL vs 3,62,100 KL) with no committed capex plan yet; FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 5.53% with Q4 at 5.81%.

calls.name: RBZ Jewellers Ltd
calls.thesis: Gold jeweller with no FY27 guidance; capacity utilisation only 50-55%, management says no manufacturing capex needed, while two large and two mid-format stores need ~INR125-150 crore inventory each, debt rising to ~1:1.2.

calls.name: Nisus Finance Services Co Ltd
calls.gLine: Core revenue FY27 / AUM: Blended revenue-to-AUM ~2.85% (scenario framework) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Nisus core revenue INR 141 cr (+110% YoY) and PAT INR 68 cr, but Q4 UAE deals (>INR 500 cr, ~INR 800 cr incl. deferrals) slipped and FY27 revenue/AUM falls to ~2.85% blended, so growth is timing-dependent.

calls.name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt to zero by end FY30 if target not delivered: INR3,000 cr target (FY30)
calls.thesis: Transformational debt-funded acquisition of TruBridge (EV ~$557m, ~3x EBITDA on $69m adjusted EBITDA) to take IKS into US RCM and EHR; no supply-side or capacity signal, and management declined to quantify synergies.

calls.name: Jash Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue FY27: INR875 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR757 crore (vs 746) as US tariff-driven production slowdown and Middle East shipping disruption hit exports; FY27 guided to INR875 crore with 12-13% PAT, backed by INR899 crore order book.

calls.name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27-28: early to mid-teens (double-digit) (FY27-28)
calls.thesis: Digitide Q4 FY26 revenue INR 800 cr (+9.2% YoY), EBITDA margin 11% flat QoQ; FY27 guide of ~100bps exit margin expansion and early-to-mid-teens growth, but reported PAT only 2.3% and D&A jumped on leases.
calls.top: FY27 ~100bps margin expansion by Q4 exit

calls.name: All Time Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capacity utilisation: 70-75% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR145.8 cr with volumes hit by polymer shortages and 10-15% shipment slippage into April; capacity at 39,000 t with 6,000 t expansion now gated on demand, utilisation guided 70-75%.

calls.name: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Ltd
calls.gLine: Insurance business growth: 20% to 25% per year over 2-3 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager with no capacity cycle; FY26 revenue up 28.7% to INR68.4 crores and PAT INR38.3 crores, but AUA growth of 4.6% was net-sales driven and trading book fully wound down, so earnings quality improved.

calls.name: Creative Newtech Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth: 25%-30% a year (annual)
calls.thesis: Creative Newtech is a market-entry distributor with a rising brand mix; Q4 margins flattered by Make-in-India mix, while receivables jumped to ~20% of turnover and Middle East freight shock threatens brand sales.

calls.name: Admach Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: above 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 call shows margin slipping (gross 33%→29%), receivables jumping to ~150-160 days and negative operating cash flow, with FY27 EBITDA >20% targeted but backed by machines still being commissioned.

calls.name: Novus Loyalty Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: above 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Loyalty platform FY26 revenue ~127 Cr (+22%), EBITDA margin 9.68%, PAT margin 7.29%; management gives no numeric FY27 guidance beyond international revenue doubling and 15-20% India growth, with a thin, promotional Q&A.
calls.top: Evasive on PAT and margin sustainability

calls.name: GHCL Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 bromine and vacuum salt revenue: approx INR 120 crore in FY27; ~INR 160 crore full-year; EBITDA margin 40-45% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Soda ash prices still under pressure with volume up ~11% but pricing down ~10% YoY; capacity cuts only "some time away" and new Greenfield soda ash timeline unset, though management says costs are now being passed through.

calls.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA flat YoY as O2C fell 4% on crude premiums, freight and SAED; refining cracks strong but throughput fell to 19.5 MMT from 20.3 and consumer businesses carried earnings.

calls.name: Raymond Ltd
calls.gLine: Aerospace revenue growth: 25% year-on-year (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Engineering (aero + precision auto) EBITDA up sharply on synergies, but Q4 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 13.9% from 16.4% and FY26 flat at INR335 crores; INR930 crores five-year capex is the supply signal.

calls.name: Bosch Ltd
calls.gLine: Margins held steady for next ~5 years: stable (5 years)
calls.thesis: Bosch Ltd is buying related-party Bosch Chassis Systems (RBIC) for INR9,068.7 cr at 10.6x FY25 EV/EBITDA, all-cash, with ~5% pro forma EPS accretion; no quarterly results discussed, and no capacity or utilisation numbers given beyond "lines are full".

calls.name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Gopalpur TAN utilisation on TPD basis: 90-95% by end FY27 (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR354 crores on fertiliser input-cost squeeze, IPA price pressure and a ~INR75 crore ammonia shutdown hit; management points to firming TAN/ammonia spreads, Equinor gas and Gopalpur commissioning in Q2 FY27.

calls.name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top line: better than FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: HUL's Q4 FY26 USG of 7% and FY27 "better than FY26" outlook rest on volume-led demand; price hikes of 2-5% against 8-10% material inflation leave margin relying on a 22.5-23.5% band.

calls.name: Automotive Axles Ltd
calls.gLine: Phase 1 and 1A capacity completion: by end December 2026 (Dec-26)
