calls.name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
calls.gLine: Biostimulant/biological revenue FY27: more than Rs 130 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up ~9% to Rs 483 cr, but record EBITDA margin was flattered by a one-off GST refund (Rs 14.5 cr in Q4); management guides FY27 lower double-digit growth with ~100 bps gross-margin pressure.
calls.top: Dahej FY27 revenue cut to Rs 75 cr

calls.name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 disbursement: INR13,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 disbursements hit record INR3,245 crore and FY27 guidance of INR13,000 crore disbursement with 14% AUM growth, spreads held at 2.75% guided, but growth is in housing-finance rundown-heavy book with prepayments elevated.

calls.name: RIR Power Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Halol turnover: 2x to 3x in next two to three years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Odisha SiC fab still stalled on 33 kV grid power, with epitaxy start slipping to Q2 FY27; FY26 revenue up 5.4% to INR90.9 crore with backlog of only INR17.4 crore, so the capex case rests on unproven timelines.

calls.name: Usha Martin Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: minimum 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Usha Martin Q4 margin 21.6% and EBITDA/ton ~INR 39,500 on rope mix and pass-through, but rope utilisation only ~75% with capacity still being added; volume guided 10-12%.
calls.top: Pass-through on steel and gas increases

calls.name: Digispice Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Profitability growth: at least 20% YoY for coming 2-3 years (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Digispice (Spice Money AEPS/BC agent network) grew GTV 10.5% to INR127.9k cr with gross margin up 13% to INR201cr on higher-margin credit and insurance, but Q4 gross margin fell to INR48.6cr and growth is subsidy-cycle driven.

calls.name: Aarti Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR 700-800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume-led utilisation gains and two new long-term contracts offset by West Asia disruption, Zone IV delay, and a rising net debt of about INR 4,300 crore (~3.6x EBITDA); FY27 capex cut to INR 700-800 crore.

calls.name: Hikal Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: not given; growth expected (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin recovered to 20.3% EBITDA and crop volumes improved, but FY26 revenue fell to INR1,713 cr, pharma lost Q4 shipments to a US FDA warning letter, and FY27 guidance was withheld.

calls.name: Relaxo Footwears Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating margin FY27: ~1pp above FY26 13.8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue +8.1% to INR 751 cr helped by GST cut restocking and price hikes of 15-18%; management guides ~1pp operating margin gain for FY27 and 4-5% volume growth, with cost inflation still uncertain.

calls.name: Sterling Tools Ltd
calls.gLine: Fastener capex FY27: INR75 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Fasteners margin guided to hold ~15%+ despite steel/energy inflation, with Q1 FY27 a pressure quarter; EV/SEM unprofitable in FY27 and 50% non-fastener revenue target pushed back; capex ₹75 cr for FY27.

calls.name: Alicon Castalloy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹495 crore (+16% YoY) but gross margin fell to 45% (−248 bps) and PAT ₹24 crore for FY26 vs ₹46 crore; FY27 guided to 8–10% growth ex-aluminium with capex ₹130–150 crore, utilisation ~78%.

calls.name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: Alkaline market share: about 20% exit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Eveready closed FY26 with 8.2% revenue and 8.9% EBITDA growth at 11.5% margin, but zinc inflation and a new INR200 crore Jammu alkaline plant (5-6 year payback) add supply and margin risk; management guides to similar margins.
calls.top: Jammu plant INR200 cr, 360m units peak

calls.name: Poly Medicure Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue FY27: INR2,300-2,400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone Q4 revenue Rs443cr (+5.2% YoY) and 26.8% FY26 standalone EBITDA margin, but management now flags a 200-300bps gross margin erosion from crude-linked input costs (~20% raw material inflation) and receivables stretched to 86 days.

calls.name: Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Sugar closing stock FY27 opening: 4.6-4.8 mt closing stock
calls.thesis: Sugar and distillery turned around on lower grain cost and record distillery volumes, but PTB Q4 order finalisation slipped and cane crush fell 8.8% to 8.25 mt; FY26 PAT ₹268.7 cr up 12.8%.

calls.name: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Indonesia volume: mid-single-digit volume, high single-digit value
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone India volume +8% and EBITDA +18% at 24.7% margin, but management flags near-term margin pressure from crude-linked inflation (7–9% RM) and a revenue-presentation change that optically lifts margins.

calls.name: Punjab National Bank
calls.gLine: NII growth FY27: 7% (FY27)
calls.thesis: PNB ends FY26 with GNPA 2.95% (from 3.95%), CRAR 17.74% and ROA 0.89% hit by a one-time tax-regime charge; NIM guide cut to 2.6-2.7% for FY27 from 2.8-2.9% earlier.

calls.name: Canara Bank
calls.thesis: Canara Bank FY26 profit 19,187 cr (+12.7%) with credit cost 0.59% and GNPA 1.84%, but Q4 flattered by 1,930 cr one-time listing gains; ECL transition ~10,000 cr absorbable, NIM guided 2.5-2.6%.

calls.name: Divis Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA/operating margin: stable (no figure) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 call shows stable volumes and no lost supply, but no margin or capex numbers; management guided only to double-digit revenue growth and "stable" margins, with FY27 capex flat unless a new CS project lands.

calls.name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Business growth FY27: around 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT Rs408 cr and CD ratio 76.6% with GNPA down to 2.78%, but NIM and cost-to-income gains rest on a one-quarter employee cost dip and technical write-off recoveries, with no supply-side metrics to judge.

calls.name: HT Media Ltd
calls.thesis: Print ad yields drove a 10% Q4 ad revenue rise and 14% FY26 print margin, while Radio and OTTplay losses were cut by exiting six loss-making frequencies and OTTplay; volumes flat, no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd
calls.gLine: Bajaj Finserv Health break-even: about 24 months
calls.thesis: Multi-line insurance and lending holding; Q4 PAT +5% reported (+24% ex-MTM), GI combined ratio 113.6% on timing, Life VNB +29% with NBM 24.5%; no capacity or pricing-cycle signal for insurers.

calls.name: D. B. Corp Ltd
calls.thesis: Print ad revenue up ~6% in Q4 and 6.3% like-for-like in FY26, but circulation fell ~2% to ~39 lakh copies and yields were flat; newsprint expected up 6-8% in Q1.

calls.name: Gravita India Ltd
calls.gLine: Total capex FY26-FY29: Rs 1,700 crore (FY29)
calls.thesis: Lead capacity expanding to 800,000 tpa by FY29 and Rs 1,700 crore capex, with peak working-capital debt of Rs 800-900 crore; copper ROCE and margin claims rest on unbuilt backward integration.
calls.top: Capex plan raised to Rs 1,700 cr

calls.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA/ton held near INR5,500 but April-May volumes flat (2.5 lakh t in April) amid steel shortage and channel destocking; management protecting margin over volume, FY27 guidance of 15-20% volume and 20-25% EBITDA growth retained.

calls.name: PDS Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-single-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: PDS Q4 FY26 is a cautious sourcing-services read: FY26 GMV up 5% to ₹19,666 crores, net debt cut to ~₹105 crores, guidance only mid-single-digit revenue and ~10% profit growth, with no volume-capacity or utilisation disclosure.
calls.top: Capex more than halved vs FY25

calls.name: SG Finserve Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27 aspiration: 35% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Supply-chain NBFC reports FY26 AUM ₹3,936 cr (+75%) with nil-NPA guidance and 25–30% medium-term AUM growth; no supply-side or utilisation data, and evasive on the ROA/fee-income questions.

calls.name: AvenuesAI Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated margins FY27: similar or slightly higher, to be guided at Q1
calls.thesis: Payments-to-AI/lending narrative with no capacity or pricing data; FY26 consolidated revenue INR8,116 cr (+103%) but net revenue only +15% to INR603 cr, and management declined to give FY27 numbers.

calls.name: PSP Projects Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital / trade receivable days: within 60 days going forward (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 66% to INR1,115 cr on a 5.4% EBITDA margin after a INR29 cr Kashi ECL provision; FY27 guided at ~INR4,500 cr revenue and 7-8% EBITDA margin, with order book INR13,447 cr.

calls.name: Star Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR600-700 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 volume up ~10% and per-ton EBITDA up to INR1,871, but FY27 guides 10-12% cement volume growth and capex stepping to INR600-700 crore amid fuel-cost and East-entry pressure.

calls.name: AAVAS Financiers Ltd
calls.gLine: Opex to AUM: below 3% on a 2-3 year platform; 2.75% once balance sheet doubles
calls.thesis: Affordable housing NBFC with 15% AUM growth and FY26 disbursements up 11%; NIM and spread gains are real but management is guiding to 20%+ growth and sub-3% opex/AUM with no numeric FY27 targets reconciling to recent volume declines.

calls.name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 turnover INR 7,548 cr and UOV above INR 11,800 cr, but Q4 revenue fell to INR 1,946 cr as developers deferred ordering, and EPC margin guide held at 8-10%.
calls.top: Q4 order inflow muted, shifted to Q1

calls.name: 360 ONE WAM LTD
calls.gLine: Quarterly TBR: 170-180 crore (quarterly)
calls.thesis: Wealth and AMC franchise posted record FY26 PAT of Rs 1,225 crores (+20.7%) and organic net flows of Rs 35,199 crores (+36%), but Q4 AMC net flows fell to ~2,300-2,400 crores on maturities and management guided to a 15-25% profit growth range.
calls.top: Q4 AMC gross flows 5,200 cr, net ~2,400 cr

calls.name: Angel One Ltd
calls.gLine: Employee cost incl. ESOP: about ₹11 billion, flat vs FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 broking volumes rebounded (orders +13.3% QoQ to 431m, EB/DAT margin 41.7%, normalised 44.4%), but cash market share fell 117 bps QoQ and management guided only to flat employee cost and a 2.5-3% new-business drag.

calls.name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Sanctions FY27: Expected to exceed INR75,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: IRFC sanctioned ~INR74,000 cr and disbursed ~INR35,000 cr in FY26 with NIM rising to 1.50%, but gave no numeric FY27 guidance and Q4 PAT was flat on new provisioning.

calls.name: Rolex Rings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15-17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR1,144 cr despite US exports down ~30%; management guides FY27 growth 15–17% and utilisation only 62–63%, with a 25% US tariff now accepted by customers.

calls.name: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 30% (standalone) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Highway O&M contractor with no capacity signal: FY26 revenue Rs 348.49 cr, PAT Rs 26.23 cr, capex only ~Rs 10 cr planned, and a 30% FY27 growth target without a numeric margin guide.

calls.name: Tarsons Products Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 standalone depreciation: INR105-110 crores peak
calls.thesis: Capex cycle ending: FY27 depreciation peaks at INR105-110 crores and maintenance capex ~INR20 crores, but Q4 standalone export fell 13.4% and gross margin slipped to ~58.5% on raw-material spikes.

calls.name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
calls.gLine: Food volume growth FY27: mid-teens (double digit)
calls.thesis: Q4 volume +14% to ~1.9mt and EBITDA/t near INR 3,400, but management flags Q1 cost inflation from crude-linked inputs and softer April demand; food guided EBITDA-neutral to FY27.
calls.top: April demand sluggish, Q1 to pick up

calls.name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Net store additions FY27: net openings in new FY, gross openings stable (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 retail sales up 7.8% with SSG 4.6% and FY26 gross openings flat, net store closures of 5-6% of area; supply is being cut, not expanded, but management gives no numeric FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Ksolves India Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual revenue growth FY27: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 43.03 cr (+29.1% YoY, +1.7% QoQ) with FY26 EBITDA margin down to 29.7% from 34.8% on planned investments; FY27 guided 18-20% growth, 25-30% margin, and DFM product write-off-style retreat.

calls.name: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue and EBITDA growth: 15% to 18% per annum over next 3-4 years (FY27-FY30)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 9% to Rs580 Cr but FY26 PAT fell to Rs176 Cr from Rs257 Cr as Atali ramp-up costs and West Asia inflation hit margins; management guides 15-18% growth with no near-term margin relief.
calls.top: API price increases resisted on existing orders

calls.name: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Tritium revenue: ~3x scale-up (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone Q4 revenue INR 282 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 10.6%, but consolidated EBITDA only INR 0.3 cr with rising inventory and receivables; supply-side signals are capacity additions, not discipline.

calls.name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 EBITDA margin: 18% (FY28)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 EBITDA ₹568 crore (14.4% margin) driven by premium mix and pricing, but management guides only flat FY27 margins with Q1 pressure, and supply-side evidence is largely capex-led backward integration rather than capacity discipline.

calls.name: Black Buck Ltd
calls.thesis: Core tolling and telematics compound (core revenue +34% FY26), but growth-business burn is widening, adjusted EBITDA margin slipped from ~36% to ~31%, and management gave no guidance.
calls.top: West Asia drag on intercity trucks

calls.name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 21.9% to Rs 74 cr with EBITDA margin 18.3%, but no capacity discipline signals; management refused numeric FY27 guidance and Bizdent pricing was traded for margin.
calls.top: Bizdent pricing pressure accepted for margin

calls.name: True Colors Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): 20-22% CAGR (medium term)
calls.thesis: Digital textile printing consumables roll-up with ~50% recurring revenue; FY26 revenue Rs 301.55 cr (+29%), EBITDA margin 15.58%, but operating cash flow negative (~Rs 35 cr) and receivables ballooned to Rs 111 cr at March-end.

calls.name: Pace Digitek Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT margin: 10% to 11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: BESS capacity doubling from 2.5 to 10 GWh by October, but FY26 EBITDA fell to Rs455 crore and receivables reached Rs2,442 crore, with cell costs up about 20% from April.

calls.name: Sudeep Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Net working capital days: 150-160 days (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 27.9% to INR642.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 34.6% from 37.8% and working capital days rose to 213; management guides margin recovery and NWC cut to 150-160 days.

calls.name: Exato Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue and PAT growth FY27: 50% to 60% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up ~35% to ₹168 Cr and PAT up ~67% to ₹16.09 Cr, but Q4 purchase-of-software/hardware jumped to ~81% of revenue from 67% as margins compressed, with no capacity or supply-side metric disclosed.
calls.top: Q4 purchase cost ~81% of revenue vs 67%

calls.name: Amagi Media Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue and margin: No numeric guidance; aspiration to 'continue to kind of grow at a healthy clip'
calls.thesis: Amagi FY26 revenue up 30% to INR 1,506 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin ~10% and PAT INR 72 cr; a SaaS/media-tech platform with no capacity-cycle signals, so supply-side read is largely not applicable.
calls.top: Gross margin compressed QoQ on pricing

calls.name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
calls.gLine: License-driven revenue share: 3% to 20% by 2030 (2030)
calls.thesis: Fractal grew FY26 revenue 19% (13% constant currency) with 22% Q4 adjusted EBITDA, but TMT client losses masked a 27% ex-TMT growth; no numeric FY27 revenue guidance was given.

calls.name: Accord Transformer & Switchgear Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR120–180 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue fell YoY (H2 INR42.6 cr) on customer-side site delays; management guides FY27 revenue INR120–180 cr and EBITDA margin 13–15%, but capacity utilisation is only 75–80% and no supply-side discipline is visible.
calls.top: Revenue deferred from FY26 to FY27

calls.name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR750 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY27 guided to INR750 crore revenue at 17% EBITDA margin while none of the INR440 crore capex adds FY27 output; Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin was only 15%, so the margin step-up is unproven.
calls.top: INR440 cr capex, zero FY27 output

calls.name: Saksoft Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30% target; 14-15% seen as bare minimum
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ~INR 249 cr, up 4% YoY and down 0.8% QoQ; management targets 30% growth but expects only 14-15%, with pipeline USD 25 mn (vs USD 5 mn six months ago) and decisions still deferred.
calls.top: Renewals to be repriced lower for AI

calls.name: Titan Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Titan Q4 FY26 demand strong (buyer growth back to 8% from flat), but margins under pressure from gold-price mix and Damas/Middle East losses; management gave a 15-20% 3-5 year CAGR but no FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 paints call: management is passing through steep crude-led inflation with decorative price hikes of about 2% in March then 5-6% per step (higher single digit net), but no volume hit yet and no capacity expansion signalled. Margin guide 13-14% held.
calls.top: Deco price hikes ~higher single digit net

calls.name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: Birla Tyres top line: INR 3,000 crore in next 4 years (4 years)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with consolidated PAT INR 755 crore (+36%), but supply additions are company-led (70,000 t carbon black, LFP and anode capex) and no FY27 numeric guidance was given.

calls.name: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Production: 10,000–11,000 boe/d (2027)
calls.thesis: Production ~15k boe/d locked behind infrastructure; FY27 target 10,000–11,000 boe/d hinges on rigs, funding and pipeline access, with HPCL crude sale reversed and INR260 crore tied up in receivables.
calls.top: INR260 crore tied up in crude invoices

calls.name: NIIT Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 9% to INR3,902m (organic core roughly flat in Q4) with EBITDA about -INR40m; order intake up 17% to INR4,209m gives book-to-bill above 1, but management guides an investment cycle to continue.

calls.name: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 sales up 15% to ₹10,827 cr and PAT up 14% to ₹652 cr on 12% volume growth, but Q1 FY27 outlook is mixed with NPK margins guided ±5–10% and sulphur supply constrained.

calls.name: Navneet Education Ltd
calls.gLine: Publication revenue growth FY27: around 15% in a single year, at least first 2 years (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR394 crore vs INR389 crore while FY26 fell 3% to INR1,683 crore; management guides FY27 publication growth ~15% on curriculum change, but stationery margins compress to ~9% and capex is minimal.

calls.name: GRP Ltd
calls.gLine: Reclaim Rubber US volume restoration: entirely restored in FY27
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR 94m (7% margin) from INR 331m as export volumes dropped ~15% and EPR income shrank; capex is shifting to Pyrova, with FY27 growth capex of INR 90-100 crore and debt-equity up to 1.15.

calls.name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Presales growth FY27: similar to ~25% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Presales up 25% to INR3,157 crore and FY27 growth guided at similar ~25%, with BD spend rising to over INR800 crore and no discounts claimed; supply-side signals are expansionary, not disciplined.
calls.top: BD spend INR200 cr → INR800 cr+

calls.name: SG Mart Ltd
calls.gLine: Service centres added in FY27: 3 more, 11-12 total (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 business EBITDA ~INR50 crores ex-INR6 crores inventory gain, with FY27 INR300-350 crores annualised EBITDA guide reaffirmed but hedged on Middle East and steel supply; capex of ~INR600 crores over two years is a growth bet, not discipline.
calls.top: Capex ~INR600 crores approved over two years

calls.name: Jtekt India Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental revenue from new capacity: INR800 crore additional over FY27 (theoretical, 10% market growth plus exports) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity built ahead of demand: CVJ line 2 at 27% utilisation and MS Gear line 6 at 21%, with management targeting full use in 1–1.5 years; FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 7.5% from 7.6%.

calls.name: JM Financial Ltd
calls.gLine: Private Markets core loan book growth FY27: 15% to 20%, ~INR5,000 crore by March 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: JM Financial's FY26 PAT rose 46% to INR1,202 crore, but CACM and wealth volumes are stalled by FPI selling; management is guiding to a second-half recovery and 20% wealth book growth, with no capacity cuts discussed.

calls.name: Mphasis Ltd
calls.thesis: Mphasis Q4 FY26 revenue $463 Mn, +7.1% YoY cc, FY27 guided high single-digit to low double-digit growth; supply-side signals are absent, with no capacity or utilisation disclosure and OCF/net income guided down to about 80%.

calls.name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 keys operationalised: 150 to 200 additional keys (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator with no capacity discipline issues; Q4 revenue up 19% to INR 110 cr and EBITDA margin 29%, but FY27 top line faces ~INR 50 cr loss from IRA Mumbai exit and no numeric guidance was given.
calls.top: IRA Mumbai exit removes ~INR 50 cr revenue

calls.name: Bank of Baroda
calls.gLine: Loan growth FY27: 12-14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bank of Baroda raised FY27 loan growth guidance to 12-14% and NIM to 2.75-2.95%, but Q4 NIM of 2.89% leans partly on IT refund interest and deposit costs are sticky at 4.78%.

calls.name: Sonata Software Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic growth: back to growth trajectory this fiscal year
calls.thesis: Sonata's international USD revenue was flat QoQ in Q4 FY26 and down 2.1% for FY26, with utilisation at 91.8% and management guiding only to similar EBITDA, so no supply-side capacity signal and growth is still pending.

calls.name: Wockhardt Ltd
calls.gLine: Zaynich global peak revenue: $1.5bn–$2bn per year (peak)
calls.thesis: Investor-meet pitch for Zaynich US/India/EM launch with no supply-side evidence; FY26 EBITDA ~INR630 crore (18.6% margin) but management guides to 12–18 months of launch losses and gives no utilisation or capacity data.
calls.top: Zaynich FDA approval, first Indian NCE

calls.name: Axiscades Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: 1,377 crore (52% growth on retained base) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 PAT of 0.4 crore and a 142 crore revenue slip; management frames FY26 as a building year and guides FY27 revenue to 1,377 crore, which the call does not support with hard numbers.
calls.top: Negative OCF from 100 crore land systems WIP

calls.name: Union Bank of India
calls.gLine: Credit growth: 13-14% for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Union Bank's Q4 FY26 call shows NIM down to 2.64% QoQ on rate cuts, LCR squeezed to ~114%, and deposits up only 2.72% YoY; management guides 13-14% credit growth and says NIM can be defended, with no capacity lever at play.

calls.name: PTC India Ltd
calls.thesis: Power trader PTC India: volumes up 12% to 92.8 BU in FY26 but margins flat and management guides to volume-led growth with no margin expansion; FY26 PAT flat at ₹397 crore ex-PEL sale.

calls.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating margin FY27: Tighter range, move towards 26% longer term
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 constant-currency revenue grew 1.2% QoQ after three sequential gains, FY26 CC revenue fell 2.4%, and margin reached 25% with no hard capacity signal; supply-side read is neutral, demand improving modestly.

calls.name: Kamdhenu Ltd
calls.gLine: Royalty rate growth: +10% to 15% per year (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Asset-light TMT franchisor: FY26 franchisee volume +10% to 37.9 lakh t and royalty +25% to INR175 cr, but PBT only +31% on a flat own plant and softer TMT prices; no capacity-discipline evidence either way.
calls.top: Royalty rate INR398 → INR435 per ton

calls.name: Indian Bank
calls.gLine: Deposit growth: 9% to 11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Indian Bank FY26 beat most guidance with advances +13.43% and gross NPA down to 1.98%, but FY27 guides NIM 3.10–3.25%, ROA 1.20–1.30%, and ECL absorption is still unquantified.

calls.name: Page Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Marketing spend: close to 5% of revenue (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume grew 10.8% to 54.5m pieces, with inventory days up to 73 from 64 as management built stock ahead of input inflation; EBITDA margin guided 19-21% versus 22% in FY26.

calls.name: eClerx Services Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 sequential revenue: stronger than Q4 (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 soft sequentially (operating revenue +0.5% cc QoQ, utilisation 74% vs 76.5% peak) but management held FY27 guidance of top-quartile growth and 24-28% EBITDA margin, with no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Hindustan Media Ventures Ltd
calls.thesis: Print ad yields drove a 100bp consolidated margin gain to 23% in Q4 on flat volumes, while Radio and OTTplay losses were cut by surrendering six loss-making frequencies and exiting OTTplay; no formal guidance given.

calls.name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
calls.gLine: Stone India commercial production: July 2026, profitable this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 PAT Rs166 crore on Rs2,961 crore income; wagon execution moderated and inventory rose ~40% to Rs1,079 crore while management guides to Q2 FY27 recovery pending a railway tender that has slipped.

calls.name: Rupa & Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +6.3% on 9% volume, but margins rebounded on Athleisure mix and a 4-5% April price hike; FY26 EBITDA fell 11.6% and FY27 guides 10-12% growth with 9-10% margin.

calls.name: Triveni Turbine Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book growth / minimum growth: ~9% growth in enquiry closing order book cited as minimum growth indication
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue record ₹6.8bn (+26%) but margin compressed on NTPC low-margin order and MTM loss; receivables swelled to ₹6.39bn (84 days vs 49), closing order book +8% to ₹20.54bn.

calls.name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit cost FY27: below 2% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small-ticket MSME NBFC in stress: GNPA fell to 3.59% from 6.61% and credit cost guided below 2%, but AUM grew only 6% on an ARC sale and FY26 PAT was just INR1.34 crore.
calls.top: Disbursements down; some decline in demand

calls.name: K.P. Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 40% to 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue INR 1,506 cr (+57%) and Q4 EBITDA margin 21%, but operating cash flow fell on inventory build; order book ~2 GW worth ~INR 3,000 cr with ~50% from group entities.
calls.top: Operating cash flow down on inventory build

calls.name: Mahanagar Gas Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: >10% possible if faster connections
calls.thesis: City gas distributor under LNG supply curtailment: I&C supply cut to ~80%, March volumes lost ~20-22% in industrial, but FY26 volume grew 8.25% and management targets 10%+ FY27 growth with ~INR1,200 crore capex.

calls.name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
calls.gLine: SIP-based stable market share and growth: slightly better net sales growth (near term)
calls.thesis: AMC posted record FY26 PAT of INR 15.29 bn (+19% YoY) and market share of 8.89%, but Q4 SIP net inflows have flattened and Q4 PAT fell 5% QoQ on negative other income.
calls.top: SIP book flat, net inflows stalled

calls.name: Dynamic Cables Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 growth slowed to 7% reported (20% core) as greenfield plant slipped about 15 months to September 2026 and order book rose only 11% after March price-driven deferrals; capacity constrained in H1.

calls.name: Adani Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Annual greenfield execution FY27: 4.5 to 5 GW, 100% PPA (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 added 5.1 GW (19.3 GW operating) but FY27 execution is being deliberately capped at 4.5-5 GW for evacuation, with ~10 GWh of BESS as the hedge; curtailment cost ~INR 1,500 crore.

calls.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 combined ratio improved to 95.7% and loss ratio fell to 65.2% (from 69.2%), but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and the gain is still being tested across cycles.

calls.name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume: 231,000 MTPA (FY27)
calls.thesis: Polymer compounder guides FY27 volume 231,000 t at 73% utilisation, ~11% EBITDA margin, with 80,000 t of new capacity added in last four months, so utilisation is diluted rather than supply discipline shown.
calls.top: Capacity ~315k t vs 231k t volume guide

calls.name: Prospect Consumer Products Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 12-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Small cashew processor scaled Changodar utilisation to 2,500–3,000 t of 4,800 t capacity, but H2 margins fell on rupee-driven input costs, D2C spend and 30% stuck inventory; EBITDA guided 12–15%.

calls.name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: 6% to 7% of FY27 revenue (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mankind Q4 FY26 revenue up 11.8% to INR3,443 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 27.1%, but capex guided up to 6-7% of FY27 revenue and FY27 tax rate rising to 25-26%, so the supply-side read is mixed.
calls.top: Capex guided to 6-7% of FY27 revenue

calls.name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Technology business margin: at least 1.5 to 2x traditional TPA margin (directional, not guidance)
calls.thesis: Medi Assist is a TPA/tech platform with no capacity cycle; FY26 operating EBITDA margin 19.3% rising quarterly (Q4 19.9%), debt-free, but retail TPA premium grew only 4.2% and group retention slipped to 93.2%.

calls.name: Signpost India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: double digit (around 20% plus per Q&A) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 46% YoY to INR162 cr with EBITDA margin 25.5% for FY26, but receivables up ~80% to INR317 cr and no supply-side capacity discipline disclosed; cash-cycle fix is promised, not shown.

calls.name: Go Digit General Insurance Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty commercial lines premium: about INR1,000 crores in 3-5 years (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: Digit reports FY26 IndAS-basis post-tax ROE of 17.7% and combined ratio 105.7%, but gross loss ratios are stable and motor OD loss ratio is rising amid retention cut to 89.6% from 95.9%.

calls.name: Umiya Mobile Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: up to 3% (about two years, FY28)
calls.thesis: Umiya Mobile is a mobile retailer expanding store count aggressively with no capacity discipline; management guides EBITDA margin to 3% by FY28 from ~1.8-1.9%, but offers no numbers on capex, and the call shows no supply-side signals.

calls.name: NIS Management Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: 12% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Security and facility manager with a FY26 consolidated revenue growth of 7.74% to INR436.70 crore and a one-time labour-code provision of INR27.82 crore; management guides 12-15% FY27 growth and receivables rose to INR124 crore at NIS Management standalone.

calls.name: VMS TMT Ltd
calls.gLine: Solar cost saving: INR5 crores annual from 15 MW
calls.thesis: Integrated TMT maker in Gujarat: CCM/hot-charging cut reheating cost ~INR1,500/ton and utilisation is only 70-75%, with no expansion planned; the margin story rests on integration and a 15 MW solar plant, not on supply discipline.

calls.name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Cell capacity commissioning: 2.4 GW cell production from 2H FY27; 6 GW by June-July 2027
calls.thesis: Q4 margins compressed to ~7% EBITDA on input-cost and rupee shock with fixed-price orders; FY26 EBITDA margin 12.78% on 3,138 MW sales, while cell capacity (2.4 GW) only starts production in 2H FY27.

calls.name: Telge Projects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: 60–70% CAGR, FY27 and beyond (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Asset-light BIM/structural engineering firm with no capacity or utilisation disclosure; growth is acquisition-aided, receivable days jumped 73→108, and 60–70% CAGR guidance is unsupported by a Rs 25 cr order book.

calls.name: Recode Studios Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: at least 50% (FY27 and H1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light beauty brand reports FY26 revenue ₹80 cr (+67%) and PAT ₹11.22 cr, but the IPO cash is funding working capital (receivables ~₹15 cr vs ₹8 cr) and management gave no supply-side or pricing evidence, with 50% growth guided without numbers for the quarter.

calls.name: Procter & Gamble Health Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 sales up 16% to about ₹1,400 crore and PAT up 30% to ₹327 crore, but management gave no numeric guidance and no capacity or capex commentary, so supply-side evidence is absent.

calls.name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 domestic tractor industry: flattish; 2-3% up or down (FY27)
calls.thesis: Escorts guides FY27 tractor industry flat to ±2-3% with H2 a substantial de-growth on high base and monsoon, while input costs (tyres, steel, base metals) rise 5-6% and only ~1.5% price taken in April.

calls.name: Excel Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Fixed asset turnover on new capex: 1 to 1.5 times
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 13% to INR281 cr and FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin 10.1%, but management gave no numeric guidance and capacity figures were withheld, leaving supply-side read thin.

calls.name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: around INR 2,800 crores
calls.thesis: Q4 chemical realisations rose sequentially (6% to 28% product-wise) and TDI is running near 80%, but methanol and acetic acid volumes are constrained by gas costs and fertiliser losses persist pending urea cost and energy norm revisions.

calls.name: SML Mahindra Ltd
calls.thesis: Mahindra-controlled SML reports FY26 revenue +18% and PAT +31%, but Q4 PAT only +2% on ~1.3% margin headwind from commodity inflation; management guides price hikes of 2–3% to offset.

calls.name: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: 5% to 10% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-war ammonia cost doubling (INR50 to INR100+/kg) passed to customers, margins temporarily widened; management sees bottom but methylamine overcapacity from Aarti caps recovery and volume guided only 5-10%.

calls.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
calls.thesis: Flexible packaging margin story with no capacity or capex signal: EBIT 8% ex a INR 88 million prior-year depreciation charge, sales flat at +10 bps, and management says raw-material pass-through is locked in.
calls.top: Raw-material costs passed through to customers

calls.name: Sangam India Ltd
calls.gLine: Renewable power share: 70%+ of power by June 2027 (June 2027)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 FY26 (INR880cr revenue, INR33cr PAT) on high utilisation and lower inventory, but management guides no new capex benefit until FY28 and FY27 growth is "similar" to FY26 top-line.

calls.name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 12-13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ipca guides FY27 consolidated growth of 12-13% and EBITDA margin rising to 22-22.3% from 20.7%, but raw-material inflation of 10-12% and 25% freight spikes cloud Q1 despite a supply-side-neutral capex picture.

calls.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Synergies (cost): about $350 million over 2-4 years (2-4 years)
calls.thesis: Sun is buying Organon for $3.99bn equity / $11.75bn EV, funded with $2–2.5bn cash plus debt, taking net debt/EBITDA to 2.3x; a capital allocation shift, not a supply-side read.

calls.name: Zydus Wellness Ltd
calls.gLine: Seasonal brands growth: consistent double-digit growth over three to four years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Q4 domestic growth only 1.7% with seasonal brands down 9.8% as delayed summer left the trade pipeline unbuilt; consolidated growth of 62.1% is acquisition-driven, and management gave no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Marico Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA growth FY27: high-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Marico guides FY27 double-digit revenue to cross INR15,000 crore and high-teen EBITDA growth, helped by copra down ~35% from peak, but crude-linked inputs still rising and no capacity signal.

calls.name: Engineers India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 10% to 15%
calls.thesis: Record order book Rs.15,109 cr (vs Rs.11,717 cr) but FY26 inflow fell to Rs.7,979 cr from Rs.8,214 cr; Middle East awards slowing, guidance held at about Rs.8,000 cr inflow.

calls.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
calls.gLine: Dividend per share: Rs.24 (FY26) (FY2026)
calls.thesis: Telco is supply-disciplined but ARPU stalled: Q4 ARPU Rs.257 up only Rs.3 QoQ, management "not happy", with radio capex moderating and FY27 capex guided "in the ballpark" of FY26's ~Rs.31,000 Cr.

calls.name: Everest Kanto Cylinder Ltd
calls.gLine: Egypt ramp-up target: around 40% initially, ~80% later (6 months after start / medium term)
calls.thesis: FY26 consolidated EBITDA up 15.7% to Rs 203 cr with margin 13.8%, but capacity is ramping (Mundra live, Egypt near) with utilisation ramp guided only after ~6 months, and US order book ~US$75m over 18-24 months.

calls.name: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd
calls.thesis: Royal Orchid guided nothing numeric for FY27 after a post-war demand hit; FY26 PAT of INR33 crore absorbed ~INR16 crore notional Ind AS hit, and management is asset-light, adding ~500 revenue-share keys with no timeline.

calls.name: Hubtown Ltd
calls.gLine: Pre-sales FY27: ~6,000 crore
calls.thesis: Mumbai developer guiding FY27 pre-sales of ~6,000 crore and collections of 3,000 crore against ~15% legacy debt cost, with the 4,000 crore 25 South/Downtown debt pool targeted to fall at least 35%; no supply-side discipline data, and the equity raise was cancelled.

calls.name: ICRA Ltd
calls.thesis: ICRA is a credit rating and analytics business where ratings grew 10.6% in Q4 and the company gave no numeric FY27 guidance; supply-side signals are absent and the call was mostly Q&A on Fintellix disclosure and capital return.

calls.name: Insecticides (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue and profit growth FY27: Decent growth; top line and bottom line positive, visible from Q1 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up ~19% and FY26 sales up ~7% with flat PAT, but working capital at 140-150 days, rising finance cost and no capacity cut; supply-side signals are mixed with price-led upside unproven after a weak May.

calls.name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: similar to FY26 growth, no number
calls.thesis: Thomas Scott grew revenue 58% to Rs 255 cr in FY26 with EBITDA margin 13.1%, but no capacity discipline or guidance was given, and receivables, short-term debt and the shift to wholesale sales raise working-capital questions.

calls.name: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: Maintain ~50% growth for 2-3 years, same profitability (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Management reports FY26 revenue +50% to INR365 crore and PAT nearly doubled to INR59.61 crore, but gives no capacity, capex or utilisation data; order book INR1600 crore (4.46x revenue) is the only supply-side anchor.

calls.name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Loan book: >INR 1 lakh crore in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Housing finance with no capacity signal; spread fell 10 bps to 2.12% on yield cuts, GNPA 0.93% and negative credit cost carry FY27 ROA guide of 2.4-2.5% (down from 2.66%).

calls.name: Varun Beverages Ltd
calls.gLine: Outlet additions: About half a million new outlets in CY26
calls.thesis: Q1 CY26 volume +16.3% with India +14.4% and India realisation -1.5%, but management is buying growth via discounts and Rs 10 packs while capex falls to Rs 500-600 crore, so supply discipline is strong and pricing is soft.

calls.name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
calls.gLine: Electronics revenue growth FY27: ~40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue up 22% to INR12,186 crore, but management guides 50–100 bps margin pressure from copper clad laminate, gold and wage costs; net working capital days jumped to 29 from 9 on inventory build.

calls.name: RITES Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: Aspire to break all-time high revenue in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order book hit record INR 9,416 crore with over 50% young, but management guided profits will not break the all-time high this year, with margins diluted by low-margin turnkey and export mix.

calls.name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
calls.thesis: Paying suppliers fell 1,200 in Q4 as Silver churn rose to ~7% monthly and gross adds slowed; growth now rests almost entirely on ARPU (8-9%) with customer growth only 1-2%.

calls.name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue CAGR: 20-30% over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: Anupam reports record FY26 revenue of INR2,384 crore (+65%) and operating cash flow of INR334 crore, with capex ended and no major capex planned, but the read is dominated by a debt-funded Bliss GVS acquisition and promotional Q&A.

calls.name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens, double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Powertrain utilisation only ~65-70% and alloy wheels at ~3M annualised exit vs 5.5M capacity, with management deferring further alloy expansion; FY27 growth guided mid-teens and capex undecided until September.

calls.name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
calls.thesis: Suspension PVC (CCVL) hit by China carbide dumping and a ₹898 Cr investment impairment; spreads now at variable-cost breakeven, while specialty is the stated capital-allocation priority.

calls.name: PB Fintech Ltd
calls.gLine: Paisabazaar costs: Roughly similar cost base this year
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 premium up 42% to ₹29,934 Cr with PAT ₹670 Cr, but this is an insurance distribution platform with no capacity or utilisation to read; the supply-side framework largely does not apply.

calls.name: One 97 Communications Ltd
calls.thesis: Paytm's Q4 FY26 call is a consumer-fintech growth story with no capacity signal; net payment margin above 3% and lending distribution are the drivers, but cost step-up is flagged and the transcript is garbled in places.

calls.name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Record FY26 standalone revenue of INR 67,689 mn (+39.2%) and EBITDA margin 3.12%, but no capacity, capex or utilisation figure given; Q4 revenue growth only ~4% and Q&A dodged several numeric questions.

calls.name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high single digits (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue INR5,252m (+22% YoY reported, +2% QoQ cc) with a low-single-digit QoQ rebound promised; FY27 guided only to high single-digit growth and 18–20% EBITDA margin, with a sharp Q4 budget miss from two large clients.
calls.top: Q4 revenue miss: two clients cut L&D budgets

calls.name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: CCL first production: November 2026 (Nov-26)
calls.thesis: Stainless washer maker pivoting into a new copper-clad laminate (CCL) plant (₹338 cr ECMS-approved, Nov-26 start) with 1,078 cr FY26 base and a 2,500 cr FY28-29 target; capex, QIP and the working-capital build are unproven, and OCF was negative.

calls.name: Max Estates Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 collections: INR2,500-3,000 crore
calls.thesis: FY26 presales INR5,305 crore, Q4 bookings INR3,300 crore, but no FY27 presales guidance given; net debt about INR100 crore and INR16,310 crore of launch revenue yet to be recognised.

calls.name: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: upwards of 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue fell ~12% YoY to INR364.94 cr on deliberate bid discipline; no capacity or supply signal, FY27 guided to 20%+ growth with working capital stretched by loans and advances of INR146.45 cr.

calls.name: AJAX Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: mid to early double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 SLCM volumes fell about 4% vs industry ~11%, EBITDA margin 12.6% vs 15.3%; Q4 price hike of 2% and 76% April share, but demand guidance is only "mid and early double-digit" and no FY27 numbers given.

calls.name: Scoda Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Scoda Tubes FY26 revenue up 7% to INR518.7 crore with Q4 flat and EBITDA margin down to 13.5% after a 15-17 day gas-driven plant shutdown; FY27 guided at 25% growth and 14-15% margin, with 13,000t welded capex slipping.

calls.name: GK Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: ~INR 3,000 cr+ (pump 1.2-1.4 lakh units; rooftop INR 600-1,000 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 standalone revenue INR 1,532.5 cr (+40%) and EBITDA margin 20.4%, but Q4 installs 17,018 fell short of the 70,000+ FY guide (61,000 delivered) and FY27 target of ~INR 3,000 cr rests on unconfirmed PM-KUSUM 2.0.

calls.name: Xpro India Ltd
calls.gLine: Barjora new line utilisation FY27: at least 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Barjora dielectric line commissioned 27 March 2026 with utilisation target of at least 50%; Q4 revenue fell to INR134.37 crore from INR158.2 crore while polymer price hikes lift replacement costs.

calls.name: Bajaj Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry-average EBIT margin ambition: 6-8%, 9% (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Consumer Products loss on operating deleverage and channel still elevated in coolers; Lighting record 8.5% EBIT margin, capex to fall below half of past levels, but no numeric FY27 guidance.
calls.top: Capex to fall below half of past

calls.name: Bata India Ltd
calls.gLine: Turns target: about 3 (currently ~2.7)
calls.thesis: Bata's second straight quarter of ~5% value growth is volume-led, but inventory cut 13% YoY and 28% over two years, margins diluted by franchise mix and one-offs, and raw-material inflation of 5-6% is not yet priced.

calls.name: Surya Roshni Ltd
calls.gLine: Steel volume FY27: 11 lakh tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 steel EBITDA/ton fell to ₹5,121 from ₹6,708 and FY27 guidance implies ~₹4,700/ton on 11 lakh tons, a sharp downshift management has not reconciled with its own export margin claims.

calls.name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Acquired group EBITDA: EUR 35 million FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 volume rebound as insolvency destocking ends and Heubach inventory cut €29m vs €20m plan; but reported EBITDA flattered by ₹82cr overhead release and ₹37cr PPA gain, with FY27 acquired EBITDA guided at €35m.

calls.name: Supreme Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 piping volume growth: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Supreme guides FY27 piping volume +15-17% and margin 14-14.5% on ~1.10 lakh MT capacity add, but industry volumes fell 9% in FY26 and channel inventory is unverifiable.
calls.top: Capacity +1.10 lakh MT to ~1.35 mn MT

calls.name: Onward Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: ~INR 25 crores over two years for existing clients (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: FY26 record revenue of INR 550 crores (+10.5%) and 13.2% gross margin, but no capacity or pricing signal; management deflects AI-substitution questions and gives only double-digit guidance.
calls.top: Evasion on AI disruption and FX growth

calls.name: Ganesh Housing Ltd
calls.gLine: Million Minds Phase 1 annual lease rental: INR 75-77 crore, from FY28 full year
calls.thesis: Land-bank monetisation drove FY26 profit (PAT INR316 crore vs FY25 strong year); no FY27 revenue/EBITDA guidance given until Q1, with Million Minds rent ~INR72-77 crore/yr from FY28 and Malabar Retreat completion targeted FY27.

calls.name: Kriti Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: Positive growth, above industry average, no number given (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 volume fell 13% to 58,630 MT and revenue fell 19%, but Q4 turned profitable with EBITDA margin 12.91% on a PVC inventory gain; management has put capex on hold for two quarters.
calls.top: Capex on hold for two quarters

calls.name: Container Corporation of India Ltd
calls.gLine: EXIM volume growth FY27: 8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: CONCOR handled a record 5.58 million TEUs in FY26 (+9.6%) but PAT fell 4.5% and Q4 domestic EBIT margin collapsed to 0.2%; FY27 guidance is EXIM 8%, domestic 15%, overall 9.5%.

calls.name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit growth FY27: 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 PAT of INR2,363 cr (+13.5%) with GNPA 2.50% and zero-ish credit cost, but NIM fell to 3.60% and FY27 guidance is conservative (NIM ~3.5%, credit growth 12%, GNPA <2.25%).

calls.name: R Systems International Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue up 29.9% YoY to INR 574.8 cr but organic growth was flat QoQ and utilisation fell to 80.5% from ~84% as bench was built for AI; margin gain partly FX-driven.

calls.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: 99acres medium term: Double billings over 3 years; 25-30% EBITDA margin
calls.thesis: Naukri billings slowed to 10% in FY26 with recruitment hiring stuck in a lukewarm market; Q4 margin held near 58% but 99acres billings grew just 2% after a one-time ₹20.5 cr warranty write-back flattered revenue.

calls.name: Camlin Fine Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 Blends revenue: above INR1,400 crores
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue hit by shipping disruption and a ~INR50 crore Middle East impact; vanillin realisation rose to above $12.5 but was helped by liquidating channel stock, and FY27 guidance of 12-14% EBITDA margin is unchanged despite a Q4 EBITDA margin of about 5%.
calls.top: Q4 vanillin sales from channel stock

calls.name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Battery business FY27 utilisation: 100% of plant and machinery utilised
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue INR175.5 cr (+18.6% YoY) with utilisation ~78%, but FY27 guidance withheld, FY26 guidance missed, and battery still loss-making; supply discipline is not evidenced.

calls.name: Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd
calls.gLine: Growth portfolio (non-ADHO) revenue: around INR500 crores in 3 years
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin hit 63% and EBITDA margin 25% standalone on MLH price cuts and mix, with management declining to guide and flagging hyperinflation in LLP and packaging from the Gulf war.

calls.name: Indus Towers Ltd
calls.thesis: Indus Towers' Q4 FY26 supply-side picture is steady, not cyclical: 4,892 macro towers and 6,192 co-locations added, tenancy stable at 1.62, but EBITDA margin slipped to 55.1% and management pays out full FY26 FCF.
calls.top: Full-year FCF fully distributed as dividend

calls.name: Orient Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost per tonne reduction: INR250/t in FY27 (average), INR500 over two years (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Document is an Ambuja Cements Q4 FY26 call transcript (filed under Orient's listing), with Orient only a minor part; cost per tonne peaked at INR4,500, FY27 capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 crore and capacity end-state pushed out, with volume guidance of 80 MT in FY27.

calls.name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: ~INR50 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Snowman's warehousing is running at 86–87% utilisation with price hikes sticking, but Q4 margins fell on start-up costs and West Asia disruption; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance beyond ~INR50 crore capex.
calls.top: West Asia volumes subdued into April

calls.name: UFO Moviez India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 43% YoY to ₹1,342m but EBITDA fell 13% QoQ and DSO rose to 147 days from 121, largely from Dhurandhar revenue booked late in March.

calls.name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin FY27: 20% to 21%
calls.thesis: Alkem FY26 revenue up 13.5% to INR147bn with EBITDA margin 20.4%, but management flagged geopolitical cost pressure, trade generics growth slowing to ~4.3%, and CEO exit with no FY27 margin expansion assured.
calls.top: API and packaging cost inflation flagged

calls.name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: ~30% envisaged, not firm (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA up 145% to INR73 crore on a flat ~10,300 MT volume base, helped by FX gains, lower debt and inventory use; management guides FY27 volume up ~30% but wants to see quarterly progress.

calls.name: Matrimony.com Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 PAT: more than double YoY (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Matchmaking billing up 10.5% YoY in Q4 with paid profiles down 4.3% YoY; ARPU-led growth, while Marriage Services losses widened to INR 5.7 crore and FY26 PAT fell to INR 34.2 crore.

calls.name: IRIS RegTech Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Receivable days: 75 to 80 days comfortable (near term)
calls.thesis: Software/RegTech call with no capacity or utilisation content; management guides INR500 crore revenue aspiration (~30% CAGR over 4-5 years), IRIS CARBON ARR growth ~35% target, and flags possible Middle East SupTech pipeline delay after June.

calls.name: Shalby Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital revenue growth: minimum 15% CAGR long term (long term)
calls.thesis: Shalby's Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA rose 43% to INR37.4 crore on a 9.4% revenue gain, but standalone EBITDA fell and PAT was lifted mainly by a tax-regime change, not operations.

calls.name: Dollar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt reduction: Debt to zero by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Dollar Industries took a 4–6% price hike in Q1 FY27 after ~2 years, Q4 gross margin fell 169bp to 28.1% on economy mix and yarn costs, and FY27 guidance was deferred to Q1 call.

calls.name: Fine Organic Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: US plant commissioning: 18 to 24 months from construction start, target 18 (post construction start)
calls.thesis: Specialty additives maker at full utilisation with FY27 guided flat on volumes until SEZ commissioning in 2H FY28; sustainable EBITDA 18-20% reiterated, while capex and acquisitions expand.

calls.name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 MDF volume growth: With the market or better; industry early double digit to mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Greenpanel FY26 reported EBITDA fell to 6.3% with PBT -INR43.8 crore; management gave no FY27 margin or volume guidance, citing Middle East chemical cost shock, a 15% price hike being discounted, and 40-45% chemical cost inflation.
calls.top: No FY27 margin or volume guidance

calls.name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Square feet growth FY27: at least 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Go Fashion is shutting small EBOs and pivoting to 700+ sq ft stores while SSSG is negative (~-3%) and Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 25.3%; management guides no degrowth and margin recovery only from Q2, with no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Tega Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Molycop debt to 3x leverage: 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Consumables flat in FY26 as orders slipped to Feb-Mar and FG built by ~INR50 crore on shipping disruption; pending orders up ~18% and Molycop acquisition adds ~$838m debt and a 3-4 year deleveraging path.
calls.top: FG up ~INR50 crore on shipping delays

calls.name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Cash conversion cycle: 320 to 340 days (going forward)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue INR925cr (+31%) and EBITDA INR371cr (40% margin) on record INR1,121cr inflows, but Q4 revenue fell 13% YoY and no capacity or utilisation data was given; order conversion hinges on government timing.

calls.name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth for existing base FY27: approx 14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Prudent's MF-distribution AUM hit a record 1.33 trn by May 5 (9.7% above FY26 average) and equity net sales hit a record INR 4,300 cr, but yield and payout changes from SEBI TER rules add uncertainty.
calls.top: Equity net sales record INR 4,300 cr

calls.name: Cello World Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 2% to 2.5% above FY26 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue record INR654 cr (+11%) but glassware sits at ~60% utilisation and breakeven, steel ware lines ramp only from July, and FY27 guidance is cut to 10-12% growth with 2-2.5% margin expansion.

calls.name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: India multi-channel FY27 GMV growth: better than FY26 (11%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: India multi-channel GMV +11% with diapering price war cutting gross margin ~140 bps; management guides FY27 growth superior to FY26 and says margin loss recovers from Q2, but no capacity or supply signals.

calls.name: Star Imaging And Path Lab Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 25-30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Diagnostics operator with revenue up only 6% to INR88.5 crore in FY26 after guiding 30-35%; FY27 growth now guided at 25-30% with capex of INR20-25 crore and no new debt, but execution delays undercut credibility.

calls.name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (blended, post SteriPort): 24% to 25% (FY27 onward)
calls.thesis: Capacity doubling from 6.6 to ~12 crore bottles (SteriPort line 3) due ~20 June; management targets 24-25% EBITDA margin, but commissioning, 4-month polymer buffer and inventory build point to a slow ramp.

calls.name: HeidelbergCement India Ltd
calls.thesis: Central India cement pricing under pressure from new capacity (JK, UltraTech ramp); management expects Q1 cost push of INR100-160/t to be passed on, but concedes near-term price weakness before monsoon ends; 95% utilisation and debottlenecked clinker give limited volume headroom.

calls.name: Federal Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: LCR operating range: 115% to 120% (ongoing)
calls.thesis: Federal Bank Q4 FY26 shows record profit of INR1,145 cr and ROA back to pre-rate-cut levels, but about INR456 cr one-off tax-refund interest flatters reported numbers and ECL transition is unquantified.
calls.top: One-off tax refund gains flatter Q4

calls.name: SKF India Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable PBT margin: 11-12% near term
calls.thesis: Post-demerger SKF India auto margins guided to 11-12% PBT (vs ~20% FY25 cited by analysts), with FY26 sales +12.8% but PBT down 694bp, capex ~INR 500cr over FY26-28 and industrial trading filling capacity gaps.

calls.name: NOCIL Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: double-digit (coming years)
calls.thesis: Q4 volumes up 7% QoQ to 150 index, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.4% as RM spike and legacy inventory costs squeezed spreads; Rs.130 cr new capacity adds to supply, offset by pending antidumping duties.

calls.name: GMM Pfaudler Ltd
calls.gLine: Medium-term consolidated EBITDA margin: 15% minimum (medium term)
calls.thesis: Order intake up 20% to INR 3,714 crore and opening backlog up 34%, but management declined numeric FY27 guidance, Q4 gross margin slipped and EBITDA margin target is only 15% medium term.
calls.top: Order intake up 20% to INR 3,714 crore

calls.name: Cemindia Projects Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 25%; later 20–25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹10,061 cr (+9%) and Q4 EBITDA margin 15.1% flattered by ₹150 cr one-time claims; management guides 10–10.5% margin and 20–25% FY27 growth.

calls.name: Simplex Castings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs300 cr (200 existing, 50 casted railway, ~50 power) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Simplex Castings FY26 revenue ~Rs202 cr (+18%), PAT Rs21.26 cr (+40.5%); FY27 target Rs300 cr with management admitting Q4 dispatches slipped into Q1 as customer sites stalled, and capacity build is ahead of confirmed orders.

calls.name: Kalyani Forge Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 15% floor; target 20% in about a year (FY27 end / early FY28)
calls.thesis: Margins up to 15.2% EBITDA on exits from low-margin business, but FY26 revenue flat at Rs 238 cr, working capital stretched (CCC peaked 176 days) and D/E rising to 1.11 with equity raise in the works.

calls.name: Ador Welding Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: +100 to 200 bps over coming periods (coming periods)
calls.thesis: Ador guides no numbers; capex ~INR30-35cr for FY27 mostly consumable lines, utilisation ~70% blended but some lines at 90-95%, and management targets ~100-200bps EBITDA margin gain over coming periods.

calls.name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Order intake FY27: INR800-1,000 cr group (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consol EBITDA 22.95% on INR189 cr revenue; order intake shifted a quarter with FY27 INR800-1,000 cr target, but receivables and working capital days rose from 169 to 184, weakening cash conversion.
themes: Waste heat recovery in steel and ferrous alloy

calls.name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
calls.gLine: Methylamine utilisation: 55-60% in June quarter; 70% within a year (Q1 FY27 / 12 months)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 13.4% with Sayakha methylamine utilisation ~40% in March and FY27 margin target 13.5–14%, but salicylic acid shut and export revenue down 7% YoY.

calls.name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Animal Healthcare recovery: recovery from this quarter onwards (qualitative)
calls.thesis: Poultry-led profit recovery (Q4 revenue +22%, PAT +174%) with Animal Healthcare tender delays unresolved and no hard FY27 guidance; capacity built, BSL-3 underused, receivables rising to INR 92 crore.

calls.name: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 powder volume growth: small increase (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 PAT above Rs100 cr on sales of Rs767 cr (up 58%), driven by bird-flu-led export pricing; management says capacity is full and FY27 volume growth will be small, with a Rs400 cr EC-shed capex aimed at cutting purchased-egg costs rather than adding top line.

calls.name: GE Power India Ltd
calls.thesis: Order book fell to INR 1,628 cr from INR 2,662 cr as FGD-EP contracts were terminated; core services orders up 32% and FY26 PBT of INR 340 cr is inflated by one-offs (BHEL ECL reversal ~INR 116 cr), with underlying EBITDA ~11%.

calls.name: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 12% to INR1,424 crores with EBITDA margin 10.2%, but Q4 margin fell to about 9% on cost pressure; new opex/as-a-service model is adding lease debt and ROU assets with little disclosure on returns.

calls.name: UCO Bank
calls.gLine: RAM share: 62-65% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Strong FY26 beat on credit growth (19.44% vs 12-15% guide) and asset quality (GNPA 2.17%, credit cost 0.62%), but FY27 guidance held at 12-14% and CD ratio rising toward 80-82%, so the supply-side read is pricing discipline on corporate loans, not capacity expansion.
calls.top: Corporate pipeline held back on pricing

calls.name: LT Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: around 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Basmati volume up ~19% and FY26 EBITDA margin around 11.8% normalised, but management guides margins back to ~12% with gross margin held at 33-33.5% and RTH capacity delayed to Q2 FY27.

calls.name: Rhi Magnesita India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA margin: 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin fell to 12.1% and FY27 guided to ~13% EBITDA on price hikes of 1-3% and coke-oven order book, but no capacity discipline is discussed and industry overcapacity persists.

calls.name: Repco Home Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 disbursement: Rs.5,000 Cr (FY2026-27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 FY26 disbursements of Rs.1186 Cr, but AUM growth lags because of pre-closures and run-down; FY27 AUM target Rs.18,000 Cr implies ~13% growth with CoF guided to fall only 10-15 bps via NHB refinance.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: TCNS breakeven: end FY27 breakeven; profitable FY28
calls.thesis: Demand-led apparel recovery at Pantaloons (+17% core, 14% LTL) with flat pricing and rising costs; capital-cycle picture is cash burn of ~INR1,000 cr standalone in FY26 with management guiding stores to only 20-22 for Pantaloons in FY27.

calls.name: Skipper Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with order book INR8,502 cr and utilisation above 85%, but FY27 revenue guided only 15% (vs 20-25% historically) as bidding slipped on transformer/HVDC and ROW constraints.

calls.name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Core category volume growth: Double-digit aspiration (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 core volumes fell 3% (branded -5%) on lapped institutional and export sales; gross margin rose to 28% but EBITDA margin slipped to ~8.1%, with no capacity discipline signal and inventory up ~INR150 crore on rate variance.

calls.name: HPL Electric & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: C&I revenue FY27: around 1,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 C&I revenue grew 26% to Rs 784 cr with wires up 50%, mostly volume-led; smart metering order book over Rs 3,200 cr, but management flagged margin pressure from commodity costs and lower smart-meter realisations.

calls.name: Mahindra Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Express revenue growth: mid- to high-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Turnaround logistics story: FY26 reported PAT ₹2.3 crore vs ₹35.8 crore loss, Express GM positive at 1.3% but still EBITDA-negative (₹31 crore loss); management gives no hard EBITDA timeline.
calls.top: Express GM turned positive, Q4 ₹6.6 crore

calls.name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: NIM improvement: 10-20 bps over next 2-3 quarters (2-3 quarters)
