calls.name: Affordable Robotic & Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Humro EBITDA margin target: 15-18%
calls.thesis: FY26 standalone EBITDA margin rose to 14.45% from 8.96% on selective, margin-led execution, but revenue fell and the Humro US/AMR book is small (about $25k/month billed) against a 225-robot FY27 target.

calls.name: CSB Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: RoA / RoE: ROA ~1.5%, ROE ~15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit up 32% QoQ to Rs202cr with GNPA 1.66%, but NIM fell 2-3bps QoQ, CTI guided 60-65% through FY27, and retail asset growth pushed to FY28.

calls.name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 27% to INR2,521 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to ~11% from 15.5%, with execution slowed by land delays and fuel-linked cost spikes; FY27 guidance is 15% growth and INR20,000-22,000 cr order wins.
calls.top: Margin hit by fuel and bitumen costs

calls.name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: about INR540 crores, funded internally (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 margin of 33.6% (+360bp) and revenue +6.9%, but capex stepping up to INR540 crores for FY27 with capacity planned to reach 2,690 KL by FY28; Solapur utilisation guided at only 40-50% at start.

calls.name: Prevest Denpro Ltd
calls.thesis: Dental materials maker grew revenue 13.9% to INR71.81 cr with 38.6% EBITDA margin, but traditional capacity sits at only 67-68% utilisation and no capex or capacity-addition guidance was given.

calls.name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
calls.gLine: KFC gross margin investment if vendor support ends: 50-70 bp headwind
calls.thesis: QSR operator (KFC/Pizza Hut) with Q4 SSSG 4% (6% ex-Navratri) and restaurant EBITDA up 110bp to 16.8% on value-led recruitment, but capex and FY27 spend held flat and Pizza Hut still declining.

calls.name: Premier Energies Ltd
calls.gLine: Total capacity by July 2026: 16.75 GVA (July 2026)
calls.thesis: Premier Energies' cell and module capacity heads to 16.75 GW by July 2026 with a ₹5,100 crore FY27 capex plan, while management declined to guide on margins despite rising cell and silver costs.

calls.name: Swiggy Ltd
calls.gLine: Quick commerce contribution margin path: steady state/positive CM; 3% positive CM in top city
calls.thesis: Swiggy's Q4 FY26 call shows quick-commerce losses still near INR700 crore per quarter, with management trading growth for profitability; no supply-side discipline signals, and MTU growth is softening on lower AOV and frequency.

calls.name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PAT: INR270-280 crore (13.5-14% margin) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 8.8% and FY26 revenue missed the prior ~35% growth guide; FY27 guided to ~INR2,000 crore revenue and PAT INR270-280 crore on 1,200 crore-plus order book conversion, with working capital stretched to 166 days.

calls.name: Indo Farm Equipment Ltd
calls.gLine: Overall revenue growth FY27: 20–25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crane capacity expansion is delayed and under-utilised, with FY27 guidance of 20–25% revenue growth, tractor utilisation near 35–45%, and cash-flow and working-capital questions left unanswered.
calls.top: New crane plant start slipped to Q2 FY27

calls.name: Meta Infotech Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT FY29: up to 4x FY26 levels (aspirational)
calls.thesis: FY26 PAT fell to INR11 crore from INR14 crore and H2 PAT was INR0.4 crore; management guides only an aspirational 4x PAT by FY29 with no numeric FY27 guidance, and attributes the miss to a vendor sale and FX.

calls.name: Glen Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 turnover: INR500 crore plus (FY28)
calls.thesis: Glen is adding ~3x plastic food-container capacity and paper food packaging (~750 MT, INR130-135 cr capex, INR500 cr turnover target by FY28) while PLA/paper straw utilisation is only 28-34% and EBITDA margin has compressed to 18-19% on pass-through of PLA costs.
calls.top: Capex raised INR100 cr → INR130-135 cr

calls.name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM CAGR (medium term): 30% to 35% annually (medium term)
calls.thesis: Secured MSME/rural lender guiding 30-35% AUM CAGR and ~40-45% PAT growth; cost of borrowing fell to 10.8% but incremental cost is 10.25-10.30%, and Q4 PAT was flattered by an INR 8.66 cr DA upfront gain.
calls.top: DA pool sale lifts Q4 NIM

calls.name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 950 crore (EPC ~300, Toll ~650)
calls.thesis: Tollway-led infra firm with record INR 1,143 cr order book and FY27 revenue guide of INR 950 cr, but no capacity or capex discipline data, and management evaded margin and Kaza profitability questions.

calls.name: Jinkushal Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: HexL share of revenue FY27: 11% to 12% of revenue; ~150 units
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 89% to INR133 crore standalone but FY26 PAT of INR12.4 crore reflects logistics and HexL costs; management declined FY27 guidance and working capital is stretching with no cash-conversion improvement guided.
calls.top: Cash conversion cycle to stay elevated

calls.name: Orkla India Ltd
calls.gLine: Kerala distribution restructuring completion: by 1 January 2027
calls.thesis: Spice deflation has bottomed: Q4 price uptick (~4% realisation) and chilli up 20-30%, but volume growth slowed to 2.2% in Q4 and no PLI income was booked in FY26 (FY25: INR 20.5 cr).

calls.name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
calls.gLine: Installed module capacity by FY27 end: 16.3 GW modules and 8.9 GW cells (end FY2027)
calls.thesis: Solar module/cell maker with cell utilisation up to 69.9% (FY26) and 79% in Q4, but a 6 GW expansion adds capacity by FY27 and working capital absorbed INR636 crore of inventory build.

calls.name: Digilogic Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 8.4% to INR78.27 cr, missing the 20-25% guidance; management blames delayed imported hardware and a INR22 cr spillover, with FY27 relying on a September order-book target of INR100 cr-plus.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 presales: No numeric guidance; new launches ~INR 9,000 cr plus ~INR 7,000 cr sustenance (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 presales of INR 4,288 crores (+69% QoQ) and FY26 presales of INR 8,136 crores, but BD of only ~INR 1,600 crores in FY26 and no FY27 presales guidance leaves pipeline lumpy.
calls.top: INR 15,000 cr launch target may slip to FY29

calls.name: Crisil Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry bank credit growth FY27: around 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Crisil Q1 FY26 revenue jumped 30.1% and PAT 45.9%, but management flagged FX gains and a USD4.5m timing pull-forward in RAS, so underlying growth is weaker than headline and no numeric guidance was given.

calls.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up only ~4% to about INR1,800 crore after a March polymer price shock (~INR200-250 crore lost); management guides FY27 better and says ~INR600 crore operating cash flow, but ~INR40 crore reported PAT loss and large debt repayments due Sept and March 2027.
calls.top: Q4 revenue short by INR200-250 crore

calls.name: Rallis India Ltd
calls.gLine: Seeds revenue growth FY27: high double-digit (mid-teens), volume plus price (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 6% to ₹456 cr with EBITDA at ₹-1 cr (vs ₹-19 cr); management sees industry shifting to seller's market on 15–25% input cost inflation, pricing hikes announced, but Q4 B2C volume was pushed via placement and Benzilla/Clasto inventory liquidation.

calls.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: Edible oil volume growth FY27: 3% to 5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 edible oil EBITDA margin only 2.58% on 23% revenue growth as palm/soy prices rose 15-23%; management guides 2-4% edible oil margin and FY27 FMCG-led EBITDA growth of 12-15%, with plantation EBITDA of INR357 crores as the swing.

calls.name: Ambuja Cements Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost reduction FY27: INR250/t reduction, another INR250 in FY28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Ambuja's Q4 FY26 cost hit ~INR4,500/t with FY27 cost reduction of only INR250/t and capex cut to INR6,000–6,500 cr; utilisation at acquired Sanghi (57%) and Penna (46%) is the drag, and pricing is still under pressure.
calls.top: Industry price up only ~INR10 in March

calls.name: Siemens Ltd
calls.thesis: Record ₹450bn backlog and Q6 orders up 33%, but EBITDA margin fell 290bp to 9.7% on commodity and Euro-driven material cost (74% of revenue); price hikes lag 3–4 months.

calls.name: Colgate Palmolive (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 9% to Rs 1,583 crore with domestic growth 9.2%, but full-year sales flat at Rs 5,984 crore; no capacity or capex signal, and management guides to balanced volume-price growth with EBITDA not guided.

calls.name: Castrol India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY26 revenue +9% to INR1,545 cr, EBITDA +7% to INR329 cr, but management flagged raw-material and FX costs flowing into Q2 with only one price round taken; margin guidance of 21-24% kept.
calls.top: Raw-material cost hit deferred to Q2

calls.name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Total capex FY27: INR1,500-1,800 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 OHT volumes (85,820 MT, +5% YoY) and FY26 highest-ever, but management stopped volume guidance, RM costs set to rise 7-8% in Q1 FY27, and capex raised to INR6,800 crore through FY29.

calls.name: Shriram Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth FY27: 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Shriram Finance Q4 FY26 AUM up 14.85% YoY to INR3.02 lakh cr with NIM 8.61% and PAT up 40.9%, but gross Stage 3 edged up to 4.58% and FY27 AUM growth budgeted at 18% is not yet reconfirmed beyond Q1.

calls.name: Pennar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT growth FY27: at least 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: PEB India utilisation at 70% with backlog ₹810 crores, but Q4 revenue growth only 2.3% and working capital rose to 82 days; management guides 20% PAT growth and 75 days working capital.

calls.name: Salzer Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 existing business revenue: INR 2,000-2,100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Margins squeezed by plastic and copper inflation (2-3% hit); FY27 EBITDA guided 9-9.5% after a June 7-10% price hike, while working capital ran near 30% of revenue vs a 25% target.

calls.name: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable consolidated EBITDA margin: 13.5% to 14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin dipped on a ~INR10,000/t steel spike not passed through until April; management guides 13-14% sustainable margin and ~17-18% FY27 volume growth to ~155,000t, while Chennai capacity doubles to 60,000t amid admitted industry overcapacity.

calls.name: TCPL Packaging Ltd
calls.thesis: Flexible packaging running well-utilised with a fourth line due by year-end, carton utilisation lower, FY27 capex ~INR 100 crore; paper cost increases still rolling through with no margin guidance, export recovery contingent on Middle East.

calls.name: Filatex India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 standalone revenue: around INR 4,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 13.9% YoY to INR 86.3 cr on lower volume, but March spread fell to roughly EBITDA-neutral and management sees Q1 FY27 output 20-25% below 1 lakh tons per quarter.

calls.name: Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Alco-Bev revenue growth FY27: 60% to 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Piccadily guides FY27 Alco-Bev growth of 60-70% value on 450 KLPD capacity, but Q4 IMFL-led growth relies on capacity just added, with short-term borrowings up 132% and DSO near 90 days.

calls.name: Emami Ltd
calls.gLine: International business growth: good double-digit growth from Q2 (Q2 FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue down 4% and EBITDA down 15% on weak summer and Middle East disruption, though gross margin rose 250bps to 68.4% and receivables fell over INR100 crores.
calls.top: Receivables cut by over INR100 crores

calls.name: 3B BlackBio Dx Ltd
calls.gLine: Coris revenue FY27: around INR50 crore, EBITDA slightly positive (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 consolidated revenue ~INR142 crore with PAT ~INR60 crore; management guides 15-20% growth for FY27 but domestic 3B molecular sales grew only ~7% ex-exports, with Chinese low-price competition and Coris EBITDA near breakeven.

calls.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Alumina production and sales FY27: ~25 lakh tonnes (FY27)
calls.thesis: NALCO guides FY27 alumina to 25 lakh tonnes on a 2 lakh tonne fifth stream, but expects alumina at $300-310/t vs $376 in FY26, with metal near $3,000-3,100/t offsetting; capex steps up to Rs4,000-5,000 crore in FY28.

calls.name: Redington Ltd
calls.gLine: Outside Arena EBITDA: 2.2% to 2.4% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q4 revenue up 25% to INR33,269 cr and PAT ex-exceptional at 1.4% margin, but Middle East war hits Q1 and FY27 guidance is only soft, with management conserving cash for large deals and M&A.
calls.top: AR provisions elevated, working capital may rise

calls.name: Central Bank of India
calls.gLine: Deposit growth FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Advances up 18.8% to ₹3.45 lakh crore and CD ratio 73.8%, but Q4 PAT of ₹724 crore was hit by a ₹632 crore one-time DTA charge; ECL transition and treasury drag weigh on FY27 earnings.

calls.name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
calls.gLine: Motorcycle industry growth: 7% to 9% near term
calls.thesis: Record Q4 with 20.8% EBITDA margin, but management flags 3.5–4% of revenue commodity inflation in Q1 with only ~40% priced back and motorcycle industry growth guided down to 7–9% from ~20%.

calls.name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Industry growth FY27 Motor: higher single-digit
calls.thesis: Growth reaccelerated in H2 (GDPI +15.7%, Q4 +18.2%) but commercial lines share fell and Motor CR is elevated industry-wide; FY26 1/n combined ratio rose to 103.4% from 102.8%.

calls.name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: upper teens / mid-teens once regulated markets start (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Zim is a sub-scale, EU-GMP-constrained pharma exporter: FY26 revenue flat at INR 3,744m, EBITDA INR 414m, with regulated revenue gated by an unresolved May 2026 re-inspection and no capacity-discipline signal.

calls.name: MSTC Ltd
calls.gLine: E-commerce revenue growth: Double-digit growth attempted, no firm number
calls.thesis: MSTC is an e-auction platform pivoting from trading to e-commerce and new platforms; revenue hit a four-year high of INR359 crore, but no capacity or pricing metrics and management declined to quantify new revenue streams.
calls.top: EPR trading platform ready, awaiting go-ahead

calls.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue (ex FV gains and ESOP): INR 1,415 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager posts FY26 PAT of INR 386 crores (+28%) on AUM crossing INR 1 lakh crore; FY27 PAT guide of INR 460 crores implies about 19% growth, below the stated 20-25% range.

calls.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
calls.thesis: LIC's FY26 VNB rose 41.6% to ₹14,179 crore with margin up 360bp to 21.2%, but about 2.8pp of the gain came from one-off operating-assumption and economic changes, and the company is withholding payout-ratio guidance pending risk-based capital.

calls.name: Sugs Lloyd Ltd
calls.gLine: FPI share of revenue: around 10% in FY28
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up ~70% to INR300 crore with margins held near 14%, but receivables are stretched, Q4 carried 40% of sales, and the INR600+ crore order is 18-24 month execution with thin disclosure on capex and working capital.

calls.name: Meesho Ltd
calls.thesis: Meesho is an asset-light marketplace with no capacity to add; the read is margin repair from logistics normalisation (CM exit rate 4%) and ad monetisation, but LTM FCF and CFO remain negative with no guidance given.

calls.name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.gLine: TER / regulatory yield impact from 1 April: 3 to 4 bps gross impact, crystallised impact in two months
calls.thesis: Industry equity AUM fell 0.4% QoQ while ICICI Pru AMC equity AUM grew 2% QoQ to INR6.2tn, with Q4 PAT down 16.8% QoQ on mark-to-market losses and ESOP timing; no supply-side levers apply to an AMC.
calls.top: Equity AUM share up 2% QoQ vs industry down

calls.name: CSM Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue and margin direction FY27: upside qualitative, no numbers
calls.thesis: GovTech software firm with no capacity or pricing signals; FY26 revenue up 12% to Rs 226 cr, Q4 revenue down YoY to Rs 60 cr, DSO stretched 58 to 129 days, and order book Rs 357.63 cr is the only hard visibility.

calls.name: DCW Ltd
calls.gLine: Finance cost FY27: Rs50cr or sub-50cr
calls.thesis: C-PVC capacity doubled to 50kt and sold out, but realisations fell over 20% and PVC-C-PVC spread compressed, so FY26 EBITDA rose only 11% to Rs240cr and FY27 Rs400cr target was effectively abandoned.

calls.name: LMW Ltd
calls.gLine: Textile offtake: much larger offtake of machines expected
calls.thesis: Textile machinery order book rose to Rs 3,300 cr (all booked in Q4) with textile utilisation only 50-55%, while machine tool utilisation 70-75% and ATC order book flat near Rs 360 cr.

calls.name: Britannia Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic growth recovery: Expected normalisation in the quarter
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consol sales +7.1% to INR 4,686 cr with PAT +21% helped by tax case releases; domestic growth ~9-9.5% ex dual-pricing and West Asia, with price hikes and no capacity-discipline signal.
calls.top: Calibrated price increases from Q1 FY27

calls.name: EIH Ltd
calls.gLine: Owned-hotel capex: ₹600–700 cr per year for next one or two years (FY27–FY28)
calls.thesis: Hotel supply-light, ARR-led FY26 with EBITDA up only 3% and PAT hit by a ₹30 cr wage-code charge; Q4 occupancy fell to 67–69% on West Asia, while 825 owned keys arrive only from 2027–2030.

calls.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 profitability vs Q4: better than Q4 (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin rebounded to 18% from 11% on phenolics spreads (EBIT margin 20%), but nitric acid ran at ~45% utilisation and management guides only to Q1 beating Q4 with no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR1,400-1,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Bhopal licence suspension wiped out about half of volume; FY26 revenue fell 14.8% to INR1,233 crores and beer volume fell 20%, with FY27 guided at INR1,400-1,500 crores contingent on licence restoration.

calls.name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: ~5% maintained through next year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Copper recycler posted Q4 FY26 revenue ~735 cr, PAT ~18.5 cr and guides ~5% EBITDA margin with 20% volume growth, but capacity expansion is modest (~40 cr capex over 2 years) and no peer-capacity discipline is discussed.

calls.name: PI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: ETR: rise to 24% (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue ₹15,652m rose sequentially, FY26 ₹67,137m with 25% EBITDA; capex ₹1,100 crore and asset turns fell from ~2.5x to ~1.5x, but management gave no volume or margin guidance beyond "growth for sure".

calls.name: CSL Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 AUM growth: 15%-25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: CSL Finance's wholesale book grows but SME retail stalled: AUM up 21% to Rs 1,448 cr, yet SME share fell to 31% and Q4 disbursements dropped 16% QoQ to Rs 301 cr.

calls.name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 dispatch volume: around 7,000 MVA (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 dispatches ~6,000 MVA of 7,500 MVA capacity (79% utilisation on dispatches), Q4 margin hit by ~INR35-40 cr stranded Middle East exports and oil up ~100%; FY27 guide INR800-850 cr with price revisions unconfirmed.

calls.name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd
calls.gLine: Zetor tractor volume FY27: 1,000 units
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to INR1,240 crore with operational EBITDA margin up 220bp to 13.4%, but management declined to guide FY27 volume growth and flagged fuel/commodity inflation and monsoon risk.

calls.name: ICICI Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Opex growth vs top-line: opex growth below top-line growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PBT ex-treasury up 10.1% to ₹18,209 crore on provisions of just ₹96 crore (0.03% of advances), but guidance is only "range-bound" NIMs and no loan or deposit growth numbers; the provision drop is partly one-off recoveries.

calls.name: Cyient Ltd
calls.gLine: Semiconductor FY27 revenue: $100 million (FY27)
calls.thesis: DET Q4 revenue fell 2.4% QoQ in constant currency to $163.5M with normalised EBIT 12.4%; management reiterates FY27 mid-to-high single digit growth and 15% EBIT exit, but Strategic Units fell 12.4% QoQ and no capacity signals were given.

calls.name: Birlasoft Ltd
calls.thesis: IT services firm with no capacity lever: Q4 revenue flat QoQ in INR at INR 1,348.6 crore, FY26 revenue down 1.2%, and margin gains came from walking away from low-margin deals and one-offs, not demand.

calls.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Growth (medium term CAGR): 16% to 18% (FY27-FY31)
calls.thesis: Mahindra Finance Q4 PAT up 55% and FY26 ROA 2.0%, but a Rs 217 cr macro overlay (about 1.5% credit cost in Q4 vs 0.9% ex-overlay) and a 12% AUM growth cap the quality of the beat.

calls.name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
calls.thesis: QSR operator prioritising volume over margin: 5-7% SSSG and 230-250 store adds held, but management gave no margin timeline as energy, wage and commodity inflation hit, with Q4 LFL at 0.2%.

calls.name: Aurum PropTech Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: similar trajectory to ~40% YoY over next three years (qualitative, not formal) (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Asset-light PropTech with no capacity cycle: Q4 continuing revenue INR 123.85 cr (+10.2% QoQ) and distribution INR 66.87 cr, but continuing PBT only INR 1.85 cr and FY26 loss before tax INR 14.96 cr.

calls.name: The New India Assurance Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Motor premium growth FY27: single digit
calls.thesis: Insurer's FY26 combined ratio hit 122.57% on wage-revision charges (116.67% ex-wage), with motor TP and OD ICRs worsening; management guides motor to single-digit growth and better ratios, but commentary on pricing is competitive and unhedged on rate relief.

calls.name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 volume growth: close to higher end of 6% to 8% (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR122 crore (INR20,114/t vs INR21,715/t) on AMET volumes down 15% and RoW down 7%; management guides only Q1 volume at 6–8% high end and EBITDA/t INR19,000–21,000.

calls.name: Chalet Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Planned capex FY27-FY29: ~INR30 billion, funded through internal accruals (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q4 RevPAR fell 3% on a 7.7pt occupancy drop, mostly Mumbai and West Asia cancellations (~10-12% disruption per management); FY27-29 capex ~INR30bn guided, funded from accruals, with no supply discipline signal.

calls.name: Eternal Ltd
calls.gLine: Quick commerce NOV CAGR (three years): ~60% (3 years)
calls.thesis: Quick commerce is pursuing ~60% NOV CAGR over three years with no margin cushion disclosed; management keeps marketing spend high and says competition is not changing its stance, so supply and pricing discipline are unproven.
calls.top: Dark stores 3,000 by March; no FY27 store number

calls.name: Latent View Analytics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 organic revenue growth (high-visibility): 12% to 13% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tech vertical shrinkage of ~$6.5-7M in largest account is the core drag; management guides FY27 organic growth 12-13% high-visibility, 18-20% target, with AI and Databricks as offsets, but no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Azad Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Inventory days: ~200 days in H1 FY27, 160-170 days in H2 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Azad's FY26 revenue rose ~30% to INR590 cr with 36.9% EBITDA, but capacity is ramping from a low base: inventory is building, receivables sit at INR309 cr, and the 25%+ growth guide is held without new numbers.

calls.name: KP Green Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 40–50% YoY minimum (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹1,250cr (+78%) with utilisation only 30–34% and inventory days up to ~195 from ~96; growth and margin claims rest on an order book management says executes entirely in FY27.

calls.name: Bharti Hexacom Ltd
calls.gLine: Dividend per share FY26: Rs.18 per share (vs Rs.10)
calls.thesis: Hexacom Q4 FY26 shows steady telecom operating leverage (47.9% margin, 148k homes net adds) but ARPU is soft (Rs.252 reported, ~Rs.257-258 EDB) and capex is stepping up to Rs.586 Cr in the quarter.

calls.name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light corporate mobility grew trips 29% to 5.23m, but EBITDA margin fell to about 11.6% on ETS price competition and cost build; management guides 11-13% margin and 18-20% growth.

calls.name: One Mobikwik Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Merchant businesses EBITDA breakeven: by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA near break-even at -INR 52m after INR 55 crore merchant investment; management guides fixed costs up 15-20% and FY27 EBITDA margin ~5%, with merchant breakeven pushed to FY28.
calls.top: Gross take rate falling on mix

calls.name: Chembond Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Quarterly revenue: Rs100 cr+ in next four quarters (possible, seasonality) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Water-treatment chemicals volume up 50% H2 over H1 to 4,813 MT and Q4 revenue Rs101.4 cr, but management flags a ~3% margin hit from raw-material spikes and public-sector units refusing price changes.

calls.name: Chatterbox Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: No formal guidance; 'significantly larger' opportunity
calls.thesis: Influencer-marketing platform grew revenue 42.5% to INR84.22 cr in FY26 but PAT margin fell to 10.9%; no capacity or pricing data, no formal guidance, and the call was evasive on governance and merger questions.

calls.name: Fabtech Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: ~25% (management said 25–30%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Turnkey pharma/healthcare facility builder; margins compressing (contribution ~43.8% vs 45.9%) with receivables up to ₹204 cr and no capacity discipline data, so the cash-conversion story is unproven despite ~25% growth guidance.

calls.name: Highness Microelectronics Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR30-32 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Micro-cap display maker guides FY27 revenue INR30-32 crore and 35% EBITDA, but utilisation is about 20% and the stated capacity case rests on Goa capex with no prior guidance to test.

calls.name: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd
calls.gLine: PLA project cost: INR3,080 crore (from INR2,850 crore) (FY27)
calls.thesis: PLA project cost overrun of INR230 crore to INR3,080 crore plus INR450 crore equity raise at INR483 signals capital-cycle expansion with a gypsum by-product plant, not a supply-discipline story; commissioning guided Q3.
calls.top: PLA project cost up INR230 crore

calls.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: >28% (FY27)
calls.thesis: BEL guides FY27 revenue growth above 15% and EBITDA margin above 28%, with order inflow above INR55,000 crore, though QRSAM timing and a flat order book cloud visibility.
calls.top: FY27 order inflow above INR55,000 cr

calls.name: EID Parry India Ltd
calls.gLine: CPG EBITDA breakeven: breakeven within 6-8 quarters; single-digit EBITDA by end of decade
calls.thesis: Refinery (PSRIPL) shut after Q4 loss of Rs 293 cr; parent infused ~Rs 600 cr to clear loans by 30 June 2026, while Karnataka sugar stays the core profit engine and dividends remain unresolved.
calls.top: Refinery shut; loans cleared by June

calls.name: Ratnamani Metals & Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 sales: INR4,800-5,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone Q4 sales fell to INR893 cr from INR1,575 cr on muted orders and Middle East shipping disruption; management guides FY27 standalone INR4,800-5,000 cr assuming normalisation within a month.

calls.name: Mahindra EPC Irrigation Ltd
calls.thesis: Management reports record FY26 revenue of INR315.8 crores (+14.8%) and PBT of INR16.99 crores, but Q4 PBT fell to INR6.4 crores on a March PE pipe price spike and receivables are high at INR217 crores.
calls.top: Raw material prices spike in March

calls.name: TVS Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Double-digit growth (verbal, no range) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin expansion (EBITDA 5.96%, +413bp YoY) came from cost control while revenue grew only 2% YoY; management gave no numeric guidance, but EMS SMT lines run at 30-40% utilisation and CSS grew 13%.

calls.name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
calls.gLine: Tangible + intangible capex: around INR300 crores run rate (next 2 years)
calls.thesis: Strides FY26 revenue up 6.4% to INR48.6bn with ex-US up 21% and EBITDA margin 19%, but US weakened, cash-to-cash cycle lengthened 7 days on 21 days higher inventory, and US growth pushed to H2 FY27.

calls.name: Entertainment Network (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Gaana breakeven: FY27 breakeven, could be defining year
calls.thesis: Radio volume share held at 25.2% but non-FCT events fell in Q4 and Gaana quarterly growth slowed to roughly 10-15%; digital now 48% of radio revenue with breakeven targeted in FY27.

calls.name: Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at Rs 4,307 cr with EBITDA margin 13.4% and ~200bp cost-led improvement; no capacity signal, media losses of Rs 175 cr and a Rs 5/share dividend despite negative standalone EPS.

calls.name: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Kaveri built inventory 17% y/y on purpose, mgmt says prices may not rise in FY27 and revenue growth should be 15-20% on volume; channel and company inventories both high, a supply-side caution.

calls.name: ZEN Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Subsidiaries UTS+ARI revenue FY27: Rs365 Cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue flat QoQ at Rs178.1 Cr, down 45% YoY, with Rs1,336 Cr order book (~Rs1,000 Cr for FY27 execution) and management reiterating Rs4,000 Cr cumulative FY27–28 revenue; no order inflow number disclosed yet.

calls.name: PG Electroplast Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: better than industry revenue growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA fell 43% to INR131.5 crore on LPG and truck disruptions and ~250bp unrecovered gross-margin hit, while management guides FY27 growth and ~8% EBITDA margin without hard numbers.

calls.name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
calls.thesis: Exchange volumes ran hot in FY26 (ADT ~2.5x, revenue more than doubled to INR2,302 crores), but management gave no numeric guidance, declined April-May participation data and flagged cyclicality and rising expenses.

calls.name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Adjusted EBITDA margin: ~13% in H1 FY27 (12-13% floor) (H1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Fragrance maker guides adjusted EBITDA margin ~13% for H1 FY27 and FY27 capex of Rs 140 crore, but refuses full-year guidance amid raw-material inflation; Rs 350 crore capex plus Rs 80-85 crore annual dev-centre opex still not earning returns.

calls.name: Pricol Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt-equity: About 0.5 to 0.6 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,077.9 cr (EBITDA 13.29%) but management flags West Asia-driven input inflation and softer earnings ahead; FY27 capex INR 680-700 cr signals capacity expansion into a soft cycle.

calls.name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year FY27 credit cost: around 90 bps (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit ₹832 crores (+65% YoY) on NIM 5.96% and credit cost 0.6%, but management guides FY27 credit cost ~90bps, says Q4 ROA of 1.8% is not permanent, and flags cost of funds may have bottomed.
calls.top: Cost of funds may have bottomed

calls.name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic volume growth FY27: At least double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Domestic refractory volumes grew 20% in FY26 with margins squeezed (EBITDA 11.3% standalone, Q4 gross margin 43.1%); no supply discipline shown, Khurda greenfield still under evaluation, pricing pass-through unresolved.
calls.top: Accepting lean pricing in new accounts

calls.name: Bharat Parenterals Ltd
calls.gLine: Innoxel revenue growth FY27: 35% to 45% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone BPL revenue fell 23% to INR 234 cr with utilisation at 48%/21%/24%, so supply is loose; FY27 guide of 10-15% growth rests on a INR 171 cr order book and two pending audits.
calls.top: Standalone revenue down 23% to INR 234 cr

calls.name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Dividend payout: INR54 per share, 81% payout
calls.thesis: Asset manager with QAAUM up 20% to INR9.3tn and FY26 PAT up 16% to INR28.6bn; flows strong but TER/BER regulation trims distributor economics, with gross impact 3-4 bps on existing book.
calls.top: Gross TER impact 3-4 bps on existing book

calls.name: Borosil Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (medium term): 15% to 20% year-on-year (medium term)
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA flat at INR176.7 crores with margin down to 15.1%; Hydra supply disruption under BIS QCO and West Asia gas costs hit Q4 margin to 11.5%, with no volume recovery guided beyond muted growth for a year.

calls.name: UTI Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone employee cost run rate per quarter: Rs 90-95 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset manager with no capacity cycle; FY26 core PAT up only 3% to Rs 460 cr, equity net sales near zero, cost base growing 15% with growth-led guidance and flat-to-weak yield outlook.

calls.name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: Retail share of revenue: double digits FY27; 25-30% in 3-5 years (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: FY26 sales up only ~8% to INR7,728m with Q4 PAT boosted by a INR222m Apulki valuation gain; receivables still 139 days, Rajasthan guided conservatively at INR100-150 crore vs earlier INR250-300 crore.
calls.top: Rajasthan revenue cut to INR100-150 cr

calls.name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
calls.gLine: Market share recovery: Reasonably close to market growth momentum very soon
calls.thesis: Asset manager with flows still below market growth; Q4 equity yield fell 2-3 bps and PAT dropped to ₹187 crore on lower other income, while management claims flows are improving from a low base.

calls.name: Dev Information Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: around INR200 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 margin rose to 8.99% but FY26 EBITDA margin fell to about 3.7% on a ~5% revenue rise; management guides FY27 revenue of about INR200 crores with 15–20% growth, with no capex or capacity discussion.

calls.name: Aether Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 29% to 30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell QoQ to INR3,051m (from INR3,188m) on logistics slippage and a one-off Q3 claim, while management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 29-30%, capex INR3,000-3,500m and CRAMS/CEM rising toward 70% of sales.

calls.name: Macfos Ltd
calls.gLine: Own-brand (Robu 2.0) gross margin: about 10% above core gross margin
calls.thesis: Macfos (Robu.in), an online electronics distributor, reports FY26 revenue of about INR312 cr, up ~67% like-for-like, with no capacity or capex signal; debt funds inventory and margin is the key watch item.

calls.name: SBFC Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Opex reduction: 20 to 25 bps through the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: SBFC guides flat 5-7% quarterly growth and 5bp credit cost range, with spreads held at 9% and opex down 20-25bp; no capacity-discipline signal, but branch expansion is paused in weaker pockets.

calls.name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: approximately INR400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue fell 8% to INR947 crore as PI/API dropped 35% on customer destocking; PI inventory now normalising, but Q4 PI revenue was only INR2.4 crore and FY27 capex of about INR400 crore keeps the cycle investment-heavy.

calls.name: TBO TEK Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 GTV and GP vs Q4 and vs Q1 FY26: Better than Q4 and better than same period last year, not quantified (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA hit by March war washout (Rs 110 cr reported) while SG&A still grew 16%; management guides Q1 better than Q4 and YoY but gives no numbers, with cash conversion timing-driven and expected to recover by Q2.
calls.top: Q1 better than Q4 and YoY

calls.name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Aspirational double-digit, conservative (FY27)
calls.thesis: Stanley is a COCO-led furniture retailer with flat revenue since FY23, Q4 B2B pulled down by ~Rs 15 crore, and only a qualitative FY27 "double-digit aspiration"; supply discipline is weak as stores keep expanding.
calls.top: B2B pulled down ~Rs 15 crore in Q4

calls.name: Solarium Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 60% to ₹368 cr but PAT only ₹20.5 cr as gross margin fell to ~30% and finance cost rose to ₹10.5 cr; module plant running at ~45% utilisation with ALMM-II and captive-demand dependence unresolved.

calls.name: National Securities Depository Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Technology capex and opex: Broadly similar to FY26; next year capex to decline (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone PAT up 5% YoY in Q4 to INR79.7 crore on subdued capital markets; FY26 PAT INR360 crore (+12.1%), with market share on net account adds at 15.4% and Q4 net share slipping sequentially.

calls.name: Nirlon Ltd
calls.gLine: Final dividend FY26: Rs 15 per share
calls.thesis: Fully leased NKP park (99.7% occupancy) with contracted escalations; FY26 PAT +59% flattered by Rs 69.5 cr deferred-tax write-back, ex-item growth ~27%; management evasive on cash of ~Rs 278-287 cr parked in FDs and on the 5% debt amortisation.

calls.name: Foods & Inns Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: ~18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 volume grew only ~4% with realisations down ~25% on low-cost 2025 crop inventory; management guides ~18% FY27 volume growth but gives no EBITDA quantum, and a 45-day spray-dryer outage hit Q4.

calls.name: Duroply Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (volume 10–12% plus price): 9–12% p.a. for next two years (FY27–FY28)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 5% YoY to ₹111.6 cr with gross margin down to 34.3% from 37% in Q3; management guides 9–12% growth for two years but cites rising petrochemical and imported raw material costs and no capacity signals.

calls.name: Heritage Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA median target: ~9% median; 6.5%-7% bad year, 10%+ good year (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 4.5% as procurement rose 8% to INR 46.67/litre while milk volume growth was only about 1%; price hikes are muting volumes and no supply relief is yet visible on prices.

calls.name: Geojit Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Investment spend for next 3 years (IT): INR30 crores (3 years)
calls.thesis: Geojit is spending through a 20% sales-force expansion (about 650 sales hires, INR29 crore cost) and has paused field hiring, with FY26 profit hit by investment and brokerage income down while distribution rose; no numeric guidance given.

calls.name: Indoco Remedies Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt repayment: ~INR 140 cr per year for next 3 years, prepay a little more (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 25.8% YoY to INR 4,291 mn and standalone EBITDA margin 14.7%, but receivables up ~45% against ~9% revenue growth, debt near INR 960 cr, and capex tightly controlled.

calls.name: AIA Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Realisation per kg: INR165/kg for full year FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit lifted by one-off ~INR65 crore FX gain and mix; management guides ~INR165/kg realisation, utilisation ~55% with capacity expansion paused, and a single mine-trial win with no volume guidance.

calls.name: Tanla Platforms Ltd
calls.gLine: Market share growth: CPaaS industry growth 8-10%; Tanla share gain at more than 10% a year
calls.thesis: Tanla's CPaaS volumes grow faster than price in SMS, with OTT revenue share flat near 31-32%, and management offers no quantified guidance; margins described as range-bound with a ₹12 crore FX loss.

calls.name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 sales flat at INR590 crore and margin hit by ~2.5% commodity drag; management held Q4 orders selectively and cited customer-requested delivery deferrals of 10-12%, with FY26 orders up 27.4%.

calls.name: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 15-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Seed company with FY26 revenue INR 4,316m (+19%) and gross margin down to 56% from 63%; inventory build to INR 4,446m and FY27 guidance of 15-20% top-line growth, with no capacity expansion (capex mainly land and vehicles).

calls.name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
calls.gLine: Cayman insurance quarterly losses: losses to decline over next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 call: India margins up on case mix and high-end procedures, but UK acquisition dilutes consolidated margin (~20% reported, ~22% normalised) and greenfield capex delivered only INR 109 crore vs INR 424 crore plan.
calls.top: Greenfield capex INR 109 cr vs 424 cr plan

calls.name: S Chand and Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating revenue growth FY27: 10%-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: S Chand guides FY27 revenue growth 10-15% and EBITDA margin 17-19% (down from 18.1%), with receivables at 160 days and paper cost pressure of 10-15% limiting upside; capex is small at Rs20m.

calls.name: Orient Electric Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 10% to INR948 cr and EBITDA margin 8.2%, but gross margin fell to 31% on commodity inflation; calibrated price hikes (~6% in April) only partly offset costs and double-digit margin path is deferred.

calls.name: Sumitomo Chemical India Ltd
calls.gLine: Monsoon: IMD forecast 92% of LPA (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record FY26 profitability (PAT INR543 cr, up 7%) on 3% revenue growth; supply-side signals are mostly inventory build and a modest capex pipeline, with FY27 margins guided as cost-pass-through dependent and monsoon-exposed.
calls.top: Price hikes three times since March

calls.name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex budget FY27 (Clean Fino-Chem): INR 80-100 crore max
calls.thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 8% QoQ to INR193 cr on volume-led recovery, but FY26 standalone fell 12% to ~INR796 cr; MEHQ pricing under China pressure and new capacity still ramping (PC-1 utilisation ~10-15%).

calls.name: Gateway Distriparks Ltd
calls.gLine: Snowman capex FY27: ~INR50 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rail volumes stay subdued on West Asia disruption with no clarity on recovery; Q4 volume about 188,000 TEUs (96,000 rail, 91,000 CFS), double-stacking averaged 40%, and Snowman margins fell on start-up costs.

calls.name: Tracxn Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Tracxn Q4 FY26 shows revenue of ₹20.5 cr with EBITDA at -6.6 cr and near-breakeven PAT; the call is a demand-led pitch with no supply-side discipline, and mgmt concedes blended ASP is falling on mix.

calls.name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated capex: lower than FY26 (INR 187 cr); no number (FY27)
calls.thesis: Veefin is a fintech software company, not a capital-cycle story; standalone revenue ~INR 70.7 cr (+90%), but supply-side evidence is thin and management is pitching pipeline and PSB Xchange ramp rather than measurable throughput.
calls.top: FY27 capex to be lower than FY26

calls.name: Updater Services Ltd
calls.gLine: IFM growth: healthy high single-digit growth
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 3% to INR750 crores with FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin 5.9% after Avon provisions; management refused formal FY27 guidance and cited Athena and Matrix softness, with cash deployment undecided.

calls.name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Travel OTA with 39% contribution margin held flat YoY in Q4 (CM up 0.4%) as train volumes fell 8% and flights CM dipped 3%; management is prioritising market share and AI build-out over margin expansion.
calls.top: Train segments down 8% YoY in Q4

calls.name: Rajesh Power Services Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 closing order book: above INR 5,000 Cr
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 52% to ₹1,628 Cr with order book ₹3,326 Cr, but receivables jumped to ₹350 Cr, payables stretched to ~58 days, and the ₹2,200 Cr L1/bid book is still unawarded.

calls.name: Rikhav Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 brokerage growth: around 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Weak H2 FY26 with PAT of INR1.20 crore and EBITDA of INR6.57 crore after cash-market share losses of INR20-23 crore; management guides FY27 brokerage growth of about 20% and offers little new capacity-discipline evidence.
calls.top: Retail and HNI brokerage slack for six months

calls.name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income ratio: 40% to 50%
calls.thesis: Asset manager with 91% equity AUM; FY26 revenue up 17% to INR424.9 crore but SIP flows and AUM softer on mark-to-market, with no capacity or supply metrics applicable, and cost guidance vague.

calls.name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost to operate: Absolute increase in Q1 from appraisals, then stable for Groww platform
calls.thesis: Groww Q4 FY26 call is a retail broking platform update with no supply-side capital-cycle content; management guided margin expansion only if revenue grows above 15%, and gave no numeric guidance.

calls.name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: ~INR 1,300 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA fell to INR 274 crores from 327 crores on soda ash price weakness, with a INR 1,837 crore US goodwill impairment; supply exits are real but early, and China inventory sits near 1.8 million tons.

calls.name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd
calls.thesis: Chola MS general insurance: combined ratio rose to 115.2% (112.2% ex-1/n) on motor OD and TP reserving, with ROE guidance softened to a medium-to-long-term 15%+ and no numeric combined-ratio guide.

calls.name: Avanti Feeds Ltd
calls.gLine: Feed sales FY27: ~580,000 MT (FY27)
calls.thesis: Feed PBT fell to ₹139 cr in Q4 (from ₹172 cr QoQ) as fish meal jumped to ₹130/kg from ₹117; management is pursuing price hikes but has not quantified them, and FY27 feed volume guided ~5.8 lakh MT.

calls.name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 volumes: fair to assume normal volumes
calls.thesis: Basmati rice exporter built inventory at low paddy prices; rice prices up ~30% since Nov-Dec, but no hard numbers on margins, volumes, or Q1 spillover, and Q4 export volume fell ~9% QoQ to 44,500 MT from 48,900 MT.

calls.name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT fell 3.6% YoY to ₹80.1 cr on margin squeeze; management guides FY27 revenue growth 15-20% and inflows ~₹8,000 cr, but has no capacity discipline signal and capex is rising.

calls.name: LTM Ltd
calls.gLine: Five-year revenue: Double revenue in five years (~15% CAGR)
calls.thesis: IT services read: Q4 USD revenue +1.2% QoQ and 8.1% YoY, but no numeric FY27 guidance and margin fell 100bp QoQ to 15.1% on wage hikes; supply signals are absent, so this is a demand-and-pricing story with hedged tone.
calls.top: Randstad tech unit acquired at €160m EV

calls.name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
calls.gLine: Electricity volume growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes hit a record 39.4 BU (+24.3% YoY) and FY26 profit rose 14.9%, but DAM prices fell 12.2% YoY to INR 3.89/unit and market coupling is a live threat to the exchange's price-discovery role.

calls.name: Route Mobile Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid to high single digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Route Mobile's FY26 revenue fell 3.7% to ₹4,408 crore while gross margin rose to 22.9% as low-margin ILD exited; FY27 guide of mid-to-high single-digit growth and ~12% EBITDA margin shows no supply-side signal.

calls.name: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: ~INR200 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up ~33% YoY on volume, but copper pass-through lag (3–6 months) compresses margins; greenfield plants ramping unevenly with Pune at ~40–50% utilisation; FY27 capex ~INR200 crores, demand-linked.

calls.name: Concord Control Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Fusion Electronics revenue: about INR 200 crore at full scale (full scale)
calls.thesis: Concord reports FY26 revenue INR 210.47 crore, EBITDA INR 62.1 crore and a INR 697 crore order book (3.3x revenue), but receivables and short-term debt rose sharply and management gave no capacity, utilisation or cash-conversion numbers.
calls.top: Receivables up sharply, no cash conversion

calls.name: Sealmatic India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up only 2% to INR103 cr while EBITDA margin fell to 17.4% from 24%, as ~INR8 cr was spent selling API seals below raw-material cost; operating cash flow negative and inventory ~INR62 cr with commissioning deferred 6–9 months.
calls.top: Inventory rose to about INR 62 crores
themes: Middle East oil & gas API seals

calls.name: Mamata Machinery Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~15% above FY26 (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue fell 8% to Rs 233.1 cr on a ~50% US collapse; management calls it one-time, targets ~15% FY27 top-line growth and ~20% margin recovery, with order book up 34% to Rs 89.59 cr.

calls.name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: maintain momentum of last 2-3 years; margin expansion expected (FY27)
calls.thesis: Maiden call with no hard supply data; FY26 revenue +17.8% to INR382.63 cr and EBITDA margin 13.83%, but blended utilisation only ~30% with management guiding just 35-40% and no capex plan disclosed.

calls.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue, margins, cash flow, balance sheet: better than FY26 on all parameters, no numbers
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up only 4% to about INR1,800 crore after a March PVC/PE price shock; management claims ~INR200-250 crore lost, ~INR133 crore adjusted PAT, and debt repayment hinges on government receivables and a Tamil Nadu land sale still unclosed.

calls.name: BASF India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 12-15% YoY but FY26 PBT pressured by input costs and mix; working capital up ~600-800 crore, FCF negative (~-300 crore), capex ~200 crore with Celesto and Dispersion Line 3 adding capacity.

calls.name: Ion Exchange India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin collapsed to 2.31% on West Asia logistics, input costs and Roha depreciation; chemicals segment EBIT margin fell ~10pts while Roha capacity was fully commissioned with no FY27 guidance.

calls.name: WSFx Global Pay Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 leisure market: Expect next one or two months to be a little challenging
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue up 26% to ~INR111 crore and PAT up 77% to INR6.14 crore, but management flags Q1 FY27 leisure contraction of ~25% and a 0.6-0.8% net margin under pressure from new AD-II competition.

calls.name: Patel Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR 5,102 crore with 13.4% EBITDA margin; FY27 guided +10% and order target INR 8,000 crore, but tender success was only ~12-13% last year and promoter pledge and asset sales remain the core story.

calls.name: Tips Music Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 content spend: INR80-90 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue up 32% YoY to INR103.9 cr and PAT up 93%, but management attributed it to a repertoire surge with no one-offs; FY27 target is 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line, with content spend guided to INR80–90 cr.

calls.name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit cost: moderate further in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Credit cards: credit cost falling (7.7% gross, down 55bps QoQ) and GNPA 2.41%, but receivables growth only 2% YoY, revolver on downward bias, and cost-to-income guided 55-58%.

calls.name: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR 150-200 crore per year (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Q4 volumes up 20% YoY to 1.17 lakh t and FY26 at 4.58 lakh t (+33%), but gas cuts to 35% in March and a 50%+ blended gas escalation weigh on Q1 FY27 EBITDA/t; capex capped at INR 150-200 crore.

calls.name: Takyon Networks Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Meaningfully higher than FY26; ~15% above FY25 level (FY27)
calls.thesis: H2 FY26 revenue fell to Rs 28.97 cr with EBITDA margin 5.3% as management deliberately deferred loss-making fixed-price contracts amid component inflation; FY27 guided to 15-20% growth on a 32 cr order book, margin 11-13%.

calls.name: Seshaasai Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: IoT growth FY27: above 47% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 revenue INR 404 cr (+9.6% YoY) with EBITDA margin 30.8%, but FY26 revenue fell 1.5% and management declined to guide FY27 until Q1; capacity is being built ahead of demand.

calls.name: ACC Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost per tonne reduction FY27: Rs250/t minimum, Rs4,250/t target
calls.thesis: ACC's combined Ambuja-group call reset FY27 volume to ~80 Mt (+8%) and capex to Rs6,000-6,500 cr, with cost peaking at Rs4,500/t in March and a Rs250/t cut targeted, but no price recovery yet.

calls.name: JSW Dulux Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth: double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Volume up 23% but revenue only 6.2% on price cuts and mix; price hikes of ~9.7% against ~13.5% raw-material pass-through need, with 3-4% still to take and margins at risk.

calls.name: Himatsingka Seide Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt: approx INR2,000 crores (within next 12 months)
calls.thesis: Home textile maker pivoting to yarn, fabric and apparel using existing capacity with no new capex; utilisation weak (sheeting 56%, terry 63%) and Middle East shipment delays persist into Q1 FY27.

calls.name: Blue Dart Express Ltd
calls.thesis: Blue Dart Q4 FY26 PBT before exceptional fell about 17% on ~8% revenue growth, with tonnage up only 4.6% and margins under pressure; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance.

calls.name: Subex Ltd
calls.thesis: Subex Q4FY26 revenue rose only 3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr with no numeric FY27 guidance; management leans on 24% order intake growth and a Middle East exposure it calls manageable.
calls.top: Q4 revenue +3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr

calls.name: Music Broadcast Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to INR 40.8 cr from INR 54 cr (down ~24%) with flat volumes and cost cuts driving EBITDA to INR 6.1 cr, but reported PAT was a loss; no supply-side discipline discussed.

calls.name: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd
calls.gLine: Growth from current infrastructure: 35-40%
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue of about INR 69 crore missed the INR 85 crore expectation as LPG cuts and a 20-25% raw-material spike hit output, though management still guides 25-30% growth if conditions normalise.

calls.name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd
calls.gLine: Mahad incremental revenue at current capacity: INR 50 crore; INR 60-65 crore at optimum utilisation (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 6.6% from 10.06% on a triple input-cost shock, Chinese oversupply and Mahad drag; management guides only to a return to ~10% and gives no FY27 revenue number.

calls.name: Electrosteel Castings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 pipe dispatch: ~7.4 lakh tons (pipes only) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Ductile iron pipe demand has collapsed as JJM funds froze: Q4 volume down 21% YoY to 1.48 lakh t, FY26 down 25%, with management guiding FY27 dispatch to ~7.4 lakh t pipes and 13-14% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Whirlpool of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-run revenue growth: early double-digit CAGR ambition (long term)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up ~7-9% and March 2026 a record shipment month, but PBT margin hit by e-waste and energy-upcharge costs not yet priced through; management gives no margin guidance and points to a harder FY27.
calls.top: Energy upcharge not yet priced through

calls.name: Havells India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes soft on channel destocking and mild summer; cables volume +6% with 14% value growth on price, but no FY27 guidance and management refused to quantify outlook.

calls.name: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: more than 10% (FY2026-27)
calls.thesis: IT services read with no capacity signal; Q4 margin 9.8% and FY26 revenue up ~11%, but US receivables slowing and management attributes US softness to the war and AI deal delays.

calls.name: Shakti Pumps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Pump capacity expansion: from Q2FY27
calls.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 2,698 cr but EBITDA margin fell to ~16% (management cites ~10% in Q4) and receivables are still INR 1,276 cr; no FY27 numbers given.

calls.name: Apollo Pipes Ltd
calls.gLine: Q1 FY27 revenue: INR400 crore+ (Q1 FY27)
calls.thesis: Apollo Pipes guides Q1 FY27 revenue to INR400 crore+ (Q4 about INR350 crore) and 35% CAGR, but Q4 gross margin fell despite 13-14% realisation rise on aggressive pricing and inventory write-downs; channel inventory reported low.
calls.top: Q4 gross margin fell despite realisation up 13-14%

calls.name: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue grew 20.2% to INR 1,411 cr with Q4 missed on Middle East and hyperscaler timing; management refuses FY27 growth number while front-loading INR 150-200 cr of development spend and INR 200-250 cr working capital.

calls.name: Power Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Loan book growth FY27: around 10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: PFC is a lender, not a capacity operator: FY26 loan book grew only 7% as prepayments hit, FY27 loan growth guided ~10% and spread cut to 2.40–2.50%, while sanctions of INR 2.85 lakh crore sit mostly undisbursed.

calls.name: VTM Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth FY27: 12-14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 PAT fell about 75% to Rs 11 crore as US tariff discounts (~18% on US home-textile sales, ~Rs 20 crore) and cotton inflation squeezed margins; FY27 guide is 12-14% top-line growth and 10-11% EBITDA margin against 7.43% in FY26.

calls.name: Maan Aluminium Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume FY27: 7,000-7,500 tonnes (analyst figure, flattish year) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity raised to 24,000 tpa but utilisation is lagging; FY26 PBT fell 18% to INR18 crore, FY27 expected flat with INR7-10 crore ramp costs and margin recovery pushed out about two years.

calls.name: Mallcom (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10-12% minimum (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell 185bp YoY to 9.34% on raw-material costs and export price concessions; management targets 10-12% growth and a return to pre-investment margins, but gives no numbers for margin recovery.

calls.name: GTPL Hathway Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex per annum: ~INR350 crore for FY27-FY29 (FY27-FY29)
calls.thesis: Cable/broadband operator posted a Q4 loss on one-offs, subscriber growth stalled, and management guides capex to ~INR350 crore a year with no near-term reduction, so supply is expanding into a flat base.
calls.top: Capex ~INR350 cr/yr, no cut for 3 yrs

calls.name: Aztec Fluids & Machinery Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue grew 9.2% to 96.53 crore with EBITDA margin 14.3% and PAT 7.41 crore; management walked back double-digit growth and is planning undisclosed capex funded by accruals, debt and possibly equity.

calls.name: Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants Ltd
calls.gLine: INR130 cr Northern Railway order execution: 25% to 30% executed in current year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order book ~INR615-750 cr and FY26 revenue +11.4% to INR171.7 cr, but H2 revenue fell to INR99.8 cr from INR115.9 cr, with receivables ~INR55 cr and no quantified guidance.
calls.top: Receivables ~INR55 cr; operating cash flow negative

calls.name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd
calls.thesis: Q4 ad revenue fell 4% YoY on a March Middle East slump, adjusted margin 6.9% and a INR4,084m one-off amortisation and impairment hit; no supply discipline signal, cost cuts are the main lever.

calls.name: Mastek Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: better than FY26, no number (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mastek Q4 FY26 was stable: revenue up 3.6% QoQ in INR, EBITDA 16.1%, 12-month backlog $300.4M (+13.5% YoY USD), but management gave no numeric FY27 growth guidance and flagged heavy renewal price cuts.

calls.name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: Tax rate FY27: 25% to 26%
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin fell ~400bp to 45.2% on crude-linked input inflation and lower realisations; management gave no FY27 margin guide and flagged near-term pressure, with only ~4% price hikes taken in March.

calls.name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000-10,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell 7% to INR168 crores on cost pressure and ECL provisions; management guides FY27 revenue up 20% and EBITDA margin 9.5-10.5%, with a working-capital stretch it expects to unwind after September.

calls.name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 total capex: INR3,200-3,400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Dalmia Bharat (cement) posted record Q4 EBITDA of Rs 902 crore and FY26 EBITDA Rs 3,083 crore, but West Asia cost shock of Rs 125-150/ton hits Q1 and FY27 capex is Rs 3,200-3,400 crore with no new capacity announced.
calls.top: Industry adds 110-120 Mt over two years

calls.name: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 15-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA margin fell to 5.83% (from 10.36% in Q3) on onerous contracts and JV reconciliation; management guides FY27 revenue up 15-20% with margin recovery, but Q1 expected to be challenging.

calls.name: Cyient DLM Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: Growth expected YoY in all four quarters; no numeric guidance
calls.thesis: FY26 revenue fell 17% to INR12,615m while order book hit a record INR24,166m (book-to-bill 1.5x); management gave no FY27 revenue number, only directional growth.
calls.top: Order book INR24,166m, highest in 10 quarters

calls.name: Yatra Online Ltd
calls.gLine: ROCE: high teens in 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Yatra's Q4 FY26 was hit by West Asia conflict: EBITDA fell 46% YoY to INR 126m as MICE bookings were cancelled or deferred, though FY26 adjusted EBITDA grew 37.5% to INR 917m and management says Q1 run-rate is about 20% above Q4.
calls.top: Q4 MICE bookings cancelled or deferred

calls.name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Shipway revenue growth: double digits, faster than Uniware (FY27)
calls.thesis: Software/SaaS for e-commerce ops: FY26 revenue +51.6% to INR204.3cr but Q4 standalone growth only 11.7% and management guides lower EBITDA for two quarters on investment, with no FY27 growth number given.
calls.top: Near-term EBITDA/PAT to fall on investment

calls.name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: recover toward ~7% (FY27 onward)
calls.thesis: Western Carriers is a rail-based logistics operator, not a cables maker, so subsector is a poor fit; Q4 EXIM containers fell 3.2% YoY and 11% QoQ, EBITDA margin slipped to 5%, and management gave no numbers but promised sequential improvement.
calls.top: Debtors above INR600 cr; days target <120

calls.name: Schaeffler India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book growth exports: minimum 10% (CY2026)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 18.8% YoY to INR 2,507 cr but down 5.1% QoQ; Industrial bearings weak on "recalibration" and price competition, while capex is being moderated and inventory built up.

calls.name: Gillette India Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 sales up 8% to ₹3,100 crore and PAT up 23% to ~₹650 crore, but management admits near-term challenges and gives no numeric FY27 guidance; supply-side signals are thin.

calls.name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 execution: not quantified; order book 2.8 GW executed over 12-15 months
calls.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR1,102 cr (+131% YoY) and FY26 execution of 2,727 MWp, but order book fell to 2.83 GW and management gave no numeric guidance, with margin defended only by a 'around 15%' threshold.
calls.top: Order inflow ~2.3 GW vs 2.4 GW prior year

calls.name: Newgen Software Technologies Ltd

calls.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd

calls.name: Praj Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Quarterly order inflow steady-state: Rs 800-900 crore band (FY27)

calls.name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
calls.thesis: Life insurer grew VNB 10.9% to ₹26.29bn with margin up 190bp to 24.7%, but APE grew only 2.2% and RoEV fell to 11.9% on negative persistency and assumption changes; growth guidance withheld.

calls.name: Concord Biotech Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: slightly better than historical ~18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: FY26 API revenue fell 12% to INR 829 crore with utilisation uneven (Unit 2 at 30%, Unit 3 at 53%); management attributes it to timing and geopolitics, but gives no numeric FY27 guidance beyond "slightly better" than ~18% historical growth.

calls.name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
calls.gLine: Store count FY27: ~20 openings and ~20 closures; flat store count (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mufti (Credo Brands) is a store-count-flat, throughput-led year: FY27 guided to ~20 openings and ~20 closures, mid-single-digit same-store growth at best, and EBITDA margin seen at 23–24% on higher ad spend.

calls.name: Glottis Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue / volume outlook FY27: No numeric guidance; management 'very positive' on FY27
calls.thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder with FY26 revenue down on softer freight rates and volumes (89,098 TEUs), margins thin at 5.2% PAT, and receivables up about 70% from extended credit days, a weak-quality signal.

calls.name: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR1,500-1,700 crore
calls.thesis: Capacity additions hit a record 64 Mt in FY26 with utilisation near 69%, and management expects Q1 FY27 cost pressure of INR100-130/t with only partial price recovery, so margins face a near-term squeeze.

calls.name: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Ltd
calls.thesis: FY26 sales flat at about Rs 4,300 crore while PAT rose 19% to about Rs 850 crore on savings; management gave no numeric growth guidance and faced repeated questions on stalled top line.

calls.name: WPIL Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated Q4 revenue fell 11% to INR511 crore while standalone project revenue collapsed to INR92 crore from INR253 crore; FY26 order book ~INR6,000 crore largely from a South African win, with JJM receivables stuck (~INR350 crore overdue).

calls.name: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty chemical utilisation FY27: better than FY25-26 (no number) (FY27)

calls.name: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd

calls.name: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ROA compression: ~10 bps

calls.name: Concord Enviro Systems Ltd

calls.name: NCC Ltd

calls.name: Marathon Nextgen Realty Ltd

calls.name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY27 disbursement: close to INR3,000 crores

calls.name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd

calls.name: Linc Ltd

calls.name: HCL Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth (cc): 1% to 4% (FY27)

calls.name: Allied Digital Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% YoY (FY27)

calls.name: Religare Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Care combined ratio: near 100% in 2 years

calls.name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd

calls.name: Emerald Finance Ltd

calls.name: IDFC First Bank Ltd

calls.name: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Ltd

calls.name: Infobeans Technologies Ltd

calls.name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd

firstTimers.name: Triveni Power Transmission Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Order book up 57% YoY to ₹626 crores and H1 capex largely complete, but Q2 product revenue fell on timing and management refuses to quantify guidance or utilisation; EBITDA margin 36.1%.

firstTimers.name: Runwal Enterprises Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “We are pleased to host the maiden Earnings Conference Call of Runwal Enterprises Limited following its listing on the stock exchanges”
firstTimers.thesis: Mumbai residential developer, Q1 FY27 revenue fell to ~Rs 3,400m from Rs 4,462m on OC-based recognition, while management guides 20-25% pre-sales growth and debt cut to ~Rs 1,900m external post-IPO.

firstTimers.name: Deepa Jewellers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Page 2 of 17 Dev Agarwal: Good evening and warm welcome to all of you to Deepa Jewellers Limited's First Ever Earnings Conference Call”
firstTimers.thesis: B2B gold jewellery maiden call: Q2 revenue +25% YoY to Rs 626 cr but EBITDA margin 7.24% on SKU-mix dip; management guides 40-45% CAGR and +80-120 bps margin, with little supply-side capex discipline evidence and heavy promoter-driven claims.

firstTimers.name: Poojaa Precision Engg. Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “It is my pleasure to welcome you all to the maiden earnings conference call of Poojaa Precision Engineering Limited”
firstTimers.thesis: Maiden call from a small aluminium precision caster: H1 FY27 revenue INR210 crore (+68%) and EBITDA margin 19%, with 82% utilisation and a new plant that doubles capacity, but guidance is aspirational and unaudited by numbers.

firstTimers.name: Varmora Granito Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “First of all, because this is our first earnings call, I would like to give a brief introduction about the company”
firstTimers.thesis: Morbi tile maker's Q2 utilisation jumped to 89% (Q1 63%) as ~10-11 PVT/ceramic plants shut and no net capacity added in H1, but management is pricing-led and the export/freight recovery is unproven.

firstTimers.name: Swastika Infra Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “It gives me great pleasure to welcome all of you to the maiden analyst call of Swastika Infra Limited”
firstTimers.thesis: Q2 revenue up 42% to INR188 cr but H1 only up 5% after a weak Q1; order book INR1,420 cr (2.8x FY26 revenue) with management guiding FY27 growth only in line with FY26 and margins normalising to ~14%.

firstTimers.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

firstTimers.name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.

firstTimers.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.

firstTimers.name: Steamhouse India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

firstTimers.name: Karamtara Engineering Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “My name is Rajiv Singh, and a very warm welcome to the first earnings conference call of Karamtara Engineering Limited as a listed company”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,581 crore (+72% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~11% with ramping new capacity; management guides FY27 revenue growth of 60-65% but gives no FY28 number, and capacity utilisation is still low.

firstTimers.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

firstTimers.name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR90.3 cr (20.8% margin) was flattered by ~INR25 cr inventory gain in a price spike; management guides FY27 adjusted EBITDA INR240-250 cr ex-gain, with Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 cr adding ~60,000 t.

firstTimers.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.

firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

firstTimers.name: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd

firstTimers.name: Novartis India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call

firstTimers.name: Kusumgar Ltd

firstTimers.name: Advit Jewels Ltd

firstTimers.name: Accord Transformer & Switchgear Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: FY26 revenue fell YoY (H2 INR42.6 cr) on customer-side site delays; management guides FY27 revenue INR120–180 cr and EBITDA margin 13–15%, but capacity utilisation is only 75–80% and no supply-side discipline is visible.

firstTimers.name: Tipco Engineering India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Tipco's FY26 revenue rose about 10% to INR146 crore with H2 up 66% and EBITDA margin 26.6%, but a debtor-days jump (72 to 169) and a Pune capex plan of INR60 crore offset the supply-side read.

firstTimers.name: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with no supply-side disclosure; FY26 revenue INR46.2 cr (+15.8%) but PAT fell ~43% and operating cash flow negative, with pipeline claims unquantified by capacity or cost discipline.

firstTimers.name: SK Minerals & Additives Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: FY26 revenue Rs 318 cr (+50%) with EBITDA margin ~10%, but H2 margins fell on raw-material inflation; manufacturing only 23% of revenue and the new polymer plant is still in teething trials.

firstTimers.name: Novus Loyalty Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “As this marks the company's first earnings call following its listing, today's interaction is an important milestone in its journey toward building long -term value and strengthening engagement with the investor community”
firstTimers.thesis: Loyalty platform FY26 revenue ~127 Cr (+22%), EBITDA margin 9.68%, PAT margin 7.29%; management gives no numeric FY27 guidance beyond international revenue doubling and 15-20% India growth, with a thin, promotional Q&A.

firstTimers.name: Kiaasa Retail Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Kiaasa is a small SME-listed ethnic-wear EBO roll-out story with FY26 revenue of Rs134.63 cr and EBITDA margin of 17.8%, but no supply-side evidence (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a 35% revenue CAGR vision to FY30 that management did not tie to capex.

firstTimers.name: Star Imaging And Path Lab Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Diagnostics operator with revenue up only 6% to INR88.5 crore in FY26 after guiding 30-35%; FY27 growth now guided at 25-30% with capex of INR20-25 crore and no new debt, but execution delays undercut credibility.

firstTimers.name: Workmates Core2Cloud Solution Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Cloud/AI services firm guides FY27 revenue to INR 210 cr (+45%) with INR 190 cr visibility, but FY26 margins fell (EBITDA 16.2% vs 17.7%) and no supply-side capacity data is given.

firstTimers.name: Om Power Transmission Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Good evening and thank yo u for taking the time out to join us in the maiden Earnings Conference Call of Om Power T ransmission Limited”
firstTimers.thesis: Maiden call of a T&D EPC: FY26 revenue INR 449 crore (+61%), order book INR 621 crore (book-to-bill 1.38x), EBITDA margin steady at 12.7%, with management guiding 50% growth in FY27 and 12-13% EBITDA margin.

firstTimers.name: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Flex-workspace operator guiding to ~10 lakh sq ft operational by FY27 end (from ~3.5 lakh), but gave no revenue numbers, and fixed assets up 160% with debt-funded expansion and thin disclosure quality.

firstTimers.name: Creative Newtech Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Creative Newtech is a market-entry distributor with a rising brand mix; Q4 margins flattered by Make-in-India mix, while receivables jumped to ~20% of turnover and Middle East freight shock threatens brand sales.
